:= by
  rw [last_eraseLast, last]
  have := s.step ⟨s.length - 1, by lia⟩
  simp only [Fin.castSucc_mk, Fin.succ_mk, mem_ofPred_eq] at this
  convert! this using 3
  exact (tsub_add_cancel_of_le h).symm

name: eq_snoc_eraseLast
statement:
theorem eq_snoc_eraseLast {s : CompositionSeries X} (h : 0 < s.length) :
    s = snoc (eraseLast s) s.last (isMaximal_eraseLast_last h)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_snoc, mem_eraseLast h, ne_eq]
  by_cases h : x = s.last <;> simp [*, s.last_mem]

name: snoc_eraseLast_last
statement:
@[simp]
theorem snoc_eraseLast_last {s : CompositionSeries X} (h : IsMaximal s.eraseLast.last s.last) :
    s.eraseLast.snoc s.last h = s
proof:
:=
  have h : 0 < s.length :=
    Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun hs => ne_of_gt (lt_of_isMaximal h) <| by simp [last, Fin.ext_iff, hs])
  (eq_snoc_eraseLast h).symm

name: refl
statement:
@[refl]
theorem refl (s : CompositionSeries X) : Equivalent s s

name: symm
statement:
@[symm]
theorem symm {s₁ s₂ : CompositionSeries X} (h : Equivalent s₁ s₂) : Equivalent s₂ s₁
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.choose.symm, fun i => iso_symm (by simpa using h.choose_spec (h.choose.symm i))⟩

name: trans
statement:
@[trans]
theorem trans {s₁ s₂ s₃ : CompositionSeries X} (h₁ : Equivalent s₁ s₂) (h₂ : Equivalent s₂ s₃) :
    Equivalent s₁ s₃
proof:
:=
  ⟨h₁.choose.trans h₂.choose,
    fun i => iso_trans (h₁.choose_spec i) (h₂.choose_spec (h₁.choose i))⟩

name: smash
statement:
protected theorem smash {s₁ s₂ t₁ t₂ : CompositionSeries X}
    (hs : s₁.last = s₂.head) (ht : t₁.last = t₂.head)
    (h₁ : Equivalent s₁ t₁) (h₂ : Equivalent s₂ t₂) :
    Equivalent (smash s₁ s₂ hs) (smash t₁ t₂ ht)
proof:
:=
  let e : Fin (s₁.length + s₂.length) ≃ Fin (t₁.length + t₂.length) :=
    calc
      Fin (s₁.length + s₂.length) ≃ (Fin s₁.length) ⊕ (Fin s₂.length) := finSumFinEquiv.symm
      _ ≃ (Fin t₁.length) ⊕ (Fin t₂.length) := Equiv.sumCongr h₁.choose h₂.choose
      _ ≃ Fin (t₁.length + t₂.length) := finSumFinEquiv
  ⟨e, by
    intro i
    refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ i
    · intro i
      simpa [e, smash_castAdd, smash_succ_castAdd] using h₁.choose_spec i
    · intro i
      simpa [e, -Fin.castSucc_natAdd, smash_natAdd, smash_succ_natAdd] using h₂.choose_spec i⟩

name: snoc
statement:
protected theorem snoc {s₁ s₂ : CompositionSeries X} {x₁ x₂ : X} {hsat₁ : IsMaximal s₁.last x₁}
    {hsat₂ : IsMaximal s₂.last x₂} (hequiv : Equivalent s₁ s₂)
    (hlast : Iso (s₁.last, x₁) (s₂.last,
      x₂)) : Equivalent (s₁.snoc x₁ hsat₁) (s₂.snoc x₂ hsat₂)
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin s₁.length.succ ≃ Fin s₂.length.succ :=
    calc
      Fin (s₁.length + 1) ≃ Option (Fin s₁.length) := finSuccEquivLast
      _ ≃ Option (Fin s₂.length) := Functor.mapEquiv Option hequiv.choose
      _ ≃ Fin (s₂.length + 1) := finSuccEquivLast.symm
  have he_last : e (Fin.last s₁.length) = Fin.last s₂.length := by
    simp [e, finSuccEquivLast_last, Functor.mapEquiv_apply]
  have he_castSucc (j : Fin s₁.length) :
      e j.castSucc = (hequiv.choose j).castSucc := by
    simp [e, finSuccEquivLast_castSucc, Functor.mapEquiv_apply]
  refine ⟨e, fun i => ?_⟩
  refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ i
  · change Iso ((snoc s₁ x₁ hsat₁).toFun (Fin.last s₁.length).castSucc,
        (snoc s₁ x₁ hsat₁).toFun (Fin.last s₁.length).succ)
      ((snoc s₂ x₂ hsat₂).toFun (e (Fin.last s₁.length)).castSucc,
        (snoc s₂ x₂ hsat₂).toFun (e (Fin.last s₁.length)).succ)
    rw [he_last]
    simpa [apply_last] using hlast
  · intro i
    change Iso ((snoc s₁ x₁ hsat₁).toFun i.castSucc.castSucc,
        (snoc s₁ x₁ hsat₁).toFun i.castSucc.succ)
      ((snoc s₂ x₂ hsat₂).toFun (e i.castSucc).castSucc,
        (snoc s₂ x₂ hsat₂).toFun (e i.castSucc).succ)
    rw [he_castSucc]
    simpa [snoc_castSucc, ← Fin.castSucc_succ] using hequiv.choose_spec i

name: length_eq
statement: theorem length_eq {s₁ s₂ : CompositionSeries X} (h : Equivalent s₁ s₂) : s₁.length = s₂.length

name: snoc_snoc_swap
proof:
:=
  let e : Fin (s.length + 1 + 1) ≃ Fin (s.length + 1 + 1) :=
    Equiv.swap (Fin.last _) (Fin.castSucc (Fin.last _))
  have h1 : ∀ {i : Fin s.length},
      (Fin.castSucc (Fin.castSucc i)) ≠ (Fin.castSucc (Fin.last _)) := by simp
  have h2 : ∀ {i : Fin s.length}, (Fin.castSucc (Fin.castSucc i)) ≠ Fin.last _ := by simp
  ⟨e, by
    intro i
    dsimp only [e]
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
    · erw [Equiv.swap_apply_left, snoc_castSucc,
      show (snoc s x₁ hsat₁).toFun (Fin.last _) = x₁ from last_snoc _ _ _, Fin.succ_last,
      show ((s.snoc x₁ hsat₁).snoc y₁ hsaty₁).toFun (Fin.last _) = y₁ from last_snoc _ _ _,
      snoc_castSucc, snoc_castSucc, Fin.succ_castSucc, snoc_castSucc, Fin.succ_last,
      show (s.snoc _ hsat₂).toFun (Fin.last _) = x₂ from last_snoc _ _ _]
      exact hr₂
    · refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
      · erw [Equiv.swap_apply_right, snoc_castSucc, snoc_castSucc, snoc_castSucc,
          Fin.succ_castSucc, snoc_castSucc, Fin.succ_last, last_snoc', last_snoc', last_snoc']
        exact hr₁
      · erw [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne h2 h1, snoc_castSucc, snoc_castSucc,
          snoc_castSucc, snoc_castSucc, Fin.succ_castSucc, snoc_castSucc,
          Fin.succ_castSucc, snoc_castSucc, snoc_castSucc, snoc_castSucc]
        exact iso_refl⟩

name: length_eq_zero_of_head_eq_head_of_last_eq_last_of_length_eq_zero
statement:
theorem length_eq_zero_of_head_eq_head_of_last_eq_last_of_length_eq_zero
    {s₁ s₂ : CompositionSeries X} (hb : s₁.head = s₂.head)
    (ht : s₁.last = s₂.last) (hs₁ : s₁.length = 0) : s₂.length = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : Fin.last s₂.length = (0 : Fin s₂.length.succ) :=
    s₂.injective (hb.symm.trans ((congr_arg s₁ (Fin.ext (by simp [hs₁]))).trans ht)).symm
  simpa [Fin.ext_iff]

name: length_pos_of_head_eq_head_of_last_eq_last_of_length_pos
statement:
theorem length_pos_of_head_eq_head_of_last_eq_last_of_length_pos {s₁ s₂ : CompositionSeries X}
    (hb : s₁.head = s₂.head) (ht : s₁.last = s₂.last) : 0 < s₁.length → 0 < s₂.length
proof:
:=
  not_imp_not.1
    (by
      simpa only [pos_iff_ne_zero, ne_eq, Decidable.not_not] using
        length_eq_zero_of_head_eq_head_of_last_eq_last_of_length_eq_zero hb.symm ht.symm)

name: eq_of_head_eq_head_of_last_eq_last_of_length_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_of_head_eq_head_of_last_eq_last_of_length_eq_zero {s₁ s₂ : CompositionSeries X}
    (hb : s₁.head = s₂.head) (ht : s₁.last = s₂.last) (hs₁0 : s₁.length = 0) : s₁ = s₂
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ x, x ∈ s₁ ↔ x = s₁.last := fun x =>
    ⟨fun hx =>  subsingleton_of_length_eq_zero hs₁0 hx s₁.last_mem, fun hx => hx.symm ▸ s₁.last_mem⟩
  have : ∀ x, x ∈ s₂ ↔ x = s₂.last := fun x =>
    ⟨fun hx =>
      subsingleton_of_length_eq_zero
        (length_eq_zero_of_head_eq_head_of_last_eq_last_of_length_eq_zero hb ht
          hs₁0) hx s₂.last_mem,
      fun hx => hx.symm ▸ s₂.last_mem⟩
  ext
  simp [*]

name: exists_last_eq_snoc_equivalent
statement:
theorem exists_last_eq_snoc_equivalent (s : CompositionSeries X) (x : X) (hm : IsMaximal x s.last)
    (hb : s.head ≤ x) :
    ∃ t : CompositionSeries X,
      t.head = s.head ∧ t.length + 1 = s.length ∧
      ∃ htx : t.last = x,
        Equivalent s (snoc t s.last (show IsMaximal t.last _ from htx.symm ▸ hm))
proof:
:= by
  induction hn : s.length generalizing s x with
  | zero =>
    exact (ne_of_gt (lt_of_le_of_lt hb (lt_of_isMaximal hm))
      (subsingleton_of_length_eq_zero hn s.last_mem s.head_mem)).elim
  | succ n ih =>
    have h0s : 0 < s.length := hn.symm ▸ Nat.succ_pos _
    by_cases hetx : s.eraseLast.last = x
    · use s.eraseLast
      simp [← hetx, hn, Equivalent.refl]
    · have imxs : IsMaximal (x ⊓ s.eraseLast.last) s.eraseLast.last :=
        isMaximal_of_eq_inf x s.last rfl (Ne.symm hetx) hm (isMaximal_eraseLast_last h0s)
      have := ih _ _ imxs (le_inf (by simpa) (le_last_of_mem s.eraseLast.head_mem)) (by simp [hn])
      rcases this with ⟨t, htb, htl, htt, hteqv⟩
      have hmtx : IsMaximal t.last x :=
        isMaximal_of_eq_inf s.eraseLast.last s.last (by rw [inf_comm, htt]) hetx
          (isMaximal_eraseLast_last h0s) hm
      use snoc t x hmtx
      refine ⟨by simp [htb], by simp [htl], by simp, ?_⟩
      have : s.Equivalent ((snoc t s.eraseLast.last <| show IsMaximal t.last _ from
        htt.symm ▸ imxs).snoc s.last
          (by simpa using isMaximal_eraseLast_last h0s)) := by
        conv_lhs => rw [eq_snoc_eraseLast h0s]
        exact Equivalent.snoc hteqv (by simpa using iso_refl)
      refine this.trans <| Equivalent.snoc_snoc_swap
        (iso_symm
            (second_iso_of_eq hm
              (sup_eq_of_isMaximal hm (isMaximal_eraseLast_last h0s) (Ne.symm hetx)) htt.symm))
        (second_iso_of_eq (isMaximal_eraseLast_last h0s)
            (sup_eq_of_isMaximal (isMaximal_eraseLast_last h0s) hm hetx) (by rw [inf_comm, htt]))

name: jordan_holder
statement:
theorem jordan_holder (s₁ s₂ : CompositionSeries X)
    (hb : s₁.head = s₂.head) (ht : s₁.last = s₂.last) :
    Equivalent s₁ s₂
proof:
:= by
  induction hle : s₁.length generalizing s₁ s₂ with
  | zero => rw [eq_of_head_eq_head_of_last_eq_last_of_length_eq_zero hb ht hle]
  | succ n ih =>
    have h0s₂ : 0 < s₂.length :=
      length_pos_of_head_eq_head_of_last_eq_last_of_length_pos hb ht (hle.symm ▸ Nat.succ_pos _)
    rcases exists_last_eq_snoc_equivalent s₁ s₂.eraseLast.last
        (ht.symm ▸ isMaximal_eraseLast_last h0s₂)
        (hb.symm ▸ s₂.head_eraseLast ▸ head_le_of_mem (last_mem _)) with
      ⟨t, htb, htl, htt, hteq⟩
    have := ih t s₂.eraseLast (by simp [htb, ← hb]) htt (Nat.succ_inj.1 (htl.trans hle))
    refine hteq.trans ?_
    conv_rhs => rw [eq_snoc_eraseLast h0s₂]
    simp only [ht]
    exact Equivalent.snoc this (by simpa [htt] using iso_refl)

name: supIndep_iff_disjoint_erase
statement:
theorem supIndep_iff_disjoint_erase [DecidableEq ι] :
    s.SupIndep f ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, Disjoint (f i) ((s.erase i).sup f)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hs _ hi => hs (erase_subset _ _) hi (notMem_erase _ _), fun hs _ ht i hi hit =>
    (hs i hi).mono_right (sup_mono fun _ hj => mem_erase.2 ⟨ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hj hit, ht hj⟩)⟩

name: SupIndep.subset
statement: theorem SupIndep.subset (ht : t.SupIndep f) (h : s ⊆ t) : s.SupIndep f
proof:
:= fun _ hu _ hi =>
  ht (hu.trans h) (h hi)

name: SupIndep.mono
statement: lemma SupIndep.mono (hf : s.SupIndep f) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, g i ≤ f i) : s.SupIndep g
proof:
:=
  fun _ ht j hj htj ↦ (hf ht hj htj).mono (h j hj) (sup_mono_fun fun b a ↦ h b (ht a))

name: supIndep_empty
statement:
@[simp, grind ←]
theorem supIndep_empty (f : ι → α) : (∅ : Finset ι).SupIndep f

name: supIndep_singleton
statement:
@[simp, grind ←]
theorem supIndep_singleton (i : ι) (f : ι → α) : ({i} : Finset ι).SupIndep f
proof:
:=
  fun s hs j hji hj => by
    rw [eq_empty_of_ssubset_singleton ⟨hs, fun h => hj (h hji)⟩, sup_empty]
    exact disjoint_bot_right

name: SupIndep.pairwiseDisjoint
statement: theorem SupIndep.pairwiseDisjoint (hs : s.SupIndep f) : (s : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint f
proof:
:=
  fun _ ha _ hb hab =>
    sup_singleton.subst <| hs (singleton_subset_iff.2 hb) ha <| notMem_singleton.2 hab

name: SupIndep.le_sup_iff
statement:
theorem SupIndep.le_sup_iff (hs : s.SupIndep f) (hts : t ⊆ s) (hi : i ∈ s) (hf : ∀ i, f i ≠ ⊥) :
    f i ≤ t.sup f ↔ i ∈ t
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, le_sup⟩
  by_contra hit
  exact hf i (disjoint_self.1 <| (hs hts hi hit).mono_right h)

name: SupIndep.antitone_fun
statement:
theorem SupIndep.antitone_fun {g : ι → α} (hle : ∀ x ∈ s, f x ≤ g x) (h : s.SupIndep g) :
    s.SupIndep f
proof:
:= fun _t hts i his hit ↦
  (h hts his hit).mono (hle i his) <| Finset.sup_mono_fun fun x hx ↦ hle x <| hts hx

name: SupIndep.image
statement:
protected theorem SupIndep.image [DecidableEq ι] {s : Finset ι'} {g : ι' → ι}
    (hs : s.SupIndep (f ∘ g)) : (s.image g).SupIndep f
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht i hi hit
  rcases subset_image_iff.mp ht with ⟨t, hts, rfl⟩
  rcases mem_image.mp hi with ⟨i, his, rfl⟩
  rw [sup_image]
  exact hs hts his (hit <| mem_image_of_mem _ ·)

name: supIndep_map
statement: theorem supIndep_map {s : Finset ι'} {g : ι' ↪ ι} : (s.map g).SupIndep f ↔ s.SupIndep (f ∘ g)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hs t ht i hi hit => ?_, fun hs => ?_⟩
  · rw [← sup_map]
    exact hs (map_subset_map.2 ht) ((mem_map' _).2 hi) (by rwa [mem_map'])
  · classical
    rw [map_eq_image]
    exact hs.image

name: supIndep_pair
statement:
@[simp]
theorem supIndep_pair [DecidableEq ι] {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    ({i, j} : Finset ι).SupIndep f ↔ Disjoint (f i) (f j)
proof:
:= by
  suffices Disjoint (f i) (f j) → Disjoint (f j) ((Finset.erase {i, j} j).sup f) by
    simpa [supIndep_iff_disjoint_erase, hij]
  rw [pair_comm]
  simp [hij.symm, disjoint_comm]

name: supIndep_univ_bool
statement:
theorem supIndep_univ_bool (f : Bool → α) :
    (Finset.univ : Finset Bool).SupIndep f ↔ Disjoint (f false) (f true)
proof:
:=
  haveI : true ≠ false := by simp only [Ne, not_false_iff, reduceCtorEq]
  (supIndep_pair this).trans disjoint_comm

name: supIndep_univ_fin_two
statement:
@[simp]
theorem supIndep_univ_fin_two (f : Fin 2 → α) :
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)).SupIndep f ↔ Disjoint (f 0) (f 1)
proof:
:=
  have : (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1 := by simp
  supIndep_pair this

name: supIndep_attach
statement:
@[simp]
theorem supIndep_attach : (s.attach.SupIndep fun a => f a) ↔ s.SupIndep f

name: SupIndep.biUnion
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro a ha b hb hab
  obtain ⟨i', hi', hb⟩ := mem_biUnion.mp hb
  let t := s.erase i'
  let u := (g i').erase b
  apply Disjoint.mono_right <| calc
    a.sup f ≤ (t.biUnion g ∪ u).sup f := by grind
    _ ≤ (t.sup fun i => (g i).sup f) ⊔ (u.sup f) := by grind
  symm
  apply Disjoint.disjoint_sup_left_of_disjoint_sup_right
  · exact (supIndep_iff_disjoint_erase.mp (hg i' hi') b hb).symm
  · rw [← sup_singleton (f := f) (b := b), ← sup_union, show u ∪ {b} = g i' by grind]
    exact (supIndep_iff_disjoint_erase.mp hs i' hi').symm

name: SupIndep.sup
SupIndep.sigma
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finset.sigma_eq_biUnion]
  apply Finset.SupIndep.biUnion
  · simpa using! hs
  · simpa [Finset.supIndep_map] using! hg

name: SupIndep.product
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finset.product_eq_biUnion]
  apply Finset.SupIndep.biUnion
  · simpa using! hs
  · exact fun i' hi' ↦ (ht.mono fun i hi ↦ Finset.le_sup (f := fun i' ↦ f (i', i)) hi').image

name: SupIndep.disjoint_sup_sup
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction u using Finset.induction generalizing v with
  | empty => simp
  | insert x u hx ih =>
    grind [= SupIndep, Disjoint.disjoint_sup_left_of_disjoint_sup_right]

name: supIndep_sigma_iff'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨fun t _ i _ _ ↦ ?_, fun i _ t _ j _ _ ↦ ?_⟩, fun h ↦ h.1.sigma h.2⟩
  · let u := (g i).map (Function.Embedding.sigmaMk i)
    let v := t.biUnion (fun j => (g j).map (Function.Embedding.sigmaMk j))
    suffices Disjoint (u.sup f) (v.sup f) by simpa only [sup_map, sup_biUnion, u, v]
    apply SupIndep.disjoint_sup_sup h <;> grind [disjoint_left]
  · suffices Disjoint (f ⟨i, j⟩) ((t.image fun b ↦ ⟨i, b⟩).sup f) by simpa only [sup_image]
    grind [= SupIndep]

name: supIndep_product_iff
statement:
theorem supIndep_product_iff {s : Finset ι} {t : Finset ι'} {f : ι × ι' → α} :
    (s.product t).SupIndep f ↔ (s.SupIndep fun i => t.sup fun i' => f (i, i'))
      ∧ t.SupIndep fun i' => s.sup fun i => f (i, i')
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨fun u _ i _ _ ↦ ?_, fun u _ i _ _ ↦ ?_⟩, fun h ↦ h.1.product h.2⟩
  · suffices Disjoint ((t.image ((i, ·))).sup f) ((u ×ˢ t).sup f) by
      simpa only [sup_image, sup_product_left]
    grind [Finset.SupIndep.disjoint_sup_sup, = product_eq_sprod, = disjoint_left]
  · suffices Disjoint ((s.image ((·, i))).sup f) ((s ×ˢ u).sup f) by
      simpa only [sup_image, sup_product_right]
    grind [Finset.SupIndep.disjoint_sup_sup, = product_eq_sprod, = disjoint_left]

name: SupIndep.union
proof:
:= by
  rw [show s ∪ t = ({s, t} : Finset _).biUnion id by simp]
  grind [SupIndep.biUnion, supIndep_pair]

name: SupIndep.insert
statement:
protected theorem SupIndep.insert [DecidableEq ι] {i : ι} {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → α}
    (hs : s.SupIndep f) (h : Disjoint (f i) (s.sup f)) : (insert i s).SupIndep f

name: supIndep_iff_pairwiseDisjoint
statement: theorem supIndep_iff_pairwiseDisjoint : s.SupIndep f ↔ (s : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint f
proof:
:=
  ⟨SupIndep.pairwiseDisjoint, fun hs _ ht _ hi hit =>
    Finset.disjoint_sup_right.2 fun _ hj => hs hi (ht hj) (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hj hit).symm⟩

name: sSupIndep_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sSupIndep_empty : sSupIndep (∅ : Set α)

name: sSupIndep.mono
statement: theorem sSupIndep.mono {t : Set α} (hst : t ⊆ s) : sSupIndep t

name: sSupIndep.pairwiseDisjoint
statement: theorem sSupIndep.pairwiseDisjoint : s.PairwiseDisjoint id
proof:
:= fun _ hx y hy h =>
  disjoint_sSup_right (hs hx) ((mem_sdiff y).mpr ⟨hy, h.symm⟩)

name: sSupIndep_singleton
statement: theorem sSupIndep_singleton (a : α) : sSupIndep ({a} : Set α)

name: sSupIndep_pair
statement:
theorem sSupIndep_pair {a b : α} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    sSupIndep ({a, b} : Set α) ↔ Disjoint a b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact h.pairwiseDisjoint (mem_insert _ _) (mem_insert_of_mem _ (mem_singleton _)) hab
  · rintro h c ((rfl : c = a) | (rfl : c = b))
    · convert! h using 1
      simp [hab, sSup_singleton]
    · convert! h.symm using 1
      simp [hab, sSup_singleton]

name: sSupIndep.disjoint_sSup
statement:
theorem sSupIndep.disjoint_sSup {x : α} {y : Set α} (hx : x ∈ s) (hy : y ⊆ s) (hxy : x ∉ y) :
    Disjoint x (sSup y)
proof:
:= by
  have := (hs.mono <| insert_subset_iff.mpr ⟨hx, hy⟩) (mem_insert x _)
  rw [insert_sdiff_of_mem _ (mem_singleton _), sdiff_singleton_eq_self hxy] at this
  exact this

name: sSupIndep_iff
statement:
theorem sSupIndep_iff {α : Type*} [CompleteLattice α] (s : Set α) :
    sSupIndep s ↔ iSupIndep ((↑) : s → α)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [iSupIndep, sSupIndep, SetCoe.forall, sSup_eq_iSup]
  refine forall₂_congr fun a ha => ?_
  simp [iSup_subtype, iSup_and]

name: iSupIndep_def
statement: theorem iSupIndep_def : iSupIndep t ↔ ∀ i, Disjoint (t i) (⨆ (j) (_ : j ≠ i), t j)

name: iSupIndep_def'
statement: theorem iSupIndep_def' : iSupIndep t ↔ ∀ i, Disjoint (t i) (sSup (t '' { j | j ≠ i }))

name: iSupIndep_def''
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_def'' :
    iSupIndep t ↔ ∀ i, Disjoint (t i) (sSup { a | ∃ j ≠ i, t j = a })

name: iSupIndep_subsingleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iSupIndep_subsingleton [Subsingleton ι] (t : ι → α) : iSupIndep t
proof:
:=
  fun i ↦ by simp [← Subsingleton.elim i]

name: iSupIndep.pairwiseDisjoint
statement: theorem iSupIndep.pairwiseDisjoint : Pairwise (Disjoint on t)
proof:
:= fun x y h =>
  disjoint_sSup_right (ht x) ⟨y, iSup_pos h.symm⟩

name: iSupIndep.mono
statement: theorem iSupIndep.mono {s t : ι → α} (hs : iSupIndep s) (hst : t ≤ s) : iSupIndep t
proof:
:=
  fun i => (hs i).mono (hst i) <| iSup₂_mono fun j _ => hst j

name: iSupIndep.comp
statement:
theorem iSupIndep.comp {ι ι' : Sort*} {t : ι → α} {f : ι' → ι} (ht : iSupIndep t)
    (hf : Injective f) : iSupIndep (t ∘ f)
proof:
:= fun i =>
  (ht (f i)).mono_right <| by
    refine (iSup_mono fun i => ?_).trans (iSup_comp_le _ f)
    exact iSup_const_mono hf.ne

name: iSupIndep.comp'
statement:
theorem iSupIndep.comp' {ι ι' : Sort*} {t : ι → α} {f : ι' → ι} (ht : iSupIndep <| t ∘ f)
    (hf : Surjective f) : iSupIndep t
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  obtain ⟨i', rfl⟩ := hf i
  rw [← hf.iSup_comp]
  exact (ht i').mono_right (biSup_mono fun j' hij => mt (congr_arg f) hij)

name: iSupIndep.sSupIndep_range
statement: theorem iSupIndep.sSupIndep_range (ht : iSupIndep t) : sSupIndep <| range t
proof:
:= by
  rw [sSupIndep_iff]
  rw [← coe_comp_rangeFactorization t] at ht
  exact ht.comp' rangeFactorization_surjective

name: iSupIndep_ne_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iSupIndep_ne_bot :
    iSupIndep (fun i : {i // t i ≠ ⊥} ↦ t i) ↔ iSupIndep t
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ h.comp Subtype.val_injective⟩
  simp only [iSupIndep_def] at h ⊢
  intro i
  cases eq_or_ne (t i) ⊥ with
  | inl hi => simp [hi]
  | inr hi => ?_
  convert! h ⟨i, hi⟩
  have : ∀ j, ⨆ (_ : t j = ⊥), t j = ⊥ := fun j ↦ by simp only [iSup_eq_bot, imp_self]
  rw [iSup_split _ (fun j ↦ t j = ⊥), iSup_subtype]
  simp only [iSup_comm (ι' := _ ≠ i), this, ne_eq, sup_of_le_right, Subtype.mk.injEq, iSup_bot,
    bot_le]

name: iSupIndep.injOn
statement: theorem iSupIndep.injOn (ht : iSupIndep t) : InjOn t {i | t i ≠ ⊥}
proof:
:= by
  rintro i _ j (hj : t j ≠ ⊥) h
  by_contra! contra
  apply hj
  suffices t j ≤ ⨆ (k) (_ : k ≠ i), t k by
    replace ht := (ht i).mono_right this
    rwa [h, disjoint_self] at ht
  replace contra : j ≠ i := Ne.symm contra
  
  exact le_iSup₂ (f := fun x _ ↦ t x) j contra

name: iSupIndep.injOn_iInf
statement:
lemma iSupIndep.injOn_iInf {β : ι → Type*} (t : (i : ι) → β i → α) (ht : ∀ i, iSupIndep (t i)) :
    InjOn (fun b : (i : ι) → β i ↦ ⨅ i, t i (b i)) {b | ⨅ i, t i (b i) ≠ ⊥}
proof:
:= by
  intro b₁ hb₁ b₂ hb₂ h_eq
  beta_reduce at h_eq
  by_contra h_ne
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, b₁ i ≠ b₂ i := Function.ne_iff.mp h_ne
  have := calc
    ⨅ i, t i (b₁ i) ≤ t i (b₁ i) ⊓ t i (b₂ i) := le_inf (iInf_le ..) (h_eq ▸ iInf_le ..)
    _ = ⊥ := (ht i (b₁ i) |>.mono_right <| le_iSup₂_of_le (b₂ i) hi.symm le_rfl).eq_bot
  simp_all

name: iSupIndep.injective
statement: theorem iSupIndep.injective (ht : iSupIndep t) (h_ne_bot : ∀ i, t i ≠ ⊥) : Injective t
proof:
:= by
  suffices univ = {i | t i ≠ ⊥} by simpa [← this] using ht.injOn
  simp_all

name: iSupIndep_pair
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_pair {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (huniv : ∀ k, k = i ∨ k = j) :
    iSupIndep t ↔ Disjoint (t i) (t j)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun h => h.pairwiseDisjoint hij
  · rintro h k
    obtain rfl | rfl := huniv k
    · refine h.mono_right (iSup_le fun i => iSup_le fun hi => Eq.le ?_)
      rw [(huniv i).resolve_left hi]
    · refine h.symm.mono_right (iSup_le fun j => iSup_le fun hj => Eq.le ?_)
      rw [(huniv j).resolve_right hj]

name: iSup_fin_three
statement:
@[simp]
lemma iSup_fin_three {α : Type*} [CompleteLattice α] {f : Fin 3 → α} :
    ⨆ i, f i = f 0 ⊔ f 1 ⊔ f 2
proof:
:= by
  suffices ⨆ i ∈ Finset.univ, f i = f 0 ⊔ f 1 ⊔ f 2 by simp [← this]
  rw [← Finset.sup_eq_iSup, show (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)) = {0, 1, 2} from rfl]
  simp [sup_assoc]

name: iSupIndep_fin_three
statement:
lemma iSupIndep_fin_three {α : Type*} [CompleteLattice α] {f : Fin 3 → α} :
    iSupIndep f ↔
      Disjoint (f 0) (f 1 ⊔ f 2) ∧
      Disjoint (f 1) (f 2 ⊔ f 0) ∧
      Disjoint (f 2) (f 0 ⊔ f 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iSupIndep_def, sup_comm (f 2) (f 0)]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, fun ⟨h₀, h₁, h₂⟩ i ↦ ?_⟩
  · simpa using h 0
  · simpa using h 1
  · simpa using h 2
  · fin_cases i <;> simpa

name: iSupIndep.map_orderIso
statement:
theorem iSupIndep.map_orderIso {ι : Sort*} {α β : Type*} [CompleteLattice α]
    [CompleteLattice β] (f : α ≃o β) {a : ι → α} (ha : iSupIndep a) : iSupIndep (f ∘ a)

name: iSupIndep_map_orderIso_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iSupIndep_map_orderIso_iff {ι : Sort*} {α β : Type*} [CompleteLattice α]
    [CompleteLattice β] (f : α ≃o β) {a : ι → α} : iSupIndep (f ∘ a) ↔ iSupIndep a
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h =>
    have hf : f.symm ∘ f ∘ a = a := congr_arg (· ∘ a) f.left_inv.comp_eq_id
    hf ▸ h.map_orderIso f.symm,
    fun h => h.map_orderIso f⟩

name: iSupIndep.disjoint_biSup
statement:
theorem iSupIndep.disjoint_biSup {ι : Type*} {α : Type*} [CompleteLattice α] {t : ι → α}
    (ht : iSupIndep t) {x : ι} {y : Set ι} (hx : x ∉ y) : Disjoint (t x) (⨆ i ∈ y, t i)
proof:
:=
  Disjoint.mono_right (biSup_mono fun _ hi => (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hi hx :)) (ht x)

name: iSupIndep.of_coe_Iic_comp
statement:
lemma iSupIndep.of_coe_Iic_comp {ι : Sort*} {a : α} {t : ι → Set.Iic a}
    (ht : iSupIndep ((↑) ∘ t : ι → α)) : iSupIndep t
proof:
:= by
  intro i x
  specialize ht i
  simp_rw [Function.comp_apply, ← Set.Iic.coe_iSup] at ht
  exact @ht x

name: iSupIndep_comp_coe_iff_supIndep
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_comp_coe_iff_supIndep {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → α} :
    iSupIndep (f ∘ ((↑) : s → ι)) ↔ s.SupIndep f
proof:
:= by
  classical
    rw [Finset.supIndep_iff_disjoint_erase]
    refine Subtype.forall.trans (forall₂_congr fun a b => ?_)
    rw [Finset.sup_eq_iSup]
    congr! 1
    refine iSup_subtype.trans ?_
    congr! 1
    simp [iSup_and, @iSup_comm _ (_ ∈ s)]

name: iSupIndep.supIndep'
statement: theorem iSupIndep.supIndep' {f : ι → α} (s : Finset ι) (h : iSupIndep f) : s.SupIndep f

name: iSupIndep_iff_supIndep_univ
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_iff_supIndep_univ [Fintype ι] {f : ι → α} :
    iSupIndep f ↔ Finset.univ.SupIndep f

name: iSupIndep.le_iff_eq_of_iSup_eq_top
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h₃ ↦ funext fun i ↦ ?_, le_of_eq⟩
  replace h₁ : Disjoint (⨆ (j) (_ : j ≠ i), f j) (g i) :=
    Disjoint.mono_left (iSup₂_mono fun j _ ↦ h₃ j) (h₁ i).symm
  replace h₂ : Codisjoint (f i) (⨆ (j) (_ : j ≠ i), f j) := by
    rw [codisjoint_iff, ← iSup_split_single f i, h₂]
  exact (le_iff_eq_of_codisjoint_of_disjoint h₂ h₁).mp (h₃ i)

name: iSupIndep.disjoint_biSup_biSup'
statement:
lemma iSupIndep.disjoint_biSup_biSup' [IsModularLattice α]
    {f : ι → α} {s t : Set ι} (hf : iSupIndep f) (hst : Disjoint s t) (hs : s.Finite) :
    Disjoint (⨆ i ∈ s, f i) (⨆ i ∈ t, f i)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ (s : Finset ι) (hst : Disjoint ↑s t), Disjoint (⨆ i ∈ s, f i) (⨆ i ∈ t, f i) by
    specialize this hs.toFinset
    aesop
  clear! s
  intro s hst
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on generalizing t with
  | empty => simp
  | insert j s₀ hj ih =>
    have hjt : j ∉ t := by aesop
    replace hst : Disjoint ↑s₀ (insert j t) := by aesop
    replace ih : Disjoint (⨆ i ∈ s₀, f i) (f j ⊔ ⨆ i ∈ t, f i) := by
      specialize ih hst
      rwa [iSup_insert] at ih
    have : Disjoint (f j) ((⨆ i ∈ t, f i) ⊔ (⨆ i ∈ (s₀ : Set ι), f i)) := by
      rw [← iSup_union]
      exact disjoint_biSup hf <| by aesop
    rw [s₀.iSup_insert j f, disjoint_comm, sup_comm]
    exact disjoint_sup_right_of_disjoint_sup_right ih this

name: iSupIndep.mem_of_biSup_eq_top
proof:
:= by
  by_contra contra
  replace h₁ : Disjoint (f i) (⨆ i ∈ s, f i) := (h₁ i).mono_right <| biSup_mono <| by aesop
  aesop

name: sSupIndep_iff_pairwiseDisjoint
statement: theorem sSupIndep_iff_pairwiseDisjoint {s : Set α} : sSupIndep s ↔ s.PairwiseDisjoint id

:=
  ⟨sSupIndep.pairwiseDisjoint, fun hs _ hi =>
    disjoint_sSup_iff.2 fun _ hj => hs hi hj.1 <| Ne.symm hj.2⟩

    disjoint_iSup_iff.2 fun _ => disjoint_iSup_iff.2 fun hij => hs hij.symm⟩

name: limsInf_le_limsSup
statement:

theorem limsInf_le_limsSup {f : Filter α} [NeBot f]

    (h₂ : f.IsBounded (· ≥ ·) := by isBoundedDefault) :

proof:
:=
  liminf_le_of_le h₂ fun a₀ ha₀ =>
    le_limsup_of_le h₁ fun a₁ ha₁ =>
      show a₀ ≤ a₁ from
        let ⟨_, hb₀, hb₁⟩ := (ha₀.and ha₁).exists

statement:

theorem limsup_le_limsup_of_le {α β} [ConditionallyCompleteLattice β] {f g : Filter α} (h : f ≤ g)
    {u : α → β}

name: limsup_eq_sInf_sSup
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem limsup_eq_sInf_sSup {ι R : Type*} (F : Filter ι) [CompleteLattice R] (a : ι → R) :
    limsup a F = sInf ((fun I => sSup (a '' I)) '' F.sets)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [limsup_eq]
    refine sInf_le_sInf fun x hx => ?_
    rcases (mem_image _ F.sets x).mp hx with ⟨I, ⟨I_mem_F, hI⟩⟩
    filter_upwards [I_mem_F] with i hi
    exact hI ▸ le_sSup (mem_image_of_mem _ hi)
  · refine le_sInf fun b hb => sInf_le_of_le (mem_image_of_mem _ hb) <| sSup_le ?_
    rintro _ ⟨_, h, rfl⟩
    exact h

name: liminf_le_of_frequently_le'
proof:
:= by
  rw [liminf_eq]
  refine sSup_le fun b hb => ?_
  have hbx : ∃ᶠ _ in f, b ≤ x := by
    contrapose! h
    exact hb.mp (h.mono fun a hbx hba hax => hbx (hba.trans hax))
  exact hbx.exists.choose_spec

name: _root_.CompleteLatticeHom.apply_limsup_iterate
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)
/
`a : α` is a fixed point. -/]
theorem _root_.CompleteLatticeHom.apply_limsup_iterate (f : CompleteLatticeHom α α) (a : α) :
    f (limsup (fun n => f^[n] a) atTop) = limsup (fun n => f^[n] a) atTop
proof:
:= by
  rw [limsup_eq_iInf_iSup_of_nat', map_iInf]
  simp_rw [_root_.map_iSup, ← Function.comp_apply (f := f), ← Function.iterate_succ' f,
    ← Nat.add_succ]
  conv_rhs => rw [iInf_split _ (0 < ·)]
  simp only [not_lt, Nat.le_zero, iInf_iInf_eq_left, add_zero, iInf_nat_gt_zero_eq, left_eq_inf]
  refine (iInf_le (fun i => ⨆ j, f^[j + (i + 1)] a) 0).trans ?_
  simp only [zero_add, iSup_le_iff]
  exact fun i => le_iSup (fun i => f^[i] a) (i + 1)

proof:
:= by
  rw [blimsup_eq_iInf_biSup] at hx
  simp only [iSup_eq_iUnion, iInf_eq_iInter, mem_iInter, mem_iUnion, exists_prop] at hx
  choose g hg hg' using hx
  refine ⟨fun i : { i | q i } => g (b i) (hl.mem_of_mem i.2), fun i => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · exact hg' (b i) (hl.mem_of_mem i.2)
  · exact hg (b i) (hl.mem_of_mem i.2)

name: exists_forall_mem_of_hasBasis_mem_blimsup'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_forall_mem_of_hasBasis_mem_blimsup hl hx
  exact ⟨fun i => f ⟨i, trivial⟩, fun i => hf ⟨i, trivial⟩⟩

name: frequently_lt_of_lt_limsSup
statement:
@[to_dual frequently_lt_of_limsInf_lt]
theorem frequently_lt_of_lt_limsSup {f : Filter α} [ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder α] {a : α}
    (hf : f.IsCobounded (· ≤ ·) := by isBoundedDefault)
    (h : a < limsSup f) : ∃ᶠ n in f, a < n
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! h
  exact limsSup_le_of_le hf h

name: eventually_lt_of_lt_liminf
statement:
@[to_dual eventually_lt_of_limsup_lt]
theorem eventually_lt_of_lt_liminf {f : Filter α} [ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder β] {u : α → β}
    {b : β} (h : b < liminf u f)
    (hu : f.IsBoundedUnder (· ≥ ·) u := by isBoundedDefault) :
    ∀ᶠ a in f, b < u a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hbc⟩ : ∃ (c : β) (_ : c ∈ { c : β | ∀ᶠ n : α in f, c ≤ u n }), b < c := by
    simp_rw [exists_prop]
    exact exists_lt_of_lt_csSup hu h
  exact hc.mono fun x hx => lt_of_lt_of_le hbc hx

name: eventually_lt_add_pos_of_limsup_le
statement:
theorem eventually_lt_add_pos_of_limsup_le [Preorder β] [AddZeroClass α] [AddLeftStrictMono α]
    {x ε : α} {u : β → α} (hu_bdd : IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) atTop u) (hu : Filter.limsup u atTop ≤ x)
    (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ b : β in atTop, u b < x + ε

name: exists_lt_of_limsup_le
statement:
@[to_dual exists_lt_of_le_liminf
/
number `n` such that ` x + ε < u n`. -/]
theorem exists_lt_of_limsup_le [AddZeroClass α] [AddLeftStrictMono α] {x ε : α} {u : ℕ → α}
    (hu_bdd : IsBoundedUnder LE.le atTop u) (hu : Filter.limsup u atTop ≤ x) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ n : PNat, u n < x + ε
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, u n < x + ε := eventually_lt_add_pos_of_limsup_le hu_bdd hu hε
  simp only [eventually_atTop] at h
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h
  exact ⟨⟨n + 1, Nat.succ_pos _⟩, hn (n + 1) (Nat.le_succ _)⟩

name: frequently_lt_of_lt_limsup
statement:
@[to_dual frequently_lt_of_liminf_lt]
theorem frequently_lt_of_lt_limsup {b : β}
    (hu : f.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) u := by isBoundedDefault)
    (h : b < limsup u f) : ∃ᶠ x in f, b < u x
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! h
  apply limsSup_le_of_le hu
  simpa using h

name: limsup_le_iff
statement:
@[to_dual le_liminf_iff]
theorem limsup_le_iff {x : β} (h₁ : f.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) u := by isBoundedDefault)
    (h₂ : f.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) u := by isBoundedDefault) :
    limsup u f ≤ x ↔ ∀ y, x < y → ∀ᶠ a in f, u a < y
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h _ h' ↦ eventually_lt_of_limsup_lt (h.trans_lt h') h₂, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  
  
  
  by_cases h' : ∀ y > x, ∃ z, x < z ∧ z < y
  · rw [← forall_gt_iff_le]
    intro y x_y
    rcases h' y x_y with ⟨z, x_z, z_y⟩
    exact (limsup_le_of_le h₁ ((h z x_z).mono (fun _ ↦ le_of_lt))).trans_lt z_y
  · apply limsup_le_of_le h₁
    push +distrib Not at h'
    rcases h' with ⟨z, x_z, hz⟩
    exact (h z x_z).mono <| fun w hw ↦ (or_iff_left (not_le_of_gt hw)).1 (hz (u w))

name: limsup_le_iff'
statement:
lemma limsup_le_iff' [DenselyOrdered β] {x : β}
    (h₁ : IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) f u := by isBoundedDefault)
    (h₂ : IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) f u := by isBoundedDefault) :
    limsup u f ≤ x ↔ ∀ y, x < y → ∀ᶠ (a : α) in f, u a ≤ y
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h _ h' ↦ (eventually_lt_of_limsup_lt (h.trans_lt h') h₂).mono fun _ ↦ le_of_lt, ?_⟩
  rw [← forall_gt_iff_le]
  intro h y x_y
  obtain ⟨z, x_z, z_y⟩ := exists_between x_y
  exact (limsup_le_of_le h₁ (h z x_z)).trans_lt z_y

name: le_limsup_iff
statement:
@[to_dual liminf_le_iff]
theorem le_limsup_iff {x : β} (h₁ : f.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) u := by isBoundedDefault)
    (h₂ : f.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) u := by isBoundedDefault) :
    x ≤ limsup u f ↔ ∀ y < x, ∃ᶠ a in f, y < u a
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h _ h' ↦ frequently_lt_of_lt_limsup h₁ (h'.trans_le h), fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  
  
  
  by_cases h' : ∀ y < x, ∃ z, y < z ∧ z < x
  · rw [← forall_lt_iff_le]
    intro y y_x
    obtain ⟨z, y_z, z_x⟩ := h' y y_x
    exact y_z.trans_le (le_limsup_of_frequently_le ((h z z_x).mono (fun _ ↦ le_of_lt)) h₂)
  · apply le_limsup_of_frequently_le _ h₂
    push +distrib Not at h'
    rcases h' with ⟨z, z_x, hz⟩
    exact (h z z_x).mono <| fun w hw ↦ (or_iff_right (not_le_of_gt hw)).1 (hz (u w))

name: le_limsup_iff'
statement:
lemma le_limsup_iff' [DenselyOrdered β] {x : β}
    (h₁ : f.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) u := by isBoundedDefault)
    (h₂ : f.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) u := by isBoundedDefault) :
    x ≤ limsup u f ↔ ∀ y < x, ∃ᶠ a in f, y ≤ u a
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h _ h' ↦ (frequently_lt_of_lt_limsup h₁ (h'.trans_le h)).mono fun _ ↦ le_of_lt, ?_⟩
  rw [← forall_lt_iff_le]
  intro h y y_x
  obtain ⟨z, y_z, z_x⟩ := exists_between y_x
  exact y_z.trans_le (le_limsup_of_frequently_le (h z z_x) h₂)

name: liminf_le_limsup_of_frequently_le
statement:
@[to_dual self (reorder := u v, h₁ h₂)]
lemma liminf_le_limsup_of_frequently_le {v : α → β} (h : ∃ᶠ x in f, u x ≤ v x)
    (h₁ : f.IsBoundedUnder (· ≥ ·) u := by isBoundedDefault)
    (h₂ : f.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) v := by isBoundedDefault) :
    liminf u f ≤ limsup v f
proof:
:= by
  rcases f.eq_or_neBot with rfl | _
  · exact (frequently_bot h).rec
  have h₃ : f.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≥ ·) u := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h₂.eventually_le
    apply IsCoboundedUnder.of_frequently_le (a := a)
    exact (h.and_eventually ha).mono fun x ⟨u_x, v_x⟩ ↦ u_x.trans v_x
  have h₄ : f.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) v := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h₁.eventually_ge
    apply IsCoboundedUnder.of_frequently_ge (a := a)
    exact (ha.and_frequently h).mono fun x ⟨u_x, v_x⟩ ↦ u_x.trans v_x
  refine (le_limsup_iff h₄ h₂).2 fun y y_v ↦ ?_
  have := (le_liminf_iff h₃ h₁).1 (le_refl (liminf u f)) y y_v
  exact (h.and_eventually this).mono fun x ⟨ux_vx, y_ux⟩ ↦ y_ux.trans_le ux_vx

name: lt_mem_sets_of_limsSup_lt
statement:
@[to_dual gt_mem_sets_of_limsInf_gt]
theorem lt_mem_sets_of_limsSup_lt (h : f.IsBounded (· ≤ ·)) (l : f.limsSup < b) :
    ∀ᶠ a in f, a < b
proof:
:=
  let ⟨c, (h : ∀ᶠ a in f, a ≤ c), hcb⟩ := exists_lt_of_csInf_lt h l
  mem_of_superset h fun _a => hcb.trans_le'

name: HasBasis.liminf_eq_ciSup_ciInf
statement:
@[to_dual
/
linear order. A reparametrization trick is needed to avoid taking the supremum of sets which are
not bounded above. -/]
theorem HasBasis.liminf_eq_ciSup_ciInf {v : Filter ι}
    {p : ι' → Prop} {s : ι' → Set ι} [Countable (Subtype p)] [Nonempty (Subtype p)]
    (hv : v.HasBasis p s) {f : ι → α} (hs : ∀ (j : Subtype p), (s j).Nonempty)
    (H : ∃ (j : Subtype p), BddBelow (range (fun (i : s j) ↦ f i))) :
    liminf f v = ⨆ (j : Subtype p), ⨅ (i : s (liminfReparam f s p j)), f i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases H with ⟨j0, hj0⟩
  let m : Set (Subtype p) := {j | BddBelow (range (fun (i : s j) ↦ f i))}
  have : ∀ (j : Subtype p), Nonempty (s j) := fun j ↦ Nonempty.coe_sort (hs j)
  have A : ⋃ (j : Subtype p), ⋂ (i : s j), Iic (f i) =
         ⋃ (j : Subtype p), ⋂ (i : s (liminfReparam f s p j)), Iic (f i) := by
    apply Subset.antisymm
    · apply iUnion_subset (fun j ↦ ?_)
      by_cases hj : j ∈ m
      · have : j = liminfReparam f s p j := by simp only [m, liminfReparam, hj, ite_true]
        conv_lhs => rw [this]
        apply subset_iUnion _ j
      · simp only [m, mem_ofPred_eq, ← nonempty_iInter_Iic_iff, not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hj
        simp only [hj, empty_subset]
    · apply iUnion_subset (fun j ↦ ?_)
      exact subset_iUnion (fun (k : Subtype p) ↦ (⋂ (i : s k), Iic (f i))) (liminfReparam f s p j)
  have B : ∀ (j : Subtype p), ⋂ (i : s (liminfReparam f s p j)), Iic (f i) =
                                Iic (⨅ (i : s (liminfReparam f s p j)), f i) := by
    intro j
    apply (Iic_ciInf _).symm
    change liminfReparam f s p j ∈ m
    by_cases Hj : j ∈ m
    · simpa only [m, liminfReparam, ite_eq_left Hj] using Hj
    · simp only [m, liminfReparam, ite_eq_right Hj]
      have Z : ∃ n, (exists_surjective_nat (Subtype p)).choose n ∈ m ∨ ∀ j, j ∉ m := by
        rcases (exists_surjective_nat (Subtype p)).choose_spec j0 with ⟨n, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨n, Or.inl hj0⟩
      rcases Nat.find_spec Z with hZ | hZ
      · exact hZ
      · exact (hZ j0 hj0).elim
  simp_rw [hv.liminf_eq_sSup_iUnion_iInter, A, B, sSup_iUnion_Iic]

name: HasBasis.liminf_eq_ite
statement:
@[to_dual
/
linear order. A reparametrization trick is needed to avoid taking the supremum of sets which are
not bounded below. -/]
theorem HasBasis.liminf_eq_ite {v : Filter ι} {p : ι' → Prop} {s : ι' → Set ι}
    [Countable (Subtype p)] [Nonempty (Subtype p)] (hv : v.HasBasis p s) (f : ι → α) :
    liminf f v = if ∃ (j : Subtype p), s j = ∅ then sSup univ else
      if ∀ (j : Subtype p), ¬BddBelow (range (fun (i : s j) ↦ f i)) then sSup ∅
      else ⨆ (j : Subtype p), ⨅ (i : s (liminfReparam f s p j)), f i
proof:
:= by
  by_cases H : ∃ (j : Subtype p), s j = ∅
  · rw [ite_eq_left H]
    rcases H with ⟨j, hj⟩
    simp [hv.liminf_eq_sSup_univ_of_empty j j.2 hj]
  rw [ite_eq_right H]
  by_cases H' : ∀ (j : Subtype p), ¬BddBelow (range (fun (i : s j) ↦ f i))
  · have A : ∀ (j : Subtype p), ⋂ (i : s j), Iic (f i) = ∅ := by
      simp_rw [← not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty, nonempty_iInter_Iic_iff]
      exact H'
    simp_rw [ite_eq_left H', hv.liminf_eq_sSup_iUnion_iInter, A, iUnion_empty]
  rw [ite_eq_right H']
  apply hv.liminf_eq_ciSup_ciInf
  · push Not at H
    simpa only [nonempty_iff_ne_empty] using H
  · push Not at H'
    exact H'

name: GaloisConnection.l_limsup_le
statement:
@[to_dual none]
theorem GaloisConnection.l_limsup_le [ConditionallyCompleteLattice β]
    [ConditionallyCompleteLattice γ] {f : Filter α} {v : α → β} {l : β → γ} {u : γ → β}
    (gc : GaloisConnection l u)
    (hlv : f.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) fun x => l (v x) := by isBoundedDefault)
    (hv_co : f.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) v := by isBoundedDefault) :
    l (limsup v f) ≤ limsup (fun x => l (v x)) f
proof:
:= by
  refine le_limsSup_of_le hlv fun c hc => ?_
  rw [Filter.eventually_map] at hc
  simp_rw [gc _ _] at hc ⊢
  exact limsSup_le_of_le hv_co hc

name: OrderIso.limsup_apply
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem OrderIso.limsup_apply {γ} [ConditionallyCompleteLattice β] [ConditionallyCompleteLattice γ]
    {f : Filter α} {u : α → β} (g : β ≃o γ)
    (hu : f.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) u := by isBoundedDefault)
    (hu_co : f.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) u := by isBoundedDefault)
    (hgu : f.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) fun x => g (u x) := by isBoundedDefault)
    (hgu_co : f.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) fun x => g (u x) := by isBoundedDefault) :
    g (limsup u f) = limsup (fun x => g (u x)) f
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ((OrderIso.to_galoisConnection g).l_limsup_le hgu hu_co) ?_
  rw [← g.symm.symm_apply_apply <| limsup (fun x => g (u x)) f, g.symm_symm]
  refine g.monotone ?_
  have hf : u = fun i => g.symm (g (u i)) := funext fun i => (g.symm_apply_apply (u i)).symm
  nth_rw 2 [hf]
  refine (OrderIso.to_galoisConnection g.symm).l_limsup_le ?_ hgu_co
  simp_rw [g.symm_apply_apply]
  exact hu

name: limsup_max
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem limsup_max [ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder β] {f : Filter α} {u v : α → β}
    (h₁ : f.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) u := by isBoundedDefault)
    (h₂ : f.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) v := by isBoundedDefault)
    (h₃ : f.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) u := by isBoundedDefault)
    (h₄ : f.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) v := by isBoundedDefault) :
    limsup (fun a ↦ max (u a) (v a)) f = max (limsup u f) (limsup v f)
proof:
:= by
  have bddmax := IsBoundedUnder.sup h₃ h₄
  have cobddmax := isCoboundedUnder_le_max (v := v) (Or.inl h₁)
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine (limsup_le_iff cobddmax bddmax).2 (fun b hb ↦ ?_)
    have hu := eventually_lt_of_limsup_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hb) h₃
    have hv := eventually_lt_of_limsup_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hb) h₄
    refine mem_of_superset (inter_mem hu hv) (fun _ ↦ by simp)
  · exact max_le (c := limsup (fun a ↦ max (u a) (v a)) f)
      (limsup_le_limsup (Eventually.of_forall (fun a : α ↦ le_max_left (u a) (v a))) h₁ bddmax)
      (limsup_le_limsup (Eventually.of_forall (fun a : α ↦ le_max_right (u a) (v a))) h₂ bddmax)

name: limsup_finset_sup'
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem limsup_finset_sup' [ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder β] {f : Filter α}
    {F : ι → α → β} {s : Finset ι} (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (h₁ : ∀ i ∈ s, f.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (F i) := by exact fun _ _ ↦ by isBoundedDefault)
    (h₂ : ∀ i ∈ s, f.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (F i) := by exact fun _ _ ↦ by isBoundedDefault) :
    limsup (fun a ↦ sup' s hs (fun i ↦ F i a)) f = sup' s hs (fun i ↦ limsup (F i) f)
proof:
:= by
  have bddsup := isBoundedUnder_le_finset_sup' hs h₂
  apply le_antisymm
  · have h₃ : ∃ i ∈ s, f.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (F i) := by
      rcases hs with ⟨i, i_s⟩
      use i, i_s
      exact h₁ i i_s
    have cobddsup := isCoboundedUnder_le_finset_sup' hs h₃
    refine (limsup_le_iff cobddsup bddsup).2 (fun b hb ↦ ?_)
    simp only [sup'_lt_iff, eventually_all_finset] at hb ⊢
    exact fun i i_s ↦ eventually_lt_of_limsup_lt (hb i i_s) (h₂ i i_s)
  · apply Finset.sup'_le hs (fun i ↦ limsup (F i) f)
    refine fun i i_s ↦ limsup_le_limsup (Eventually.of_forall (fun a ↦ ?_)) (h₁ i i_s) bddsup
    simp only [le_sup'_iff]
    use i, i_s

name: limsup_finset_sup
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_neBot f with (rfl | _)
  · simp [limsup_eq, csInf_univ]
  rcases Finset.eq_empty_or_nonempty s with (rfl | s_nemp)
  · simp only [sup_empty, limsup_const]
  rw [← Finset.sup'_eq_sup s_nemp fun i ↦ limsup (F i) f, ← limsup_finset_sup' s_nemp h₁ h₂]
  congr
  ext a
  exact Eq.symm (Finset.sup'_eq_sup s_nemp (fun i ↦ F i a))

name: empty
statement: @[simp] protected theorem empty : IsAntichain r ∅

name: singleton
statement: @[simp] protected theorem singleton : IsAntichain r {a}

name: subset
statement: protected theorem subset (hs : IsAntichain r s) (h : t ⊆ s) : IsAntichain r t

name: mono
statement: theorem mono (hs : IsAntichain r₁ s) (h : r₂ ≤ r₁) : IsAntichain r₂ s

name: mono_on
statement:
theorem mono_on (hs : IsAntichain r₁ s) (h : s.Pairwise fun ⦃a b⦄ => r₂ a b → r₁ a b) :
    IsAntichain r₂ s
proof:
:=
  hs.imp_on <| h.imp fun _ _ h h₁ h₂ => h₁ <| h h₂

name: eq
statement:
protected theorem eq (hs : IsAntichain r s) {a b : α} (ha : a ∈ s) (hb : b ∈ s) (h : r a b) :
    a = b
proof:
:=
  Set.Pairwise.eq hs ha hb <| not_not_intro h

name: eq'
statement:
protected theorem eq' (hs : IsAntichain r s) {a b : α} (ha : a ∈ s) (hb : b ∈ s) (h : r b a) :
    a = b

name: antisymm
statement: protected theorem antisymm (h : IsAntichain r univ) : Std.Antisymm r

name: subsingleton
statement: protected theorem subsingleton [Std.Trichotomous r] (h : IsAntichain r s) : s.Subsingleton
proof:
:= by
  rintro a ha b hb
  obtain hab | hab | hab := trichotomous_of r a b
  · exact h.eq ha hb hab
  · exact hab
  · exact h.eq' ha hb hab

name: flip
statement: protected theorem flip (hs : IsAntichain r s) : IsAntichain (flip r) s
proof:
:= fun _ ha _ hb h =>
  hs hb ha h.symm

name: swap
statement: theorem swap (hs : IsAntichain r s) : IsAntichain (swap r) s

name: image
statement:
theorem image (hs : IsAntichain r s) (f : α → β) (h : ∀ ⦃a b⦄, r' (f a) (f b) → r a b) :
    IsAntichain r' (f '' s)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ _ ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ hbc hr
  exact hs hb hc (ne_of_apply_ne _ hbc) (h hr)

name: preimage
statement:
theorem preimage (hs : IsAntichain r s) {f : β → α} (hf : Injective f)
    (h : ∀ ⦃a b⦄, r' a b → r (f a) (f b)) : IsAntichain r' (f ⁻¹' s)
proof:
:= fun _ hb _ hc hbc hr =>
  hs hb hc (hf.ne hbc) <| h hr

name: _root_.isAntichain_insert
statement:
theorem _root_.isAntichain_insert :
    IsAntichain r (insert a s) ↔ IsAntichain r s ∧ ∀ ⦃b⦄, b ∈ s → a ≠ b → ¬r a b ∧ ¬r b a

name: insert
statement:
protected theorem insert (hs : IsAntichain r s) (hl : ∀ ⦃b⦄, b ∈ s → a ≠ b → ¬r b a)
    (hr : ∀ ⦃b⦄, b ∈ s → a ≠ b → ¬r a b) : IsAntichain r (insert a s)
proof:
:=
  isAntichain_insert.2 ⟨hs, fun _ hb hab => ⟨hr hb hab, hl hb hab⟩⟩

name: _root_.isAntichain_insert_of_symm
statement:
theorem _root_.isAntichain_insert_of_symm [Std.Symm r] :
    IsAntichain r (insert a s) ↔ IsAntichain r s ∧ ∀ ⦃b⦄, b ∈ s → a ≠ b → ¬r a b

name: insert_of_symm
statement:
theorem insert_of_symm (hs : IsAntichain r s) [Std.Symm r] (h : ∀ ⦃b⦄, b ∈ s → a ≠ b → ¬r a b) :
    IsAntichain r (insert a s)

name: image_relEmbedding
statement: theorem image_relEmbedding (hs : IsAntichain r s) (φ : r ↪r r') : IsAntichain r' (φ '' s)
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb b' hb' h₁ h₂
  rw [Set.mem_image] at hb hb'
  obtain ⟨⟨a, has, rfl⟩, ⟨a', has', rfl⟩⟩ := hb, hb'
  exact hs has has' (fun haa' => h₁ (by rw [haa'])) (φ.map_rel_iff.mp h₂)

name: preimage_relEmbedding

    IsAntichain r (φ ⁻¹' t)

:= fun _ ha _s ha' hne hle =>
  ht ha ha' (fun h => hne (φ.injective h)) (φ.map_rel_iff.mpr hle)

    exact ⟨IsAntichain.singleton, isGreatest_singleton⟩⟩

name: IsAntichain.eq_setOfPred_maximal
statement:
theorem IsAntichain.eq_setOfPred_maximal (ht : IsAntichain (· ≤ ·) t)
    (h : ∀ x, Maximal (· ∈ s) x → x ∈ t) (hs : ∀ a ∈ t, ∃ b, b ≤ a ∧ Maximal (· ∈ s) b) :
    {x | Maximal (· ∈ s) x} = t
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.ext fun x ↦ ⟨h _, fun hx ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hyx, hy⟩ := hs x hx
  rwa [← ht.eq (h y hy) hx hyx]

proof:
:=

proof:
:=
  (Set.Pairwise.eq hs ha hb) fun h =>
    False.elim <| (h c).elim (not_not_intro hac) (not_not_intro hbc)

name: image
statement:
theorem image (hs : IsStrongAntichain r s) {f : α → β} (hf : Surjective f)

proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ _ ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ hab c
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hf c
  exact (hs ha hb (ne_of_apply_ne _ hab) _).imp (mt <| h _ _) (mt <| h _ _)

statement:

  (hs ha hb (hf.ne hab) _).imp (mt <| h _ _) (mt <| h _ _)

name: image
statement:
protected theorem image {s : β → β → Prop} (e : r ≃r s) {c : Set α} (hc : IsMaxAntichain r c) :
    IsMaxAntichain s (e '' c) where
  left
proof:
:= hc.isAntichain.image _ fun _ _ ↦ e.map_rel_iff'.mp
  right t ht hf := by
    rw [← e.coe_fn_toEquiv, ← e.toEquiv.eq_preimage_iff_image_eq, ← Equiv.image_symm_eq_preimage]
    exact hc.2 (ht.image _ fun _ _ ↦ e.symm.map_rel_iff.mp)
      ((e.toEquiv.subset_symm_image _ _).2 hf)

name: isEmpty_iff
statement: protected theorem isEmpty_iff (h : IsMaxAntichain r s) : IsEmpty α ↔ s = ∅
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ ↦ s.eq_empty_of_isEmpty, fun h' ↦ ?_⟩
  constructor
  intro x
  simp only [IsMaxAntichain, h', IsAntichain.empty, empty_subset, forall_const, true_and] at h
  exact singleton_ne_empty x (h IsAntichain.singleton).symm

  mp h
proof:
:= ⟨h.prop, fun _ ht hst ↦ hst.antisymm <| h.le_of_ge ht hst⟩
  mpr h := ⟨h.isAntichain, fun _ ht hst ↦ h.right ht hst |>.ge⟩

name: isCofinal_iff_iUnion_Iio_eq_univ
statement:
theorem isCofinal_iff_iUnion_Iio_eq_univ [NoMaxOrder α] {s : Set α} :
    IsCofinal s ↔ ⋃ i ∈ s, Iio i = univ where
  mpr hs
proof:
:= by
    rw [isCofinal_iff_iUnion_Iic_eq_univ, ← univ_subset_iff, ← hs]
    gcongr
    exact Iio_subset_Iic_self
  mp hs := by
    simp_rw [eq_univ_iff_forall, mem_iUnion, exists_prop]
    intro x
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_gt x
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hz'⟩ := hs y
    exact ⟨z, hz, hy.trans_le hz'⟩

statement:

  intro a
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩ := h.wf.has_min (Set.Ici a) Set.nonempty_Ici

  by_contra! hc'
  exact hb' c (hb.trans hc') hc

  rw [← extent_ssubset_extent_iff, Set.ssubset_iff_exists] at h
  simpa [← not_le, principal_le_iff, and_comm] using h.2

  rw [not_iff_comm, not_exists, ← le_principal_iff]
  simp_rw [← not_le, not_and, not_not]
  rfl

  rw [← not_le, principal_le_iff]
  rw [not_iff_comm, not_exists, ← principal_le_iff]
  rw [← intent_subset_intent_iff]
  simp_rw [← not_le, not_and, not_not]

name: ScottContinuousOn.monotone
statement:
protected theorem ScottContinuousOn.monotone (D : Set (Set α)) (hD : ∀ a b : α, a ≤ b → {a, b} ∈ D)
    (h : ScottContinuousOn D f) : Monotone f
proof:
:= by
  refine fun a b hab =>
    (h (hD a b hab) (insert_nonempty _ _) (directedOn_pair hab) ?_).1
      (mem_image_of_mem _ <| mem_insert _ _)
  rw [IsLUB, upperBounds_insert, upperBounds_singleton,
    inter_eq_self_of_subset_right (Ici_subset_Ici.2 hab)]
  exact isLeast_Ici

name: ScottContinuousOn.comp
statement:
@[fun_prop, to_fun]
theorem ScottContinuousOn.comp {g : β → γ} {D'}
    (hD : ∀ a b : α, a ≤ b → {a, b} ∈ D) (hD' : Set.MapsTo (f '' ·) D D')
    (hg : ScottContinuousOn D' g) (hf : ScottContinuousOn D f) :
    ScottContinuousOn D (g ∘ f)
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd₁ hd₂ hd₃ a ha
  have hd : DirectedOn (fun x1 x2 ↦ x1 ≤ x2) (f '' d) := by
    have := hf.monotone
    simp only [Monotone, DirectedOn, mem_image, exists_exists_and_eq_and, forall_exists_index,
      and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂] at ⊢ this hd₃
    grind
  rw [Set.image_comp]
  exact hg (hD' hd₁) ⟨f hd₂.choose, by grind⟩ hd (hf hd₁ hd₂ hd₃ ha)

name: ScottContinuousOn.image_comp

theorem ScottContinuousOn.image_comp {g : β → γ}

name: ScottContinuousOn.prodMk
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma ScottContinuousOn.prodMk {g : α → γ} (hD : ∀ a b : α, a ≤ b → {a, b} ∈ D)
    (hf : ScottContinuousOn D f) (hg : ScottContinuousOn D g) :
    ScottContinuousOn D fun x => (f x, g x)
proof:
:= fun d hd₁ hd₂ hd₃ a hda => by
  rw [IsLUB, IsLeast, upperBounds]
  constructor
  · simp only [mem_image, forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂, mem_ofPred_eq,
      Prod.mk_le_mk]
    intro b hb
    exact ⟨hf.monotone D hD (hda.1 hb), hg.monotone D hD (hda.1 hb)⟩
  · intro ⟨p₁, p₂⟩ hp
    simp only [mem_image, forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂, mem_ofPred_eq,
      Prod.mk_le_mk] at hp
    constructor
    · rw [isLUB_le_iff (hf hd₁ hd₂ hd₃ hda), upperBounds]
      simp only [mem_image, forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂, mem_ofPred_eq]
      intro _ hb
      exact (hp _ hb).1
    · rw [isLUB_le_iff (hg hd₁ hd₂ hd₃ hda), upperBounds]
      simp only [mem_image, forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂, mem_ofPred_eq]
      intro _ hb
      exact (hp _ hb).2

name: ScottContinuous.sup
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma ScottContinuous.sup₂ :
    ScottContinuous fun b : β × β => (b.1 ⊔ b.2 : β)
proof:
:= fun d _ _ ⟨p₁, p₂⟩ hdp => by
  simp only [IsLUB, IsLeast, upperBounds, Prod.forall, mem_ofPred_eq, Prod.mk_le_mk] at hdp
  simp only [IsLUB, IsLeast, upperBounds, mem_image, Prod.exists, forall_exists_index, and_imp]
  have e1 : (p₁, p₂) ∈ lowerBounds {x | ∀ (b₁ b₂ : β), (b₁, b₂) ∈ d → (b₁, b₂) ≤ x} := hdp.2
  simp only [lowerBounds, mem_ofPred_eq, Prod.forall, Prod.mk_le_mk] at e1
  refine ⟨fun a b₁ b₂ hbd hba => ?_,fun b hb => ?_⟩
  · rw [← hba]
    exact sup_le_sup (hdp.1 _ _ hbd).1 (hdp.1 _ _ hbd).2
  · rw [sup_le_iff]
    exact e1 _ _ fun b₁ b₂ hb' => sup_le_iff.mp (hb b₁ b₂ hb' rfl)

proof:
:= by
    simp_rw [Set.ext_iff, mem_Ico, mem_singleton_iff] at h

    obtain rfl := (h a).mp ⟨le_refl a, hac.trans_lt hcb⟩
    exact ⟨rfl, ⟨hcb, fun d hcd hdb ↦ hcd.ne ((h d).mp ⟨hcd.le, hdb⟩).symm⟩⟩
  mpr := fun ⟨rfl, hcov⟩ ↦ hcov.Ico_eq

name: Set.Ioo_eq_singleton_iff
statement:
@[to_dual none]
theorem Set.Ioo_eq_singleton_iff : Ioo a b = {c} ↔ a ⋖ c ∧ c ⋖ b where
  mp h
proof:
:= by
    simp_rw [Set.ext_iff, mem_Ioo, mem_singleton_iff] at h
    have ⟨hac, hcb⟩ := (h c).mpr rfl
    exact ⟨⟨hac, fun d had hdc ↦ hdc.ne ((h d).mp ⟨had, hdc.trans hcb⟩)⟩,
      ⟨hcb, fun d hcd hdb ↦ hcd.ne ((h d).mp ⟨hac.trans hcd, hdb⟩).symm⟩⟩
  mpr := fun ⟨hac, hcb⟩ ↦ by
    rw [← Ioc_union_Ico_eq_Ioo hac.lt hcb.lt, hac.Ioc_eq, hcb.Ico_eq, union_self]

name: Set.Ioi_eq_singleton_iff
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem Set.Ioi_eq_singleton_iff : Ioi a = {b} ↔ IsTop b ∧ a ⋖ b where
  mp h
proof:
:= by
    simp_rw [Set.ext_iff, mem_Ioi, mem_singleton_iff] at h
    have hb : a < b := (h b).mpr rfl
    exact ⟨fun c ↦ not_lt.mp fun hc ↦ hc.ne.symm ((h c).mp (hb.trans hc)),
      ⟨hb, fun c hac hcb ↦ hcb.ne ((h c).mp hac)⟩⟩
  mpr := fun ⟨hb, hab⟩ ↦ by
    cases b, hb using IsTop.rec; rwa [← Ioc_top, Ioc_eq_singleton_right_iff]

:= by

  have : c.2 = b := h₂.le.2.antisymm h₁.le.2
  rw [← @Prod.mk.eta _ _ c, this, mk_lt_mk_iff_left] at h₁ h₂
  exact h h₁ h₂

name: mk_wcovBy_mk_iff

theorem mk_wcovBy_mk_iff : (a₁, b₁) ⩿ (a₂, b₂) ↔ a₁ ⩿ a₂ ∧ b₁ = b₂ ∨ b₁ ⩿ b₂ ∧ a₁ = a₂
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain rfl | rfl : a₁ = a₂ ∨ b₁ = b₂ := fst_eq_or_snd_eq_of_wcovBy h
    · exact Or.inr ⟨mk_wcovBy_mk_iff_right.1 h, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨mk_wcovBy_mk_iff_left.1 h, rfl⟩
  · rintro (⟨h, rfl⟩ | ⟨h, rfl⟩)
    · exact mk_wcovBy_mk_iff_left.2 h
    · exact mk_wcovBy_mk_iff_right.2 h

proof:

    · exact Or.inr ⟨mk_covBy_mk_iff_right.1 h, rfl⟩

name: _root_.WCovBy.eval
statement:
@[to_dual self]
lemma _root_.WCovBy.eval (h : a ⩿ b) (i : ι) : a i ⩿ b i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨h.1 i, fun ci h₁ h₂ ↦ ?_⟩
  have hcb : Function.update a i ci ≤ b := by simpa [update_le_iff, h₂.le] using fun j hj ↦ h.1 j
  refine h.2 (by simpa) (lt_of_le_not_ge hcb ?_)
  simp [le_update_iff, h₂.not_ge]

name: exists_forall_antisymmRel_of_covBy
statement:
lemma exists_forall_antisymmRel_of_covBy (h : a ⋖ b) :
    ∃ i, ∀ j ≠ i, AntisymmRel (· ≤ ·) (a j) (b j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [CovBy, Pi.lt_def, not_and, and_imp, forall_exists_index, not_exists] at h
  obtain ⟨⟨hab, ⟨i, hi⟩⟩, h⟩ := h
  refine ⟨i, fun j hj ↦ ?_⟩
  let c : (i : ι) → α i := Function.update a i (b i)
  have h₁ : c ≤ b := by simpa [update_le_iff, c] using fun k hk ↦ hab k
  have h₂ : ¬ c j < b j := h (by simp [c, hi.le]) i (by simpa [c]) h₁ j
  exact ⟨hab j, by simpa [lt_iff_le_not_ge, hab j, c, hj] using h₂⟩

name: exists_forall_antisymmRel_of_wcovBy
statement:
lemma exists_forall_antisymmRel_of_wcovBy [Nonempty ι] (h : a ⩿ b) :
    ∃ i, ∀ j ≠ i, AntisymmRel (· ≤ ·) (a j) (b j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wcovBy_iff_covBy_or_le_and_le] at h
  obtain h | h := h
  · exact exists_forall_antisymmRel_of_covBy h
  · inhabit ι
    exact ⟨default, fun j hj ↦ ⟨h.left j, h.right j⟩⟩

name: wcovBy_iff_antisymmRel
statement:
lemma wcovBy_iff_antisymmRel [Nonempty ι] :
    a ⩿ b ↔ ∃ i, a i ⩿ b i ∧ ∀ j ≠ i, AntisymmRel (· ≤ ·) (a j) (b j)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_forall_antisymmRel_of_wcovBy h
    exact ⟨i, h.eval _, hi⟩
  rintro ⟨i, hab, h⟩
  refine ⟨fun j ↦ (eq_or_ne j i).elim (· ▸ hab.1) (h j · |>.1), fun c hac hcb ↦ ?_⟩
  have haci : a i < c i := by
    obtain ⟨hac, j, hj⟩ := Pi.lt_def.1 hac
    exact (eq_or_ne j i).elim (· ▸ hj) fun hj' ↦
      ((lt_of_antisymmRel_of_lt (h j hj').symm hj).not_ge (hcb.le j)).elim
  have hcbi : c i < b i := by
    obtain ⟨hcb, j, hj⟩ := Pi.lt_def.1 hcb
    exact (eq_or_ne j i).elim (· ▸ hj) fun hj' ↦
      ((lt_of_lt_of_antisymmRel hj (h j hj').symm).not_ge (hac.le j)).elim
  exact hab.2 haci hcbi

name: covBy_iff_antisymmRel
statement:
lemma covBy_iff_antisymmRel :
    a ⋖ b ↔ ∃ i, a i ⋖ b i ∧ ∀ j ≠ i, AntisymmRel (· ≤ ·) (a j) (b j)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := (Pi.lt_def.1 h.1).2
    have : Nonempty ι := ⟨j⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_forall_antisymmRel_of_wcovBy h.wcovBy
    obtain rfl : i = j := by_contra fun this ↦ (hi j (Ne.symm this)).2.not_gt hj
    exact ⟨i, covBy_iff_wcovBy_and_lt.2 ⟨h.wcovBy.eval i, hj⟩, hi⟩
  rintro ⟨i, hi, h⟩
  have : Nonempty ι := ⟨i⟩
  refine covBy_iff_wcovBy_and_lt.2 ⟨wcovBy_iff_antisymmRel.2 ⟨i, hi.wcovBy, h⟩, ?_⟩
  exact Pi.lt_def.2 ⟨fun j ↦ (eq_or_ne j i).elim (· ▸ hi.1.le) (h j · |>.1), i, hi.1⟩

name: exists_subset_accumulate_of_directed
statement:
lemma exists_subset_accumulate_of_directed {s : ℕ → Set α}
  (hd : Directed (· ⊆ ·) s) (n : ℕ) : ∃ m, accumulate s n ⊆ s m
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => use 0; simp [accumulate_def]
  | succ n hn =>
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hn
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hd m (n + 1)
    simp at hk
    exact ⟨k, by simp; grind⟩

    (∃ n, accumulate s n = univ) ↔ ∃ n, s n = univ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun ⟨n, hn⟩ ↦ ⟨n,
    subset_antisymm (subset_univ _) (hn.symm.le.trans subset_accumulate)⟩⟩
  contrapose!
  intro h n
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_subset_accumulate_of_directed hd n
  grind

name: Preorder.toLE_injective
statement:
@[ext]
lemma Preorder.toLE_injective : Function.Injective (@Preorder.toLE α)
proof:
:=
  fun
  | { lt := A_lt, lt_iff_le_not_ge := A_iff, .. },
    { lt := B_lt, lt_iff_le_not_ge := B_iff, .. } => by
    rintro ⟨⟩
    have : A_lt = B_lt := by
      funext a b
      rw [A_iff, B_iff]
    cases this
    congr

name: LinearOrder.toPartialOrder_injective
statement:
@[ext]
lemma LinearOrder.toPartialOrder_injective : Function.Injective (@LinearOrder.toPartialOrder α)
proof:
:=
  fun
  | { le := A_le, lt := A_lt,
      toDecidableLE := A_decidableLE, toDecidableEq := A_decidableEq, toDecidableLT := A_decidableLT
      min := A_min, max := A_max, min_def := A_min_def, max_def := A_max_def,
      compare := A_compare, compare_eq_compareOfLessAndEq := A_compare_canonical, .. },
    { le := B_le, lt := B_lt,
      toDecidableLE := B_decidableLE, toDecidableEq := B_decidableEq, toDecidableLT := B_decidableLT
      min := B_min, max := B_max, min_def := B_min_def, max_def := B_max_def,
      compare := B_compare, compare_eq_compareOfLessAndEq := B_compare_canonical, .. } => by
    rintro ⟨⟩
    obtain rfl : A_decidableLE = B_decidableLE := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    obtain rfl : A_decidableEq = B_decidableEq := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    obtain rfl : A_decidableLT = B_decidableLT := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    have : A_min = B_min := by
      funext a b
      exact (A_min_def _ _).trans (B_min_def _ _).symm
    cases this
    have : A_max = B_max := by
      funext a b
      exact (A_max_def _ _).trans (B_max_def _ _).symm
    cases this
    have : A_compare = B_compare := by
      funext a b
      exact (A_compare_canonical _ _).trans (B_compare_canonical _ _).symm
    congr

  · grind

  · rintro (⟨h₁, h₂⟩ | ⟨h₁, h₂⟩)
    · exact ⟨⟨h₁.le, h₂⟩, fun h ↦ h₁.not_ge h.1⟩

name: eq_or_eq_or_eq_of_forall_not_lt_lt

  exacts [h h₁ h₂, h h₂ h₃, h h₃ h₂, h h₃ h₁, h h₁ h₃, h h₂ h₃, h h₁ h₃, h h₂ h₁]

name: atomistic
statement: lemma atomistic (hS : BooleanGenerators S) (a : α) (ha : a ≤ sSup S) : ∃ T ⊆ S, a = sSup T
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, rfl⟩ := IsCompactlyGenerated.exists_sSup_eq a
  have aux : ∀ b : α, IsCompactElement b → b ≤ sSup S → ∃ T ⊆ S, b = sSup T := by
    intro b hb hbS
    obtain ⟨s, hs₁, hs₂⟩ := (isCompactElement_iff_exists_le_sSup_of_le_sSup b).1 hb S hbS
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hS.finitelyAtomistic s b hs₁ hb hs₂
    refine ⟨t, ?_, Finset.sup_id_eq_sSup t⟩
    refine Set.Subset.trans ?_ hs₁
    simpa only [Finset.coe_subset] using ht
  choose T hT₁ hT₂ using aux
  use sSup {T c h₁ h₂ | (c ∈ C) (h₁ : IsCompactElement c) (h₂ : c ≤ sSup S)}
  constructor
  · apply _root_.sSup_le
    rintro _ ⟨c, -, h₁, h₂, rfl⟩
    apply hT₁
  · apply le_antisymm
    · apply _root_.sSup_le
      intro c hc
      rw [hT₂ c (hC _ hc) ((le_sSup hc).trans ha)]
      apply sSup_le_sSup
      apply _root_.le_sSup
      use c, hc, hC _ hc, (le_sSup hc).trans ha
    · simp only [Set.sSup_eq_sUnion, sSup_le_iff, Set.mem_sUnion, Set.mem_ofPred_eq,
        forall_exists_index, and_imp]
      rintro a T b hbC hb hbS rfl haT
      apply (le_sSup haT).trans
      rw [← hT₂]
      exact le_sSup hbC

name: isAtomistic_of_sSup_eq_top
statement:
lemma isAtomistic_of_sSup_eq_top (hS : BooleanGenerators S) (h : sSup S = ⊤) :
    IsAtomistic α
proof:
:= by
  refine CompleteLattice.isAtomistic_iff.2 fun a ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hs'⟩ := hS.atomistic a (h ▸ le_top)
  exact ⟨s, hs', fun I hI ↦ hS.isAtom I (hs hI)⟩

name: mem_of_isAtom_of_le_sSup_atoms
statement:
lemma mem_of_isAtom_of_le_sSup_atoms (hS : BooleanGenerators S) (a : α) (ha : IsAtom a)
    (haS : a ≤ sSup S) : a ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, hT, rfl⟩ := hS.atomistic a haS
  obtain rfl | ⟨a, haT⟩ := T.eq_empty_or_nonempty
  · simp only [sSup_empty] at ha
    exact (ha.1 rfl).elim
  suffices sSup T = a from this ▸ hT haT
  have : a ≤ sSup T := le_sSup haT
  rwa [ha.le_iff_eq, eq_comm] at this
  exact (hS.isAtom a (hT haT)).1

name: sSup_inter
statement:
lemma sSup_inter (hS : BooleanGenerators S) {T₁ T₂ : Set α} (hT₁ : T₁ ⊆ S) (hT₂ : T₂ ⊆ S) :
    sSup (T₁ ∩ T₂) = (sSup T₁) ⊓ (sSup T₂)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply le_inf
    · apply sSup_le_sSup Set.inter_subset_left
    · apply sSup_le_sSup Set.inter_subset_right
  obtain ⟨X, hX, hX'⟩ := hS.atomistic (sSup T₁ ⊓ sSup T₂) (inf_le_left.trans (sSup_le_sSup hT₁))
  rw [hX']
  apply _root_.sSup_le
  intro I hI
  apply _root_.le_sSup
  constructor
  · apply (hS.mono hT₁).mem_of_isAtom_of_le_sSup_atoms _ _ _
    · exact (hS.mono hX).isAtom I hI
    · exact (_root_.le_sSup hI).trans (hX'.ge.trans inf_le_left)
  · apply (hS.mono hT₂).mem_of_isAtom_of_le_sSup_atoms _ _ _
    · exact (hS.mono hX).isAtom I hI
    · exact (_root_.le_sSup hI).trans (hX'.ge.trans inf_le_right)

:= by

lemma sSup_le_sSup_iff_of_atoms (hS : BooleanGenerators S) (X Y : Set α) (hX : X ⊆ S) (hY : Y ⊆ S) :
    sSup X ≤ sSup Y ↔ X ⊆ Y
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, sSup_le_sSup⟩
  intro h a ha
  apply (hS.mono hY).mem_of_isAtom_of_le_sSup_atoms _ _ ((le_sSup ha).trans h)

  apply le_antisymm
  · exact hS.isAtom
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨T, hT, rfl⟩ := hS.atomistic a (le_top.trans h.ge)
  exact hS.mem_of_isAtom_of_le_sSup_atoms _ ha (sSup_le_sSup hT)

:= by
  ext a
  simp only [mem_upperBounds, Set.forall_mem_range, partialSups_le_iff]
  exact ⟨fun h _ ↦ h _ _ le_rfl, fun h _ _ _ ↦ h _⟩

name: bddAbove_range_partialSups
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bddAbove_range_partialSups {f : ι → α} :
    BddAbove (Set.range (partialSups f)) ↔ BddAbove (Set.range f)

name: Monotone.partialSups_eq
statement:
theorem Monotone.partialSups_eq {f : ι → α} (hf : Monotone f) :
    partialSups f = f

name: partialSups_mono
statement:
theorem partialSups_mono :
    Monotone (partialSups : (ι → α) → ι →o α)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h _ ↦ partialSups_le_iff.2 fun j hj ↦ (h j).trans (le_partialSups_of_le _ hj)

name: partialSups_monotone
statement:
lemma partialSups_monotone (f : ι → α) :
    Monotone (partialSups f)
proof:
:=
  fun i _ hnm ↦ partialSups_le f i _ (fun _ hm'n ↦ le_partialSups_of_le _ (hm'n.trans hnm))

name: Pi.partialSups_apply
statement:
protected lemma Pi.partialSups_apply {τ : Type*} {π : τ → Type*} [∀ t, SemilatticeSup (π t)]
    (f : ι → (t : τ) → π t) (i : ι) (t : τ) :
    partialSups f i t = partialSups (f · t) i

name: comp_partialSups
statement:
lemma comp_partialSups {F : Type*} [FunLike F α β] [SupHomClass F α β] (f : ι → α) (g : F) :
    partialSups (g ∘ f) = g ∘ partialSups f

name: map_partialSups
statement:
lemma map_partialSups {F : Type*} [FunLike F α β] [SupHomClass F α β] (f : F) (g : ι → α) (i : ι) :
    partialSups (fun j ↦ f (g j)) i = f (partialSups g i)

name: partialSups_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem partialSups_succ [LinearOrder ι] [LocallyFiniteOrderBot ι] [SuccOrder ι]
    (f : ι → α) (i : ι) :
    partialSups f (Order.succ i) = partialSups f i ⊔ f (Order.succ i)
proof:
:= by
  suffices Iic (Order.succ i) = Iic i ∪ {Order.succ i} by simp only [partialSups_apply, this,
    sup'_union nonempty_Iic ⟨_, mem_singleton_self _⟩ f, sup'_singleton]
  ext
  simp only [mem_Iic, mem_union, mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · exact fun h ↦ (Order.le_succ_iff_eq_or_le.mp h).symm
  · exact fun h ↦ h.elim (le_trans · <| Order.le_succ _) le_of_eq

name: partialSups_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem partialSups_bot [PartialOrder ι] [LocallyFiniteOrder ι] [OrderBot ι]
    (f : ι → α) : partialSups f ⊥ = f ⊥
proof:
:= by
  simp only [partialSups_apply]
  
  suffices Iic (⊥ : ι) = {⊥} by simp only [this, sup'_singleton]
  simp only [← coe_eq_singleton, coe_Iic, Set.Iic_bot]

name: partialSups_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem partialSups_zero (f : ℕ → α) : partialSups f 0 = f 0

name: partialSups_eq_sup'_range
statement:
theorem partialSups_eq_sup'_range (f : ℕ → α) (n : ℕ) :

statement:

lemma disjoint_partialSups_left {f : ι → α} {i : ι} {x : α} :

name: partialSups_eq_ciSup_Iic
statement:
theorem partialSups_eq_ciSup_Iic [ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] (f : ι → α) (i : ι) :
    partialSups f i = ⨆ i : Set.Iic i, f i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [partialSups_apply]
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact sup'_le _ _ fun j hj ↦ Finite.le_ciSup_of_le
      ⟨j, by simpa only [Set.mem_Iic, mem_Iic] using hj⟩ le_rfl
  · exact ciSup_le fun ⟨j, hj⟩ ↦ le_sup' f (by simpa only [mem_Iic, Set.mem_Iic] using hj)

name: ciSup_partialSups_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ciSup_partialSups_eq [ConditionallyCompleteLattice α]
    {f : ι → α} (h : BddAbove (Set.range f)) :
    ⨆ i, partialSups f i = ⨆ i, f i
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hι : Nonempty ι
  · refine (ciSup_le fun i ↦ ?_).antisymm (ciSup_mono ?_ <| le_partialSups f)
    · simpa only [partialSups_eq_ciSup_Iic] using ciSup_le fun i ↦ le_ciSup h _
    · rwa [bddAbove_range_partialSups]
  · exact congr_arg _ (funext (not_nonempty_iff.mp hι).elim)

name: ciSup_partialSups_eq'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ciSup_partialSups_eq' [ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder α] (f : ι → α) :
    ⨆ i, partialSups f i = ⨆ i, f i
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : BddAbove (Set.range f)
  · exact ciSup_partialSups_eq h
  · rw [iSup, iSup, ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder.csSup_of_not_bddAbove _ h,
      ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder.csSup_of_not_bddAbove _
        (bddAbove_range_partialSups.not.mpr h)]

name: iSup_partialSups_eq
statement:
theorem iSup_partialSups_eq (f : ι → α) :
    ⨆ i, partialSups f i = ⨆ i, f i

name: partialSups_eq_biSup
statement:
theorem partialSups_eq_biSup (f : ι → α) (i : ι) :
    partialSups f i = ⨆ j ≤ i, f j
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [iSup_subtype] using! partialSups_eq_ciSup_Iic f i

name: iSup_le_iSup_of_partialSups_le_partialSups
statement:
theorem iSup_le_iSup_of_partialSups_le_partialSups {f g : ι → α}
    (h : partialSups f ≤ partialSups g) : ⨆ i, f i ≤ ⨆ i, g i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← iSup_partialSups_eq f, ← iSup_partialSups_eq g]
  exact iSup_mono h

name: iSup_eq_iSup_of_partialSups_eq_partialSups
statement:
theorem iSup_eq_iSup_of_partialSups_eq_partialSups {f g : ι → α}
    (h : partialSups f = partialSups g) : ⨆ i, f i = ⨆ i, g i
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← iSup_partialSups_eq f, ← iSup_partialSups_eq g, h]

name: partialSups_eq_sUnion_image
statement:
lemma partialSups_eq_sUnion_image (s : ℕ → Set α) (n : ℕ) :
    partialSups s n = ⋃₀ ↑((Finset.range (n + 1)).image s)

name: partialSups_eq_biUnion_range
statement:
lemma partialSups_eq_biUnion_range (s : ℕ → Set α) (n : ℕ) :
    partialSups s n = ⋃ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), s i

name: exists_partialSups_eq
statement:
theorem exists_partialSups_eq (f : ι → α) (i : ι) :
    ∃ j ≤ i, partialSups f i = f j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj_mem, hj_le⟩ : ∃ j ∈ Finset.Iic i, ∀ k ∈ Finset.Iic i, f k ≤ f j :=
    Finset.exists_max_image _ _ ⟨i, Finset.mem_Iic.mpr le_rfl⟩
  simp only [Finset.mem_Iic] at hj_mem hj_le
  use j, hj_mem
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact partialSups_le _ _ _ fun k hk => hj_le k hk
  · exact le_partialSups_of_le f hj_mem

name: cmpLE_swap
statement:
theorem cmpLE_swap {α} [LE α] [@Std.Total α (· ≤ ·)] [DecidableLE α] (x y : α) :
    (cmpLE x y).swap = cmpLE y x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases xy : x ≤ y <;> by_cases yx : y ≤ x <;> simp [cmpLE, *, Ordering.swap]
  cases not_or_intro xy yx (total_of _ _ _)

proof:

statement: theorem compares_swap [LT α] {a b : α} {o : Ordering} : o.swap.Compares a b ↔ o.Compares b a
proof:
:= by
  cases o
  · exact Iff.rfl
  · exact eq_comm
  · exact Iff.rfl

name: swap_eq_iff_eq_swap
statement: theorem swap_eq_iff_eq_swap {o o' : Ordering} : o.swap = o' ↔ o = o'.swap

name: Compares.eq_lt
statement:
theorem Compares.eq_lt [Preorder α] : ∀ {o} {a b : α}, Compares o a b → (o = lt ↔ a < b)
  | lt, _, _, h => ⟨fun _ => h, fun _ => rfl⟩
  | eq, a, b, h => ⟨fun h => by injection h, fun h' => (ne_of_lt h' h).elim⟩
  | gt, a, b, h => ⟨fun h => by injection h, fun h' => (lt_asymm h h').elim⟩

name: Compares.ne_lt
statement:
theorem Compares.ne_lt [Preorder α] : ∀ {o} {a b : α}, Compares o a b → (o ≠ lt ↔ b ≤ a)
  | lt, _, _, h => ⟨absurd rfl, fun h' => (not_le_of_gt h h').elim⟩
  | eq, _, _, h => ⟨fun _ => ge_of_eq h, fun _ h => by injection h⟩
  | gt, _, _, h => ⟨fun _ => le_of_lt h, fun _ h => by injection h⟩

name: Compares.eq_eq
statement:
theorem Compares.eq_eq [Preorder α] : ∀ {o} {a b : α}, Compares o a b → (o = eq ↔ a = b)
  | lt, a, b, h => ⟨fun h => by injection h, fun h' => (ne_of_lt h h').elim⟩
  | eq, _, _, h => ⟨fun _ => h, fun _ => rfl⟩
  | gt, a, b, h => ⟨fun h => by injection h, fun h' => (ne_of_gt h h').elim⟩

name: Compares.eq_gt
statement: theorem Compares.eq_gt [Preorder α] {o} {a b : α} (h : Compares o a b) : o = gt ↔ b < a

name: Compares.ne_gt
statement: theorem Compares.ne_gt [Preorder α] {o} {a b : α} (h : Compares o a b) : o ≠ gt ↔ a ≤ b

name: Compares.le_total
statement:
theorem Compares.le_total [Preorder α] {a b : α} : ∀ {o}, Compares o a b → a ≤ b ∨ b ≤ a
  | lt, h => Or.inl (le_of_lt h)
  | eq, h => Or.inl (le_of_eq h)
  | gt, h => Or.inr (le_of_lt h)

name: Compares.le_antisymm
statement:
theorem Compares.le_antisymm [Preorder α] {a b : α} : ∀ {o}, Compares o a b → a ≤ b → b ≤ a → a = b
  | lt, h, _, hba => (not_le_of_gt h hba).elim
  | eq, h, _, _ => h
  | gt, h, hab, _ => (not_le_of_gt h hab).elim

name: Compares.inj
statement:
theorem Compares.inj [Preorder α] {o₁} :
    ∀ {o₂} {a b : α}, Compares o₁ a b → Compares o₂ a b → o₁ = o₂
  | lt, _, _, h₁, h₂ => h₁.eq_lt.2 h₂
  | eq, _, _, h₁, h₂ => h₁.eq_eq.2 h₂
  | gt, _, _, h₁, h₂ => h₁.eq_gt.2 h₂

name: compares_iff_of_compares_impl
statement:
theorem compares_iff_of_compares_impl [LinearOrder α] [Preorder β] {a b : α} {a' b' : β}
    (h : ∀ {o}, Compares o a b → Compares o a' b') (o) : Compares o a b ↔ Compares o a' b'
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨h, fun ho => ?_⟩
  rcases lt_trichotomy a b with hab | hab | hab
  · have hab : Compares Ordering.lt a b := hab
    rwa [ho.inj (h hab)]
  · have hab : Compares Ordering.eq a b := hab
    rwa [ho.inj (h hab)]
  · have hab : Compares Ordering.gt a b := hab
    rwa [ho.inj (h hab)]

name: mk_monotone

name: lift_monotone
statement:
theorem lift_monotone {α β : Type*} [Preorder α] {s : Setoid α} [Preorder β]
    (f : α → β) (hf : Monotone f) (H : ∀ x₁ x₂, x₁ ≈ x₂ → f x₁ = f x₂) :
    Monotone (Quotient.lift f H)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  induction x using Quotient.inductionOn with | h x
  induction y using Quotient.inductionOn with | h y
  induction h
  on_goal 2 => rename_i IH; apply IH.trans
  all_goals
    rename_i h
    cases h with
    | inl h => exact hf h
    | inr h => exact (H _ _ h).le

name: mk_le_mk
statement: theorem mk_le_mk {x y : α} : Quotient.mk s x ≤ Quotient.mk s y ↔ x ≤ y ∨ x ≈ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← propext_iff]
  revert x y
  apply congrFun₂ <| @Relation.transGen_eq_self α _ ⟨fun x y z h₁ h₂ ↦ ?_⟩
  cases h₁ <;> cases h₂ <;> rename_i h₁ h₂
  · exact .inl <| h₁.trans h₂
  · rw [or_iff_not_imp_left, not_le]
    rw [← Quotient.eq_iff_equiv] at *
    exact fun h ↦ ((H _).out h₂.symm rfl ⟨h.le, h₁⟩).trans h₂
  · rw [or_iff_not_imp_left, not_le]
    rw [← Quotient.eq_iff_equiv] at *
    exact fun h ↦ ((H _).out h₁.symm rfl ⟨h₂, h.le⟩).symm
  · exact .inr (_root_.trans h₁ h₂)

@[simp]
theorem mem_toIdeal {I : Set P} (h : IsIdeal I) {a : P} : a ∈ h.toIdeal ↔ a ∈ I

name: coe_toIdeal

@[simp]

name: toIdeal_le

theorem toIdeal_le {I : Set P} (h : IsIdeal I) {J : Ideal P} : h.toIdeal ≤ J ↔ I ⊆ J

name: le_toIdeal

theorem le_toIdeal {I : Set P} (h : IsIdeal I) {J : Ideal P} : J ≤ h.toIdeal ↔ (J : Set P) ⊆ I

name: isProper_of_notMem
statement: theorem isProper_of_notMem {I : Ideal P} {p : P} (notMem : p ∉ I) : IsProper I
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hp ↦ by
    have := mem_univ p
    rw [← hp] at this
    exact notMem this⟩

name: inter_nonempty
statement: theorem inter_nonempty [IsCodirectedOrder P] (I J : Ideal P) : (I ∩ J : Set P).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := I.nonempty
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := J.nonempty
  obtain ⟨c, hac, hbc⟩ := exists_le_le a b
  exact ⟨c, I.lower hac ha, J.lower hbc hb⟩

theorem top_toLowerSet : (⊤ : Ideal P).toLowerSet = ⊤

name: coe_top

name: IsProper.ne_top
statement: theorem IsProper.ne_top (_ : IsProper I) : I ≠ ⊤

name: sup_mem
statement: theorem sup_mem (hx : x ∈ s) (hy : y ∈ s) : x ⊔ y ∈ s
proof:
:=
  let ⟨_, hz, hx, hy⟩ := s.directed x hx y hy
  s.lower (sup_le hx hy) hz

name: sup_mem_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sup_mem_iff : x ⊔ y ∈ I ↔ x ∈ I ∧ y ∈ I
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨I.lower le_sup_left h, I.lower le_sup_right h⟩, fun h ↦ sup_mem h.1 h.2⟩

name: finsetSup_mem_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma finsetSup_mem_iff {P : Type*} [SemilatticeSup P] [OrderBot P]

proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on <;> simp [*]

name: coe_sup

name: eq_sup_of_le_sup
statement:
theorem eq_sup_of_le_sup {x i j : P} (hi : i ∈ I) (hj : j ∈ J) (hx : x ≤ i ⊔ j) :
    ∃ i' ∈ I, ∃ j' ∈ J, x = i' ⊔ j'
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨x ⊓ i, I.lower inf_le_right hi, x ⊓ j, J.lower inf_le_right hj, ?_⟩
  calc
    x = x ⊓ (i ⊔ j) := left_eq_inf.mpr hx
    _ = x ⊓ i ⊔ x ⊓ j := inf_sup_left _ _ _

name: coe_sup_eq
statement: theorem coe_sup_eq : ↑(I ⊔ J) = { x | ∃ i ∈ I, ∃ j ∈ J, x = i ⊔ j }

name: IsProper.notMem_of_compl_mem
statement: theorem IsProper.notMem_of_compl_mem (hI : IsProper I) (hxc : xᶜ ∈ I) : x ∉ I
proof:
:= by
  intro hx
  apply hI.top_notMem
  have ht : x ⊔ xᶜ ∈ I := sup_mem ‹_› ‹_›
  rwa [sup_compl_eq_top] at ht

name: IsProper.notMem_or_compl_notMem
statement: theorem IsProper.notMem_or_compl_notMem (hI : IsProper I) : x ∉ I ∨ xᶜ ∉ I
proof:
:= by
  have h : xᶜ ∈ I → x ∉ I := hI.notMem_of_compl_mem
  tauto

name: biSup_mem_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem biSup_mem_iff {α : Type*} {f : α → P} {s : Set α} (hs : s.Finite) :
    ⨆ i ∈ s, f i ∈ I ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  induction s, hs using Finite.induction_on with simp [↓iSup_insert, sup_mem_iff, *]

name: biSup_finset_mem_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem biSup_finset_mem_iff {α : Type*} {f : α → P} {s : Finset α} :

name: iSup_mem_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iSup_mem_iff {α : Sort*} [Finite α] {f : α → P} : ⨆ i, f i ∈ I ↔ ∀ i, f i ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  simpa [← Equiv.plift.symm.iSup_comp, Equiv.plift.forall_congr_left]
    using biSup_mem_iff (f := f ∘ PLift.down) Set.finite_univ

name: sequenceOfCofinals.monotone
statement: theorem sequenceOfCofinals.monotone : Monotone (sequenceOfCofinals p 𝒟)
proof:

  apply monotone_nat_of_le_succ
  intro n
  dsimp only [sequenceOfCofinals, Nat.add]
  cases (Encodable.decode n : Option ι)
  · rfl
  · apply Cofinal.le_above

name: isIdeal_sUnion_of_directedOn
statement:
lemma isIdeal_sUnion_of_directedOn {C : Set (Set P)} (hidl : ∀ I ∈ C, IsIdeal I)
    (hD : DirectedOn (· ⊆ ·) C) (hNe : C.Nonempty) : IsIdeal C.sUnion
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨isLowerSet_sUnion (fun I hI ↦ (hidl I hI).1), Set.nonempty_sUnion.2 ?_,
    directedOn_sUnion hD (fun J hJ => (hidl J hJ).3)⟩
  let ⟨I, hI⟩ := hNe
  exact ⟨I, ⟨hI, (hidl I hI).2⟩⟩

name: IsProper.exists_le_maximal
statement:
theorem IsProper.exists_le_maximal [LE P] [OrderTop P] {I : Ideal P} (hI : I.IsProper) :
    ∃ J, I ≤ J ∧ J.IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  rcases IsCoatomic.eq_top_or_exists_le_coatom I with rfl | ⟨J, hJ, hJ'⟩
  · simp [isProper_iff_ne_top] at hI
  · exact ⟨J, hJ', isMaximal_iff_isCoatom.2 hJ⟩

name: exists_maximal
statement:
theorem exists_maximal [PartialOrder P] [OrderTop P] [Nontrivial P] :
    ∃ (I : Ideal P), I.IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_ne (⊤ : P) with ⟨a, ha⟩
  rw [← isProper_principal_iff] at ha
  rcases ha.exists_le_maximal with ⟨I, -, hI⟩
  exact ⟨I, hI⟩

name: acc_def
statement:
theorem acc_def {α} {r : α → α → Prop} {a : α} : Acc r a ↔ ∀ b, r b a → Acc r b where
  mp h
proof:
:= h.rec fun _ h _ ↦ h
  mpr := .intro a

name: exists_not_acc_lt_of_not_acc
statement: theorem exists_not_acc_lt_of_not_acc {α} {a : α} {r} (h : ¬Acc r a) : ∃ b, ¬Acc r b ∧ r b a
proof:
:= by
  rw [acc_def] at h
  push Not at h
  simpa only [and_comm]

name: not_acc_iff_exists_descending_chain
statement:
theorem not_acc_iff_exists_descending_chain {α} {r : α → α → Prop} {x : α} :
    ¬Acc r x ↔ ∃ f : ℕ → α, f 0 = x ∧ ∀ n, r (f (n + 1)) (f n) where
  mp hx
proof:
:= let f : ℕ → {a : α // ¬Acc r a} :=
      Nat.rec ⟨x, hx⟩ fun _ a ↦ ⟨_, (exists_not_acc_lt_of_not_acc a.2).choose_spec.1⟩
    ⟨(f · |>.1), rfl, fun n ↦ (exists_not_acc_lt_of_not_acc (f n).2).choose_spec.2⟩
  mpr h acc := acc.rec
    (fun _x _ ih ⟨f, hf⟩ ↦ ih (f 1) (hf.1 ▸ hf.2 0) ⟨(f <| · + 1), rfl, fun _ ↦ hf.2 _⟩) h

name: acc_iff_isEmpty_descending_chain
statement:
theorem acc_iff_isEmpty_descending_chain {α} {r : α → α → Prop} {x : α} :
    Acc r x ↔ IsEmpty { f : ℕ → α // f 0 = x ∧ ∀ n, r (f (n + 1)) (f n) }

name: wellFounded_iff_isEmpty_descending_chain
statement:
theorem wellFounded_iff_isEmpty_descending_chain {α} {r : α → α → Prop} :
    WellFounded r ↔ IsEmpty { f : ℕ → α // ∀ n, r (f (n + 1)) (f n) } where
  mp
proof:
:= fun ⟨h⟩ ↦ ⟨fun ⟨f, hf⟩ ↦ (acc_iff_isEmpty_descending_chain.mp (h (f 0))).false ⟨f, rfl, hf⟩⟩
  mpr h := ⟨fun _ ↦ acc_iff_isEmpty_descending_chain.mpr ⟨fun ⟨f, hf⟩ ↦ h.false ⟨f, hf.2⟩⟩⟩

name: has_min
statement:
theorem has_min {α} {r : α → α → Prop} (H : WellFounded r) (s : Set α) :
    s.Nonempty → ∃ a ∈ s, ∀ x ∈ s, ¬r x a
  | ⟨a, ha⟩ => show ∃ b ∈ s, ∀ x ∈ s, ¬r x b from
    Acc.recOn (H.apply a) (fun x _ IH =>
        not_imp_not.1 fun hne hx => hne <| ⟨x, hx, fun y hy hyx => hne <| IH y hyx hy⟩)
      ha

name: not_rightTotal
statement: theorem not_rightTotal (wf : WellFounded r) [Nonempty α] : ¬ Relator.RightTotal r
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨a, -, ha⟩ := wf.has_min Set.univ Set.univ_nonempty
  obtain ⟨b, hba⟩ := h a
  specialize ha b (Set.mem_univ b)
  contradiction

name: not_leftTotal
statement:
theorem not_leftTotal (wf : WellFounded (Function.swap r)) [Nonempty α] :
    ¬ Relator.LeftTotal r
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨a, -, ha⟩ := wf.has_min Set.univ Set.univ_nonempty
  obtain ⟨b, hab⟩ := h a
  specialize ha b (Set.mem_univ b)
  contradiction

name: min_eq_of_forall_not_lt
statement:
theorem min_eq_of_forall_not_lt [Std.Trichotomous r] (wf : WellFounded r) {s : Set α} {m : α}
    (hms : m ∈ s) (hrm : ∀ x ∈ s, ¬r x m) : wf.min s ⟨m, hms⟩ = m
proof:
:=
  Std.Trichotomous.trichotomous _ m (hrm _ <| wf.min_mem s _) (wf.not_lt_min s hms)

theorem notMem_of_lt_min {wf : WellFounded r} {s : Set α} {hs : s.Nonempty} {x : α}
