name: wellFounded_iff_has_min
statement:
theorem wellFounded_iff_has_min {r : α → α → Prop} :
    WellFounded r ↔ ∀ s : Set α, s.Nonempty → ∃ m ∈ s, ∀ x ∈ s, ¬r x m
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => h.has_min, fun h => ⟨fun x => ?_⟩⟩
  by_contra hx
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hm'⟩ := h {x | ¬Acc r x} ⟨x, hx⟩
  refine hm ⟨_, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  by_contra hy'
  exact hm' y hy' hy

name: wellFoundedLT_iff_exists_minimal
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem wellFoundedLT_iff_exists_minimal [Preorder α] :
    WellFoundedLT α ↔ ∀ s : Set α, s.Nonempty → ∃ m, Minimal (· ∈ s) m
proof:
:= by
  simp only [isWellFounded_iff, wellFounded_iff_has_min, not_lt_iff_le_imp_ge, Minimal]

name: minimal_wellFounded_lt_min
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem minimal_wellFounded_lt_min [Preorder α] [WellFoundedLT α] {s : Set α} (h : s.Nonempty) :
    Minimal (· ∈ s) (wellFounded_lt.min s h)

name: isWellOrder_iff_exists_not_lt_and_eq_or_gt
statement:
theorem isWellOrder_iff_exists_not_lt_and_eq_or_gt :
    IsWellOrder α r ↔ ∀ s : Set α, s.Nonempty → ∃ m ∈ s, ∀ x ∈ s, ¬r x m ∧ (m = x ∨ r m x)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h s hs ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ { wf := ?_, trichotomous a b := ?_ }⟩
  · grind [h.wf.has_min, trichotomous_of r]
  · grind [wellFounded_iff_has_min]
  · grind [h {a, b} <| by simp]

name: min_image
statement:
theorem min_image {r : β → β → Prop} [Std.Trichotomous r] (wf : WellFounded r) (f : α → β)
    {s : Set α} (hne : s.Nonempty) :
    wf.min (f '' s) (hne.image f) = f (wf.onFun (f := f) |>.min s hne)
proof:
:= by
  apply min_eq_of_forall_not_lt wf <| Set.mem_image_of_mem f <| min_mem wf.onFun s hne
  rintro _ ⟨a, has, rfl⟩
  exact wf.onFun.not_lt_min s has

name: not_rel_apply_succ
statement: theorem not_rel_apply_succ [h : IsWellFounded α r] (f : ℕ → α) : ∃ n, ¬ r (f (n + 1)) (f n)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! hf
  exact (wellFounded_iff_isEmpty_descending_chain.1 h.wf).elim ⟨f, hf⟩

name: lt_sup
statement:
protected theorem lt_sup {r : α → α → Prop} (wf : WellFounded r) {s : Set α} (h : Bounded r s) {x}
    (hx : x ∈ s) : r x (wf.sup s h)
proof:
:=
  min_mem wf { x | ∀ a ∈ s, r a x } h x hx

@[to_dual le_max]
theorem WellFoundedLT.min_le [WellFoundedLT β] {x : β} {s : Set β} (hx : x ∈ s) :

name: WellFounded.min_le
Set.range_injOn_strictMono_of_wellFoundedLT
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf g hg hfg
  ext a
  apply WellFoundedLT.induction a
  intro a IH
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hfg ▸ mem_range_self a
  obtain h | rfl | h := lt_trichotomy b a
  · rw [← IH b h] at hb
    cases (hf.injective hb).not_lt h
  · rw [hb]
  · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hfg.symm ▸ mem_range_self a
    have := hg h
    rw [hb, ← hc, hf.lt_iff_lt] at this
    rw [IH c this] at hc
    cases (hg.injective hc).not_lt this

name: Set.range_injOn_strictAnti_of_wellFoundedGT
proof:
:=
  fun _ hf _ hg ↦ Set.range_injOn_strictMono_of_wellFoundedLT (β := βᵒᵈ) hf.dual hg.dual

StrictMono.id_le
statement: theorem StrictMono.id_le [WellFoundedLT β] {f : β → β} (hf : StrictMono f) : id ≤ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [Pi.le_def]
  by_contra! H
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hm'⟩ := wellFounded_lt.has_min {i | f i < i} H
  exact hm' _ (hf hm) hm

name: StrictMono.not_bddAbove_range_of_wellFoundedLT
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem StrictMono.not_bddAbove_range_of_wellFoundedLT {f : β → β} [WellFoundedLT β] [NoMaxOrder β]
    (hf : StrictMono f) : ¬ BddAbove (Set.range f)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_gt a
  exact ((hf.le_apply.trans_lt (hf hb)).trans_le <| ha (Set.mem_range_self _)).false

name: Acc.induction_bot'
statement:
theorem Acc.induction_bot' {α β} {r : α → α → Prop} {a bot : α} (ha : Acc r a) {C : β → Prop}
    {f : α → β} (ih : ∀ b, f b ≠ f bot → C (f b) → ∃ c, r c b ∧ C (f c)) : C (f a) → C (f bot)
proof:
:=
  (@Acc.recOn _ _ (fun x _ => C (f x) → C (f bot)) _ ha) fun x _ ih' hC =>
    (eq_or_ne (f x) (f bot)).elim (fun h => h ▸ hC) (fun h =>
      let ⟨y, hy₁, hy₂⟩ := ih x h hC
      ih' y hy₁ hy₂)

name: map_isSuccLimit
statement: theorem map_isSuccLimit (hf : IsNormal f) (ha : IsSuccLimit a) : IsSuccLimit (f a)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun b hb ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := not_isMin_iff.1 ha.not_isMin
    exact not_isMin_iff.2 ⟨_, hf.strictMono hb⟩
  · obtain ⟨c, hc, hc'⟩ := (hf.lt_iff_exists_lt ha).1 hb.lt
    have hc' := hb.ge_of_gt hc'
    rw [hf.strictMono.le_iff_le] at hc'
    exact hc.not_ge hc'

name: map_isLUB
statement:
theorem map_isLUB (hf : IsNormal f) {s : Set α} (hs : IsLUB s a) (hs' : s.Nonempty) :
    IsLUB (f '' s) (f a)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun b hb ↦ ?_⟩
  · simpa [mem_upperBounds, hf.strictMono.le_iff_le] using hs.1
  · by_cases ha : a ∈ s
    · simp_all [mem_upperBounds]
    · have ha' := hs.isSuccLimit_of_notMem hs' ha
      rw [le_iff_forall_le hf ha']
      intro c hc
      obtain ⟨d, hd, hcd, hda⟩ := hs.exists_between hc
      simp_rw [mem_upperBounds, forall_mem_image] at hb
      exact (hf.strictMono hcd).le.trans (hb hd)

  refine ⟨fun x y h ↦ hf.strictMono h, fun b hb c hc ↦ hf.2 (hb.subtypeVal (isLowerSet_Iio _)) ?_⟩
  simpa [upperBounds] using! fun d hd ↦ hc ⟨d, hd.trans b.2⟩ hd

name: iSup_iterate_mem_fixedPoints
statement:
theorem iSup_iterate_mem_fixedPoints [WellFoundedLT α] {f : α → α} (a : α) (hf : IsNormal f)
    (hf' : BddAbove (.range fun n ↦ f^[n] a)) : ⨆ n, f^[n] a ∈ f.fixedPoints
proof:
:= by
  rw [f.mem_fixedPoints_iff, hf.map_iSup hf']
  apply le_antisymm <;> refine ciSup_le fun n ↦ ?_
  · rw [← f.iterate_succ_apply']
    exact le_ciSup hf' _
  · apply hf.strictMono.le_apply.trans
    apply (le_ciSup (hf'.mono _) n)
    simp_rw [← f.iterate_succ_apply']
    grind

name: preimage_Iic
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun _ ↦ le_csSup h₂) (fun y hy ↦ ?_)
  obtain hy | rfl := hy.lt_or_eq
  · rw [lt_csSup_iff h₂ h₁] at hy
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hyz⟩ := hy
    exact (hf.strictMono hyz).le.trans hz
  · rw [mem_preimage, hf.map_sSup h₁ h₂]
    apply (csSup_le_csSup bddAbove_Iic _ (image_preimage_subset ..)).trans
    · rw [csSup_Iic]
    · simpa

name: apply_of_isSuccLimit
statement:
theorem apply_of_isSuccLimit (hf : IsNormal f) (ha : IsSuccLimit a) :
    f a = ⨆ b : Iio a, f b
proof:
:= by
  convert! map_iSup hf _
  · exact ha.iSup_Iio.symm
  · exact ⟨⊥, ha.bot_lt⟩
  · use a
    rintro _ ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩
    exact hx.le

name: of_succ_lt
statement:
theorem of_succ_lt
    (hs : ∀ a, f a < f (succ a)) (hl : ∀ {a}, IsSuccLimit a → IsLUB (f '' Iio a) (f a)) :
    IsNormal f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun a b ↦ ?_, fun ha ↦ (hl ha).2⟩
  induction b using SuccOrder.limitRecOn with
  | isMin b hb => exact hb.not_lt.elim
  | succ b hb IH =>
    intro hab
    obtain rfl | h := (lt_succ_iff_eq_or_lt_of_not_isMax hb).1 hab
    · exact hs a
    · exact (IH h).trans (hs b)
  | isSuccLimit b hb IH =>
    intro hab
    have hab' := hb.succ_lt hab
    exact (IH _ hab' (lt_succ_of_not_isMax hab.not_isMax)).trans_le
      ((hl hb).1 (mem_image_of_mem _ hab'))

name: ext_iff
statement:
theorem ext_iff [OrderBot α] {g : α → β} (hf : IsNormal f) (hg : IsNormal g) :
    f = g ↔ f ⊥ = g ⊥ ∧ ∀ a, f a = g a → f (succ a) = g (succ a)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp_all
  rintro ⟨H₁, H₂⟩
  ext a
  induction a using SuccOrder.limitRecOn with
  | isMin a ha => rw [ha.eq_bot, H₁]
  | succ a ha IH => exact H₂ a IH
  | isSuccLimit a ha IH =>
    apply (hf.isLUB_image_Iio_of_isSuccLimit ha).unique
    convert! hg.isLUB_image_Iio_of_isSuccLimit ha using 1
    aesop

name: exists_map_le_lt_map_succ_of_exists_ge
statement:
theorem exists_map_le_lt_map_succ_of_exists_ge [NoMaxOrder α] [OrderBot α] [WellFoundedLT β]
    {f : α → β} {x : β} (hf : IsNormal f) (hf' : ∃ y, x ≤ f y) (hx : f ⊥ ≤ x) :
    ∃ a, f a ≤ x ∧ x < f (succ a)
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty β := ⟨x⟩
  let := WellFoundedLT.toOrderBot β
  let := WellFoundedLT.conditionallyCompleteLinearOrderBot α
  let := WellFoundedLT.conditionallyCompleteLinearOrderBot β
  have H : BddAbove (f ⁻¹' Iic x) :=
    have ⟨y, hy⟩ := hf'
    ⟨y, fun z hz ↦ hf.strictMono.le_iff_le.1 <| hz.trans hy⟩
  refine ⟨sSup (f ⁻¹' Set.Iic x), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hf.le_iff_le_sSup ⟨⊥, hx⟩ H]
  · rw [← not_le, hf.le_iff_le_sSup ⟨⊥, hx⟩ H, not_le, lt_succ_iff]

name: dirSupClosed_range
statement: theorem dirSupClosed_range {f : α → α} (hf : IsNormal f) : DirSupClosed (range f)
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs hs₀ _ a ha
  have hf' : (f ⁻¹' s).Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hs₀
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hs hb
    exact ⟨c, hb⟩
  have : Nonempty α := ⟨a⟩
  let := WellFoundedLT.toOrderBot α
  let := WellFoundedLT.conditionallyCompleteLinearOrderBot α
  have hfl : IsLUB (f ⁻¹' s) (sSup (f ⁻¹' s)) :=
    isLUB_csSup hf' ⟨a, fun b hb ↦ hf.strictMono.le_apply.trans (ha.1 hb)⟩
  have ha' := hf.map_isLUB hfl hf'
  rw [image_preimage_eq_of_subset hs] at ha'
  obtain rfl := ha.unique ha'
  exact mem_range_self _

@[to_dual
/
elements satisfying `P`. -/]
theorem minimal_iff_isMin (hP : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, P y → x ≤ y → P x) : Minimal P x ↔ P x ∧ IsMin x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.prop, fun _ h' ↦ h.le_of_le (hP h.prop h') h'⟩, fun h ↦ ⟨h.1, fun _ _  h' ↦ h.2 h'⟩⟩

theorem Minimal.or (h : Minimal (fun x ↦ P x ∨ Q x) x) : Minimal P x ∨ Minimal Q x
proof:

  obtain ⟨h | h, hmin⟩ := h
  · exact .inl ⟨h, fun y hy hyx ↦ hmin (Or.inl hy) hyx⟩
  exact .inr ⟨h, fun y hy hyx ↦ hmin (Or.inr hy) hyx⟩

proof:
:= by

proof:
:= by

statement:

/

proof:

name: minimal_iff_minimal_of_imp_of_forall
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem minimal_iff_minimal_of_imp_of_forall (hPQ : ∀ ⦃x⦄, Q x → P x)
    (h : ∀ ⦃x⦄, P x → ∃ y, y ≤ x ∧ Q y) : Minimal P x ↔ Minimal Q x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h' ↦ ⟨?_, fun y hy hyx ↦ h'.le_of_le (hPQ hy) hyx⟩,
    fun h' ↦ ⟨hPQ h'.prop, fun y hy hyx ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨y, hyx, hy⟩ := h h'.prop
    rwa [((h'.le_of_le (hPQ hy)) hyx).antisymm hyx]
  obtain ⟨z, hzy, hz⟩ := h hy
  exact (h'.le_of_le hz (hzy.trans hyx)).trans hzy

proof:

    fun h ↦ ⟨h.1, fun _ ht hts x hxs ↦ by_contra fun hxt ↦

name: minimal_mem_image_monotone
statement:
@[to_dual (reorder := hf (x y, 3 4))]
theorem minimal_mem_image_monotone (hf : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, x ∈ s → y ∈ s → (f x ≤ f y ↔ x ≤ y))
    (hx : Minimal (· ∈ s) x) : Minimal (· ∈ f '' s) (f x)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨mem_image_of_mem f hx.prop, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  rw [hf hx.prop hy, hf hy hx.prop]
  exact hx.le_of_le hy

statement:

theorem minimal_mem_image_monotone_iff (ha : a ∈ s)
    (hf : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, x ∈ s → y ∈ s → (f x ≤ f y ↔ x ≤ y)) :
    Minimal (· ∈ f '' s) (f a) ↔ Minimal (· ∈ s) a
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨ha, fun y hys ↦ ?_⟩, minimal_mem_image_monotone hf⟩
  rw [← hf ha hys, ← hf hys ha]
  exact h.le_of_le (mem_image_of_mem f hys)

    (hx : Minimal (· ∈ s) x) : Maximal (· ∈ f '' s) (f x)
proof:
:=
  minimal_mem_image_monotone (β := βᵒᵈ) (fun _ _ h h' ↦ hf h' h) hx

    Minimal (· ∈ f '' s) (f a) ↔ Maximal (· ∈ s) a
proof:
:=
  maximal_mem_image_monotone_iff (β := βᵒᵈ) ha (fun _ _ h h' ↦ hf h' h)

name: image_monotone_setOfPred_minimal
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.ext fun x ↦ ⟨?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, (hx : Minimal _ x), rfl⟩
    exact (minimal_mem_image_monotone_iff hx.prop hf).2 hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := (mem_ofPred_eq ▸ h).prop
  exact mem_image_of_mem _ <| (minimal_mem_image_monotone_iff (s := Set.ofPred P) hy hf).1 h

  refine fun x _ ↦ or_iff_not_imp_left.2 fun hx ↦ ?_

  intro y hy
  apply Not.imp_symm <| Std.Trichotomous.trichotomous x y (hx <| mem_extent_of_rel_extent · hy)

name: zorny_lemma
statement: lemma zorny_lemma : zorny_statement
proof:
:= by
  let s : Set α := {x | whatever x}
  suffices ∃ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, y ⊆ x → y = x by 
    proof_post_zorn
  apply zorn_subset 
  rintro c hcs hc
  obtain rfl | hcnemp := c.eq_empty_or_nonempty 
  · exact ⟨edge_case_construction,
      proof_that_edge_case_construction_respects_whatever,
      proof_that_edge_case_construction_contains_all_stuff_in_c⟩
  · exact ⟨construction,
      proof_that_construction_respects_whatever,
      proof_that_construction_contains_all_stuff_in_c⟩

name: exists_maximal_of_chains_bounded
statement:
theorem exists_maximal_of_chains_bounded (h : ∀ c, IsChain r c → ∃ ub, ∀ a ∈ c, a ≺ ub)
    (trans : ∀ {a b c}, a ≺ b → b ≺ c → a ≺ c) : ∃ m, ∀ a, m ≺ a → a ≺ m
proof:
:=
  have : ∃ ub, ∀ a ∈ maxChain r, a ≺ ub := h _ <| maxChain_spec.left
  let ⟨ub, (hub : ∀ a ∈ maxChain r, a ≺ ub)⟩ := this
  ⟨ub, fun a ha =>
    have : IsChain r (insert a <| maxChain r) :=
      maxChain_spec.1.insert fun b hb _ => Or.inr <| trans (hub b hb) ha
    hub a <| by
      rw [maxChain_spec.right this (subset_insert _ _)]
      exact mem_insert _ _⟩

name: exists_maximal_of_nonempty_chains_bounded
statement:
theorem exists_maximal_of_nonempty_chains_bounded [Nonempty α]
    (h : ∀ c, IsChain r c → c.Nonempty → ∃ ub, ∀ a ∈ c, a ≺ ub)
    (trans : ∀ {a b c}, a ≺ b → b ≺ c → a ≺ c) : ∃ m, ∀ a, m ≺ a → a ≺ m
proof:
:=
  exists_maximal_of_chains_bounded
    (fun c hc =>
      (eq_empty_or_nonempty c).elim
        (fun h => ⟨Classical.arbitrary α, fun x hx => (h ▸ hx : x ∈ (∅ : Set α)).elim⟩) (h c hc))
    trans

@[to_dual zorn_ge]
theorem zorn_le (h : ∀ c : Set α, IsChain (· ≤ ·) c → BddAbove c) : ∃ m : α, IsMax m

statement:

theorem zorn_le_nonempty [Nonempty α]

name: zorn_le
statement:
@[to_dual zorn_ge₀]
theorem zorn_le₀ (s : Set α) (ih : ∀ c ⊆ s, IsChain (· ≤ ·) c → ∃ ub ∈ s, ∀ z ∈ c, z ≤ ub) :
    ∃ m, Maximal (· ∈ s) m

name: zorn_le_nonempty
statement:
@[to_dual zorn_ge_nonempty₀]
theorem zorn_le_nonempty₀ (s : Set α)
    (ih : ∀ c ⊆ s, IsChain (· ≤ ·) c → ∀ y ∈ c, ∃ ub ∈ s, ∀ z ∈ c, z ≤ ub) (x : α) (hxs : x ∈ s) :
    ∃ m, x ≤ m ∧ Maximal (· ∈ s) m
proof:
:= by
  have H := zorn_le₀ ({ y ∈ s | x ≤ y }) fun c hcs hc => ?_
  · rcases H with ⟨m, ⟨hms, hxm⟩, hm⟩
    exact ⟨m, hxm, hms, fun z hzs hmz => @hm _ ⟨hzs, hxm.trans hmz⟩ hmz⟩
  · rcases c.eq_empty_or_nonempty with (rfl | ⟨y, hy⟩)
    · exact ⟨x, ⟨hxs, le_rfl⟩, fun z => False.elim⟩
    · rcases ih c (fun z hz => (hcs hz).1) hc y hy with ⟨z, hzs, hz⟩
      exact ⟨z, ⟨hzs, (hcs hy).2.trans <| hz _ hy⟩, hz⟩

name: zorn_le_nonempty_Ici
statement:
@[to_dual zorn_ge_nonempty_Iic₀]
theorem zorn_le_nonempty_Ici₀ (a : α)
    (ih : ∀ c ⊆ Ici a, IsChain (· ≤ ·) c → ∀ y ∈ c, ∃ ub, ∀ z ∈ c, z ≤ ub) (x : α) (hax : a ≤ x) :
    ∃ m, x ≤ m ∧ IsMax m
proof:
:= by
  let ⟨m, hxm, ham, hm⟩ := zorn_le_nonempty₀ (Ici a) (fun c hca hc y hy ↦ ?_) x hax
  · exact ⟨m, hxm, fun z hmz => hm (ham.trans hmz) hmz⟩
  · have ⟨ub, hub⟩ := ih c hca hc y hy
    exact ⟨ub, (hca hy).trans (hub y hy), hub⟩

name: zorn_subset
statement:
theorem zorn_subset (S : Set (Set α))
    (h : ∀ c ⊆ S, IsChain (· ⊆ ·) c → ∃ ub ∈ S, ∀ s ∈ c, s ⊆ ub) : ∃ m, Maximal (· ∈ S) m

name: zorn_subset_nonempty
statement:
theorem zorn_subset_nonempty (S : Set (Set α))
    (H : ∀ c ⊆ S, IsChain (· ⊆ ·) c → c.Nonempty → ∃ ub ∈ S, ∀ s ∈ c, s ⊆ ub) (x) (hx : x ∈ S) :
    ∃ m, x ⊆ m ∧ Maximal (· ∈ S) m
proof:
:=
  zorn_le_nonempty₀ _ (fun _ cS hc y yc => H _ cS hc ⟨y, yc⟩) _ hx

name: zorn_superset
statement:
theorem zorn_superset (S : Set (Set α))
    (h : ∀ c ⊆ S, IsChain (· ⊆ ·) c → ∃ lb ∈ S, ∀ s ∈ c, lb ⊆ s) : ∃ m, Minimal (· ∈ S) m
proof:
:=
  (@zorn_le₀ (Set α)ᵒᵈ _ S) fun c cS hc => h c cS hc.symm

name: zorn_superset_nonempty
statement:
theorem zorn_superset_nonempty (S : Set (Set α))
    (H : ∀ c ⊆ S, IsChain (· ⊆ ·) c → c.Nonempty → ∃ lb ∈ S, ∀ s ∈ c, lb ⊆ s) (x) (hx : x ∈ S) :
    ∃ m, m ⊆ x ∧ Minimal (· ∈ S) m
proof:
:=
  @zorn_le_nonempty₀ (Set α)ᵒᵈ _ S (fun _ cS hc y yc => H _ cS hc.symm ⟨y, yc⟩) _ hx

name: IsChain.exists_maxChain
statement: theorem IsChain.exists_maxChain (hc : IsChain r c) : ∃ M, @IsMaxChain _ r M ∧ c ⊆ M
proof:
:= by
  have H := zorn_subset_nonempty { s | c ⊆ s ∧ IsChain r s } ?_ c ⟨Subset.rfl, hc⟩
  · obtain ⟨M, hcM, hM⟩ := H
    exact ⟨M, ⟨hM.prop.2, fun d hd hMd ↦ hM.eq_of_subset ⟨hcM.trans hMd, hd⟩ hMd⟩, hcM⟩
  rintro cs hcs₀ hcs₁ ⟨s, hs⟩
  refine
    ⟨⋃₀cs, ⟨fun _ ha => Set.mem_sUnion_of_mem ((hcs₀ hs).left ha) hs, ?_⟩, fun _ =>
      Set.subset_sUnion_of_mem⟩
  rintro y ⟨sy, hsy, hysy⟩ z ⟨sz, hsz, hzsz⟩ hyz
  obtain rfl | hsseq := eq_or_ne sy sz
  · exact (hcs₀ hsy).right hysy hzsz hyz
  rcases hcs₁ hsy hsz hsseq with h | h
  · exact (hcs₀ hsz).right (h hysy) hzsz hyz
  · exact (hcs₀ hsy).right hysy (h hzsz) hyz

name: _root_.IsChain.exists_subset_flag
statement: lemma _root_.IsChain.exists_subset_flag (hc : IsChain (· ≤ ·) c) : ∃ s : Flag α, c ⊆ s

name: exists_mem
statement: lemma exists_mem (a : α) : ∃ s : Flag α, a ∈ s
proof:

name: eq_or_principal
statement:
theorem eq_or_principal [IsWellOrder β s] (f : r ≼i s) :
    Surjective f ∨ ∃ b, ∀ x, x ∈ Set.range f ↔ s x b
proof:
:= by
  apply or_iff_not_imp_right.2
  intro h b
  push Not at h
  apply IsWellFounded.induction s b
  intro x IH
  obtain ⟨y, ⟨hy, hs⟩ | ⟨hy, hs⟩⟩ := h x
  · obtain (rfl | h) := (trichotomous y x).resolve_left hs
    · exact hy
    · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy
      exact f.mem_range_of_rel h
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := IH y hs
    cases hy (Set.mem_range_self z)

name: gameAdd_iff
statement:
theorem gameAdd_iff {rα rβ} {x y : α × β} :
    GameAdd rα rβ x y ↔ rα x.1 y.1 ∧ x.2 = y.2 ∨ rβ x.2 y.2 ∧ x.1 = y.1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro (@⟨a₁, a₂, b, h⟩ | @⟨a, b₁, b₂, h⟩)
    exacts [Or.inl ⟨h, rfl⟩, Or.inr ⟨h, rfl⟩]
  · revert x y
    rintro ⟨a₁, b₁⟩ ⟨a₂, b₂⟩ (⟨h, rfl : b₁ = b₂⟩ | ⟨h, rfl : a₁ = a₂⟩)
    exacts [GameAdd.fst h, GameAdd.snd h]

statement:
theorem Acc.sym2_gameAdd {a b} (ha : Acc rα a) (hb : Acc rα b) :
    Acc (Sym2.GameAdd rα) s(a, b)
proof:
:= by
  induction ha generalizing b with | _ a _ iha
  induction hb with | _ b hb ihb
  refine Acc.intro _ fun s => ?_
  induction s with | _ c d
  rw [Sym2.GameAdd]
  dsimp
  rintro ((rc | rd) | (rd | rc))
  · exact iha c rc ⟨b, hb⟩
  · exact ihb d rd
  · rw [Sym2.eq_swap]
    exact iha d rd ⟨b, hb⟩
  · rw [Sym2.eq_swap]
    exact ihb c rc

proof:

      (update_le_iff.mpr ⟨hg, fun _ _ => bot_le⟩)).1

name: symmDiff_symmDiff_left
statement:
theorem symmDiff_symmDiff_left :
    a ∆ b ∆ c = a \ (b ⊔ c) ⊔ b \ (a ⊔ c) ⊔ c \ (a ⊔ b) ⊔ a ⊓ b ⊓ c
proof:
:=
  calc
    a ∆ b ∆ c = a ∆ b \ c ⊔ c \ a ∆ b := symmDiff_def _ _
    _ = a \ (b ⊔ c) ⊔ b \ (a ⊔ c) ⊔ (c \ (a ⊔ b) ⊔ c ⊓ a ⊓ b) := by
        { rw [sdiff_symmDiff', sup_comm (c ⊓ a ⊓ b), symmDiff_sdiff] }
    _ = a \ (b ⊔ c) ⊔ b \ (a ⊔ c) ⊔ c \ (a ⊔ b) ⊔ a ⊓ b ⊓ c := by ac_rfl

name: symmDiff_symmDiff_right
statement:
theorem symmDiff_symmDiff_right :
    a ∆ (b ∆ c) = a \ (b ⊔ c) ⊔ b \ (a ⊔ c) ⊔ c \ (a ⊔ b) ⊔ a ⊓ b ⊓ c
proof:
:=
  calc
    a ∆ (b ∆ c) = a \ b ∆ c ⊔ b ∆ c \ a := symmDiff_def _ _
    _ = a \ (b ⊔ c) ⊔ a ⊓ b ⊓ c ⊔ (b \ (c ⊔ a) ⊔ c \ (b ⊔ a)) := by
        { rw [sdiff_symmDiff', sup_comm (a ⊓ b ⊓ c), symmDiff_sdiff] }
    _ = a \ (b ⊔ c) ⊔ b \ (a ⊔ c) ⊔ c \ (a ⊔ b) ⊔ a ⊓ b ⊓ c := by ac_rfl

statement:
theorem symmDiff_symmDiff_right' :
    a ∆ (b ∆ c) = a ⊓ b ⊓ c ⊔ a ⊓ bᶜ ⊓ cᶜ ⊔ aᶜ ⊓ b ⊓ cᶜ ⊔ aᶜ ⊓ bᶜ ⊓ c
proof:
:=
  calc
    a ∆ (b ∆ c) = a ⊓ (b ⊓ c ⊔ bᶜ ⊓ cᶜ) ⊔ (b ⊓ cᶜ ⊔ c ⊓ bᶜ) ⊓ aᶜ := by
        { rw [symmDiff_eq, compl_symmDiff, bihimp_eq', symmDiff_eq] }
    _ = a ⊓ b ⊓ c ⊔ a ⊓ bᶜ ⊓ cᶜ ⊔ b ⊓ cᶜ ⊓ aᶜ ⊔ c ⊓ bᶜ ⊓ aᶜ := by
        { rw [inf_sup_left, inf_sup_right, ← sup_assoc, ← inf_assoc, ← inf_assoc] }
    _ = a ⊓ b ⊓ c ⊔ a ⊓ bᶜ ⊓ cᶜ ⊔ aᶜ ⊓ b ⊓ cᶜ ⊔ aᶜ ⊓ bᶜ ⊓ c := (by
      congr 1
      · congr 1
        rw [inf_comm, inf_assoc]
      · apply inf_left_right_swap)

name: IsCoatomic.of_isChain_bounded
statement:
theorem IsCoatomic.of_isChain_bounded {α : Type*} [PartialOrder α] [OrderTop α]
    (h : ∀ c : Set α, IsChain (· ≤ ·) c → c.Nonempty → ⊤ ∉ c → ∃ x ≠ ⊤, x ∈ upperBounds c) :
    IsCoatomic α
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x => le_top.eq_or_lt.imp_right fun hx => ?_⟩
  have := zorn_le_nonempty₀ (Ico x ⊤) (fun c hxc hc y hy => ?_) x (left_mem_Ico.2 hx)
  · obtain ⟨y, hxy, hmax⟩ := this
    refine ⟨y, ⟨hmax.prop.2.ne, fun z hyz ↦ le_top.eq_or_lt.resolve_right fun hz => ?_⟩, hxy⟩
    exact hyz.ne <| hmax.eq_of_le ⟨hxy.trans hyz.le, hz⟩ hyz.le
  rcases h c hc ⟨y, hy⟩ fun h => (hxc h).2.ne rfl with ⟨z, hz, hcz⟩
  exact ⟨z, ⟨le_trans (hxc hy).1 (hcz hy), hz.lt_top⟩, hcz⟩

name: IsAtomic.of_isChain_bounded
statement:
theorem IsAtomic.of_isChain_bounded {α : Type*} [PartialOrder α] [OrderBot α]

      ∀ c : Set α,
        IsChain (· ≤ ·) c → c.Nonempty → ⊥ ∉ c → ∃ x ≠ ⊥, x ∈ lowerBounds c) :
    IsAtomic α
proof:
:=
  isCoatomic_dual_iff_isAtomic.mp <| IsCoatomic.of_isChain_bounded fun c hc => h c hc.symm

proof:
:= by
  refine and_congr_right' ⟨fun h c hac ↦ h hac, fun h c hac hcb ↦
    @h ⟨c, mem_iff_forall_le_or_ge.2 fun d hd ↦ ?_⟩ hac hcb⟩
  classical
  obtain hda | had := le_or_gt (⟨d, hd⟩ : s) a
  · exact .inr ((Subtype.coe_le_coe.2 hda).trans hac.le)
  obtain hbd | hdb := le_or_gt b ⟨d, hd⟩
  · exact .inl (hcb.le.trans hbd)
  · cases h had hdb

statement:
theorem Finite.wellQuasiOrdered (r : α → α → Prop) [Finite α] [Std.Refl r] :
    WellQuasiOrdered r
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  obtain ⟨m, n, h, hf⟩ := Set.finite_univ.exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem (f := f)
    fun _ ↦ Set.mem_univ _
  exact ⟨m, n, h, hf ▸ refl _⟩

name: WellQuasiOrdered.exists_monotone_subseq
statement:
theorem WellQuasiOrdered.exists_monotone_subseq [IsPreorder α r] (h : WellQuasiOrdered r)
    (f : ℕ → α) : ∃ g : ℕ ↪o ℕ, ∀ m n, m ≤ n → r (f (g m)) (f (g n))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, h1 | h2⟩ := exists_increasing_or_nonincreasing_subseq r f
  · refine ⟨g, fun m n hle => ?_⟩
    obtain hlt | rfl := hle.lt_or_eq
    exacts [h1 m n hlt, refl_of r _]
  · obtain ⟨m, n, hlt, hle⟩ := h (f ∘ g)
    cases h2 m n hlt hle

name: wellQuasiOrdered_iff_exists_monotone_subseq
statement:
theorem wellQuasiOrdered_iff_exists_monotone_subseq [IsPreorder α r] :
    WellQuasiOrdered r ↔ ∀ f : ℕ → α, ∃ g : ℕ ↪o ℕ, ∀ m n : ℕ, m ≤ n → r (f (g m)) (f (g n))
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h f
  · exact h.exists_monotone_subseq f
  · obtain ⟨g, gmon⟩ := h f
    exact ⟨_, _, g.strictMono Nat.zero_lt_one, gmon _ _ (Nat.zero_le 1)⟩

name: WellQuasiOrdered.prod
statement:
theorem WellQuasiOrdered.prod [IsPreorder α r] (hr : WellQuasiOrdered r) (hs : WellQuasiOrdered s) :
    WellQuasiOrdered fun a b : α × β ↦ r a.1 b.1 ∧ s a.2 b.2
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  obtain ⟨g, h₁⟩ := hr.exists_monotone_subseq (Prod.fst ∘ f)
  obtain ⟨m, n, h, hf⟩ := hs (Prod.snd ∘ f ∘ g)
  exact ⟨g m, g n, g.strictMono h, h₁ _ _ h.le, hf⟩

name: WellQuasiOrdered.pi
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  have : IsPreorder (∀ i, α i) (fun a b : ∀ i, α i => ∀ i, r i (a i) (b i)) :=
    { refl a i := refl (a i)
      trans a b c hab hbc i := _root_.trans (hab i) (hbc i) }
  suffices ∀ (s : Finset ι) (f : ℕ → ∀ i, α i),
    ∃ g : ℕ ↪o ℕ, ∀ ⦃a b : ℕ⦄, a ≤ b → ∀ i, i ∈ s → r i ((f ∘ g) a i) ((f ∘ g) b i) by
    rw [wellQuasiOrdered_iff_exists_monotone_subseq]
    intro f
    simpa only [Finset.mem_univ, true_imp_iff] using! this Finset.univ f
  refine Finset.cons_induction ?_ ?_
  · intro f
    exists RelEmbedding.refl (· ≤ ·)
    simp only [IsEmpty.forall_iff, imp_true_iff, Finset.notMem_empty]
  · intro i s hi ih f
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := (hr i).exists_monotone_subseq (f · i)
    obtain ⟨g', hg'⟩ := ih (f ∘ g)
    refine ⟨g'.trans g, fun a b hab => (Finset.forall_mem_cons _ _).2 ?_⟩
    exact ⟨hg _ _ (OrderHomClass.mono g' hab), hg' hab⟩

name: RelIso.wellQuasiOrdered_iff
statement:

proof:

  congr! with g a b
  simp [f.map_rel_iff]

name: WellQuasiOrdered.of_surjective
proof:
:= by
  intro seq
  have ⟨_, _, hle, hr⟩ := h (Function.surjInv hf ∘ seq)
  exact ⟨_, _, hle, by simpa [Function.surjInv_eq] using f.map_rel hr⟩

theorem WellQuasiOrdered.wellFounded {α : Type*} {r : α → α → Prop} [IsPreorder α r]
    (h : WellQuasiOrdered r) : WellFounded fun a b ↦ r a b ∧ ¬ r b a
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Preorder α :=
    { le := r
      le_refl := refl_of r
      le_trans := fun _ _ _ => trans_of r }
  have : WellQuasiOrderedLE α := ⟨h⟩

name: WellQuasiOrderedLE.finite_of_isAntichain
statement:
theorem WellQuasiOrderedLE.finite_of_isAntichain [WellQuasiOrderedLE α] {s : Set α}
    (h : IsAntichain (· ≤ ·) s) : s.Finite

name: wellQuasiOrderedLE_iff
statement:
theorem wellQuasiOrderedLE_iff :
    WellQuasiOrderedLE α ↔ WellFoundedLT α ∧ ∀ s : Set α, IsAntichain (· ≤ ·) s → s.Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.to_wellFoundedLT, fun s ↦ h.finite_of_isAntichain⟩,
    fun ⟨hwf, hc⟩ ↦ ⟨fun f ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨g, h1 | h2⟩ := exists_increasing_or_nonincreasing_subseq (· > ·) f
  · exfalso
    apply RelEmbedding.not_wellFounded _ hwf.wf
    exact (RelEmbedding.ofMonotone _ h1).swap
  · contrapose! hc
    refine ⟨Set.range (f ∘ g), ?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩ _ ⟨n, rfl⟩ _ hf
      obtain h | rfl | h := lt_trichotomy m n
      · exact hc _ _ (g.strictMono h) hf
      · contradiction
      · exact h2 _ _ h (lt_of_le_not_ge hf (hc _ _ (g.strictMono h)))
    · refine Set.infinite_range_of_injective fun m n (hf : f (g m) = f (g n)) ↦ ?_
      obtain h | rfl | h := lt_trichotomy m n <;>
        (first | rfl | cases (hf ▸ hc _ _ (g.strictMono h)) le_rfl)

name: iSup
statement:
theorem iSup₂_iInf₂_le_iInf₂_iSup₂ [CompleteLinearOrder β] :
    ⨆ y ∈ Y, ⨅ x ∈ X, f x y ≤ ⨅ x ∈ X, ⨆ y ∈ Y, f x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [iSup₂_le_iff]; intro y hy
  rw [le_iInf₂_iff]; intro x hx
  exact iInf₂_le_of_le x hx (le_iSup₂_of_le y hy (le_refl _))

name: IsSaddlePointOn.swap_left
statement:
lemma IsSaddlePointOn.swap_left [Preorder β] {a a' : E} {b b' : F} (ha' : a' ∈ X) (hb : b ∈ Y)
    (h : IsSaddlePointOn X Y f a b) (h' : IsSaddlePointOn X Y f a' b') :
    IsSaddlePointOn X Y f a b'
proof:
:= fun x hx y hy ↦
  le_trans (h a' ha' y hy) (h' x hx b hb)

name: IsSaddlePointOn.swap_right
statement:
lemma IsSaddlePointOn.swap_right [Preorder β] {a a' : E} {b b' : F} (ha : a ∈ X) (hb' : b' ∈ Y)

    IsSaddlePointOn X Y f a' b

name: isSaddlePointOn_iff
statement:
lemma isSaddlePointOn_iff [CompleteLinearOrder β]
    {a : E} (ha : a ∈ X) {b : F} (hb : b ∈ Y) :
    IsSaddlePointOn X Y f a b ↔
      ⨆ y ∈ Y, f a y = f a b ∧ ⨅ x ∈ X, f x b = f a b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩, fun ⟨h, h'⟩ x hx y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  · apply le_antisymm
    · simp only [iSup_le_iff]
      exact h a ha
    · apply le_iSup₂ b hb
  · apply le_antisymm
    · apply iInf₂_le a ha
    · simp only [le_iInf_iff]
      intro x hx
      exact h x hx b hb
  · trans f a b
    · 
      rw [← h]
      apply le_iSup₂ y hy
    · 
      rw [← h']
      apply iInf₂_le x hx

name: isSaddlePointOn_iff'
statement:
lemma isSaddlePointOn_iff' [CompleteLinearOrder β]
    {a : E} (ha : a ∈ X) {b : F} (hb : b ∈ Y) :
    IsSaddlePointOn X Y f a b ↔
      ⨆ y ∈ Y, f a y ≤ ⨅ x ∈ X, f x b
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSaddlePointOn_iff ha hb]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨h, h'⟩ ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · exact le_trans (le_of_eq h) (le_of_eq h'.symm)
  · apply le_antisymm
    · exact le_trans h (iInf₂_le a ha)
    · apply le_iSup₂ b hb
  · apply le_antisymm
    · apply iInf₂_le a ha
    · apply le_trans (le_iSup₂ b hb) h

name: isSaddlePointOn_value
statement:
lemma isSaddlePointOn_value [CompleteLinearOrder β]
    {a : E} (ha : a ∈ X) {b : F} (hb : b ∈ Y)
    (h : IsSaddlePointOn X Y f a b) :
    ⨅ x ∈ X, ⨆ y ∈ Y, f x y = f a b ∧
      ⨆ y ∈ Y, ⨅ x ∈ X, f x y = f a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSaddlePointOn_iff ha hb] at h
  constructor
  · apply le_antisymm
    · rw [← h.1]
      exact le_trans (iInf₂_le a ha) (le_rfl)
    · rw [← h.2]
      apply iInf₂_mono
      intro x _
      apply le_iSup₂ b hb
  · apply le_antisymm
    · rw [← h.1]
      apply iSup₂_mono
      intro y _
      apply iInf₂_le a ha
    · rw [← h.2]
      apply le_trans (le_rfl) (le_iSup₂ b hb)

name: height_le
statement:
lemma height_le {a : α} {n : ℕ∞} (h : ∀ (p : LTSeries α), p.last = a → p.length ≤ n) :
    height a ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  apply height_le_iff.mpr
  intro p hlast
  wlog hlenpos : p.length ≠ 0
  · simp_all
  
  let p' := p.eraseLast.snoc a (lt_of_lt_of_le (p.eraseLast_last_rel_last (by simp_all)) hlast)
  rw [show p.length = p'.length by simp [p']; lia]
  apply h
  simp [p']

  rw [height_eq_iSup_last_eq]
  apply Equiv.iSup_congr ⟨RelSeries.reverse, RelSeries.reverse, fun _ ↦ RelSeries.reverse_reverse _,
    fun _ ↦ RelSeries.reverse_reverse _⟩

name: length_le_height
statement:
lemma length_le_height {p : LTSeries α} {x : α} (hlast : p.last ≤ x) :
    p.length ≤ height x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hlen0 : p.length ≠ 0
  · let p' := p.eraseLast.snoc x (by
      apply lt_of_lt_of_le
      · apply p.step ⟨p.length - 1, by lia⟩
      · convert! hlast
        simp only [Fin.succ_mk, RelSeries.last, Fin.last]
        congr; lia)
    suffices p'.length ≤ height x by
      simp only [RelSeries.snoc_length, RelSeries.eraseLast_length, Nat.cast_add, ENat.natCast_sub,
        Nat.cast_one, p'] at this
      convert! this
      norm_cast
      lia
    refine le_iSup₂_of_le p' ?_ le_rfl
    simp [p']
  · simp_all

name: rev_index_le_coheight
statement: lemma rev_index_le_coheight (p : LTSeries α) (i : Fin (p.length + 1)) : i.rev ≤ coheight (p i)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using! index_le_height (α := αᵒᵈ) p.reverse i.rev

name: height_eq_index_of_length_eq_height_last
statement:
lemma height_eq_index_of_length_eq_height_last {p : LTSeries α} (h : p.length = height p.last)
    (i : Fin (p.length + 1)) : height (p i) = i
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (height_le ?_) (index_le_height p i)
  intro p' hp'
  have hp'' := length_le_height_last (p := p'.smash (p.drop i) (by simpa))
  simp [← h] at hp''; clear h
  norm_cast at *
  lia

name: coheight_eq_index_of_length_eq_head_coheight
statement:
lemma coheight_eq_index_of_length_eq_head_coheight {p : LTSeries α} (h : p.length = coheight p.head)
    (i : Fin (p.length + 1)) : coheight (p i) = i.rev
proof:
:= by
  simpa using! height_eq_index_of_length_eq_height_last (α := αᵒᵈ) (p := p.reverse) (by simpa) i.rev

name: height_mono
statement:
@[gcongr]
lemma height_mono : Monotone (α := α) height
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ hab ↦ biSup_mono (fun _ hla => hla.trans hab)

name: coheight_anti
statement:
@[gcongr]
lemma coheight_anti : Antitone (α := α) coheight

name: height_add_const
statement:
private lemma height_add_const (a : α) (n : ℕ∞) :
    height a + n = ⨆ (p : LTSeries α) (_ : p.last = a), p.length + n
proof:
:= by
  have hne : Nonempty { p : LTSeries α // p.last = a } := ⟨RelSeries.singleton _ a, rfl⟩
  rw [height_eq_iSup_last_eq, iSup_subtype', iSup_subtype', ENat.iSup_add]

name: height_strictMono
statement:
@[gcongr] lemma height_strictMono {x y : α} (hxy : x < y) (hfin : height x < ⊤) :
    height x < height y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ENat.add_one_le_iff hfin.ne, height_add_const, iSup₂_le_iff]
  intro p hlast
  have := length_le_height_last (p := p.snoc y (by simp [*]))
  simpa using this

name: height_add_one_le
statement: lemma height_add_one_le {a b : α} (hab : a < b) : height a + 1 ≤ height b
proof:
:= by
  cases hfin : height a with
  | top =>
    have : ⊤ ≤ height b := by
      rw [← hfin]
      gcongr
    simp [this]
  | coe n =>
    apply Order.add_one_le_of_lt
    rw [← hfin]
    gcongr
    simp [hfin]

name: coheight_strictAnti
statement:
@[gcongr] lemma coheight_strictAnti {x y : α} (hyx : y < x) (hfin : coheight x < ⊤) :
    coheight x < coheight y

name: coheight_add_one_le
statement: lemma coheight_add_one_le {a b : α} (hab : b < a) : coheight a + 1 ≤ coheight b
proof:
:= by
  cases hfin : coheight a with
  | top =>
    have : ⊤ ≤ coheight b := by
      rw [← hfin]
      gcongr
    simp [this]
  | coe n =>
    apply Order.add_one_le_of_lt
    rw [← hfin]
    gcongr
    simp [hfin]

name: height_le_height_apply_of_strictMono
statement:
lemma height_le_height_apply_of_strictMono (f : α → β) (hf : StrictMono f) (x : α) :
    height x ≤ height (f x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [height_eq_iSup_last_eq]
  apply iSup₂_le
  intro p hlast
  apply le_iSup₂_of_le (p.map f hf) (by simp [hlast]) (by simp)

name: coheight_le_coheight_apply_of_strictMono
statement:
lemma coheight_le_coheight_apply_of_strictMono (f : α → β) (hf : StrictMono f) (x : α) :
    coheight x ≤ coheight (f x)
proof:
:= by
  apply height_le_height_apply_of_strictMono (α := αᵒᵈ)
  exact fun _ _ h ↦ hf h

name: coheight_eq_of_strictMono
statement:
lemma coheight_eq_of_strictMono (f : α → β) (hf : StrictMono f)
    (h : ∀ a : α, ∀ b : β, f a < b → ∃ (a' : α), a < a' ∧ f a' = b) (a : α) :
    coheight a = coheight (f a)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Order.coheight_le_coheight_apply_of_strictMono _ hf _) ?_
  refine coheight_le_iff'.mpr fun p hp ↦ ?_
  induction p using RelSeries.inductionOn generalizing a with
  | singleton x => simp
  | cons p x hx ih =>
    simp only [RelSeries.head_cons] at hp
    obtain ⟨a', haa', ha'⟩ := h a p.head (by grind)
    grw [RelSeries.cons_length, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, ih a' ha'.symm]
    exact coheight_add_one_le haa'

name: height_eq_of_strictMono
statement:
lemma height_eq_of_strictMono (f : α → β) (hf : StrictMono f)
    (h : ∀ a : α, ∀ b : β, b < f a → ∃ (a' : α), a' < a ∧ f a' = b) (a : α) :
    height a = height (f a)
proof:
:= by
  have : coheight (OrderDual.toDual a) = coheight (OrderDual.toDual (f a)) :=
    coheight_eq_of_strictMono (α := αᵒᵈ) (β := βᵒᵈ) (f := OrderDual.toDual ∘ f ∘ OrderDual.toDual)
    (strictMono_dual_iff.mp hf) (fun a b hab ↦ h a b hab) _
  simpa [Order.coheight_toDual] using this

name: height_orderIso
statement:
@[simp]
lemma height_orderIso (f : α ≃o β) (x : α) : height (f x) = height x
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · simpa using height_le_height_apply_of_strictMono _ f.symm.strictMono (f x)
  · exact height_le_height_apply_of_strictMono _ f.strictMono x

name: coheight_orderIso
statement: lemma coheight_orderIso (f : α ≃o β) (x : α) : coheight (f x) = coheight x

name: exists_eq_iSup_of_iSup_eq_coe
statement:
private lemma exists_eq_iSup_of_iSup_eq_coe {α : Type*} [Nonempty α] {f : α → ℕ∞} {n : ℕ}
    (h : (⨆ x, f x) = n) : ∃ x, f x = n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := ENat.sSup_mem_of_nonempty_of_lt_top (h ▸ ENat.natCast_lt_top _)
  use x
  simpa [hx] using! h

name: exists_series_of_le_height
statement:
lemma exists_series_of_le_height (a : α) {n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ height a) :
    ∃ p : LTSeries α, p.last = a ∧ p.length = n
proof:
:= by
  have hne : Nonempty { p : LTSeries α // p.last = a } := ⟨RelSeries.singleton _ a, rfl⟩
  cases ha : height a with
  | top =>
    clear h
    rw [height_eq_iSup_last_eq, iSup_subtype', ENat.iSup_natCast_eq_top, bddAbove_def] at ha
    contrapose! ha
    use n
    rintro m ⟨⟨p, rfl⟩, hp⟩
    simp only at hp
    by_contra! hnm
    apply ha (p.drop ⟨m-n, by lia⟩) (by simp) (by simp; lia)
  | coe m =>
    rw [ha, Nat.cast_le] at h
    rw [height_eq_iSup_last_eq, iSup_subtype'] at ha
    obtain ⟨⟨p, hlast⟩, hlen⟩ := exists_eq_iSup_of_iSup_eq_coe ha
    simp only [Nat.cast_inj] at hlen
    use p.drop ⟨m-n, by lia⟩
    constructor
    · simp [hlast]
    · simp [hlen]; lia

name: exists_series_of_le_coheight
statement:
lemma exists_series_of_le_coheight (a : α) {n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ coheight a) :
    ∃ p : LTSeries α, p.head = a ∧ p.length = n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hl⟩ := exists_series_of_le_height (α := αᵒᵈ) a h
  exact ⟨p.reverse, by simpa, by simpa⟩

name: exists_series_of_height_eq_coe
statement:
lemma exists_series_of_height_eq_coe (a : α) {n : ℕ} (h : height a = n) :
    ∃ p : LTSeries α, p.last = a ∧ p.length = n

name: exists_series_of_coheight_eq_coe
statement:
lemma exists_series_of_coheight_eq_coe (a : α) {n : ℕ} (h : coheight a = n) :
    ∃ p : LTSeries α, p.head = a ∧ p.length = n

name: height_eq_iSup_lt_height
statement: lemma height_eq_iSup_lt_height (x : α) : height x = ⨆ y < x, height y + 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply height_le
    intro p hp
    cases hlen : p.length with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n =>
      apply le_iSup_of_le p.eraseLast.last
      apply le_iSup_of_le (by rw [← hp]; exact p.eraseLast_last_rel_last (by lia))
      rw [height_add_const]
      apply le_iSup₂_of_le p.eraseLast (by rfl) (by simp [hlen])
  · apply iSup₂_le; intro y hyx
    rw [height_add_const]
    apply iSup₂_le; intro p hp
    apply le_iSup₂_of_le (p.snoc x (hp ▸ hyx)) (by simp) (by simp)

name: coheight_eq_iSup_gt_coheight
statement: lemma coheight_eq_iSup_gt_coheight (x : α) : coheight x = ⨆ y > x, coheight y + 1

name: height_le_coe_iff
statement: lemma height_le_coe_iff {x : α} {n : ℕ} : height x ≤ n ↔ ∀ y < x, height y < n
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [height_eq_iSup_lt_height, iSup₂_le_iff]
  congr! 2 with y _
  cases height y
  · simp
  · norm_cast

name: coheight_le_coe_iff
statement: lemma coheight_le_coe_iff {x : α} {n : ℕ} : coheight x ≤ n ↔ ∀ y > x, coheight y < n

name: height_eq_top_iff
statement:
lemma height_eq_top_iff {x : α} :
    height x = ⊤ ↔ ∀ n, ∃ p : LTSeries α, p.last = x ∧ p.length = n where
  mp h n
proof:
:= by
    apply exists_series_of_le_height x (n := n)
    simp [h]
  mpr h := by
    rw [height_eq_iSup_last_eq, iSup_subtype', ENat.iSup_natCast_eq_top, bddAbove_def]
    push Not
    intro n
    obtain ⟨p, hlast, hp⟩ := h (n + 1)
    exact ⟨p.length, ⟨⟨⟨p, hlast⟩, by simp [hp]⟩, by simp [hp]⟩⟩

name: coheight_eq_top_iff
statement:
lemma coheight_eq_top_iff {x : α} :
    coheight x = ⊤ ↔ ∀ n, ∃ p : LTSeries α, p.head = x ∧ p.length = n
proof:
:= by
  convert! height_eq_top_iff (α := αᵒᵈ) (x := x) using 2 with n
  constructor <;> (intro ⟨p, hp, hl⟩; use p.reverse; constructor <;> simpa)

statement: lemma height_ne_zero {x : α} : height x ≠ 0 ↔ ¬ IsMin x

statement: @[simp] lemma height_pos {x : α} : 0 < height x ↔ ¬ IsMin x

statement: lemma coheight_ne_zero {x : α} : coheight x ≠ 0 ↔ ¬ IsMax x

statement: @[simp] lemma coheight_pos {x : α} : 0 < coheight x ↔ ¬ IsMax x

statement: @[simp] lemma height_bot (α : Type*) [Preorder α] [OrderBot α] : height (⊥ : α) = 0

statement: @[simp] lemma coheight_top (α : Type*) [Preorder α] [OrderTop α] : coheight (⊤ : α) = 0

statement: lemma height_pos_of_bot_lt {x : α} [OrderBot α] (h : ⊥ < x) : 0 < height x

name: coe_lt_height_iff
statement:
lemma coe_lt_height_iff {x : α} {n : ℕ} (hfin : height x < ⊤) :
    n < height x ↔ ∃ y < x, height y = n where
  mp h
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨m, hx : height x = m⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp hfin.ne_top
    rw [hx] at h; norm_cast at h
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hlen⟩ := exists_series_of_height_eq_coe x hx
    use p ⟨n, by lia⟩
    constructor
    · rw [← hp]
      apply LTSeries.strictMono
      simp [Fin.last]; lia
    · exact height_eq_index_of_length_eq_height_last (by simp [hlen, hp, hx]) ⟨n, by lia⟩
  mpr := fun ⟨y, hyx, hy⟩ =>
    hy ▸ height_strictMono hyx (lt_of_le_of_lt (height_mono hyx.le) hfin)

name: coe_lt_coheight_iff
statement:
lemma coe_lt_coheight_iff {x : α} {n : ℕ} (hfin : coheight x < ⊤) :
    n < coheight x ↔ ∃ y > x, coheight y = n

name: height_eq_coe_add_one_iff
statement:
lemma height_eq_coe_add_one_iff {x : α} {n : ℕ} :
    height x = n + 1 ↔ height x < ⊤ ∧ (∃ y < x, height y = n) ∧ (∀ y < x, height y ≤ n)
proof:
:= by
  wlog hfin : height x < ⊤
  · simp_all [← Nat.cast_add_one, -Nat.cast_add]
  simp only [hfin, true_and]
  trans n < height x ∧ height x ≤ n + 1
  · rw [le_antisymm_iff, and_comm]
    simp [ENat.add_one_le_iff]
  · congr! 1
    · exact coe_lt_height_iff hfin
    · simpa [hfin, ENat.lt_add_one_iff] using height_le_coe_iff (x := x) (n := n + 1)

name: coheight_eq_coe_add_one_iff
statement:
lemma coheight_eq_coe_add_one_iff {x : α} {n : ℕ} :
    coheight x = n + 1 ↔
      coheight x < ⊤ ∧ (∃ y > x, coheight y = n) ∧ (∀ y > x, coheight y ≤ n)

name: height_eq_coe_iff
statement:
lemma height_eq_coe_iff {x : α} {n : ℕ} :
    height x = n ↔
      height x < ⊤ ∧ (n = 0 ∨ ∃ y < x, height y = n - 1) ∧ (∀ y < x, height y < n)
proof:
:= by
  wlog hfin : height x < ⊤
  · simp_all
  simp only [hfin, true_and]
  cases n
  case zero => simp [isMin_iff_forall_not_lt]
  case succ n =>
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_eq_zero, one_ne_zero, and_false, false_or]
    rw [height_eq_coe_add_one_iff]
    simp only [hfin, true_and]
    congr! 3
    rename_i y _
    cases height y <;> simp; norm_cast; lia

name: coheight_eq_coe_iff
statement:
lemma coheight_eq_coe_iff {x : α} {n : ℕ} :
    coheight x = n ↔
      coheight x < ⊤ ∧ (n = 0 ∨ ∃ y > x, coheight y = n - 1) ∧ (∀ y > x, coheight y < n)

name: height_eq_coe_iff_minimal_le_height
statement:
lemma height_eq_coe_iff_minimal_le_height {a : α} {n : ℕ} :
    height a = n ↔ Minimal (fun y => n ≤ height y) a
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hfin : height a < ⊤
  · cases hn : n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ => simp [minimal_iff_forall_lt, height_eq_coe_add_one_iff, ENat.add_one_le_iff,
        coe_lt_height_iff, *]
  · suffices ∃ x < a, ↑n ≤ height x by
      simp_all [minimal_iff_forall_lt]
    simp only [top_le_iff, height_eq_top_iff] at hfin
    obtain ⟨p, rfl, hp⟩ := hfin (n + 1)
    use p.eraseLast.last, p.eraseLast_last_rel_last (by lia)
    simpa [hp] using length_le_height_last (p := p.eraseLast)

name: coheight_eq_coe_iff_maximal_le_coheight
statement:
lemma coheight_eq_coe_iff_maximal_le_coheight {a : α} {n : ℕ} :
    coheight a = n ↔ Maximal (fun y => n ≤ coheight y) a

name: one_lt_height_iff
statement: lemma one_lt_height_iff {x : α} : 1 < Order.height x ↔ ∃ y z, z < y ∧ y < x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ENat.add_one_le_iff ENat.one_ne_top, one_add_one_eq_two]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨p, hp, hlen⟩ := Order.exists_series_of_le_height x (n := 2) h
    refine ⟨p 1, p 0, p.rel_of_lt ?_, hp ▸ p.rel_of_lt ?_⟩ <;> simp [Fin.lt_def, hlen]
  · rintro ⟨y, z, hzy, hyx⟩
    let p : LTSeries α := RelSeries.fromListIsChain [z, y, x] (List.cons_ne_nil z [y, x])
      (List.IsChain.cons_cons hzy <| List.isChain_pair.mpr hyx)
    have : p.last = x := by simp [p, ← RelSeries.getLast_toList]
    exact Order.length_le_height this.le

name: krullDim_eq_bot_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma krullDim_eq_bot_iff : krullDim α = ⊥ ↔ IsEmpty α
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_bot_iff, krullDim, iSup_le_iff]
  simp only [le_bot_iff, WithBot.natCast_ne_bot, isEmpty_iff]
  exact ⟨fun H x ↦ H ⟨0, fun _ ↦ x, by simp⟩, (· <| · 1)⟩

name: krullDim_nonneg_iff
statement: lemma krullDim_nonneg_iff : 0 ≤ krullDim α ↔ Nonempty α
proof:
:= by
  contrapose!
  rw [← krullDim_eq_bot_iff, ← WithBot.lt_coe_bot, bot_eq_zero, WithBot.coe_zero]

statement: lemma krullDim_eq_bot [IsEmpty α] : krullDim α = ⊥

statement: theorem krullDim_ne_bot_iff : krullDim α ≠ ⊥ ↔ Nonempty α

name: krullDim_nonpos_iff_forall_isMax
statement: lemma krullDim_nonpos_iff_forall_isMax : krullDim α ≤ 0 ↔ ∀ x : α, IsMax x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [krullDim, iSup_le_iff, isMax_iff_forall_not_lt]
  refine ⟨fun H x y h ↦ (H ⟨1, ![x, y],
    fun i ↦ by obtain rfl := Subsingleton.elim i 0; simpa⟩).not_gt (by simp), ?_⟩
  · rintro H ⟨_ | n, l, h⟩
    · simp
    · cases H (l 0) (l 1) (h 0)

name: krullDim_nonpos_iff_forall_isMin
statement: lemma krullDim_nonpos_iff_forall_isMin : krullDim α ≤ 0 ↔ ∀ x : α, IsMin x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [krullDim_nonpos_iff_forall_isMax, IsMax, IsMin]
  exact forall_comm

name: krullDim_le_one_iff
statement: lemma krullDim_le_one_iff : krullDim α ≤ 1 ↔ ∀ x : α, IsMin x ∨ IsMax x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isMax_iff_forall_not_lt, isMin_iff_forall_not_lt, krullDim, iSup_le_iff]
  contrapose!
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨_ | _ | n, l, hl⟩, hl'⟩
    iterate 2 · cases hl'.not_ge (by simp)
    exact ⟨l 1, ⟨l 0, hl 0⟩, l 2, hl 1⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, ⟨y, hxy⟩, z, hzx⟩
    exact ⟨⟨2, ![y, x, z], fun i ↦ by fin_cases i <;> simpa⟩, by simp⟩

name: one_le_krullDim_iff
statement: lemma one_le_krullDim_iff : 1 ≤ krullDim α ↔ ∃ x y : α, x < y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← krullDim_pos_iff, ← Nat.cast_zero, ← ENat.WithBot.add_one_le_iff, Nat.cast_zero, zero_add]

name: krullDim_nonpos_of_subsingleton
statement: lemma krullDim_nonpos_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton α] : krullDim α ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [krullDim_nonpos_iff_forall_isMax]
  exact fun x y h ↦ (Subsingleton.elim x y).ge

statement:
lemma krullDim_eq_zero [Nonempty α] [Subsingleton α] :
    krullDim α = 0

name: krullDim_eq_zero_of_unique
statement: lemma krullDim_eq_zero_of_unique [Unique α] : krullDim α = 0

name: krullDim_le_one_iff_forall_isMax
statement:
lemma krullDim_le_one_iff_forall_isMax [OrderBot α] :
    krullDim α ≤ 1 ↔ ∀ x : α, x ≠ ⊥ → IsMax x

name: krullDim_eq_zero_iff_of_orderBot
statement:
lemma krullDim_eq_zero_iff_of_orderBot [OrderBot α] :
    krullDim α = 0 ↔ Subsingleton α
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun H ↦ subsingleton_of_forall_eq ⊥ fun _ ↦ le_bot_iff.mp
    (krullDim_nonpos_iff_forall_isMax.mp H.le ⊥ bot_le), fun _ ↦ Order.krullDim_eq_zero⟩

name: krullDim_pos_iff_of_orderBot
statement:
lemma krullDim_pos_iff_of_orderBot [OrderBot α] :
    0 < krullDim α ↔ Nontrivial α
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial, ← Order.krullDim_eq_zero_iff_of_orderBot,
    ← ne_eq, ← lt_or_lt_iff_ne, or_iff_right]
  simp [Order.krullDim_nonneg]

name: krullDim_le_one_iff_forall_isMin
statement:
lemma krullDim_le_one_iff_forall_isMin [OrderTop α] :
    krullDim α ≤ 1 ↔ ∀ x : α, x ≠ ⊤ → IsMin x

name: krullDim_eq_zero_iff_of_orderTop
statement:
lemma krullDim_eq_zero_iff_of_orderTop [OrderTop α] :
    krullDim α = 0 ↔ Subsingleton α
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun H ↦ subsingleton_of_forall_eq ⊤ fun _ ↦ top_le_iff.mp
    (krullDim_nonpos_iff_forall_isMin.mp H.le ⊤ le_top), fun _ ↦ Order.krullDim_eq_zero⟩

name: krullDim_pos_iff_of_orderTop
statement:
lemma krullDim_pos_iff_of_orderTop [OrderTop α] :
    0 < krullDim α ↔ Nontrivial α
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial, ← Order.krullDim_eq_zero_iff_of_orderTop,
    ← ne_eq, ← lt_or_lt_iff_ne, or_iff_right]
  simp [Order.krullDim_nonneg]

name: krullDim_le_one_iff_of_boundedOrder
statement:
lemma krullDim_le_one_iff_of_boundedOrder [BoundedOrder α] :
    krullDim α ≤ 1 ↔ ∀ x : α, x = ⊥ ∨ x = ⊤

name: krullDim_eq_length_of_finiteDimensionalOrder
statement:
lemma krullDim_eq_length_of_finiteDimensionalOrder [FiniteDimensionalOrder α] :
    krullDim α = (LTSeries.longestOf α).length
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm
    (iSup_le <| fun _ ↦ WithBot.coe_le_coe.mpr <| WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr <|
      RelSeries.length_le_length_longestOf _ _) <|
    le_iSup (fun (i : LTSeries _) ↦ (i.length : WithBot (WithTop ℕ))) <| LTSeries.longestOf _

name: krullDim_eq_top
statement:
lemma krullDim_eq_top [InfiniteDimensionalOrder α] :
    krullDim α = ⊤
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm le_top <| le_iSup_iff.mpr <| fun m hm ↦ match m, hm with
  | ⊥, hm => False.elim <| by
    have : Inhabited α := ⟨LTSeries.withLength _ 0 0⟩
    exact not_le_of_gt (WithBot.bot_lt_coe _ : ⊥ < (0 : WithBot (WithTop ℕ))) <| hm default
  | ⊤, _ => le_refl _
  | m, hm => by
    rw [top_le_iff, ENat.WithBot.eq_top_iff_forall_ge]
    intro n
    simpa using hm (LTSeries.withLength _ n)

name: krullDim_eq_top_iff
statement: lemma krullDim_eq_top_iff : krullDim α = ⊤ ↔ InfiniteDimensionalOrder α
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun _ ↦ krullDim_eq_top⟩
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty α
  · simp [krullDim_eq_bot] at h
  cases finiteDimensionalOrder_or_infiniteDimensionalOrder α
  · rw [krullDim_eq_length_of_finiteDimensionalOrder] at h
    cases h
  · infer_instance

name: le_krullDim_iff
statement: lemma le_krullDim_iff {n : ℕ} : n ≤ krullDim α ↔ ∃ l : LTSeries α, l.length = n
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty α
  · simp [krullDim_eq_bot]
  cases finiteDimensionalOrder_or_infiniteDimensionalOrder α
  · rw [krullDim_eq_length_of_finiteDimensionalOrder, Nat.cast_le]
    constructor
    · exact fun H ↦ ⟨(LTSeries.longestOf α).take ⟨_, Nat.lt_succ_of_le H⟩, rfl⟩
    · exact fun ⟨l, hl⟩ ↦ hl ▸ l.longestOf_is_longest
  · simpa [krullDim_eq_top] using SetRel.InfiniteDimensional.exists_relSeries_with_length n

name: krullDim_eq_iSup_length
statement:
lemma krullDim_eq_iSup_length [Nonempty α] :
    krullDim α = ⨆ (p : LTSeries α), (p.length : ℕ∞)

name: krullDim_lt_coe_iff
statement: lemma krullDim_lt_coe_iff {n : ℕ} : krullDim α < n ↔ ∀ l : LTSeries α, l.length < n
proof:
:= by
  rw [krullDim, ← WithBot.coe_natCast]
  rcases n with - | n
  · rw [ENat.natCast_zero, ← bot_eq_zero, WithBot.lt_coe_bot]
    simp
  · simp [ENat.WithBot.lt_add_one_iff, WithBot.coe_natCast]

name: krullDim_le_of_strictMono
statement: lemma krullDim_le_of_strictMono (f : α → β) (hf : StrictMono f) : krullDim α ≤ krullDim β
proof:
:=
  iSup_le fun p ↦ le_sSup ⟨p.map f hf, rfl⟩

name: krullDim_le_of_strictComono_and_surj
statement:
lemma krullDim_le_of_strictComono_and_surj
    (f : α → β) (hf : ∀ ⦃a b⦄, f a < f b → a < b) (hf' : Function.Surjective f) :
    krullDim β ≤ krullDim α
proof:
:=
  iSup_le fun p ↦ le_sSup ⟨p.comap _ hf hf', rfl⟩

name: krullDim_eq_of_orderIso
statement: lemma krullDim_eq_of_orderIso (f : α ≃o β) : krullDim α = krullDim β

name: krullDim_orderDual
statement: @[simp] lemma krullDim_orderDual : krullDim αᵒᵈ = krullDim α
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (iSup_le fun i ↦ le_sSup ⟨i.reverse, rfl⟩) <|
    iSup_le fun i ↦ le_sSup ⟨i.reverse, rfl⟩

name: height_le_krullDim
statement: lemma height_le_krullDim (a : α) : height a ≤ krullDim α
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty α := ⟨a⟩
  rw [krullDim_eq_iSup_length]
  simp only [WithBot.coe_le_coe]
  exact height_le fun p _ ↦ le_iSup_of_le p le_rfl

name: coheight_le_krullDim
statement: lemma coheight_le_krullDim (a : α) : coheight a ≤ krullDim α
proof:
:= by
  simpa using! height_le_krullDim (α := αᵒᵈ) a

name: _root_.LTSeries.height_last_longestOf
statement:
@[simp]
lemma _root_.LTSeries.height_last_longestOf [FiniteDimensionalOrder α] :
    height (LTSeries.longestOf α).last = krullDim α
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (height_le_krullDim _) ?_
  rw [krullDim_eq_length_of_finiteDimensionalOrder, height]
  norm_cast
  exact le_iSup_iff.mpr <| fun _ h ↦ iSup_le_iff.mp (h _) le_rfl

name: krullDim_eq_iSup_height_of_nonempty
statement: lemma krullDim_eq_iSup_height_of_nonempty [Nonempty α] : krullDim α = ↑(⨆ (a : α), height a)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply iSup_le
    intro p
    suffices p.length ≤ ⨆ (a : α), height a from (WithBot.unbotD_le_iff fun _ => this).mp this
    apply le_iSup_of_le p.last (length_le_height_last (p := p))
  · rw [WithBot.coe_iSup (by bddDefault)]
    apply iSup_le
    apply height_le_krullDim

name: krullDim_eq_iSup_coheight_of_nonempty
statement:
lemma krullDim_eq_iSup_coheight_of_nonempty [Nonempty α] :
    krullDim α = ↑(⨆ (a : α), coheight a)

name: krullDim_eq_iSup_height_add_coheight_of_nonempty
statement:
lemma krullDim_eq_iSup_height_add_coheight_of_nonempty [Nonempty α] :
    krullDim α = ↑(⨆ (a : α), height a + coheight a)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [krullDim_eq_iSup_height_of_nonempty, WithBot.coe_le_coe]
    apply ciSup_mono (by bddDefault) (by simp)
  · wlog hnottop : krullDim α < ⊤
    · simp_all
    rw [krullDim_eq_iSup_length, WithBot.coe_le_coe]
    apply iSup_le
    intro a
    have : height a < ⊤ := WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt (height_le_krullDim a) hnottop)
    have : coheight a < ⊤ := WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt (coheight_le_krullDim a) hnottop)
    cases hh : height a with
    | top => simp_all
    | coe n =>
      cases hch : coheight a with
      | top => simp_all
      | coe m =>
        obtain ⟨p₁, hlast, hlen₁⟩ := exists_series_of_height_eq_coe a hh
        obtain ⟨p₂, hhead, hlen₂⟩ := exists_series_of_coheight_eq_coe a hch
        apply le_iSup_of_le ((p₁.smash p₂) (by simp [*])) (by simp [*])

name: krullDim_eq_iSup_height
statement: lemma krullDim_eq_iSup_height : krullDim α = ⨆ (a : α), ↑(height a)
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty α with
  | inl h => rw [krullDim_eq_bot, ciSup_of_empty]
  | inr h => rw [krullDim_eq_iSup_height_of_nonempty, WithBot.coe_iSup (OrderTop.bddAbove _)]

name: krullDim_eq_iSup_coheight
statement: lemma krullDim_eq_iSup_coheight : krullDim α = ⨆ (a : α), ↑(coheight a)
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty α with
  | inl h => rw [krullDim_eq_bot, ciSup_of_empty]
  | inr h => rw [krullDim_eq_iSup_coheight_of_nonempty, WithBot.coe_iSup (OrderTop.bddAbove _)]

name: height_top_eq_krullDim
statement:
@[simp] 
lemma height_top_eq_krullDim [OrderTop α] : height (⊤ : α) = krullDim α
proof:
:= by
  rw [krullDim_eq_iSup_length]
  simp only [WithBot.coe_inj]
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact height_le fun p _ ↦ le_iSup_of_le p le_rfl
  · exact iSup_le fun _ => length_le_height le_top

name: coheight_bot_eq_krullDim
statement:
@[simp] 
lemma coheight_bot_eq_krullDim [OrderBot α] : coheight (⊥ : α) = krullDim α
proof:
:= by
  rw [← krullDim_orderDual]
  exact height_top_eq_krullDim (α := αᵒᵈ)

name: height_eq_krullDim_Iic
statement: lemma height_eq_krullDim_Iic (x : α) : (height x : ℕ∞) = krullDim (Set.Iic x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← height_top_eq_krullDim, height, height, WithBot.coe_inj]
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply iSup_le; intro p; apply iSup_le; intro hp
    let q := LTSeries.mk p.length (fun i ↦ (⟨p.toFun i, le_trans (p.monotone (Fin.le_last _)) hp⟩
     : Set.Iic x)) (fun _ _ h ↦ p.strictMono h)
    simp only [le_top, iSup_pos, ge_iff_le]
    exact le_iSup (fun p ↦ (p.length : ℕ∞)) q
  · apply iSup_le; intro p; apply iSup_le; intro _
    have mono : StrictMono (fun (y : Set.Iic x) ↦ y.1) := fun _ _ h ↦ h
    rw [← LTSeries.map_length p (fun x ↦ x.1) mono]
    refine le_iSup₂ (f := fun p hp ↦ (p.length : ℕ∞)) (p.map (fun x ↦ x.1) mono) ?_
    exact (p.toFun (Fin.last p.length)).2

name: coheight_eq_krullDim_Ici
statement:
lemma coheight_eq_krullDim_Ici {α : Type*} [Preorder α] (x : α) :
    (coheight x : ℕ∞) = krullDim (Set.Ici x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coheight, ← krullDim_orderDual, Order.krullDim_eq_of_orderIso (OrderIso.refl _)]
  exact height_eq_krullDim_Iic _

name: finiteDimensionalOrder_iff_krullDim_ne_bot_and_top
statement:
lemma finiteDimensionalOrder_iff_krullDim_ne_bot_and_top :
    FiniteDimensionalOrder α ↔ krullDim α ≠ ⊥ ∧ krullDim α ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : Nonempty α
  · simp [← not_infiniteDimensionalOrder_iff, ← krullDim_eq_top_iff]
  · constructor
    · exact (fun h1 ↦ False.elim (h (LTSeries.nonempty_of_finiteDimensionalOrder α)))
    · exact (fun h1 ↦ False.elim (h1.1 (krullDim_eq_bot_iff.mpr (not_nonempty_iff.mp h))))

name: krullDim_ne_bot_of_finiteDimensionalOrder
statement: lemma krullDim_ne_bot_of_finiteDimensionalOrder [FiniteDimensionalOrder α] : krullDim α ≠ ⊥

name: krullDim_ne_top_of_finiteDimensionalOrder
statement: lemma krullDim_ne_top_of_finiteDimensionalOrder [FiniteDimensionalOrder α] : krullDim α ≠ ⊤

name: coheight_lt_top
statement: lemma coheight_lt_top [FiniteDimensionalOrder α] (x : α) : coheight x < ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [← WithBot.coe_lt_coe]
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt (coheight_le_krullDim x)
  simpa using krullDim_ne_top_of_finiteDimensionalOrder.lt_top

lemma KrullDimLE.mono {n m : ℕ} (e : n ≤ m) (α : Type*) [Preorder α] [KrullDimLE n α] :

statement:
lemma krullDim_eq_one_iff_of_boundedOrder {α : Type*} [PartialOrder α] [BoundedOrder α] :
    krullDim α = 1 ↔ IsSimpleOrder α
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_antisymm_iff, krullDim_le_one_iff_of_boundedOrder, WithBot.one_le_iff_pos,
    Order.krullDim_pos_iff_of_orderBot, isSimpleOrder_iff, and_comm]

name: krullDim_of_isSimpleOrder
statement:
@[simp] lemma krullDim_of_isSimpleOrder {α : Type*} [PartialOrder α] [BoundedOrder α]
    [IsSimpleOrder α] : krullDim α = 1

name: height_nat
statement: @[simp] lemma height_nat (n : ℕ) : height n = n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with | ind n ih =>
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply height_le_coe_iff.mpr
    simp +contextual only [ih, Nat.cast_lt, implies_true]
  · exact length_le_height_last (p := LTSeries.range n)

name: coheight_of_noMaxOrder
statement: @[simp] lemma coheight_of_noMaxOrder [NoMaxOrder α] (a : α) : coheight a = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hstrictmono⟩ := Nat.exists_strictMono ↑(Set.Ioi a)
  apply coheight_eq_top_iff.mpr
  intro m
  use { length := m, toFun := fun i => if i = 0 then a else f i, step := ?step }
  case h => simp [RelSeries.head]
  case step =>
    intro ⟨i, hi⟩
    by_cases hzero : i = 0
    · subst i
      exact (f 1).prop
    · suffices f i < f (i + 1) by simp [Fin.ext_iff, hzero, this]
      apply hstrictmono
      lia

name: height_of_noMinOrder
statement: @[simp] lemma height_of_noMinOrder [NoMinOrder α] (a : α) : height a = ⊤

statement: @[simp] lemma krullDim_of_noMaxOrder [Nonempty α] [NoMaxOrder α] : krullDim α = ⊤

statement: @[simp] lemma krullDim_of_noMinOrder [Nonempty α] [NoMinOrder α] : krullDim α = ⊤

statement: lemma coheight_nat (n : ℕ) : coheight n = ⊤

name: height_coe_withBot
statement: @[simp] lemma height_coe_withBot (x : α) : height (x : WithBot α) = height x + 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply height_le
    intro p hlast
    wlog hlenpos : p.length ≠ 0
    · simp_all
    
    let p' : LTSeries α := {
      length := p.length - 1
      toFun := fun ⟨i, hi⟩ => (p ⟨i+1, by lia⟩).unbot (by
        apply ne_bot_of_gt (b := p.head)
        apply p.strictMono
        exact compare_gt_iff_gt.mp rfl)
      step := fun i => by simpa [WithBot.unbot_lt_iff] using! p.step ⟨i + 1, by lia⟩ }
    have hlast' : p'.last = x := by
      simp only [p', RelSeries.last, WithBot.unbot_eq_iff, ← hlast, Fin.last]
      congr
      lia
    suffices p'.length ≤ height p'.last by
      simpa [p', hlast'] using! this
    apply length_le_height_last
  · rw [height_add_const]
    apply iSup₂_le
    intro p hlast
    let p' := (p.map _ WithBot.coe_strictMono).cons ⊥ (by simp)
    apply le_iSup₂_of_le p' (by simp [p', hlast]) (by simp [p'])

name: coheight_coe_withTop
statement: @[simp] lemma coheight_coe_withTop (x : α) : coheight (x : WithTop α) = coheight x + 1
proof:
:= by
  have := height_coe_withBot (OrderDual.toDual x)
  rw [← height_orderIso (WithBot.toDualTopEquiv (α := α))] at this
  exact this

name: height_coe_withTop
statement: @[simp] lemma height_coe_withTop (x : α) : height (x : WithTop α) = height x
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply height_le
    intro p hlast
    
    let p' : LTSeries α := {
      length := p.length
      toFun := fun i => (p i).untop (by
        apply WithTop.lt_top_iff_ne_top.mp
        apply lt_of_le_of_lt
        · exact p.monotone (Fin.le_last _)
        · rw [RelSeries.last] at hlast
          simp [hlast])
      step := fun i => by simpa [WithTop.untop_lt_iff, WithTop.coe_untop] using p.step i }
    have hlast' : p'.last = x := by
      simp only [p', RelSeries.last, WithTop.untop_eq_iff, ← hlast]
    suffices p'.length ≤ height p'.last by
      rw [hlast'] at this
      simpa [p'] using this
    apply length_le_height_last
  · apply height_le
    intro p hlast
    let p' := p.map _ WithTop.coe_strictMono
    apply le_iSup₂_of_le p' (by simp [p', hlast]) (by simp [p'])

name: coheight_zero_of_coheight_one_of_strictMono
statement:
lemma coheight_zero_of_coheight_one_of_strictMono
    {α β : Type*} [Preorder α] [Preorder β] (f : WithTop α → β) (hf : StrictMono f) (x : α)
    (h : coheight (f x) = 1) : coheight x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := coheight_le_coheight_apply_of_strictMono f hf x
  rw [h] at this
  have h₁ : coheight (x : WithTop α) = 1 := le_antisymm this (by simp)
  simpa using h₁

name: coheight_coe_withBot
statement: @[simp] lemma coheight_coe_withBot (x : α) : coheight (x : WithBot α) = coheight x
proof:
:= by
  have := height_coe_withTop (OrderDual.toDual x)
  rw [← height_orderIso (WithTop.toDualBotEquiv (α := α))] at this
  exact this

name: krullDim_WithTop
statement: @[simp] lemma krullDim_WithTop [Nonempty α] : krullDim (WithTop α) = krullDim α + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← height_top_eq_krullDim, krullDim_eq_iSup_height_of_nonempty, height_eq_iSup_lt_height]
  norm_cast
  simp_rw [WithTop.lt_top_iff_ne_top]
  rw [ENat.iSup_add, iSup_subtype']
  symm
  apply Equiv.withTopSubtypeNe.symm.iSup_congr
  simp

name: krullDim_withBot
statement: @[simp] lemma krullDim_withBot [Nonempty α] : krullDim (WithBot α) = krullDim α + 1
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← krullDim_orderDual]
  conv_rhs => rw [← krullDim_orderDual]
  rw [krullDim_eq_of_orderIso (WithTop.toDualBotEquiv (α := α)).symm]
  exact krullDim_WithTop (α := αᵒᵈ)

name: krullDim_enat
statement:
@[simp]
lemma krullDim_enat : krullDim ℕ∞ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  change (krullDim (WithTop ℕ) = ⊤)
  simp [← WithBot.coe_top, ← WithBot.coe_one, ← WithBot.coe_add]

name: height_enat
statement:
@[simp]
lemma height_enat (n : ℕ∞) : height n = n
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | top => simp only [← WithBot.coe_eq_coe, height_top_eq_krullDim, krullDim_enat, WithBot.coe_top]
  | coe n => exact (height_coe_withTop _).trans (height_nat _)

name: coheight_coe_enat
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coheight_coe_enat (n : ℕ) : coheight (n : ℕ∞) = ⊤

name: height_le_of_krullDim_preimage_le
statement:
lemma height_le_of_krullDim_preimage_le (x : α) :
    Order.height x ≤ (m + 1) * Order.height (f x) + m
proof:
:= by
  generalize h' : Order.height (f x) = n
  cases n with | top => simp | coe n =>
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing x with | h n ih =>
    refine height_le_iff.mpr fun p hp ↦ le_of_not_gt fun h_len ↦ ?_
    let i : Fin (p.length + 1) := ⟨p.length - (m + 1), Nat.sub_lt_succ p.length _⟩
    suffices h'' : f (p i) < f x by
      obtain ⟨n', hn'⟩ : ∃ (n' : ℕ), n' = height (f (p i)) := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp
        ((height_mono h''.le).trans_lt (h' ▸ ENat.natCast_lt_top _)).ne
      have h_lt : n' < n := ENat.natCast_lt_natCast.mp
        (h' ▸ hn' ▸ height_strictMono h'' (hn' ▸ ENat.natCast_lt_top _))
      have := (length_le_height_last (p := p.take i)).trans <| ih n' h_lt (p i) hn'.symm
      rw [RelSeries.take_length, ENat.natCast_sub, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, tsub_le_iff_right,
        add_assoc, add_comm _ (_ + 1), ← add_assoc, ← mul_add_one] at this
      refine not_lt_of_ge ?_ (h_len.trans_le this)
      gcongr
      rwa [← ENat.natCast_one, ← ENat.natCast_add, ENat.natCast_le_natCast]
    refine (f.monotone ((p.monotone (Fin.le_last _)).trans hp)).lt_of_not_ge fun h'' ↦ ?_
    let q' : LTSeries α := p.drop i
    let q : LTSeries (f ⁻¹' {f x}) := ⟨q'.length, fun j ↦ ⟨q' j, le_antisymm
      (f.monotone (le_trans (b := q'.last) (q'.monotone (Fin.le_last _)) (p.last_drop _ ▸ hp)))
      (le_trans (b := f q'.head) (p.head_drop _ ▸ h'')
        (f.monotone (q'.monotone (Fin.zero_le _))))⟩, fun i ↦ q'.step i⟩
    have := (LTSeries.length_le_krullDim q).trans (h (f x))
    simp only [RelSeries.drop_length, Nat.cast_le, tsub_le_iff_right, q', i, q] at this
    have : p.length > m := ENat.natCast_lt_natCast.mp ((le_add_left le_rfl).trans_lt h_len)
    lia

name: coheight_le_of_krullDim_preimage_le
statement:
lemma coheight_le_of_krullDim_preimage_le (x : α) :
    Order.coheight x ≤ (m + 1) * Order.coheight (f x) + m
proof:
:= by
  rw [Order.coheight, Order.coheight]
  apply height_le_of_krullDim_preimage_le (f := f.dual)
  exact fun x ↦ le_of_eq_of_le (krullDim_orderDual (α := f ⁻¹' {x})) (h x)

name: krullDim_le_of_krullDim_preimage_le
statement:
lemma krullDim_le_of_krullDim_preimage_le :
    Order.krullDim α ≤ (m + 1) * Order.krullDim β + m
proof:
:= by

  refine fun x ↦ (WithBot.coe_mono (height_le_of_krullDim_preimage_le f h x)).trans ?_

  gcongr
  exacts [right_eq_inf.mp rfl, le_iSup_iff.mpr fun b a ↦ a (f x)]

statement:
theorem acc_iff_isEmpty_subtype_mem_range {x} :
    Acc r x ↔ IsEmpty { f : ((· > ·) : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) ↪r r // x ∈ Set.range f } where
  mp acc
proof:
:= .mk fun ⟨f, k, hk⟩ ↦ not_acc_iff_exists_descending_chain.mpr
    ⟨(f <| k + ·), hk, fun _n ↦ f.map_rel_iff.2 (Nat.lt_succ_self _)⟩ acc
  mpr h := of_not_not fun nacc ↦
    have ⟨f, hf⟩ := not_acc_iff_exists_descending_chain.mp nacc
    h.elim ⟨natGT f hf.2, 0, hf.1⟩

name: exists_subseq_of_forall_mem_union
statement:
theorem exists_subseq_of_forall_mem_union {s t : Set α} (e : ℕ → α) (he : ∀ n, e n ∈ s ∪ t) :
    ∃ g : ℕ ↪o ℕ, (∀ n, e (g n) ∈ s) ∨ ∀ n, e (g n) ∈ t
proof:
:= by
  classical
    have : Infinite (e ⁻¹' s) ∨ Infinite (e ⁻¹' t) := by
      simp only [Set.infinite_coe_iff, ← Set.infinite_union, ← Set.preimage_union,
        Set.eq_univ_of_forall fun n => Set.mem_preimage.2 (he n), Set.infinite_univ]
    cases this
    exacts [⟨Nat.orderEmbeddingOfSet (e ⁻¹' s), Or.inl fun n => (Nat.Subtype.ofNat (e ⁻¹' s) _).2⟩,
      ⟨Nat.orderEmbeddingOfSet (e ⁻¹' t), Or.inr fun n => (Nat.Subtype.ofNat (e ⁻¹' t) _).2⟩]

name: exists_increasing_or_nonincreasing_subseq'
statement:
theorem exists_increasing_or_nonincreasing_subseq' (r : α → α → Prop) (f : ℕ → α) :
    ∃ g : ℕ ↪o ℕ,
      (∀ n : ℕ, r (f (g n)) (f (g (n + 1)))) ∨ ∀ m n : ℕ, m < n → ¬r (f (g m)) (f (g n))
proof:
:= by
  classical
    let bad : Set ℕ := { m | ∀ n, m < n → ¬r (f m) (f n) }
    by_cases hbad : Infinite bad
    · refine ⟨Nat.orderEmbeddingOfSet bad, Or.intro_right _ fun m n mn => ?_⟩
      have h := @Set.mem_range_self _ _ ↑(Nat.orderEmbeddingOfSet bad) m
      rw [Nat.orderEmbeddingOfSet_range bad] at h
      exact h _ ((OrderEmbedding.lt_iff_lt _).2 mn)
    · rw [Set.infinite_coe_iff, Set.Infinite, not_not] at hbad
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, ∀ n, m ≤ n → n ∉ bad := by
        by_cases he : hbad.toFinset.Nonempty
        · refine
            ⟨(hbad.toFinset.max' he).succ, fun n hn nbad =>
              Nat.not_succ_le_self _
                (hn.trans (hbad.toFinset.le_max' n (hbad.mem_toFinset.2 nbad)))⟩
        · exact ⟨0, fun n _ nbad => he ⟨n, hbad.mem_toFinset.2 nbad⟩⟩
      have h : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ n' : ℕ, n < n' ∧ r (f (n + m)) (f (n' + m)) := by
        intro n
        have h := hm _ (Nat.le_add_left m n)
        simp only [bad, exists_prop, not_not, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_forall] at h
        obtain ⟨n', hn1, hn2⟩ := h
        refine ⟨n + n' - n - m, by lia, ?_⟩
        convert! hn2
        lia
      let g' : ℕ → ℕ := @Nat.rec (fun _ => ℕ) m fun n gn => Nat.find (h gn)
      exact
        ⟨(RelEmbedding.natLT (fun n => g' n + m) fun n =>
              Nat.add_lt_add_right (Nat.find_spec (h (g' n))).1 m).orderEmbeddingOfLTEmbedding,
          Or.intro_left _ fun n => (Nat.find_spec (h (g' n))).2⟩

name: exists_increasing_or_nonincreasing_subseq
statement:
theorem exists_increasing_or_nonincreasing_subseq (r : α → α → Prop) [IsTrans α r] (f : ℕ → α) :
    ∃ g : ℕ ↪o ℕ,
      (∀ m n : ℕ, m < n → r (f (g m)) (f (g n))) ∨ ∀ m n : ℕ, m < n → ¬r (f (g m)) (f (g n))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hr | hnr⟩ := exists_increasing_or_nonincreasing_subseq' r f
  · refine ⟨g, Or.intro_left _ fun m n mn => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (Nat.succ_le_iff.2 mn)
    induction x with
    | zero => apply hr
    | succ x ih =>
      apply IsTrans.trans _ _ _ _ (hr _)
      exact ih (lt_of_lt_of_le m.lt_succ_self (Nat.le_add_right _ _))
  · exact ⟨g, Or.intro_right _ hnr⟩

name: Infinite.exists_strictMono_or_strictAnti
statement:
theorem Infinite.exists_strictMono_or_strictAnti (α : Type*) [LinearOrder α] [Infinite α] :
    ∃ f : ℕ → α, StrictMono f ∨ StrictAnti f
proof:
:= by
  let f := Infinite.natEmbedding α
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := exists_increasing_or_nonincreasing_subseq (· < ·) f
  refine ⟨f ∘ g, ?_⟩
  rcases hg with hIncreasing | hNonincreasing
  · exact Or.inl hIncreasing
  · refine Or.inr <| fun m n hmn ↦ lt_of_le_of_ne ?_ ((f.injective.comp g.injective).ne ?_)
    · grind
    · grind

  intro
  obtain ⟨f, hStrictMono | hStrictAnti⟩ := Infinite.exists_strictMono_or_strictAnti α
  · exact not_strictMono_of_wellFoundedGT f hStrictMono
  · exact not_strictAnti_of_wellFoundedLT f hStrictAnti

name: wellFoundedGT_iff_monotone_chain_condition'
statement:
theorem wellFoundedGT_iff_monotone_chain_condition' [Preorder α] :
    WellFoundedGT α ↔ ∀ a : ℕ →o α, ∃ n, ∀ m, n ≤ m → ¬a n < a m
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h a => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨x, ⟨n, rfl⟩, H⟩ := h.wf.has_min _ (Set.range_nonempty a)
    exact ⟨n, fun m _ => H _ (Set.mem_range_self _)⟩
  · rw [WellFoundedGT, isWellFounded_iff, RelEmbedding.wellFounded_iff_isEmpty]
    refine ⟨fun a => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h (a.swap : _ →r _).toOrderHom
    exact hn n.succ n.lt_succ_self.le ((RelEmbedding.map_rel_iff _).2 n.lt_succ_self)

name: exists_covBy_seq_of_wellFoundedLT_wellFoundedGT
statement:
theorem exists_covBy_seq_of_wellFoundedLT_wellFoundedGT (α) [Preorder α]
    [Nonempty α] [wfl : WellFoundedLT α] [wfg : WellFoundedGT α] :
    ∃ a : ℕ → α, IsMin (a 0) ∧ ∃ n, IsMax (a n) ∧ ∀ i < n, a i ⋖ a (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  choose next hnext using exists_covBy_of_wellFoundedLT (α := α)
  have hα := Set.nonempty_iff_univ_nonempty.mp ‹_›
  classical
  let a : ℕ → α := Nat.rec (wfl.wf.min _ hα) fun _n a ↦ if ha : IsMax a then a else next ha
  refine ⟨a, isMin_iff_forall_not_lt.mpr fun _ ↦ wfl.wf.not_lt_min _ (Set.mem_univ _), ?_⟩
  have cov n (hn : ¬ IsMax (a n)) : a n ⋖ a (n + 1) := by
    change a n ⋖ if ha : IsMax (a n) then a n else _
    rw [dite_eq_right hn]
    exact hnext hn
  have H : ∃ n, IsMax (a n) := by
    by_contra!
    exact (RelEmbedding.natGT a fun n ↦ (cov n (this n)).1).not_wellFounded wfg.wf
  exact ⟨_, wellFounded_lt.min_mem _ H, fun i h ↦ cov _ (wellFounded_lt.not_lt_min _ · h)⟩

name: exists_covBy_seq_of_wellFoundedLT_wellFoundedGT_of_le
statement:
theorem exists_covBy_seq_of_wellFoundedLT_wellFoundedGT_of_le {α : Type*} [PartialOrder α]
    [wfl : WellFoundedLT α] [wfg : WellFoundedGT α] {x y : α} (h : x ≤ y) :
    ∃ a : ℕ → α, a 0 = x ∧ ∃ n, a n = y ∧ ∀ i < n, a i ⋖ a (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let S := Set.Icc x y
  let hS : BoundedOrder S :=
    { top := ⟨y, h, le_rfl⟩, le_top x := x.2.2, bot := ⟨x, le_rfl, h⟩, bot_le x := x.2.1 }
  obtain ⟨a, h₁, n, h₂, e⟩ := exists_covBy_seq_of_wellFoundedLT_wellFoundedGT S
  simp only [isMin_iff_eq_bot, Subtype.ext_iff, isMax_iff_eq_top] at h₁ h₂
  exact ⟨Subtype.val ∘ a, h₁, n, h₂, fun i hi ↦ ⟨(e i hi).1, fun c hc h ↦ (e i hi).2
    (c := ⟨c, (a i).2.1.trans hc.le, h.le.trans (a _).2.2⟩) hc h⟩⟩

theorem bounded_inter_not (H : ∀ a b, ∃ m, ∀ c, r c a ∨ r c b → r c m) (a : α) :

name: Directed.extend_bot
proof:
:= by
  intro a b
  rcases (em (∃ i, e i = a)).symm with (ha | ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  · use b
    simp [Function.extend_apply' _ _ _ ha]
  rcases (em (∃ i, e i = b)).symm with (hb | ⟨j, rfl⟩)
  · use e i
    simp [Function.extend_apply' _ _ _ hb]
  rcases hf i j with ⟨k, hi, hj⟩
  use e k
  simp only [he.extend_apply, *, true_and]

name: DirectedOn.insert
statement:
protected theorem DirectedOn.insert [Std.Refl r] (a : α) {s : Set α} (hd : DirectedOn r s)
    (ha : ∀ b ∈ s, ∃ c ∈ s, a ≼ c ∧ b ≼ c) : DirectedOn r (insert a s)
proof:
:= by
  rintro x (rfl | hx) y (rfl | hy)
  · exact ⟨y, Set.mem_insert _ _, refl _, refl _⟩
  · obtain ⟨w, hws, hwr⟩ := ha y hy
    exact ⟨w, Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ hws, hwr⟩
  · obtain ⟨w, hws, hwr⟩ := ha x hx
    exact ⟨w, Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ hws, hwr.symm⟩
  · obtain ⟨w, hws, hwr⟩ := hd x hx y hy
    exact ⟨w, Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ hws, hwr⟩

proof:
:= fun a as ↦
  let ⟨x, xs, xm, xa⟩ := hd m hm a as
  xa.trans (hmax x xs xm)

name: isTop_or_exists_gt
statement:
@[to_dual isBot_or_exists_lt]
theorem isTop_or_exists_gt [IsDirectedOrder α] (a : α) : IsTop a ∨ ∃ b, a < b

name: isTop_iff_isMax
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem isTop_iff_isMax [IsDirectedOrder α] : IsTop a ↔ IsMax a

name: Monotone.forall_le_of_antitone
statement:
theorem Monotone.forall_le_of_antitone [IsDirectedOrder α] [Preorder β] {f g : α → β}
    (hf : Monotone f) (hg : Antitone g) (h : f ≤ g) (m n : α) : f m ≤ g n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hkm, hkn⟩ := exists_ge_ge m n
  calc
    f m ≤ f k := hf hkm
    _ ≤ g k := h _
    _ ≤ g n := hg hkn

name: exists_lt_of_directed_ge
statement:
@[to_dual exists_lt_of_directed_le]
theorem exists_lt_of_directed_ge [IsCodirectedOrder β] :
    ∃ a b : β, a < b
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_pair_ne β with ⟨a, b, hne⟩
  rcases isBot_or_exists_lt a with (ha | ⟨c, hc⟩)
  exacts [⟨a, b, (ha b).lt_of_ne hne⟩, ⟨_, _, hc⟩]

name: IsMax.not_isMin
statement:
@[to_dual]
protected theorem IsMax.not_isMin [IsDirectedOrder β] {b : β} (hb : IsMax b) : ¬ IsMin b
proof:
:= by
  intro hb'
  obtain ⟨a, c, hac⟩ := exists_lt_of_directed_le β
  have := hb.isTop a
  obtain rfl := (hb' <| this).antisymm this
  exact hb'.not_lt hac

name: IsMin.not_isMax'
statement:
@[to_dual]
protected theorem IsMin.not_isMax' [IsDirectedOrder β] {b : β} (hb : IsMin b) : ¬ IsMax b

name: constant_of_monotone_antitone
statement:
lemma constant_of_monotone_antitone [IsDirectedOrder α] (hf : Monotone f) (hf' : Antitone f)
    (a b : α) : f a = f b
proof:
:= by
  have := hf.forall_le_of_antitone hf' le_rfl
  exact le_antisymm (this a b) (this b a)

name: constant_of_monotoneOn_antitoneOn
statement:
lemma constant_of_monotoneOn_antitoneOn (hf : MonotoneOn f s) (hf' : AntitoneOn f s)
    (hs : DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) s) : ∀ ⦃a⦄, a ∈ s → ∀ ⦃b⦄, b ∈ s → f a = f b
proof:
:= by
  rintro a ha b hb
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hac, hbc⟩ := hs _ ha _ hb
  exact le_antisymm ((hf ha hc hac).trans <| hf' hb hc hbc) ((hf hb hc hbc).trans <| hf' ha hc hac)

name: proj
statement:
lemma proj {d : Set (Π i, α i)} (hd : DirectedOn (fun x y => ∀ i, r i (x i) (y i)) d) (i : ι) :
    DirectedOn (r i) ((fun a => a i) '' d)
proof:
:=
  DirectedOn.mono_comp (fun _ _ h => h) (mono hd fun ⦃_ _⦄ h ↦ h i)

name: pi
statement:
lemma pi {d : (i : ι) → Set (α i)} (hd : ∀ (i : ι), DirectedOn (r i) (d i)) :
    DirectedOn (fun x y => ∀ i, r i (x i) (y i)) (Set.pi Set.univ d)
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb
  choose f hfd haf hbf using fun i => hd i (a i) (ha i trivial) (b i) (hb i trivial)
  exact ⟨f, fun i _ => hfd i, haf, hbf⟩

name: fst
statement:
lemma fst {d : Set (α × β)} (hd : DirectedOn (fun p q ↦ p.1 ≼₁ q.1 ∧ p.2 ≼₂ q.2) d) :
    DirectedOn (· ≼₁ ·) (Prod.fst '' d)
proof:
:=
  DirectedOn.mono_comp (fun ⦃_ _⦄ h ↦ h) (mono hd fun ⦃_ _⦄ h ↦ h.1)

name: snd
statement:
lemma snd {d : Set (α × β)} (hd : DirectedOn (fun p q ↦ p.1 ≼₁ q.1 ∧ p.2 ≼₂ q.2) d) :
    DirectedOn (· ≼₂ ·) (Prod.snd '' d)
proof:
:=
  DirectedOn.mono_comp (fun ⦃_ _⦄ h ↦ h) (mono hd fun ⦃_ _⦄ h ↦ h.2)

name: prod
statement:
lemma prod {d₁ : Set α} {d₂ : Set β} (h₁ : DirectedOn (· ≼₁ ·) d₁) (h₂ : DirectedOn (· ≼₂ ·) d₂) :
    DirectedOn (fun p q ↦ p.1 ≼₁ q.1 ∧ p.2 ≼₂ q.2) (d₁ ×ˢ d₂)
proof:
:= fun _ hpd _ hqd => by
  obtain ⟨r₁, hdr₁, hpr₁, hqr₁⟩ := h₁ _ hpd.1 _ hqd.1
  obtain ⟨r₂, hdr₂, hpr₂, hqr₂⟩ := h₂ _ hpd.2 _ hqd.2
  exact ⟨⟨r₁, r₂⟩, ⟨hdr₁, hdr₂⟩, ⟨hpr₁, hpr₂⟩, ⟨hqr₁, hqr₂⟩⟩

name: inf_sup_le_assoc_of_le
statement:
@[to_dual existing]
theorem inf_sup_le_assoc_of_le {x z : α} (y : α) : z ≤ x → x ⊓ (y ⊔ z) ≤ x ⊓ y ⊔ z
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [inf_comm x, sup_comm _ z]

name: sup_inf_assoc_of_le
statement:

theorem sup_inf_assoc_of_le {x : α} (y : α) {z : α} (h : x ≤ z) : (x ⊔ y) ⊓ z = x ⊔ y ⊓ z
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (sup_inf_le_assoc_of_le y h)
    (le_inf (sup_le_sup_left inf_le_left _) (sup_le h inf_le_right))

name: eq_of_le_of_inf_le_of_le_sup
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem eq_of_le_of_inf_le_of_le_sup (hxy : x ≤ y) (hinf : y ⊓ z ≤ x) (hsup : y ≤ x ⊔ z) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  refine hxy.antisymm ?_
  rw [← inf_eq_right, sup_inf_assoc_of_le _ hxy] at hsup
  rwa [← hsup, sup_le_iff, and_iff_right rfl.le, inf_comm]

@[to_dual]
theorem eq_of_le_of_inf_le_of_sup_le (hxy : x ≤ y) (hinf : y ⊓ z ≤ x ⊓ z) (hsup : y ⊔ z ≤ x ⊔ z) :

theorem sup_lt_sup_of_lt_of_inf_le_inf (hxy : y < x) (hinf : x ⊓ z ≤ y ⊓ z) : y ⊔ z < x ⊔ z
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_of_ne (sup_le_sup_right (le_of_lt hxy) _) fun hsup =>
    ne_of_lt hxy <| eq_of_le_of_inf_le_of_sup_le (le_of_lt hxy) hinf (le_of_eq hsup.symm)

name: strictMono_inf_prod_sup
statement: theorem strictMono_inf_prod_sup : StrictMono fun x ↦ (x ⊓ z, x ⊔ z)
proof:
:= fun _x _y hxy ↦
  ⟨⟨inf_le_inf_right _ hxy.le, sup_le_sup_right hxy.le _⟩,
    fun ⟨inf_le, sup_le⟩ ↦ (sup_lt_sup_of_lt_of_inf_le_inf hxy inf_le).not_ge sup_le⟩

name: wellFounded_lt_exact_sequence
statement:
theorem wellFounded_lt_exact_sequence {β γ : Type*} [Preorder β] [Preorder γ]
    [h₁ : WellFoundedLT β] [h₂ : WellFoundedLT γ] (K : α)
    (f₁ : β → α) (f₂ : α → β) (g₁ : γ → α) (g₂ : α → γ) (gci : GaloisCoinsertion f₁ f₂)
    (gi : GaloisInsertion g₂ g₁) (hf : ∀ a, f₁ (f₂ a) = a ⊓ K) (hg : ∀ a, g₁ (g₂ a) = a ⊔ K) :
    WellFoundedLT α
proof:
:=
  StrictMono.wellFoundedLT (f := fun A ↦ (f₂ A, g₂ A)) fun A B hAB ↦ by
    simp only [Prod.le_def, lt_iff_le_not_ge, ← gci.l_le_l_iff, ← gi.u_le_u_iff, hf, hg]
    exact strictMono_inf_prod_sup hAB

name: wellFounded_gt_exact_sequence
statement:
theorem wellFounded_gt_exact_sequence {β γ : Type*} [Preorder β] [Preorder γ]
    [WellFoundedGT β] [WellFoundedGT γ] (K : α)
    (f₁ : β → α) (f₂ : α → β) (g₁ : γ → α) (g₂ : α → γ) (gci : GaloisCoinsertion f₁ f₂)
    (gi : GaloisInsertion g₂ g₁) (hf : ∀ a, f₁ (f₂ a) = a ⊓ K) (hg : ∀ a, g₁ (g₂ a) = a ⊔ K) :
    WellFoundedGT α
proof:
:=
  wellFounded_lt_exact_sequence (α := αᵒᵈ) (β := γᵒᵈ) (γ := βᵒᵈ)
    K g₁ g₂ f₁ f₂ gi.dual gci.dual hg hf

name: le_iff_eq_of_codisjoint_of_disjoint
statement:
lemma le_iff_eq_of_codisjoint_of_disjoint [Lattice α] [BoundedOrder α] [IsModularLattice α]
    {a b c : α} (h₀ : Codisjoint a b) (h₁ : Disjoint b c) :
    a ≤ c ↔ a = c
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h₂ ↦ le_antisymm h₂ <| by simpa [h₀.eq_top, h₁.eq_bot] using sup_inf_le_assoc_of_le b h₂,
   le_of_eq⟩

name: isModularLattice_iff_inf_sup_inf_assoc
statement:
theorem isModularLattice_iff_inf_sup_inf_assoc [Lattice α] :
    IsModularLattice α ↔ ∀ x y z : α, x ⊓ z ⊔ y ⊓ z = (x ⊓ z ⊔ y) ⊓ z
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => @IsModularLattice.inf_sup_inf_assoc _ _ h, fun h =>
    ⟨fun y z xz => by rw [← inf_eq_left.2 xz, h]⟩⟩

name: disjoint_sup_right_of_disjoint_sup_left
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem disjoint_sup_right_of_disjoint_sup_left [Lattice α] [OrderBot α]
    [IsModularLattice α] (h : Disjoint a b) (hsup : Disjoint (a ⊔ b) c) :
    Disjoint a (b ⊔ c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [disjoint_iff_inf_le, ← h.eq_bot, sup_comm]
  apply le_inf inf_le_left
  apply (inf_le_inf_right (c ⊔ b) le_sup_right).trans
  rw [sup_comm, IsModularLattice.sup_inf_sup_assoc, hsup.eq_bot, bot_sup_eq]

name: disjoint_sup_left_of_disjoint_sup_right
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem disjoint_sup_left_of_disjoint_sup_right [Lattice α] [OrderBot α]
    [IsModularLattice α] (h : Disjoint b c) (hsup : Disjoint a (b ⊔ c)) :
    Disjoint (a ⊔ b) c
proof:
:= by
  rw [disjoint_comm, sup_comm]
  apply Disjoint.disjoint_sup_right_of_disjoint_sup_left h.symm
  rwa [sup_comm, disjoint_comm] at hsup

name: _root_.disjoint_sup_right_of_disjoint_sup_right
statement:
@[to_dual]
lemma _root_.disjoint_sup_right_of_disjoint_sup_right [Lattice α] [OrderBot α] [IsModularLattice α]
    (h₁ : Disjoint a (b ⊔ c)) (h₂ : Disjoint b (c ⊔ a)) :
    Disjoint c (a ⊔ b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sup_comm] at h₂ ⊢
  rw [disjoint_comm]
  exact (h₁.mono_right le_sup_right).disjoint_sup_left_of_disjoint_sup_right h₂

name: Set.Iic.isCompl_inf_inf_of_isCompl_of_le
statement:
lemma Set.Iic.isCompl_inf_inf_of_isCompl_of_le [Lattice α] [BoundedOrder α] [IsModularLattice α]
    {a b c : α} (h₁ : IsCompl b c) (h₂ : b ≤ a) :
    IsCompl (⟨a ⊓ b, inf_le_left⟩ : Iic a) (⟨a ⊓ c, inf_le_left⟩ : Iic a)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp [disjoint_iff, Subtype.ext_iff, inf_comm a c, inf_assoc a, ← inf_assoc b, h₁.inf_eq_bot]
  · simp only [Iic.codisjoint_iff, inf_comm a, IsModularLattice.inf_sup_inf_assoc]
    simp [inf_of_le_left h₂, h₁.sup_eq_top]

name: exists_inf_eq_and_sup_eq
statement: theorem exists_inf_eq_and_sup_eq (hb : a ≤ b) (hc : b ≤ c) : ∃ b', b ⊓ b' = a ∧ b ⊔ b' = c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hdisjoint, hcodisjoint⟩ := exists_isCompl b
  refine ⟨(d ⊔ a) ⊓ c, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [← inf_assoc, ← inf_sup_assoc_of_le _ hb, hdisjoint.eq_bot] using hb.trans hc
  · simp [← sup_inf_assoc_of_le _ hc, ← sup_assoc, hcodisjoint.eq_top]

statement: theorem exists_disjoint_and_sup_eq (h : a ≤ b) : ∃ a', Disjoint a a' ∧ a ⊔ a' = b
