  apply exists_inf_eq_and_sup_eq h (by simp)

name: _root_.Disjoint.exists_isCompl
statement:
theorem _root_.Disjoint.exists_isCompl {a b : α} (hab : Disjoint a b) :
    ∃ a' : α, a ≤ a' ∧ IsCompl a' b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := ComplementedLattice.exists_isCompl (a ⊔ b)
  exact ⟨u ⊔ a, le_sup_right, hab.isCompl_sup_left_of_isCompl_sup_right hu.symm⟩

name: northcott_iff_tendsto
statement:
theorem northcott_iff_tendsto [LinearOrder β] [NoMaxOrder β] :
    Northcott h ↔ Tendsto h cofinite atTop
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [northcott_iff, tendsto_atTop, eventually_cofinite, not_le]
  refine ⟨fun H b ↦ (H b).subset fun x ↦ le_of_lt, fun H b ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨b', hc⟩ := exists_gt b
  exact (H b').subset fun x hx ↦ lt_of_le_of_lt hx hc

name: exists_min_image
statement:
theorem exists_min_image [LinearOrder β] [Northcott h] (s : Set α) (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    ∃ a ∈ s, ∀ a' ∈ s, h a ≤ h a'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a₁, h₁⟩ := hs
  obtain ⟨a₂, h₂, h₃⟩ := Set.exists_min_image ({a | h a ≤ h a₁} ∩ s) h
    ((finite_le (h a₁)).inter_of_left s) ⟨a₁, le_rfl, h₁⟩
  grind

name: comp_of_bddAbove
statement:
lemma comp_of_bddAbove [Preorder β] [LE γ] [Northcott h] (H : ∀ c, BddAbove (h' ⁻¹' {x | x ≤ c})) :
    Northcott (h' ∘ h) where
  finite_le c
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := bddAbove_def.mp (H c)
    exact (finite_le (h := h) b).subset <| by grind

name: comp_of_finite_fibers
statement:
lemma comp_of_finite_fibers [LE γ] [Northcott h'] [Filter.TendstoCofinite h] :
    Northcott (h' ∘ h) where

proof:
:= by
    refine Set.Finite.of_finite_fibers h ?_ fun x _ ↦
      (Filter.TendstoCofinite.finite_preimage_singleton h x).inter_of_right _
    exact (finite_le (h := h') c).subset <| by grind

:= by

      Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    exact fun a ↦ le_ωSup c a
  · simp only [lowerBounds, upperBounds, Set.mem_range, forall_exists_index,

name: eq_of_chain
statement: theorem eq_of_chain {c : Chain (Part α)} {a b : α} (ha : some a ∈ c) (hb : some b ∈ c) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, ha⟩ := ha; replace ha := ha.symm
  obtain ⟨j, hb⟩ := hb; replace hb := hb.symm
  rw [eq_some_iff] at ha hb
  rcases le_total i j with hij | hji
  · have := c.monotone hij _ ha; apply mem_unique this hb
  · have := c.monotone hji _ hb; apply Eq.symm; apply mem_unique this ha

name: mem_chain_of_mem_
statement: theorem mem_chain_of_mem_ωSup {c : Chain (Part α)} {a : α} (h : a ∈ Part.ωSup c) : some a ∈ c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Part.ωSup] at h; split_ifs at h with h_1
  · have h' := Classical.choose_spec h_1
    rw [← eq_some_iff] at h
    rw [← h]
    exact h'

name: exists_supIrred_decomposition
statement:
@[to_dual
/
elements. This is the order-theoretic analogue of prime factorisation. -/]
theorem exists_supIrred_decomposition (a : α) :
    ∃ s : Finset α, s.sup id = a ∧ ∀ ⦃b⦄, b ∈ s → SupIrred b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply WellFoundedLT.induction a _
  clear a
  rintro a ih
  by_cases ha : SupIrred a
  · exact ⟨{a}, by simp [ha]⟩
  rw [not_supIrred] at ha
  obtain ha | ⟨b, c, rfl, hb, hc⟩ := ha
  · exact ⟨∅, by simp [ha.eq_bot]⟩
  obtain ⟨s, rfl, hs⟩ := ih _ hb
  obtain ⟨t, rfl, ht⟩ := ih _ hc
  exact ⟨s ∪ t, sup_union, forall_mem_union.2 ⟨hs, ht⟩⟩

@[simp] lemma range_subset_range : range m ⊆ range n ↔ n ≤ m where
  mp h x
proof:
:= by
    rw [← mem_range.mp (Set.range_subset_iff.mp h x)]
    exact n.monotone m.le_apply
  mpr h :=
    range_subset_range_iff_exists_comp.mpr ⟨m, (comp_eq_right_iff_le.mpr h).symm⟩

name: DirSupClosedOn.union
statement:
theorem DirSupClosedOn.union (hDL : IsLowerSet D)
    (hs : DirSupClosedOn D s) (ht : DirSupClosedOn D t) : DirSupClosedOn D (s ∪ t)
proof:
:= by
  intro d hD hdu hd₀ hd₁ a ha
  have hdst : d ∩ s ∪ d ∩ t = d := by grind
  wlog h : DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) (d ∩ s) ∧ IsCofinalFor (d ∩ t) (d ∩ s)
  · rw [union_comm] at hdu hdst ⊢
    exact this hDL ht hs hD hdu hd₀ hd₁ ha hdst <|
      (directedOn_union_iff.mp (by rwa [hdst])).resolve_right h
  obtain ⟨hds, hcof⟩ := h
  have hcof' : IsCofinalFor d (d ∩ s) := hcof.union_right.mono_left hdst.ge
  exact .inl <| hs (hDL inter_subset_left hD) inter_subset_right
    (hcof'.nonempty hd₀) hds (ha.of_isCofinalFor inter_subset_left hcof')

statement:
theorem DirSupInaccOn.of_inter_subset
    (h : ∀ ⦃d : Set α⦄, d ∈ D → d.Nonempty → DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) d →
      ∀ ⦃a : α⦄, IsLUB d a → a ∈ s → ∃ b ∈ d, Ici b ∩ d ⊆ s) : DirSupInaccOn D s
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd₀ hd₁ hd₂ a hda hd₃
  obtain ⟨b, hbd, hb⟩ := h hd₀ hd₁ hd₂ hda hd₃
  exact ⟨b, hbd, hb ⟨le_rfl, hbd⟩⟩

name: dirSupInaccOn_iff_inter_subset
statement:
theorem dirSupInaccOn_iff_inter_subset (hDL : IsLowerSet D) :
    DirSupInaccOn D s ↔ ∀ ⦃d : Set α⦄, d ∈ D → d.Nonempty → DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) d →
      ∀ ⦃a : α⦄, IsLUB d a → a ∈ s → ∃ b ∈ d, Ici b ∩ d ⊆ s where
  mpr
proof:
:= .of_inter_subset
  mp h t hD ht₀ ht₁ a ha has := by
    by_contra! H
    have hcof : IsCofinalFor t (t \ s) := by grind [IsCofinalFor, not_subset]
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxs⟩ := h (hDL sdiff_subset hD) (hcof.nonempty ht₀)
      (ht₁.of_isCofinalFor sdiff_subset hcof)
      (ha.of_isCofinalFor sdiff_subset hcof) has
    exact hx.2 hxs

name: dirSupInacc_iff_inter_subset
statement:

@[elab_as_elim]
lemma closure_bot_sup_induction {p : ∀ g ∈ closure s, Prop} (mem : ∀ x hx, p x (subset_closure hx))
    (bot : p ⊥ bot_mem)
    (sup : ∀ x hx y hy, p x hx → p y hy → p (x ⊔ y) (supClosed _ hx hy))
    (compl : ∀ x hx, p x hx → p xᶜ (compl_mem hx)) {x} (hx : x ∈ closure s) : p x hx

name: closure_eq_latticeClosure
statement:
lemma closure_eq_latticeClosure (hs1 : ⊥ ∈ s) (hs2 : compl '' s = s) :
    closure s = latticeClosure s
proof:
:= by
  refine subset_antisymm ?_ latticeClosure_subset_closure
  intro t ht
  induction ht using closure_bot_sup_induction with
  | mem _ hx => apply subset_latticeClosure hx
  | bot => apply subset_latticeClosure hs1
  | sup _ _ _ _ hx hy => apply isSublattice_latticeClosure.supClosed hx hy
  | compl _ _ h =>
    rw [← compl_image_latticeClosure_eq_of_compl_image_eq_self hs2]
    exact mem_image_of_mem compl h

name: mem_closure_iff_sup_sdiff
statement:
theorem mem_closure_iff_sup_sdiff {a : α} :
    a ∈ closure s ↔ ∃ t : Finset (s × s), a = t.sup fun x ↦ x.1.1 \ x.2.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨closure_bot_sup_induction
    (fun x h ↦ ⟨{(⟨x, h⟩, ⟨⊥, bot_mem⟩)}, by simp⟩) ⟨∅, by simp⟩ ?_ ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, rfl⟩
    exact t.sup_mem _ (subset_closure bot_mem) (fun _ h _ ↦ sup_mem h) _
      fun x hx ↦ sdiff_mem (subset_closure x.1.2) (subset_closure x.2.2)
  · rintro _ - _ - ⟨t₁, rfl⟩ ⟨t₂, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨t₁ ∪ t₂, by rw [Finset.sup_union]⟩
  rintro x - ⟨t, rfl⟩
  refine t.induction ⟨{(⟨⊤, top_mem⟩, ⟨⊥, bot_mem⟩)}, by simp⟩ fun ⟨x, y⟩ t _ ⟨tc, eq⟩ ↦ ?_
  simp_rw [Finset.sup_insert, compl_sup, eq]
  refine tc.induction ⟨∅, by simp⟩ fun ⟨z, w⟩ tc _ ⟨t, eq⟩ ↦ ?_
  simp_rw [Finset.sup_insert, inf_sup_left, eq]
  use {(z, ⟨_, isSublattice.supClosed x.2 w.2⟩), (⟨_, isSublattice.infClosed y.2 z.2⟩, w)} ∪ t
  simp_rw [Finset.sup_union, Finset.sup_insert, Finset.sup_singleton, _root_.sdiff_eq,
    compl_sup, inf_left_comm z.1, compl_inf, compl_compl, inf_sup_right, inf_assoc]

name: closure_sdiff_sup_induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim] theorem closure_sdiff_sup_induction {p : ∀ g ∈ closure s, Prop}
    (sdiff : ∀ x hx y hy, p (x \ y) (sdiff_mem (subset_closure hx) (subset_closure hy)))
    (sup : ∀ x hx y hy, p x hx → p y hy → p (x ⊔ y) (sup_mem hx hy))
    (x) (hx : x ∈ closure s) : p x hx
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := (mem_closure_iff_sup_sdiff isSublattice bot_mem top_mem).mp hx
  revert hx
  classical
  refine t.induction (by simpa using sdiff _ bot_mem _ bot_mem) fun x t _ ih hxt ↦ ?_
  simp only [Finset.sup_insert] at hxt ⊢
  exact sup _ _ _ ((mem_closure_iff_sup_sdiff isSublattice bot_mem top_mem).mpr ⟨_, rfl⟩)
    (sdiff _ x.1.2 _ x.2.2) (ih _)

name: semilatticeSup_mk'_partialOrder_eq_semilatticeInf_mk'_partialOrder
statement:
theorem semilatticeSup_mk'_partialOrder_eq_semilatticeInf_mk'_partialOrder
    {α : Type*} [Max α] [Min α]
    (sup_comm : ∀ a b : α, a ⊔ b = b ⊔ a) (sup_assoc : ∀ a b c : α, a ⊔ b ⊔ c = a ⊔ (b ⊔ c))
    (sup_idem : ∀ a : α, a ⊔ a = a) (inf_comm : ∀ a b : α, a ⊓ b = b ⊓ a)
    (inf_assoc : ∀ a b c : α, a ⊓ b ⊓ c = a ⊓ (b ⊓ c)) (inf_idem : ∀ a : α, a ⊓ a = a)
    (sup_inf_self : ∀ a b : α, a ⊔ a ⊓ b = a) (inf_sup_self : ∀ a b : α, a ⊓ (a ⊔ b) = a) :
    @SemilatticeSup.toPartialOrder _ (SemilatticeSup.mk' sup_comm sup_assoc sup_idem) =
      @SemilatticeInf.toPartialOrder _ (SemilatticeInf.mk' inf_comm inf_assoc inf_idem)
proof:
:=
  PartialOrder.ext fun a b =>
    show a ⊔ b = b ↔ b ⊓ a = a from
      ⟨fun h => by rw [← h, inf_comm, inf_sup_self], fun h => by rw [← h, sup_comm, sup_inf_self]⟩

name: inf_sup_left
statement:
@[to_dual existing]
theorem inf_sup_left (a b c : α) : a ⊓ (b ⊔ c) = a ⊓ b ⊔ a ⊓ c
proof:
:=
  calc
    a ⊓ (b ⊔ c) = a ⊓ (a ⊔ c) ⊓ (b ⊔ c) := by rw [inf_sup_self]
    _ = a ⊓ (a ⊓ b ⊔ c) := by simp only [inf_assoc, sup_inf_right]
    _ = (a ⊔ a ⊓ b) ⊓ (a ⊓ b ⊔ c) := by rw [sup_inf_self]
    _ = (a ⊓ b ⊔ a) ⊓ (a ⊓ b ⊔ c) := by rw [sup_comm]
    _ = a ⊓ b ⊔ a ⊓ c := by rw [sup_inf_left]

name: le_of_inf_le_sup_le
statement:
@[to_dual self (reorder := x y, h₁ h₂)]
theorem le_of_inf_le_sup_le (h₁ : x ⊓ z ≤ y ⊓ z) (h₂ : x ⊔ z ≤ y ⊔ z) : x ≤ y
proof:
:=
  calc
    x ≤ y ⊓ z ⊔ x := le_sup_right
    _ = (y ⊔ x) ⊓ (x ⊔ z) := by rw [sup_inf_right, sup_comm x]
    _ ≤ (y ⊔ x) ⊓ (y ⊔ z) := inf_le_inf_left _ h₂
    _ = y ⊔ x ⊓ z := by rw [← sup_inf_left]
    _ ≤ y ⊔ y ⊓ z := sup_le_sup_left h₁ _
    _ ≤ _ := sup_le (le_refl y) inf_le_left

    (hP : Antitone P) (hQ : Antitone Q) : ((∃ x, P x) ∧ ∃ x, Q x) ↔ (∃ x, P x ∧ Q x)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨⟨x, hPx⟩, ⟨y, hQx⟩⟩ ↦ ⟨x ⊓ y, ⟨hP inf_le_left hPx, hQ inf_le_right hQx⟩⟩,
    fun ⟨x, hPx, hQx⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨x, hPx⟩, ⟨x, hQx⟩⟩⟩

name: sup
statement:
protected theorem sup [Preorder α] [SemilatticeSup β] {f g : α → β} {s : Set α}
    (hf : AntitoneOn f s) (hg : AntitoneOn g s) : AntitoneOn (f ⊔ g) s
proof:
:=
  fun _ hx _ hy h => sup_le_sup (hf hx hy h) (hg hx hy h)

name: max

name: of_map_inf
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem of_map_inf [SemilatticeInf α] [SemilatticeSup β]
    (h : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, f (x ⊓ y) = f x ⊔ f y) : AntitoneOn f s
proof:
:= fun x hx y hy hxy =>
  sup_eq_left.1 <| by rw [← h _ hx _ hy, inf_eq_left.2 hxy]

name: map_sup
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem map_sup [SemilatticeInf β] (hf : AntitoneOn f s) (hx : x ∈ s) (hy : y ∈ s) :
    f (x ⊔ y) = f x ⊓ f y
proof:
:= by
  cases le_total x y <;> have := hf ?_ ?_ ‹_› <;>
    first
    | assumption
    | simp only [*, sup_of_le_left, sup_of_le_right, inf_of_le_left, inf_of_le_right]

name: coe_sup
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp, norm_cast) (rename := Psup → Pinf)]
theorem coe_sup [SemilatticeSup α] {P : α → Prop}
    (Psup : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, P x → P y → P (x ⊔ y)) (x y : Subtype P) :
    (haveI := Subtype.semilatticeSup Psup; (x ⊔ y : Subtype P) : α) = (x ⊔ y : α)

name: mk_sup_mk
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp) (rename := Psup → Pinf)]
theorem mk_sup_mk [SemilatticeSup α] {P : α → Prop}

    (haveI := Subtype.semilatticeSup Psup; (⟨x, hx⟩ ⊔ ⟨y, hy⟩ : Subtype P)) =
      ⟨x ⊔ y, Psup hx hy⟩

name: pairwise_iff_lt
statement: lemma pairwise_iff_lt [Std.Symm p] : Pairwise p ↔ ∀ ⦃a b⦄, a < b → p a b
proof:
:= by

name: Std.LawfulOrderCmp.compareOfLessAndEq
statement:
theorem Std.LawfulOrderCmp.compareOfLessAndEq (α : Type*)
    [LE α] [LT α] [LawfulOrderLT α] [IsLinearOrder α] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableLT α] :
    LawfulOrderCmp (fun a b : α ↦ compareOfLessAndEq a b)
proof:
:=
  let : Ord α := ⟨fun a b : α ↦ _root_.compareOfLessAndEq a b⟩
  { isLE_compare _ _ :=
      have : DecidableLE α := fun _ _ ↦ Classical.propDecidable _
      isLE_compareOfLessAndEq Std.le_antisymm Std.not_le (fun _ _ ↦ Std.le_total)
    isGE_compare _ _ :=
      have : DecidableLE α := fun _ _ ↦ Classical.propDecidable _
      isGE_compareOfLessAndEq Std.le_antisymm Std.not_le (fun _ _ ↦ Std.le_total) }

proof:
:=

  h.antisymm <| f.lfp_le <| f.mono h

name: lfp_induction
statement:
theorem lfp_induction {p : α → Prop} (step : ∀ a, p a → a ≤ f.lfp → p (f a))
    (hSup : ∀ s, (∀ a ∈ s, p a) → p (sSup s)) : p f.lfp
proof:
:= by
  set s := { a | a ≤ f.lfp ∧ p a }
  specialize hSup s fun a => And.right
  suffices sSup s = f.lfp from this ▸ hSup
  have h : sSup s ≤ f.lfp := sSup_le fun b => And.left
  have hmem : f (sSup s) ∈ s := ⟨f.map_le_lfp h, step _ hSup h⟩
  exact h.antisymm (f.lfp_le <| le_sSup hmem)

proof:
:=
  le_antisymm ((f.comp g).map_lfp ▸ f.mono (lfp_le_fixed _ <| congr_arg g (f.comp g).map_lfp)) <|
    lfp_le _ (congr_arg f (g.comp f).map_lfp).le

name: lfp_lfp
statement: theorem lfp_lfp (h : α →o α →o α) : (lfp.comp h).lfp = h.onDiag.lfp
proof:
:= by
  let a := (lfp.comp h).lfp
  refine (lfp_le _ ?_).antisymm (lfp_le _ (Eq.le ?_))
  · exact lfp_le _ h.onDiag.map_lfp.le
  have ha : (lfp ∘ h) a = a := (lfp.comp h).map_lfp
  calc
    h a a = h a (h a).lfp := congr_arg (h a) ha.symm
    _ = (h a).lfp := (h a).map_lfp
    _ = a := ha

:=

name: lfp_eq_sSup_iterate
statement:
theorem lfp_eq_sSup_iterate (h : ωScottContinuous f) :
    f.lfp = ⨆ n, f^[n] ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply lfp_le_fixed
    exact Function.mem_fixedPoints.mp (ωSup_iterate_mem_fixedPoint
      ⟨f, h.map_ωSup_of_orderHom⟩ ⊥ bot_le)
  · apply le_lfp
    intro a h_a
    exact ωSup_iterate_le_prefixedPoint ⟨f, h.map_ωSup_of_orderHom⟩ ⊥ bot_le h_a bot_le

statement:
theorem chainHeight_eq_iSup :
    s.chainHeight r = ⨆ t : {t : Set α // t ⊆ s ∧ IsChain r t}, t.val.encard

name: chainHeight_le_encard
statement: theorem chainHeight_le_encard : s.chainHeight r ≤ s.encard

name: chainHeight_ne_top_of_finite
statement: theorem chainHeight_ne_top_of_finite (h : s.Finite) : s.chainHeight r ≠ ⊤
proof:
:=
  LT.lt.ne_top <| lt_of_le_of_lt (chainHeight_le_encard s r) <| lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr <|
    encard_ne_top_iff.mpr h

name: exists_isChain_of_le_chainHeight
statement:
theorem exists_isChain_of_le_chainHeight {r} {s : Set α} (n : ℕ) (h : n ≤ s.chainHeight r) :
    ∃ t ⊆ s, t.encard = n ∧ IsChain r t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h' : n = 0
  · exact ⟨∅, by simp [h']⟩
  · obtain ⟨t, ht₁, ht₂, ht₃⟩ : ∃ t ⊆ s, IsChain r t ∧ n ≤ t.encard := by
      contrapose! h
      refine iSup_lt_iff.mpr ⟨n - 1, ?_, fun m ↦ ENat.le_sub_one_of_lt <| h m.1 m.2.1 m.2.2⟩
      exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_one_lt h'
    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := exists_subset_encard_eq ht₃
    exact ⟨u, hu₁.trans ht₁, hu₂, ht₂.mono hu₁⟩

name: exists_eq_chainHeight_of_chainHeight_ne_top
statement:
theorem exists_eq_chainHeight_of_chainHeight_ne_top (h : s.chainHeight r ≠ ⊤) :
    ∃ t ⊆ s, t.encard = s.chainHeight r ∧ IsChain r t
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty { t // t ⊆ s ∧ IsChain r t } := ⟨∅, by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_eq_iSup_of_lt_top (by rwa [← chainHeight_eq_iSup, lt_top_iff_ne_top])
  exact ⟨t.1, t.2.1, ht, t.2.2⟩

name: exists_eq_chainHeight_of_finite
statement:
theorem exists_eq_chainHeight_of_finite (h : s.Finite) :
     ∃ t ⊆ s, t.encard = s.chainHeight r ∧ IsChain r t

name: encard_le_chainHeight_of_isChain
statement:
theorem encard_le_chainHeight_of_isChain {r} (s t : Set α) (hs : t ⊆ s) (hc : IsChain r t) :
    t.encard ≤ s.chainHeight r
proof:
:=
  le_iSup_iff.mpr fun _ hb ↦ hb ⟨t, hs, hc⟩

name: encard_eq_chainHeight_of_isChain
statement:
theorem encard_eq_chainHeight_of_isChain {r} (s : Set α) (hc : IsChain r s) :

name: finite_of_chainHeight_ne_top
statement:
theorem finite_of_chainHeight_ne_top {r} {s : Set α} (hc : IsChain r s) (h : s.chainHeight r ≠ ⊤) :

name: not_isChain_of_chainHeight_lt_encard
statement:
theorem not_isChain_of_chainHeight_lt_encard (s t : Set α) (ht : t ⊆ s)
    (he : s.chainHeight r < t.encard) : ¬ IsChain r t
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! hh
  grw [encard_le_chainHeight_of_isChain _ _ ht hh] at he
  exact (lt_self_iff_false _).mp he

name: chainHeight_eq_top_iff
statement:
theorem chainHeight_eq_top_iff :
    s.chainHeight r = ⊤ ↔ ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ t ⊆ s, t.encard = n ∧ IsChain r t
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h _ ↦ exists_isChain_of_le_chainHeight _ (le_top.trans_eq h.symm), fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  contrapose! h
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp h
  refine ⟨n + 1, fun l hl he ↦ not_isChain_of_chainHeight_lt_encard r s l hl ?_⟩
  rw [← hn, he]
  exact_mod_cast lt_add_one _

name: chainHeight_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chainHeight_eq_zero_iff : s.chainHeight r = 0 ↔ s = ∅
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [chainHeight, iSup_eq_zero, encard_eq_zero, Subtype.forall, and_imp] at h
    ext x
    simpa using h {x}
  · simp_all [chainHeight]

theorem chainHeight_empty : (∅ : Set α).chainHeight r = 0

name: one_le_chainHeight_iff
statement:

theorem one_le_chainHeight_iff : 1 ≤ s.chainHeight r ↔ s.Nonempty

  · intros

statement:

theorem chainHeight_of_isEmpty [IsEmpty α] : s.chainHeight r = 0

name: chainHeight_mono
statement:
@[gcongr, mono]
theorem chainHeight_mono (s t : Set α) (h : s ⊆ t) : s.chainHeight r ≤ t.chainHeight r
proof:
:= by
  refine forall_natCast_le_iff_le.mp fun n hn ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨a, ha₁, ha₂, ha₃⟩ := exists_isChain_of_le_chainHeight n hn
  exact ha₂ ▸ encard_le_chainHeight_of_isChain _ _ (ha₁.trans h) ha₃

name: chainHeight_flip
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chainHeight_flip : s.chainHeight (flip r) = s.chainHeight r
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_of_forall_natCast_le_iff fun n ↦ ⟨fun hn ↦ ?_, fun hn ↦ ?_⟩
  all_goals
  · obtain ⟨a, ha₁, ha₂, ha₃⟩ := exists_isChain_of_le_chainHeight n hn
    exact ha₂ ▸ encard_le_chainHeight_of_isChain _ _ ha₁ <|
      fun _ hx _ hy hne ↦ by simpa [flip, Or.comm] using ha₃ hx hy hne

name: chainHeight_eq_of_relEmbedding
statement:
theorem chainHeight_eq_of_relEmbedding (e : r ↪r r') :
    (e '' s).chainHeight r' = s.chainHeight r
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_of_forall_natCast_le_iff fun n ↦ ⟨fun hn ↦ ?_, fun hn ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨a, ha₁, ha₂, ha₃⟩ := exists_isChain_of_le_chainHeight n hn
    rw [← ha₂, ← Set.encard_preimage_of_injective_subset_range e.injective (by grind)]
    exact encard_le_chainHeight_of_isChain _ _ (preimage_subset ha₁ e.injective.injOn) <|
      ha₃.preimage_relEmbedding e
  · obtain ⟨a, ha₁, ha₂, ha₃⟩ := exists_isChain_of_le_chainHeight n hn
    rw [← ha₂, ← e.injective.encard_image]
    exact encard_le_chainHeight_of_isChain _ _ (by grind) <| ha₃.image e

name: chainHeight_eq_of_relIso
statement: theorem chainHeight_eq_of_relIso (e : r ≃r r') : (e '' s).chainHeight r' = s.chainHeight r

name: chainHeight_coe_univ

theorem chainHeight_coe_univ : (@Set.univ ↑s).chainHeight (r ↑· ↑·) = s.chainHeight r
proof:
:= by
  have hc := Set.chainHeight_eq_of_relEmbedding univ <| Subtype.relEmbedding (r · ·) (· ∈ s)
  have hs : Subtype.val ⁻¹'o (r · ·) = (fun x y : s ↦ r x y) := by funext; simp
  simpa [hs] using hc.symm

name: supClosed_empty

lemma SupClosed.directedOn (hs : SupClosed s) : DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) s

name: IsLowerSet.supClosed_iff_directedOn
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem IsLowerSet.supClosed_iff_directedOn (h : IsLowerSet s) :
    SupClosed s ↔ DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) s

:= by
  refine ⟨SupClosed.directedOn, fun hd a ha b hb ↦ ?_⟩

name: SupClosed.preimage
statement:
@[to_dual]
lemma SupClosed.preimage [FunLike F β α] [SupHomClass F β α] (hs : SupClosed s) (f : F) :

proof:
:=
  fun a ha b hb ↦ by simpa [map_sup] using hs ha hb

@[to_dual]
lemma SupClosed.image [FunLike F α β] [SupHomClass F α β] (hs : SupClosed s) (f : F) :
    SupClosed (f '' s)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ _ ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
  rw [← map_sup]
  exact Set.mem_image_of_mem _ <| hs ha hb

proof:
:= by

  refine ({t ∈ s.powerset | t.Nonempty}.attach.image
    fun t ↦ t.1.sup' (mem_filter.1 t.2).2 id).finite_toSet.subset ?_
  rintro _ ⟨t, ht, hts, rfl⟩
  simp only [id_eq, coe_image, mem_image, mem_coe, mem_attach, true_and, Subtype.exists,

name: supClosure_prod

  le_antisymm (supClosure_min (Set.prod_mono subset_supClosure subset_supClosure) <|
    supClosed_supClosure.prod supClosed_supClosure) <| by
      rintro ⟨_, _⟩ ⟨⟨u, hu, hus, rfl⟩, v, hv, hvt, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨u ×ˢ v, hu.product hv, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa only [coe_product] using Set.prod_mono hus hvt
      · simp [prodMk_sup'_sup']

name: latticeClosure_sup_inf_induction
statement:
@[to_dual self (reorder := sup inf)]
lemma latticeClosure_sup_inf_induction (p : (a : α) → a ∈ latticeClosure s → Prop)
    (mem : ∀ (a : α) (has : a ∈ s), p a (subset_latticeClosure has))
    (sup : ∀ (a : α) (has : a ∈ latticeClosure s) (b : α) (hbs : b ∈ latticeClosure s),
      p a has → p b hbs → p (a ⊔ b) (isSublattice_latticeClosure.supClosed has hbs))
    (inf : ∀ (a : α) (has : a ∈ latticeClosure s) (b : α) (hbs : b ∈ latticeClosure s),
      p a has → p b hbs → p (a ⊓ b) (isSublattice_latticeClosure.infClosed has hbs))
    {a : α} (has : a ∈ latticeClosure s) :
    p a has
proof:
:= by
  have h : IsSublattice { a : α | ∃ has : a ∈ latticeClosure s, p a has } := {
    supClosed := fun a ⟨has, hpa⟩ b ⟨hbs, hpb⟩ =>
      ⟨isSublattice_latticeClosure.supClosed has hbs, sup a has b hbs hpa hpb⟩
    infClosed := fun a ⟨has, hpa⟩ b ⟨hbs, hpb⟩ =>
      ⟨isSublattice_latticeClosure.infClosed has hbs, inf a has b hbs hpa hpb⟩ }
  refine (latticeClosure_min (fun a ha ↦ ?_) h has).choose_spec
  exact ⟨subset_latticeClosure ha, mem a ha⟩

name: image_latticeClosure
statement:
@[to_dual self (reorder := map_sup map_inf)]
lemma image_latticeClosure (s : Set α) (f : α → β)
    (map_sup : ∀ a b, f (a ⊔ b) = f a ⊔ f b) (map_inf : ∀ a b, f (a ⊓ b) = f a ⊓ f b) :
    f '' latticeClosure s = latticeClosure (f '' s)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [subset_antisymm_iff, Set.image_subset_iff]
  constructor <;> apply latticeClosure_sup_inf_induction
  · exact fun a ha ↦ subset_latticeClosure <| Set.mem_image_of_mem _ ha
  · rintro a - b - ha hb
    simpa [map_sup] using isSublattice_latticeClosure.supClosed ha hb
  · rintro a - b - ha hb
    simpa [map_inf] using isSublattice_latticeClosure.infClosed ha hb
  · exact Set.image_mono subset_latticeClosure
  · rintro _ - _ - ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a ⊔ b, isSublattice_latticeClosure.supClosed ha hb, map_sup ..⟩
  · rintro _ - _ - ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a ⊓ b, isSublattice_latticeClosure.infClosed ha hb, map_inf ..⟩

lemma image_latticeClosure' (s : Set α) (f : α → β)

proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Set.image_comp, Equiv.image_symm_eq_preimage, ← ofDual_preimage_latticeClosure]
    using! image_latticeClosure s (ofDual.symm ∘ f) map_sup map_inf

name: ici_isAdmissible
statement:
lemma ici_isAdmissible (le_map : ∀ x, x ≤ f x) : IsAdmissible x f (Ici x) where
  base_isLeast
proof:
:= ⟨le_refl x, fun _ h ↦ h⟩
  image_self_subset_self := by
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact le_trans hy (le_map _)
  cSup_mem := by
    intro c hc
    have ⟨y, hy⟩ := c.Nonempty'
    exact le_trans (hc hy) (le_cSup _ _ hy)

name: bot_isAdmissible
statement:
lemma bot_isAdmissible (le_map : ∀ x, x ≤ f x) : IsAdmissible x f (bot x f) where
  base_isLeast
proof:
:= by
    constructor
    · exact fun _ h ↦ h.base_isLeast.1
    · intro y hy
      exact hy (Ici x) (ici_isAdmissible le_map)
  image_self_subset_self := by
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ s hs
    exact hs.image_self_subset_self ⟨y, ⟨mem_sInter.1 hy _ hs, rfl⟩⟩
  cSup_mem := by
    intro c hc s hs
    exact hs.cSup_mem c (subset_trans hc (sInter_subset_of_mem hs))

name: subset_bot_iff
statement:
lemma subset_bot_iff {s : Set α} (h : IsAdmissible x f s) : s ⊆ bot x f ↔ s = bot x f where
  mp h'
proof:
:= subset_antisymm h' (sInter_subset_of_mem h)
  mpr h' := h' ▸ subset_refl (bot x f)

name: map_mem_bot
statement: lemma map_mem_bot {y : α} (le_map : ∀ x, x ≤ f x) (h : y ∈ bot x f) : f y ∈ bot x f

name: bot_eq_of_le_or_map_le
statement:
lemma bot_eq_of_le_or_map_le {y : α} (le_map : ∀ x, x ≤ f x) (hy : IsExtremePt x f y) :
    {z ∈ bot x f | z ≤ y ∨ f y ≤ z} = bot x f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← subset_bot_iff]
  · apply sep_subset
  · apply IsAdmissible.mk
    · constructor
      · constructor
        · exact (bot_isAdmissible le_map).base_isLeast.1
        · exact Or.inl ((bot_isAdmissible le_map).base_isLeast.2 hy.mem_bot)
      · exact fun y h ↦ (bot_isAdmissible le_map).base_isLeast.2 h.1
    · rintro _ ⟨z, ⟨hz, (hzy | hyz)⟩, rfl⟩ <;>
        refine ⟨map_mem_bot le_map hz, ?_⟩
      · rcases le_iff_lt_or_eq.1 hzy with (hzy | rfl)
        · left; exact hy.map_le_of_mem_of_lt hz hzy
        · right; exact le_refl _
      · right; exact le_trans hyz (le_map z)
    · intro c hc
      refine ⟨(bot_isAdmissible le_map).cSup_mem _ (subset_trans hc (sep_subset _ _)), ?_⟩
      · by_cases! h : ∀ z ∈ c, z ≤ y
        · left; apply cSup_le c y h
        · rcases h with ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩
          have h' := Or.resolve_left (hc hz).2 hzy
          right
          apply le_trans h' (le_cSup _ _ hz)

name: setOfPred_isExtremePt_isAdmissible
statement:
lemma setOfPred_isExtremePt_isAdmissible (le_map : ∀ x, x ≤ f x) :
    IsAdmissible x f {y | IsExtremePt x f y}
proof:
:= by
  apply IsAdmissible.mk
  · constructor
    · refine ⟨(bot_isAdmissible le_map).base_isLeast.1, ?_⟩
      intro y hy hyx
      exfalso
      exact lt_irrefl x (lt_of_le_of_lt ((bot_isAdmissible le_map).base_isLeast.2 hy) hyx)
    · exact fun y h ↦ (bot_isAdmissible le_map).base_isLeast.2 h.1
  · rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨map_mem_bot le_map hy.mem_bot, ?_⟩
    intro z hz hzy
    have hz' := hz
    rw [← bot_eq_of_le_or_map_le le_map hy] at hz'
    rcases hz' with ⟨_, (hz' | hz')⟩
    · rcases le_iff_lt_or_eq.1 hz' with (hz' | rfl)
      · exact le_trans (hy.map_le_of_mem_of_lt hz hz') (le_map y)
      · exact le_refl (f z)
    · exfalso
      exact lt_irrefl z (lt_of_lt_of_le hzy hz')
  · intro c hc
    refine ⟨(bot_isAdmissible le_map).cSup_mem _ (subset_trans hc (fun _ h ↦ h.mem_bot)), ?_⟩
    intro y hy hy'
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ : ∃ z ∈ c, ¬ (f z ≤ y) := by
      by_contra! h
      apply lt_irrefl y (lt_of_lt_of_le hy' ?_)
      apply cSup_le
      intro z hz
      exact le_trans (le_map z) (h z hz)
    have h : y ≤ z := by
      rw [← bot_eq_of_le_or_map_le le_map (hc hz)] at hy
      exact Or.resolve_right hy.2 hzy
    obtain hyz | rfl := le_iff_lt_or_eq.1 h
    · exact le_trans ((hc hz).map_le_of_mem_of_lt hy hyz) (le_cSup _ _ hz)
    · have hc' := (bot_isAdmissible le_map).cSup_mem _ (subset_trans hc fun _ h ↦ h.mem_bot)
      rw [← bot_eq_of_le_or_map_le le_map (hc hz)] at hc'
      apply hc'.2.resolve_left
      intro hc'
      exact lt_irrefl y (lt_of_lt_of_le hy' hc')

statement: lemma bot_isChain (le_map : ∀ x, x ≤ f x) : IsChain (· ≤ ·) (bot x f)

name: nonempty_fixedPoints_of_inflationary
statement:
theorem nonempty_fixedPoints_of_inflationary [Nonempty α] (le_map : ∀ x, x ≤ f x) :
    (fixedPoints f).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  let x : α := Classical.ofNonempty
  let y := cSup
    (NonemptyChain.mk (bot x f) ⟨x, (bot_isAdmissible le_map).base_isLeast.1⟩ (bot_isChain le_map))
  use y
  apply le_antisymm (le_cSup _ _ (_ : f y ∈ bot x f)) (le_map y)
  apply (bot_isAdmissible le_map).image_self_subset_self
  use y
  exact ⟨(bot_isAdmissible le_map).cSup_mem _ (subset_refl _), rfl⟩

name: lex_lt_of_lt_of_preorder
statement:
theorem lex_lt_of_lt_of_preorder [∀ i, Preorder (β i)] {r} (hwf : WellFounded r) {x y : ∀ i, β i}
    (hlt : x < y) : ∃ i, (∀ j, r j i → x j ≤ y j ∧ y j ≤ x j) ∧ x i < y i
proof:

  let h' := Pi.lt_def.1 hlt
  let ⟨i, hi, hl⟩ := hwf.has_min {i | x i < y i} h'.2
  ⟨i, fun j hj => ⟨h'.1 j, not_not.1 fun h => hl j (lt_of_le_not_ge (h'.1 j) h) hj⟩, hi⟩

name: trichotomous_lex
statement:
theorem trichotomous_lex [∀ i, Std.Trichotomous (α := β i) s] (wf : WellFounded r) :
    Std.Trichotomous (Pi.Lex r @s)
proof:
:=
  { trichotomous a b hab hba := by
      by_contra! h
      rw [Function.ne_iff] at h
      let i := wf.min {i | a i ≠ b i} h
      have hri j (hr : r j i) : a j = b j := not_not.mp (fun h => wf.not_lt_min _ (by grind) hr)
      have := Std.Trichotomous.trichotomous (a i) (b i) (hab ⟨i, hri, ·⟩)
      exact hba ⟨i, (hri · · |>.symm), Not.imp_symm this <| wf.min_mem {i | a i ≠ b i} h⟩ }

  rintro ⟨j, hj, h⟩
  dsimp at h
  obtain rfl : j = i := by

  rwa [update_self] at h

name: bddAbove_prod
statement:
@[to_dual]
lemma bddAbove_prod {s : Set (α × β)} :
    BddAbove s ↔ BddAbove (Prod.fst '' s) ∧ BddAbove (Prod.snd '' s)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨p, hp⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨p.1, forall_mem_image.2 fun _q hq ↦ (hp hq).1⟩,
    ⟨p.2, forall_mem_image.2 fun _q hq ↦ (hp hq).2⟩⟩,
    fun ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨y, hy⟩⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨x, y⟩, fun _p hp ↦
      ⟨hx <| mem_image_of_mem _ hp, hy <| mem_image_of_mem _ hp⟩⟩⟩

name: isLUB_prod
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem isLUB_prod {s : Set (α × β)} {p : α × β} :
    IsLUB s p ↔ IsLUB (Prod.fst '' s) p.1 ∧ IsLUB (Prod.snd '' s) p.2
proof:
:= by
  refine
    ⟨fun H =>
      ⟨⟨monotone_fst.mem_upperBounds_image H.1, fun a ha => ?_⟩,
        ⟨monotone_snd.mem_upperBounds_image H.1, fun a ha => ?_⟩⟩,
      fun H => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · suffices h : (a, p.2) ∈ upperBounds s from (H.2 h).1
    exact fun q hq => ⟨ha <| mem_image_of_mem _ hq, (H.1 hq).2⟩
  · suffices h : (p.1, a) ∈ upperBounds s from (H.2 h).2
    exact fun q hq => ⟨(H.1 hq).1, ha <| mem_image_of_mem _ hq⟩
  · exact fun q hq => ⟨H.1.1 <| mem_image_of_mem _ hq, H.2.1 <| mem_image_of_mem _ hq⟩
  · exact fun q hq =>
      ⟨H.1.2 <| monotone_fst.mem_upperBounds_image hq,
        H.2.2 <| monotone_snd.mem_upperBounds_image hq⟩

theorem isLUB_pi {s : Set (∀ a, π a)} {f : ∀ a, π a} :
    IsLUB s f ↔ ∀ a, IsLUB (Function.eval a '' s) (f a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
    refine
      ⟨fun H a => ⟨(Function.monotone_eval a).mem_upperBounds_image H.1, fun b hb => ?_⟩, fun H =>
        ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · suffices h : Function.update f a b ∈ upperBounds s from Function.update_self a b f ▸ H.2 h a
      exact fun g hg => le_update_iff.2 ⟨hb <| mem_image_of_mem _ hg, fun i _ => H.1 hg i⟩
    · exact fun g hg a => (H a).1 (mem_image_of_mem _ hg)
    · exact fun g hg a => (H a).2 ((Function.monotone_eval a).mem_upperBounds_image hg)

proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hxz, hyz⟩ := hd x (hst hx) y (hst hy)
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hzw⟩ := hc hz

name: isCofinalFor_or_isCofinalFor_of_directedOn_union

theorem isCofinalFor_or_isCofinalFor_of_directedOn_union (h : DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) (s ∪ t)) :
    IsCofinalFor t s ∨ IsCofinalFor s t
proof:
:= by
  rw [or_iff_not_imp_left]
  intro hts x hx
  simp only [IsCofinalFor, not_forall, not_exists, not_and] at hts
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hys⟩ := hts
  obtain ⟨z, (hzs | hzt), hxz, hyz⟩ := h x (.inl hx) y (.inr hy)
  · cases hys z hzs hyz
  · exact ⟨z, hzt, hxz⟩

name: directedOn_union_iff

theorem directedOn_union_iff :
    DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) (s ∪ t) ↔
      DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) s ∧ IsCofinalFor t s ∨ DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) t ∧ IsCofinalFor s t
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases isCofinalFor_or_isCofinalFor_of_directedOn_union h with hts | hst
    · exact .inl ⟨DirectedOn.of_isCofinalFor h subset_union_left hts.union_right, hts⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨DirectedOn.of_isCofinalFor h subset_union_right hst.union_left, hst⟩
  · rintro (⟨hs, hts⟩ | ⟨ht, hst⟩) x hx y hy
    · obtain ⟨x', hx', hxx'⟩ := hts.union_right hx
      obtain ⟨y', hy', hyy'⟩ := hts.union_right hy
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hx'z, hy'z⟩ := hs x' hx' y' hy'
      exact ⟨z, .inl hz, hxx'.trans hx'z, hyy'.trans hy'z⟩
    · obtain ⟨x', hx', hxx'⟩ := hst.union_left hx
      obtain ⟨y', hy', hyy'⟩ := hst.union_left hy
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hx'z, hy'z⟩ := ht x' hx' y' hy'
      exact ⟨z, .inr hz, hxx'.trans hx'z, hyy'.trans hy'z⟩

theorem bbdAbove_range_sup {ι : Sort*} {α : Type*} [SemilatticeSup α] {f g : ι → α}

  have ⟨ag, hag⟩ := hg

  mp h
proof:

  mpr := fun ⟨hf, hg⟩ ↦ bbdAbove_range_sup hf hg

proof:

    ⟨lowerBounds_le_upperBounds Ha.1 Hb.1 ⟨x, Hx⟩, fun hab =>

name: exists_covby_infinite_Ici_of_infinite_Ici
statement:
theorem exists_covby_infinite_Ici_of_infinite_Ici [IsStronglyAtomic α]
    (ha : (Set.Ici a).Infinite) (hfin : {x | a ⋖ x}.Finite) :
    ∃ b, a ⋖ b ∧ (Set.Ici b).Infinite
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h
  refine ((hfin.biUnion (t := Set.Ici) (by simpa using h)).subset (fun b hb ↦ ?_)).not_infinite
    (ha.sdiff (Set.finite_singleton a))
  obtain ⟨x, hax, hxb⟩ := ((show a ≤ b from hb.1).lt_of_ne (Ne.symm hb.2)).exists_covby_le
  exact Set.mem_biUnion hax hxb

name: exists_maximalFor
statement:
@[to_dual]
lemma exists_maximalFor (f : ι → α) (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    ∃ i, MaximalFor (· ∈ s) f i
proof:
:= by
  induction hs using Finset.Nonempty.cons_induction with
  | singleton i => exact ⟨i, by simp⟩
  | @cons i s hi hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := ih
    by_cases hji : f j ≤ f i
    · refine ⟨i, mem_cons_self .., ?_⟩
      simp only [mem_cons, forall_eq_or_imp, imp_self, true_and]
      exact fun k hk hik ↦ _root_.trans (hj.2 hk <| _root_.trans hji hik) hji
    · exact ⟨j, mem_cons_of_mem hj.1, by simpa [hji] using hj.2⟩

  exact ⟨b, hab, hb, fun c hc hbc ↦ hbmin hc (hab.trans hbc) hbc⟩

theorem Finite.exists_subsingleton_isCofinal {s : Set α} (hs : s.Finite) (hs' : IsCofinal s) :

proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hn := s.eq_empty_or_nonempty
  · use ∅; simpa
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hs.exists_maximal hn

    exact hbc.trans (ha.le hc)

name: OrderEmbedding.range_eq_iff
statement:
lemma OrderEmbedding.range_eq_iff
    {α β : Type*} [LinearOrder α] [PartialOrder β] [Finite α]
    {f g : α ↪o β} :
    Set.range f = Set.range g ↔ f = g
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, by rintro rfl; rfl⟩
  let ef := (f.strictMono.strictMonoOn .univ).orderIso
  let eg := (g.strictMono.strictMonoOn .univ).orderIso
  let i : f '' .univ ≃o g '' .univ :=
    { __ := Set.equivOfEq (by simpa using! h)
      map_rel_iff' := by rfl }
  have : (ef.trans i).trans eg.symm = .refl _ := by
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  ext x
  simpa only [OrderIso.trans_apply, OrderIso.apply_symm_apply, OrderIso.refl_apply, Subtype.ext_iff]
    using! congr(eg ($this ⟨x, Set.mem_univ x⟩))

name: OrderHom.range_eq_iff
statement:
lemma OrderHom.range_eq_iff {α β : Type*} [LinearOrder α] [PartialOrder β]
    [Finite α] {f g : α →o β}
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (hg : Function.Injective g) :
    Set.range f = Set.range g ↔ f = g
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, by rintro rfl; rfl⟩
  ext : 2
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun ((OrderEmbedding.range_eq_iff
    (f := .ofStrictMono f (f.monotone.strictMono_of_injective hf))
    (g := .ofStrictMono g (g.monotone.strictMono_of_injective hg))).1 (by simpa)) _

theorem IsChain.image_of_map_rel (r : α → α → Prop) (s : β → β → Prop) (f : α → β)
    (h : ∀ x y, r x y → s (f x) (f y)) {c : Set α} (hrc : IsChain r c) : IsChain s (f '' c)
proof:

  fun _ ⟨_, ha₁, ha₂⟩ _ ⟨_, hb₁, hb₂⟩ =>

proof:
:= by
  intro _ ha _ hb hne

  grind

statement: theorem IsChain.total (h : IsChain r s) (hx : x ∈ s) (hy : y ∈ s) : x ≺ y ∨ y ≺ x

name: IsChain.directedOn
statement: theorem IsChain.directedOn (H : IsChain r s) : DirectedOn r s
proof:
:= fun x hx y hy =>
  ((H.total hx hy).elim fun h => ⟨y, hy, h, refl _⟩) fun h => ⟨x, hx, refl _, h⟩

name: IsChain.directed
statement:
protected theorem IsChain.directed {f : β → α} {c : Set β} (h : IsChain (f ⁻¹'o r) c) :
    Directed r fun x : { a : β // a ∈ c } => f x
proof:
:=
  fun ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩ =>
    (by_cases fun hab : a = b => by
      simp only [hab, exists_prop, and_self_iff, Subtype.exists]
      exact ⟨b, hb, refl _⟩)
    fun hab => ((h ha hb hab).elim fun h => ⟨⟨b, hb⟩, h, refl _⟩) fun h => ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, refl _, h⟩

name: IsChain.exists3
statement:
theorem IsChain.exists3 (hchain : IsChain r s) [IsTrans α r] {a b c} (mem1 : a ∈ s) (mem2 : b ∈ s)
    (mem3 : c ∈ s) : ∃ (z : _) (_ : z ∈ s), r a z ∧ r b z ∧ r c z
proof:
:= by
  rcases directedOn_iff_directed.mpr (IsChain.directed hchain) a mem1 b mem2 with ⟨z, mem4, H1, H2⟩
  rcases directedOn_iff_directed.mpr (IsChain.directed hchain) z mem4 c mem3 with
    ⟨z', mem5, H3, H4⟩
  exact ⟨z', mem5, _root_.trans H1 H3, _root_.trans H2 H3, H4⟩

proof:
:= by
  cases hs.total hx hy with
  | inr h' => exact h'
  | inl h' => simpa [lt_iff_le_not_ge, h'] using h

proof:

lemma IsMaxChain.image {s : β → β → Prop} (e : r ≃r s) {c : Set α} (hc : IsMaxChain r c) :

  left
proof:
:= hc.isChain.image e
  right t ht hf := by
    rw [← e.coe_fn_toEquiv, ← e.toEquiv.eq_preimage_iff_image_eq, ← Equiv.image_symm_eq_preimage]
    exact hc.2 (ht.image e.symm) ((e.toEquiv.subset_symm_image _ _).2 hf)

name: succChain_spec
statement:
theorem succChain_spec (h : ∃ t, IsChain r s ∧ SuperChain r s t) :
    SuperChain r s (SuccChain r s)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsChain r s ∧ SuperChain r s h.choose := h.choose_spec
  simpa [SuccChain, dite_eq_left, exists_and_left.mp h] using this.2

name: IsChain.succ
statement: theorem IsChain.succ (hs : IsChain r s) : IsChain r (SuccChain r s)
proof:
:= by
  if h : ∃ t, IsChain r s ∧ SuperChain r s t then exact (succChain_spec h).1
  else
    rw [exists_and_left] at h
    simpa [SuccChain, dite_eq_right, h] using hs

name: IsChain.superChain_succChain
statement:
theorem IsChain.superChain_succChain (hs₁ : IsChain r s) (hs₂ : ¬IsMaxChain r s) :
    SuperChain r s (SuccChain r s)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsMaxChain, _root_.not_and, not_forall, exists_prop] at hs₂
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hst⟩ := hs₂ hs₁
  exact succChain_spec ⟨t, hs₁, ht, ssubset_iff_subset_ne.2 hst⟩

name: subset_succChain
statement: theorem subset_succChain : s ⊆ SuccChain r s
proof:
:= by
  if h : ∃ t, IsChain r s ∧ SuperChain r s t then exact (succChain_spec h).2.1
  else
    simp [SuccChain, h]

proof:

  exact
    sup_le_sup (inf_le_inf_left _ <| hnot_anti le_sup_left)

name: boundary_le_boundary_sup_sup_boundary_inf_left
statement: theorem boundary_le_boundary_sup_sup_boundary_inf_left : ∂ a ≤ ∂ (a ⊔ b) ⊔ ∂ (a ⊓ b)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [boundary, sup_inf_left, sup_inf_right, sup_right_idem, le_inf_iff, sup_assoc,
    sup_comm _ a]
  refine ⟨⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> try { exact le_sup_of_le_left inf_le_left } <;>
    refine inf_le_of_right_le ?_
  · rw [hnot_le_iff_codisjoint_right, codisjoint_left_comm]
    exact codisjoint_hnot_left
  · refine le_sup_of_le_right ?_
    rw [hnot_le_iff_codisjoint_right]
    exact codisjoint_hnot_right.mono_right (hnot_anti inf_le_left)

name: extend_partialOrder
statement:
theorem extend_partialOrder {α : Type u} (r : α → α → Prop) [IsPartialOrder α r] :
    ∃ s : α → α → Prop, IsLinearOrder α s ∧ r ≤ s
proof:
:= by
  let S := { s | IsPartialOrder α s }
  have hS : ∀ c, c ⊆ S → IsChain (· ≤ ·) c → ∀ y ∈ c, ∃ ub ∈ S, ∀ z ∈ c, z ≤ ub := by
    rintro c hc₁ hc₂ s hs
    have := (hc₁ hs).1
    refine ⟨sSup c, ?_, fun z hz => le_sSup hz⟩
    refine
        { refl := ?_
          trans := ?_
          antisymm := ?_ } <;>
      simp_rw [binary_relation_sSup_iff]
    · intro x
      exact ⟨s, hs, refl x⟩
    · rintro x y z ⟨s₁, h₁s₁, h₂s₁⟩ ⟨s₂, h₁s₂, h₂s₂⟩
      have : IsPartialOrder _ _ := hc₁ h₁s₁
      have : IsPartialOrder _ _ := hc₁ h₁s₂
      rcases hc₂.total h₁s₁ h₁s₂ with h | h
      · exact ⟨s₂, h₁s₂, _root_.trans (h _ _ h₂s₁) h₂s₂⟩
      · exact ⟨s₁, h₁s₁, _root_.trans h₂s₁ (h _ _ h₂s₂)⟩
    · rintro x y ⟨s₁, h₁s₁, h₂s₁⟩ ⟨s₂, h₁s₂, h₂s₂⟩
      have : IsPartialOrder _ _ := hc₁ h₁s₁
      have : IsPartialOrder _ _ := hc₁ h₁s₂
      rcases hc₂.total h₁s₁ h₁s₂ with h | h
      · exact antisymm (h _ _ h₂s₁) h₂s₂
      · apply antisymm h₂s₁ (h _ _ h₂s₂)
  obtain ⟨s, hrs, hs⟩ := zorn_le_nonempty₀ S hS r ‹_›
  have : IsPartialOrder α s := hs.prop
  refine ⟨s,
    { total := ?_, refl := hs.1.refl, trans := hs.1.trans, antisymm := hs.1.antisymm }, hrs⟩
  intro x y
  by_contra! h
  let s' x' y' := s x' y' ∨ s x' x ∧ s y y'
  rw [hs.eq_of_le (y := s') ?_ fun _ _ ↦ Or.inl] at h
  · apply h.1 (Or.inr ⟨refl _, refl _⟩)
  · refine
    { refl := fun x ↦ Or.inl (refl _)
      trans := ?_
      antisymm := ?_ }
    · rintro a b c (ab | ⟨ax : s a x, yb : s y b⟩) (bc | ⟨bx : s b x, yc : s y c⟩)
      · exact Or.inl (_root_.trans ab bc)
      · exact Or.inr ⟨_root_.trans ab bx, yc⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨ax, _root_.trans yb bc⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨ax, yc⟩
    rintro a b (ab | ⟨ax : s a x, yb : s y b⟩) (ba | ⟨bx : s b x, ya : s y a⟩)
    · exact antisymm ab ba
    · exact (h.2 (_root_.trans ya (_root_.trans ab bx))).elim
    · exact (h.2 (_root_.trans yb (_root_.trans ba ax))).elim
    · exact (h.2 (_root_.trans yb bx)).elim

name: Fin.strictMono_insertNth_iff
statement:
lemma Fin.strictMono_insertNth_iff (q : Fin (n + 1)) (x : α) (f : Fin n → α) :
    StrictMono (q.insertNth x f) ↔
      StrictMono f ∧ (∀ i, i.castSucc < q → f i < x) ∧ (∀ i, q ≤ i.castSucc → x < f i)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨fun a b hab ↦ ?_, ⟨fun i hlt ↦ ?_, fun i hlt ↦ ?_⟩⟩, ?_⟩
  · simpa [hab] using h (a := q.succAbove a) (b := q.succAbove b)
  · have : q.succAbove i < q := by simp [succAbove_of_castSucc_lt, hlt]
    simpa using h this
  · have : q < q.succAbove i := by simp [succAbove_of_le_castSucc, hlt, ← le_castSucc_iff]
    simpa using h this
  · rintro ⟨h, hlt, hgt⟩ a b hab
    cases a using succAboveCases q <;> cases b using succAboveCases q
    · simp at hab
    · rename_i j
      have : q ≤ j.castSucc := by simpa [lt_succAbove_iff_le_castSucc] using hab
      simpa using hgt _ this
    · rename_i j
      have : j.castSucc < q := by simpa [succAbove_lt_iff_castSucc_lt] using hab
      simpa using hlt _ this
    · simpa using h <| (strictMono_succAbove _).lt_iff_lt.mp hab

    StrictMono (Fin.cons 0 f) ↔ f = Fin.succ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ funext fun i ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ by simp [h, strictMono_id]⟩
  have key (g : Fin (n + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (hg : StrictMono g) : g = id := by
    
    refine funext fun x ↦ le_antisymm ?_ (hg.id_le x)
    simpa using ((Fin.rev_strictAnti.comp_strictMono hg).comp Fin.rev_strictAnti).id_le (Fin.rev x)
  simpa using congrFun (key _ h) i.succ

name: monotone_vecCons
statement:
@[simp]
lemma monotone_vecCons : Monotone (vecCons a f) ↔ a ≤ f 0 ∧ Monotone f

name: predAbove_right_monotone
statement: lemma predAbove_right_monotone (p : Fin n) : Monotone p.predAbove
proof:
:= fun a b H => by
  dsimp [predAbove]
  split_ifs with ha hb hb
  all_goals simp only [le_iff_val_le_val, val_pred]
  · exact pred_le_pred H
  · calc
      _ ≤ _ := Nat.pred_le _
      _ ≤ _ := H
  · exact le_pred_of_lt ((not_lt.mp ha).trans_lt hb)
  · exact H

name: predAbove_left_monotone
statement: lemma predAbove_left_monotone (i : Fin (n + 1)) : Monotone fun p ↦ predAbove p i
proof:
:= fun a b H ↦ by
  dsimp [predAbove]
  split_ifs with ha hb hb
  · rfl
  · exact pred_le _
  · have : b < a := castSucc_lt_castSucc_iff.mpr (hb.trans_le (le_of_not_gt ha))
    exact absurd H this.not_ge
  · rfl

name: predAbove_left_injective
statement: lemma predAbove_left_injective : Injective (@predAbove n)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_add_one_eq.2 i.size_positive
  wlog! h : i < j generalizing i j
  · obtain h | rfl := h.lt_or_eq
    · exact (this hij.symm h).symm
    · rfl
  replace hij := congr_fun hij i.succ
  rw [predAbove_succ_self, Fin.predAbove_of_le_castSucc _ _ (by simpa),
    ← Fin.castSucc_inj, castSucc_castPred] at hij
  exact (i.castSucc_lt_succ.ne hij).elim

statement: @[simp] lemma coe_orderIso_apply (e : Fin n ≃o Fin m) (i : Fin n) : (e i : ℕ) = i
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with ⟨i, hi⟩
  dsimp only
  induction i using Nat.strong_induction_on with | _ i h
  refine le_antisymm (forall_lt_iff_le.1 fun j hj => ?_) (forall_lt_iff_le.1 fun j hj => ?_)
  · have := e.symm.lt_symm_apply.1 (mk_lt_of_lt_val hj)
    specialize h _ this (e.symm _).is_lt
    simp only [Fin.eta, OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] at h
    rwa [h]
  · rwa [← h j hj (hj.trans hi), ← lt_def, e.lt_iff_lt]

name: insertNth_zero_monotone
statement:
lemma insertNth_zero_monotone
    {f : Fin (n + 1) → α} (hf : Monotone f) (x : α) (hx : x ≤ f 0) :

proof:

name: insertNth_monotone
statement:
lemma insertNth_monotone
    {f : Fin (n + 1) → α} (hf : Monotone f) (i : Fin n) (x : α)
    (hx₁ : f i.castSucc ≤ x) (hx₂ : x ≤ f i.succ) :
    Monotone (Fin.insertNth i.castSucc.succ (α := fun _ ↦ α) x f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.monotone_iff_le_succ]
  intro j
  obtain hj | rfl | hj := lt_trichotomy j i.castSucc
  · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := j.eq_castSucc_of_ne_last (Fin.ne_last_of_lt hj)
    grind [insertNth_apply_below, castPred_castSucc, hf j.castSucc_le_succ]
  · rwa [← succAbove_succ_self i.castSucc, insertNth_apply_succAbove, insertNth_apply_same]
  · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := j.eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Fin.ne_zero_of_lt hj)
    grind [insertNth_apply_same, insertNth_apply_above, hf j.castSucc_le_succ]

    StrictMono (Fin.insertNth i.castSucc.succ (α := fun _ ↦ α) x f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.strictMono_iff_lt_succ] at hf ⊢
  intro j
  obtain hj | rfl | hj := lt_trichotomy j i.castSucc
  · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := j.eq_castSucc_of_ne_last (Fin.ne_last_of_lt hj)
    grind [insertNth_apply_below, castPred_castSucc]
  · rwa [← succAbove_succ_self i.castSucc, insertNth_apply_succAbove, insertNth_apply_same]
  · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := j.eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Fin.ne_zero_of_lt hj)
    grind [insertNth_apply_same, insertNth_apply_above]

name: strictMono_insertNth_last

name: iterate_sup_le_sup_iff
statement:
theorem iterate_sup_le_sup_iff {α : Type*} [SemilatticeSup α] (f : α →o α) :
    (∀ n₁ n₂ a₁ a₂, f^[n₁ + n₂] (a₁ ⊔ a₂) ≤ f^[n₁] a₁ ⊔ f^[n₂] a₂) ↔
      ∀ a₁ a₂, f (a₁ ⊔ a₂) ≤ f a₁ ⊔ a₂
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · exact h 1 0
  · intro n₁ n₂ a₁ a₂
    have h' : ∀ n a₁ a₂, f^[n] (a₁ ⊔ a₂) ≤ f^[n] a₁ ⊔ a₂ := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => intro a₁ a₂; rfl
      | succ n ih =>
        intro a₁ a₂
        calc
          f^[n + 1] (a₁ ⊔ a₂) = f^[n] (f (a₁ ⊔ a₂)) := Function.iterate_succ_apply f n _
          _ ≤ f^[n] (f a₁ ⊔ a₂) := f.mono.iterate n (h a₁ a₂)
          _ ≤ f^[n] (f a₁) ⊔ a₂ := ih _ _
          _ = f^[n + 1] a₁ ⊔ a₂ := by rw [← Function.iterate_succ_apply]
    calc
      f^[n₁ + n₂] (a₁ ⊔ a₂) = f^[n₁] (f^[n₂] (a₁ ⊔ a₂)) :=
        Function.iterate_add_apply f n₁ n₂ _
      _ = f^[n₁] (f^[n₂] (a₂ ⊔ a₁)) := by rw [sup_comm]
      _ ≤ f^[n₁] (f^[n₂] a₂ ⊔ a₁) := f.mono.iterate n₁ (h' n₂ _ _)
      _ = f^[n₁] (a₁ ⊔ f^[n₂] a₂) := by rw [sup_comm]
      _ ≤ f^[n₁] a₁ ⊔ f^[n₂] a₂ := h' n₁ a₁ _

statement:
lemma StrictMono.denselyOrdered_range {X Y : Type*} [LinearOrder X] [DenselyOrdered X] [Preorder Y]
    {f : X → Y} (hf : StrictMono f) :
    DenselyOrdered (Set.range f)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  simpa [← exists_and_left, ← exists_and_right, exists_comm, hf.lt_iff_lt]
    using fun _ _ ↦ exists_between

name: denselyOrdered_iff_of_orderIsoClass
statement:
lemma denselyOrdered_iff_of_orderIsoClass {X Y F : Type*} [Preorder X] [Preorder Y]
    [EquivLike F X Y] [OrderIsoClass F X Y] (f : F) :
    DenselyOrdered X ↔ DenselyOrdered Y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro H
    refine ⟨fun a b h ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_between ((map_inv_lt_map_inv_iff f).mpr h)
    exact ⟨f c, by simpa using hc⟩
  · intro H
    refine ⟨fun a b h ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_between ((map_lt_map_iff f).mpr h)
    exact ⟨EquivLike.inv f c, by simpa using hc⟩

name: denselyOrdered_iff_of_strictAnti
statement:
lemma denselyOrdered_iff_of_strictAnti {X Y F : Type*} [LinearOrder X] [Preorder Y]
    [EquivLike F X Y] (f : F) (hf : StrictAnti f) :
    DenselyOrdered X ↔ DenselyOrdered Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← denselyOrdered_orderDual]
  let e : Xᵒᵈ ≃o Y := ⟨OrderDual.ofDual.trans (f : X ≃ Y), ?_⟩
  · exact denselyOrdered_iff_of_orderIsoClass e
  · simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, EquivLike.coe_coe, OrderDual.forall, OrderDual.ofDual_toDual,
      OrderDual.toDual_le_toDual]
    intro a b
    rw [hf.le_iff_ge]

name: OrderEmbedding.eq_of_range_eq
statement:
lemma OrderEmbedding.eq_of_range_eq [Preorder α] [Preorder β] [Subsingleton (α ≃o α)]
    {f g : α ↪o β} (h : Set.range f = Set.range g) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  let e : α ≃o α := f.orderIso.trans ((Set.orderIsoOfEq _ _ h).trans g.orderIso.symm)
  have he : e = OrderIso.refl α := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  ext x
  have : g (e x) = f x := congrArg Subtype.val <|
    g.orderIso.apply_symm_apply (Set.orderIsoOfEq _ _ h (f.orderIso x))
  simp_all

name: StrictMono.eq_of_range_eq
statement:
lemma StrictMono.eq_of_range_eq [LinearOrder α] [Preorder β]
    [Subsingleton (α ≃o α)] {f g : α → β} (hf : StrictMono f) (hg : StrictMono g)
    (h : Set.range f = Set.range g) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  have : Set.range (OrderEmbedding.ofStrictMono f hf) = Set.range f := by simp
  have : Set.range (OrderEmbedding.ofStrictMono g hg) = Set.range g := by simp
  grind [OrderEmbedding.eq_of_range_eq]

name: mono_iff_injective
statement:
theorem mono_iff_injective {A B : NonemptyFinLinOrd.{u}} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    Mono f ↔ Function.Injective f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ConcreteCategory.mono_of_injective f⟩
  intro _ a₁ a₂ h
  let X := of (ULift (Fin 1))
  let g₁ : X ⟶ A := ofHom ⟨fun _ => a₁, fun _ _ _ => by rfl⟩
  let g₂ : X ⟶ A := ofHom ⟨fun _ => a₂, fun _ _ _ => by rfl⟩
  change g₁ (ULift.up (0 : Fin 1)) = g₂ (ULift.up (0 : Fin 1))
  have eq : g₁ ≫ f = g₂ ≫ f := by
    ext
    exact h
  rw [cancel_mono] at eq
  rw [eq]

name: epi_iff_surjective
statement:
theorem epi_iff_surjective {A B : NonemptyFinLinOrd.{u}} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    Epi f ↔ Function.Surjective f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro
    dsimp only [Function.Surjective]
    by_contra! ⟨m, hm⟩
    let Y := of (ULift (Fin 2))
    let p₁ : B ⟶ Y := ofHom
      ⟨fun b => if b < m then ULift.up 0 else ULift.up 1, fun x₁ x₂ h => by
        simp only
        split_ifs with h₁ h₂ h₂
        any_goals apply Fin.zero_le
        · exfalso
          exact h₁ (lt_of_le_of_lt h h₂)
        · rfl⟩
    let p₂ : B ⟶ Y := ofHom
      ⟨fun b => if b ≤ m then ULift.up 0 else ULift.up 1, fun x₁ x₂ h => by
        simp only
        split_ifs with h₁ h₂ h₂
        any_goals apply Fin.zero_le
        · exfalso
          exact h₁ (h.trans h₂)
        · rfl⟩
    have h : p₁ m = p₂ m := by
      congr
      rw [← cancel_epi f]
      ext a : 3
      simp only [p₁, p₂, hom_hom_comp, OrderHom.comp_coe, Function.comp_apply]
      change ite _ _ _ = ite _ _ _
      split_ifs with h₁ h₂ h₂
      any_goals rfl
      · exfalso
        exact h₂ (le_of_lt h₁)
      · exfalso
        exact hm a (eq_of_le_of_not_lt h₂ h₁)
    simp [Y, p₁, p₂, ConcreteCategory.hom_ofHom] at h
  · intro h
    exact ConcreteCategory.epi_of_surjective f h

@[to_dual (attr := elab_as_elim)
/
noncomputable def isSuccPrelimitRecOn : motive b :=
  if hb : IsSuccPrelimit b then isSuccPrelimit b hb else
    haveI H := Classical.choose_spec (not_isSuccPrelimit_iff_succ_eq.1 hb)

proof:
:= by
  have hb' := mt IsSuccPrelimit.isMax hb
  have H := Classical.choose_spec (not_isSuccPrelimit_iff_succ_eq.1 hb')
  rw [isSuccPrelimitRecOn, dite_eq_right hb', cast_eq_iff_heq]
  congr!
  exact (succ_eq_succ_iff_of_not_isMax H.1 hb).1 H.2

name: prelimitRecOn_of_isSuccPrelimit
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := elab_as_elim)
/
noncomputable def prelimitRecOn : motive b :=
  wellFounded_lt.fix
    (fun a IH ↦ if h : IsSuccPrelimit a then isSuccPrelimit a h IH else
      haveI H := Classical.choose_spec (not_isSuccPrelimit_iff_succ_eq.1 h)
      cast (congr_arg motive H.2) (succ _ H.1 <| IH _ <| H.2.subst <| lt_succ_of_not_isMax H.1))
    b

@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
theorem prelimitRecOn_of_isSuccPrelimit (hb : IsSuccPrelimit b) :
    prelimitRecOn b succ isSuccPrelimit =
      isSuccPrelimit b hb fun x _ ↦ SuccOrder.prelimitRecOn x succ isSuccPrelimit
proof:
:= by
  rw [prelimitRecOn, WellFounded.fix_eq, dite_eq_left hb]; rfl

name: prelimitRecOn_succ_of_not_isMax
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem prelimitRecOn_succ_of_not_isMax (hb : ¬IsMax b) :
    prelimitRecOn (Order.succ b) succ isSuccPrelimit =
      succ b hb (prelimitRecOn b succ isSuccPrelimit)
proof:
:= by
  have h := mt IsSuccPrelimit.isMax hb
  have H := Classical.choose_spec (not_isSuccPrelimit_iff_succ_eq.1 h)
  rw [prelimitRecOn, WellFounded.fix_eq, dite_eq_right h]
  have {a c : α} {ha hc} {x : ∀ a, motive a} (h : a = c) :
    cast (congr_arg (motive ∘ Order.succ) h) (succ a ha (x a)) = succ c hc (x c) := by subst h; rfl
  exact this <| (succ_eq_succ_iff_of_not_isMax H.1 hb).1 H.2

name: prelimitRecOn_succ
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
theorem prelimitRecOn_succ [NoMaxOrder α] (b : α) :

name: limitRecOn_isMin

name: LE.le.exists_succ_iterate
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem LE.le.exists_succ_iterate (h : a ≤ b) : ∃ n, succ^[n] a = b

name: exists_succ_iterate_iff_le
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem exists_succ_iterate_iff_le : (∃ n, succ^[n] a = b) ↔ a ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, exists_succ_iterate_of_le⟩
  rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
  exact id_le_iterate_of_id_le le_succ n a

name: Succ.rec
statement:
theorem Succ.rec {m : α} {P : ∀ n, m ≤ n → Prop} (rfl : P m le_rfl)
    (succ : ∀ n (hmn : m ≤ n), P n hmn → P (succ n) (hmn.trans <| le_succ _)) ⦃n : α⦄
    (hmn : m ≤ n) : P n hmn
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hmn.exists_succ_iterate
  induction n with
  | zero => exact rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp_rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    exact succ _ (id_le_iterate_of_id_le le_succ n m) (ih _)

name: Succ.rec_iff
statement:
@[to_dual Pred.rec_iff]
theorem Succ.rec_iff {p : α → Prop} (hsucc : ∀ a, p a ↔ p (succ a)) {a b : α} (h : a ≤ b) :
    p a ↔ p b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := h.exists_succ_iterate
  exact Iterate.rec (fun b => p a ↔ p b) Iff.rfl (fun c hc => hc.trans (hsucc _)) n

name: le_total_of_codirected
statement:
@[to_dual le_total_of_directed]
lemma le_total_of_codirected {r v₁ v₂ : α} (h₁ : r ≤ v₁) (h₂ : r ≤ v₂) : v₁ ≤ v₂ ∨ v₂ ≤ v₁
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := h₁.exists_succ_iterate
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := h₂.exists_succ_iterate
  clear h₁ h₂
  wlog h : n ≤ m
  · rw [Or.comm]
    apply this
    exact Nat.le_of_not_ge h
  left
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h
  rw [Nat.add_comm, Function.iterate_add, Function.comp_apply]
  apply Order.le_succ_iterate

name: lt_or_le_of_codirected
statement:
@[to_dual (reorder := h₁ h₂) lt_or_le_of_directed]
lemma lt_or_le_of_codirected [SuccOrder α] [IsSuccArchimedean α] {r v₁ v₂ : α} (h₁ : r ≤ v₁)
    (h₂ : r ≤ v₂) : v₁ < v₂ ∨ v₂ ≤ v₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [Classical.or_iff_not_imp_right]
  intro nh
  rcases le_total_of_codirected h₁ h₂ with h | h
  · apply lt_of_le_of_ne h (ne_of_not_le nh).symm
  · contradiction

name: StrictMono.not_bddAbove_range_of_isSuccArchimedean
statement:
@[to_dual]
lemma StrictMono.not_bddAbove_range_of_isSuccArchimedean [NoMaxOrder α] [SuccOrder β]
    [IsSuccArchimedean β] (hf : StrictMono f) : ¬ BddAbove (Set.range f)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨m, hm⟩
  have hm' : ∀ a, f a ≤ m := fun a ↦ hm <| Set.mem_range_self _
  obtain ⟨a₀⟩ := ‹Nonempty α›
  suffices ∀ b, f a₀ ≤ b → ∃ a, b < f a by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, m < f a := this m (hm' a₀)
    exact ha.not_ge (hm' a)
  have h : ∀ a, ∃ a', f a < f a' := fun a ↦ (exists_gt a).imp (fun a' h ↦ hf h)
  apply Succ.rec
  · exact h a₀
  rintro b _ ⟨a, hba⟩
  exact (h a).imp (fun a' ↦ (succ_le_of_lt hba).trans_lt)

name: Succ.rec_bot
statement:
@[to_dual Pred.rec_top]
theorem Succ.rec_bot (p : α → Prop) (hbot : p ⊥) (hsucc : ∀ a, p a → p (succ a)) (a : α) : p a
proof:
:=
  Succ.rec hbot (fun x _ h => hsucc x h) (bot_le : ⊥ ≤ a)

name: SuccOrder.forall_ne_bot_iff
statement:
@[to_dual]
lemma SuccOrder.forall_ne_bot_iff
    [Nontrivial α] [PartialOrder α] [OrderBot α] [SuccOrder α] [IsSuccArchimedean α]
    (P : α → Prop) :
    (∀ i, i ≠ ⊥ → P i) ↔ (∀ i, P (SuccOrder.succ i))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h i ↦ h _ (Order.succ_ne_bot i), fun h i hi ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := exists_succ_iterate_of_le (bot_le : ⊥ ≤ i)
  have hj : 0 < j := by apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero; contrapose hi; simp [hi]
  rw [← Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos hj]
  simp only [Function.iterate_succ', Function.comp_apply]
  apply h

name: BddAbove.exists_isGreatest_of_nonempty
statement:
@[to_dual]
lemma BddAbove.exists_isGreatest_of_nonempty {X : Type*} [LinearOrder X] [SuccOrder X]
    [IsSuccArchimedean X] {S : Set X} (hS : BddAbove S) (hS' : S.Nonempty) :
    ∃ x, IsGreatest S x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hS
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hS'
  by_cases hm' : m ∈ S
  · exact ⟨_, hm', hm⟩
  have hn' := hm hn
  revert hn hm hm'
  refine Succ.rec ?_ ?_ hn'
  · simp +contextual
  intro m _ IH hm hn hm'
  rw [mem_upperBounds] at IH hm
  simp_rw [Order.le_succ_iff_eq_or_le] at hm
  replace hm : ∀ x ∈ S, x ≤ m := by
    intro x hx
    refine (hm x hx).resolve_left ?_
    rintro rfl
    exact hm' hx
  by_cases hmS : m ∈ S
  · exact ⟨m, hmS, hm⟩
  · exact IH hm hn hmS

name: IsSuccArchimedean.of_orderIso
statement:
protected lemma IsSuccArchimedean.of_orderIso [SuccOrder X] [IsSuccArchimedean X] [SuccOrder Y]
    (f : X ≃o Y) : IsSuccArchimedean Y where
  exists_succ_iterate_of_le {a b} h
proof:
:= by
    refine (exists_succ_iterate_of_le ((map_inv_le_map_inv_iff f).mpr h)).imp ?_
    intro n
    rw [← f.apply_eq_iff_eq, EquivLike.apply_inv_apply]
    rintro rfl
    clear h
    induction n generalizing a with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n IH => simp only [Function.iterate_succ', Function.comp_apply, IH, f.map_succ]

    intro n

    | zero => simp
    | succ n IH => simp only [Function.iterate_succ', Function.comp_apply, IH, f.map_pred]

name: monotoneOn_of_le_succ

lemma monotoneOn_of_le_succ (hs : s.OrdConnected)
    (hf : ∀ a, ¬ IsMax a → a ∈ s → succ a ∈ s → f a ≤ f (succ a)) : MonotoneOn f s
proof:
:= by
  rintro a ha b hb hab
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := exists_succ_iterate_of_le hab
  clear hab
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n hn =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply'] at hb ⊢
    have : succ^[n] a ∈ s := hs.1 ha hb ⟨le_succ_iterate .., le_succ _⟩
    by_cases hb' : IsMax (succ^[n] a)
    · rw [succ_eq_iff_isMax.2 hb']
      exact hn this
    · exact (hn this).trans (hf _ hb' this hb)

name: strictMonoOn_of_lt_succ

lemma strictMonoOn_of_lt_succ (hs : s.OrdConnected)

proof:

  rintro a ha b hb hab
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := exists_succ_iterate_of_le hab.le
  obtain _ | n := n
  · simp at hab
  apply not_isMax_of_lt at hab
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using hf _ hab ha hb
  | succ n hn =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply'] at hb ⊢
    have : succ^[n + 1] a ∈ s := hs.1 ha hb ⟨le_succ_iterate .., le_succ _⟩
    by_cases hb' : IsMax (succ^[n + 1] a)

@[to_dual]
lemma csSup_mem_of_not_isSuccLimit (hne : s.Nonempty) (hbdd : BddAbove s)
    (hlim : ¬ IsSuccLimit (sSup s)) : sSup s ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSuccLimit_iff, not_and_or, not_not] at hlim
  rcases hlim with (hmin | hlim)
  · have ⟨a, has⟩ := hne
    rwa [← hmin.eq_of_le <| le_csSup hbdd has]
  · have ⟨y, hy⟩ := not_forall_not.mp hlim
    have ⟨i, his, hi⟩ := exists_lt_of_lt_csSup hne hy.lt
    exact eq_of_le_of_not_lt (le_csSup hbdd his) (hy.2 hi) ▸ his

name: iSup_succ
statement: theorem iSup_succ [SuccOrder α] (x : α) : ⨆ a : Iio x, succ a.1 = x
proof:
:= by
  have H : BddAbove (range fun a : Iio x ↦ succ a.1) :=
    ⟨succ x, by simp +contextual [upperBounds, succ_le_succ, le_of_lt]⟩
  apply le_antisymm _ (le_of_forall_lt fun y hy ↦ ?_)
  · rw [ciSup_le_iff' H]
    exact fun a ↦ succ_le_of_lt a.2
  · rw [lt_ciSup_iff' H]
    exact ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, lt_succ_of_not_isMax hy.not_isMax⟩

name: sSup_mem_of_not_isSuccPrelimit
statement:
@[to_dual]
lemma sSup_mem_of_not_isSuccPrelimit (hlim : ¬ IsSuccPrelimit (sSup s)) : sSup s ∈ s
proof:

name: succFn_spec
statement: theorem succFn_spec (i : ι) : IsGLB (Set.Ioi i) (succFn i)

name: le_succFn
statement: theorem le_succFn (i : ι) : i ≤ succFn i
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_isGLB_iff (succFn_spec i), mem_lowerBounds]
  exact fun x hx ↦ le_of_lt hx

name: isGLB_Ioc_of_isGLB_Ioi
statement:
theorem isGLB_Ioc_of_isGLB_Ioi {i j k : ι} (hij_lt : i < j) (h : IsGLB (Set.Ioi i) k) :
    IsGLB (Set.Ioc i j) k
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [IsGLB, IsGreatest, mem_upperBounds, mem_lowerBounds] at h ⊢
  refine ⟨fun x hx ↦ h.1 x hx.1, fun x hx ↦ h.2 x ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  rcases le_or_gt y j with h_le | h_lt
  · exact hx y ⟨hy, h_le⟩
  · exact le_trans (hx j ⟨hij_lt, le_rfl⟩) h_lt.le

name: isMax_of_succFn_le
statement: theorem isMax_of_succFn_le [LocallyFiniteOrder ι] (i : ι) (hi : succFn i ≤ i) : IsMax i
proof:
:= by
  refine fun j _ ↦ not_lt.mp fun hij_lt ↦ ?_
  have h_succFn_eq : succFn i = i := le_antisymm hi (le_succFn i)
  have h_glb : IsGLB (Finset.Ioc i j : Set ι) i := by
    rw [Finset.coe_Ioc]
    have h := succFn_spec i
    rw [h_succFn_eq] at h
    exact isGLB_Ioc_of_isGLB_Ioi hij_lt h
  have hi_mem : i ∈ Finset.Ioc i j := by
    refine Finset.isGLB_mem _ h_glb ?_
    exact ⟨_, Finset.mem_Ioc.mpr ⟨hij_lt, le_rfl⟩⟩
  rw [Finset.mem_Ioc] at hi_mem
  exact lt_irrefl i hi_mem.1

name: succFn_le_of_lt
statement: theorem succFn_le_of_lt (i j : ι) (hij : i < j) : succFn i ≤ j
proof:
:= by
  have h := succFn_spec i
  rw [IsGLB, IsGreatest, mem_lowerBounds] at h
  exact h.1 j hij

name: le_of_lt_succFn
statement: theorem le_of_lt_succFn (j i : ι) (hij : j < succFn i) : j ≤ i
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_isGLB_iff (succFn_spec i)] at hij
  obtain ⟨k, hk_lb, hk⟩ := hij
  rw [mem_lowerBounds] at hk_lb
  exact not_lt.mp fun hi_lt_j ↦ not_le.mpr hk (hk_lb j hi_lt_j)

statement: theorem toZ_of_ge (hi : i0 ≤ i) : toZ i0 i = Nat.find (exists_succ_iterate_of_le hi)

name: toZ_of_eq

name: iterate_pred_toZ

statement: lemma toZ_nonneg (hi : i0 ≤ i) : 0 ≤ toZ i0 i

name: toZ_neg
statement: theorem toZ_neg (hi : i < i0) : toZ i0 i < 0
proof:
:= by
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne ?_ ?_
  · rw [toZ_of_lt hi]
    lia
  · by_contra h
    have h_eq := iterate_pred_toZ i hi
    rw [← h_eq, h] at hi
    simp only [neg_zero, Int.toNat_zero, Function.iterate_zero, id, lt_self_iff_false] at hi

name: toZ_iterate_succ_le
statement: theorem toZ_iterate_succ_le (n : ℕ) : toZ i0 (succ^[n] i0) ≤ n
proof:

  norm_cast
  exact Nat.find_min' _ rfl

name: toZ_iterate_pred_ge
statement: theorem toZ_iterate_pred_ge (n : ℕ) : -(n : ℤ) ≤ toZ i0 (pred^[n] i0)
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt i0 (pred^[n] i0) with h | h
  · have h_eq : pred^[n] i0 = i0 := le_antisymm (pred_iterate_le _ _) h
    rw [h_eq, toZ_of_eq]
    lia
  · rw [toZ_of_lt h]
    refine Int.neg_le_neg ?_
    norm_cast
    exact Nat.find_min' _ rfl

name: toZ_iterate_succ_of_not_isMax
statement:
theorem toZ_iterate_succ_of_not_isMax (n : ℕ) (hn : ¬IsMax (succ^[n] i0)) :
    toZ i0 (succ^[n] i0) = n
proof:
:= by
  let m := (toZ i0 (succ^[n] i0)).toNat
  have h_eq : succ^[m] i0 = succ^[n] i0 := iterate_succ_toZ _ (le_succ_iterate _ _)
  by_cases hmn : m = n
  · nth_rw 2 [← hmn]
    rw [Int.toNat_eq_max, toZ_of_ge (le_succ_iterate _ _), max_eq_left]
    exact Int.natCast_nonneg _
  suffices IsMax (succ^[n] i0) from absurd this hn
  exact isMax_iterate_succ_of_eq_of_ne h_eq.symm (Ne.symm hmn)

name: toZ_iterate_pred_of_not_isMin
statement:
theorem toZ_iterate_pred_of_not_isMin (n : ℕ) (hn : ¬IsMin (pred^[n] i0)) :
    toZ i0 (pred^[n] i0) = -n
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with - | n
  · simp
  have : pred^[n.succ] i0 < i0 := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne (pred_iterate_le _ _) fun h_pred_iterate_eq ↦ hn ?_
    have h_pred_eq_pred : pred^[n.succ] i0 = pred^[0] i0 := by
      rwa [Function.iterate_zero, id]
    exact isMin_iterate_pred_of_eq_of_ne h_pred_eq_pred (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
  let m := (-toZ i0 (pred^[n.succ] i0)).toNat
  have h_eq : pred^[m] i0 = pred^[n.succ] i0 := iterate_pred_toZ _ this
  by_cases hmn : m = n + 1
  · nth_rw 2 [← hmn]
    rw [Int.toNat_eq_max, toZ_of_lt this, max_eq_left, neg_neg]
    rw [neg_neg]
    exact Int.natCast_nonneg _
  · suffices IsMin (pred^[n.succ] i0) from absurd this hn
    exact isMin_iterate_pred_of_eq_of_ne h_eq.symm (Ne.symm hmn)

name: toZ_strictMono
statement: theorem toZ_strictMono : StrictMono (toZ i0)
proof:
:= by
  intro j i h_le
  contrapose! h_le
  rcases le_or_gt i0 i with hi | hi <;> rcases le_or_gt i0 j with hj | hj
  · rw [← iterate_succ_toZ i hi, ← iterate_succ_toZ j hj]
    exact Monotone.monotone_iterate_of_le_map succ_mono (le_succ _) (Int.toNat_le_toNat h_le)
  · exact absurd ((toZ_neg hj).trans_le (toZ_nonneg hi)) (not_lt.mpr h_le)
  · exact hi.le.trans hj
  · rw [← iterate_pred_toZ i hi, ← iterate_pred_toZ j hj]
    refine Monotone.antitone_iterate_of_map_le pred_mono (pred_le _) (Int.toNat_le_toNat ?_)
    exact Int.neg_le_neg h_le

name: pred_succ_iterate_of_not_isMax
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem pred_succ_iterate_of_not_isMax (i : α) (n : ℕ) (hin : ¬IsMax (succ^[n - 1] i)) :
    pred^[n] (succ^[n] i) = i
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [Function.iterate_zero, id]
  | succ n hn =>
    rw [Nat.succ_sub_succ_eq_sub, Nat.sub_zero] at hin
    have h_not_max : ¬IsMax (succ^[n - 1] i) := by
      rcases n with - | n
      · simpa using hin
      rw [Nat.succ_sub_succ_eq_sub, Nat.sub_zero] at hn ⊢
      have h_sub_le : succ^[n] i ≤ succ^[n.succ] i := by
        rw [Function.iterate_succ']
        exact le_succ _
      refine fun h_max => hin fun j hj => ?_
      have hj_le : j ≤ succ^[n] i := h_max (h_sub_le.trans hj)
      exact hj_le.trans h_sub_le
    rw [Function.iterate_succ, Function.iterate_succ']
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [pred_succ_of_not_isMax hin]
    exact hn h_not_max

variable [Preorder α] [NoMaxOrder α]

@[to_dual]
instance [hα : Nonempty α] : IsEmpty (PredOrder (WithTop α))
proof:
:=
  ⟨by
    intro
    cases h : pred (⊤ : WithTop α) with
    | top => exact hα.elim fun a => (min_of_le_pred h.ge).not_lt <| coe_lt_top a
    | coe a =>
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_gt a
      rw [← coe_lt_coe, ← h] at hc
      exact (le_pred_of_lt (coe_lt_top c)).not_gt hc⟩

name: pred_findAtom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma pred_findAtom (r : α) : Order.pred (findAtom r) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  unfold findAtom
  generalize h : Nat.find (bot_le (a := r)).exists_pred_iterate = n
  cases n
  · have : Order.pred^[0] r = ⊥ := by
      rw [← h]
      apply Nat.find_spec (bot_le (a := r)).exists_pred_iterate
    simp only [Function.iterate_zero, id_eq] at this
    simp [this]
  · simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_right, ← Function.iterate_succ_apply', Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
    rw [← h]
    apply Nat.find_spec (bot_le (a := r)).exists_pred_iterate

name: findAtom_eq_bot

lemma findAtom_eq_bot {r : α} :
    findAtom r = ⊥ ↔ r = ⊥ where
  mp h
proof:
:= by
    unfold findAtom at h
    have := Nat.find_min' (bot_le (a := r)).exists_pred_iterate h
    replace : Nat.find (bot_le (a := r)).exists_pred_iterate = 0 := by lia
    simpa [this] using h
  mpr h := by simp [h]

name: RootedTree.mem_subtrees_disjoint_iff
statement:
lemma RootedTree.mem_subtrees_disjoint_iff {t₁ t₂ : SubRootedTree t}
    (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ t.subtrees) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ t.subtrees) (v₁ v₂ : t) (h₁ : v₁ ∈ t₁)
    (h₂ : v₂ ∈ t₂) :
    Disjoint v₁ v₂ ↔ t₁ ≠ t₂ where
  mp h
proof:
:= by
    intro nh
    have : t₁.root ≤ (v₁ : t) ⊓ (v₂ : t) := by
      simp only [le_inf_iff]
      exact ⟨h₁, nh ▸ h₂⟩
    rw [h.eq_bot] at this
    simp only [le_bot_iff] at this
    exact t₁.root_ne_bot_of_mem_subtrees ht₁ this
  mpr h := by
    rw [SubRootedTree.mem_iff] at h₁ h₂
    contrapose h
    rw [disjoint_iff, ← ne_eq, ← bot_lt_iff_ne_bot] at h
    rcases lt_or_le_of_directed (by simp : v₁ ⊓ v₂ ≤ v₁) h₁ with oh | oh
    · simp_all [RootedTree.subtrees, IsAtom.lt_iff]
    rw [le_inf_iff] at oh
    ext
    simpa only [ht₂.le_iff_eq ht₁.1, ht₁.le_iff_eq ht₂.1, eq_comm, or_self] using
      le_total_of_directed oh.2 h₂

name: RootedTree.subtrees_disjoint
statement: lemma RootedTree.subtrees_disjoint : t.subtrees.PairwiseDisjoint ((↑) : _ → Set t)
proof:
:= by
  intro t₁ ht₁ t₂ ht₂ h
  rw [Function.onFun_apply, Set.disjoint_left]
  intro a ha hb
  rw [← mem_subtrees_disjoint_iff ht₁ ht₂ a a ha hb, disjoint_self] at h
  subst h
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, SubRootedTree.bot_mem_iff] at ha
  exact t₁.root_ne_bot_of_mem_subtrees ht₁ ha

name: reflTransGen_of_succ_of_le
statement:
theorem reflTransGen_of_succ_of_le (r : α → α → Prop) {n m : α} (h : ∀ i ∈ Ico n m, r i (succ i))
    (hnm : n ≤ m) : ReflTransGen r n m
proof:
:= by
  revert h; refine Succ.rec ?_ ?_ hnm
  · intro _
    exact ReflTransGen.refl
  · intro m hnm ih h
    have : ReflTransGen r n m := ih fun i hi => h i ⟨hi.1, hi.2.trans_le <| le_succ m⟩
    rcases (le_succ m).eq_or_lt with hm | hm
    · rwa [← hm]
    exact this.tail (h m ⟨hnm, hm⟩)

name: reflTransGen_of_succ_of_ge
statement:
theorem reflTransGen_of_succ_of_ge (r : α → α → Prop) {n m : α} (h : ∀ i ∈ Ico m n, r (succ i) i)
    (hmn : m ≤ n) : ReflTransGen r n m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← reflTransGen_swap]
  exact reflTransGen_of_succ_of_le (swap r) h hmn

name: reflTransGen_of_succ
statement:
theorem reflTransGen_of_succ (r : α → α → Prop) {n m : α} (h1 : ∀ i ∈ Ico n m, r i (succ i))
    (h2 : ∀ i ∈ Ico m n, r (succ i) i) : ReflTransGen r n m
proof:
:=

proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total n m with hnm | hmn
  · rw [Ico_eq_empty_of_le hnm, Ioc_eq_empty_of_le (hf hnm), biUnion_empty]
  · refine Succ.rec ?_ ?_ hmn
    · simp
    · intro k hmk ihk
      rw [← Ioc_union_Ioc_eq_Ioc (hf hmk) (hf <| le_succ _), union_comm, ← ihk]
      by_cases hk : IsMax k

      · rw [Ico_succ_right_eq_insert_of_not_isMax hmk hk, biUnion_insert]

name: sdiff_inf_upperClosure
statement:
@[to_dual]
lemma sdiff_inf_upperClosure (hts : t ⊆ s) (hst : ∀ b ∈ s, ∀ c ∈ t, b ≤ c → b ∈ t) :
    s.sdiff t ⊓ upperClosure t = s
proof:
:= by
  refine ge_antisymm (le_inf le_sdiff_left <| le_upperClosure.2 hts) fun a ha ↦ ?_
  obtain hat | hat := em (a ∈ t)
  · exact subset_union_right (subset_upperClosure hat)
  · refine subset_union_left ⟨ha, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨b, hb, hab⟩
    exact hat <| hst _ ha _ hb hab

  · obtain ⟨a, ma, rfl⟩ := x
    exact ⟨a.2, fun b x y ↦ by simpa [h (show a ≤ ⟨b, y⟩ by exact x) ma]⟩
  · have ma : a.1 ∈ Subtype.val '' s := by simp [a.2, y]
    simpa only [mem_image, Subtype.coe_inj, exists_eq_right] using (h ma).2 x b.2

  · obtain ⟨a, ma, rfl⟩ := x
    exact ⟨a.2, fun b x y ↦ by simpa [h (show ⟨b, y⟩ ≤ a by exact x) ma]⟩
  · have ma : a.1 ∈ Subtype.val '' s := by simp [a.2, y]
    simpa only [mem_image, Subtype.coe_inj, exists_eq_right] using (h ma).2 x b.2

is smaller than all elements of `s`, and that this is not the case of any `w>b`.
See `sInf_eq_of_forall_ge_of_forall_gt_exists_lt` for a version in complete lattices. -/ ]
protected theorem DirectedOn.csSup_eq_of_forall_le_of_forall_lt_exists_gt
    (hd : DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) s) (hs : s.Nonempty) (H : ∀ a ∈ s, a ≤ b)

name: inf_coe
statement:
lemma inf_coe (s t : NonemptyInterval α) :
    (s : Interval α) ⊓ t = if h : s.fst ≤ t.snd ∧ t.fst ≤ s.snd then
      coe ⟨⟨s.fst ⊔ t.fst, s.snd ⊓ t.snd⟩,
        sup_le (le_inf s.fst_le_snd h.1) <| le_inf h.2 t.fst_le_snd⟩
      else ⊥

name: coe_inf
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_inf : ∀ s t : Interval α, (↑(s ⊓ t) : Set α) = ↑s ∩ ↑t
  | ⊥, _ => by
    rw [bot_inf_eq]
    exact (empty_inter _).symm
  | (s : NonemptyInterval α), ⊥ => by
    rw [inf_bot_eq]
    exact (inter_empty _).symm
  | (s : NonemptyInterval α), (t : NonemptyInterval α) => by
    simp only [coe_coe, NonemptyInterval.coe_def, Icc_inter_Icc, inf_coe]
    split_ifs with h
    · simp only [coe_coe, NonemptyInterval.coe_def]
    · refine (Icc_eq_empty <| mt ?_ h).symm
      exact fun h ↦ ⟨le_sup_left.trans <| h.trans inf_le_right,
        le_sup_right.trans <| h.trans inf_le_left⟩

end Decidable

@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_sInf [DecidableLE α] (S : Set (Interval α)) : ↑(sInf S) = ⋂ s ∈ S, (s : Set α)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change ((dite _ _ _ : Interval α) : Set α) = ⋂ (s : Interval α) (_ : s ∈ S), (s : Set α)
  split_ifs with h
  · ext
    simp [Interval.forall, h.1, ← forall_and, ← NonemptyInterval.mem_def]
  simp_rw [not_and_or, Classical.not_not] at h
  rcases h with h | h
  · refine (eq_empty_of_subset_empty ?_).symm
    exact iInter₂_subset_of_subset _ h Subset.rfl
  · refine (not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 ?_).symm
    rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    rw [mem_iInter₂] at hx
    exact h fun s ha t hb => (hx _ ha).1.trans (hx _ hb).2

proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases eq_empty_or_nonempty s with
  | inl h => subst h; apply notMem_empty
  | inr h => rw [Nat.sInf_def h] at hm; exact Nat.find_min h hm

name: sInf_le
statement: protected theorem sInf_le {s : Set ℕ} {m : ℕ} (hm : m ∈ s) : sInf s ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Nat.sInf_def ⟨m, hm⟩]
  exact Nat.find_min' ⟨m, hm⟩ hm

name: nonempty_of_pos_sInf
statement: theorem nonempty_of_pos_sInf {s : Set ℕ} (h : 0 < sInf s) : s.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  by_contra contra
  rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at contra
  have h' : sInf s ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h
  apply h'
  rw [Nat.sInf_eq_zero]
  right
  assumption

name: nonempty_of_sInf_eq_succ
statement: theorem nonempty_of_sInf_eq_succ {s : Set ℕ} {k : ℕ} (h : sInf s = k + 1) : s.Nonempty

name: eq_Ici_of_nonempty_of_upward_closed
statement:
theorem eq_Ici_of_nonempty_of_upward_closed {s : Set ℕ} (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (hs' : ∀ k₁ k₂ : ℕ, k₁ ≤ k₂ → k₁ ∈ s → k₂ ∈ s) : s = Ici (sInf s)
proof:
:=
  ext fun n ↦ ⟨fun H ↦ Nat.sInf_le H, fun H ↦ hs' (sInf s) n H (sInf_mem hs)⟩

name: sInf_upward_closed_eq_succ_iff
statement:
theorem sInf_upward_closed_eq_succ_iff {s : Set ℕ} (hs : ∀ k₁ k₂ : ℕ, k₁ ≤ k₂ → k₁ ∈ s → k₂ ∈ s)
    (k : ℕ) : sInf s = k + 1 ↔ k + 1 ∈ s ∧ k ∉ s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro H
    rw [eq_Ici_of_nonempty_of_upward_closed (nonempty_of_sInf_eq_succ _) hs, H, mem_Ici, mem_Ici]
    · exact ⟨le_rfl, k.not_succ_le_self⟩
    · exact k
    · assumption
  · rintro ⟨H, H'⟩
    rw [sInf_def (⟨_, H⟩ : s.Nonempty), find_eq_iff]
    exact ⟨H, fun n hnk hns ↦ H' <| hs n k (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hnk) hns⟩

name: sSup_mem
statement: theorem sSup_mem {s : Set ℕ} (h₁ : s.Nonempty) (h₂ : BddAbove s) : sSup s ∈ s
proof:
:=
  let ⟨k, hk⟩ := h₂
  h₁.csSup_mem ((finite_le_nat k).subset hk)

name: sInf_add
statement:
theorem sInf_add {n : ℕ} {p : ℕ → Prop} (hn : n ≤ sInf { m | p m }) :
    sInf { m | p (m + n) } + n = sInf { m | p m }
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain h | ⟨m, hm⟩ := { m | p (m + n) }.eq_empty_or_nonempty
  · rw [h, Nat.sInf_empty, zero_add]
    obtain hnp | hnp := hn.eq_or_lt
    · exact hnp
    suffices hp : p (sInf { m | p m } - n + n) from (h.subset hp).elim
    rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hn]
    exact csInf_mem (nonempty_of_pos_sInf <| n.zero_le.trans_lt hnp)
  · have hp : ∃ n, n ∈ { m | p m } := ⟨_, hm⟩
    rw [Nat.sInf_def ⟨m, hm⟩, Nat.sInf_def hp]
    rw [Nat.sInf_def hp] at hn
    exact find_add hn

name: sInf_add'
statement:
theorem sInf_add' {n : ℕ} {p : ℕ → Prop} (h : 0 < sInf { m | p m }) :
    sInf { m | p m } + n = sInf { m | p (m - n) }
proof:
:= by
  suffices h₁ : n ≤ sInf {m | p (m - n)} by
    convert! sInf_add h₁
    simp_rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_right]
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := nonempty_of_pos_sInf h
  refine
    le_csInf ⟨m + n, ?_⟩ fun b hb ↦
      le_of_not_gt fun hbn ↦
        ne_of_mem_of_not_mem ?_ (notMem_of_lt_sInf h) (Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hbn.le)
  · dsimp
    rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel_right]
  · exact hb

statement:
@[simp]
lemma r_inf_sup_iff (c : LatticeCon α) {x y : α} : c.r (x ⊓ y) (x ⊔ y) ↔ c.r x y where
  mp h
proof:
:= c.trans (by simpa using c.inf (c.refl x) (c.symm h)) (by simpa using c.inf h (c.refl y))
  mpr h := c.trans (by simpa using c.inf h (c.refl y)) (by simpa using c.sup (c.symm h) (c.refl y))

name: closed_interval
statement:
private lemma closed_interval {r : α → α → Prop}
    (h₂ : ∀ ⦃x y : α⦄, r x y ↔ r (x ⊓ y) (x ⊔ y))
    (h₄ : ∀ ⦃x y t : α⦄, x ≤ y → r x y → r (x ⊓ t) (y ⊓ t) ∧ r (x ⊔ t) (y ⊔ t))
    (a b c d : α) (hab : a ≤ b) (hbd : b ≤ d) (hac : a ≤ c) (hcd : c ≤ d) (had : r a d) :
    r b c
proof:
:= by
  suffices r (b ⊓ c ⊓ (b ⊔ c)) (d ⊓ (b ⊔ c)) by
    simpa [h₂, inf_eq_right.mpr (sup_le hbd hcd)] using this
  apply (h₄ (inf_le_of_left_le hbd) _).1
  simpa [sup_eq_right.mpr (le_inf hab hac), sup_eq_left.mpr (inf_le_of_left_le hbd)] using
    ((h₄ (le_trans hab hbd) had).2 : r (a ⊔ b ⊓ c) (d ⊔ b ⊓ c))

name: transitive
statement:
private lemma transitive {r : α → α → Prop}
    (h₂ : ∀ ⦃x y : α⦄, r x y ↔ r (x ⊓ y) (x ⊔ y))
    (h₃ : ∀ ⦃x y z : α⦄, x ≤ y → y ≤ z → r x y → r y z → r x z)
    (h₄ : ∀ ⦃x y t : α⦄, x ≤ y → r x y → r (x ⊓ t) (y ⊓ t) ∧ r (x ⊔ t) (y ⊔ t)) :
    ∀ {x y z : α}, r x y → r y z → r x z
proof:
:= by
  intro x y z hxy hyz
  exact closed_interval h₂ h₄ (x ⊓ y ⊓ z) _ _ (x ⊔ y ⊔ z) (by simp [inf_assoc, inf_le_left])
    (by simp [sup_assoc, le_sup_left]) inf_le_right le_sup_right
    (h₃ (by simpa [inf_assoc] using inf_le_of_right_le inf_le_sup)
    (by simp [sup_assoc, le_sup_right]) (h₃
    (by simpa [inf_assoc] using inf_le_right (b := y ⊓ z)) inf_le_sup (by
      suffices r (x ⊓ y ⊓ (y ⊓ z)) ((x ⊔ y) ⊓ (y ⊓ z)) by
        rw [inf_comm x, inf_assoc]
        simpa [inf_comm x, ← inf_inf_distrib_left] using this
      exact (h₄ inf_le_sup (h₂.mp hxy)).1) (h₂.mp hyz)) (by
        simpa [sup_comm y x, sup_sup_distrib_left y x z, sup_assoc] using
          ((h₄ inf_le_sup (h₂.mp hxy)).2 : r (x ⊓ y ⊔ (y ⊔ z)) (x ⊔ y ⊔ (y ⊔ z)))))

name: ScottContinuousOn.fromProd
statement:
lemma ScottContinuousOn.fromProd [Preorder α] [Preorder β] [Preorder γ]
    {f : α × β → γ} {D : Set (Set (α × β))}
    (h₁ : ∀ a, ScottContinuousOn ((fun d => Prod.snd '' d) '' D) (fun b => f (a, b)))
    (h₂ : ∀ b, ScottContinuousOn ((fun d => Prod.fst '' d) '' D) (fun a => f (a, b)))
    (h₁' : ∀ a, Monotone (fun b => f (a, b))) (h₂' : ∀ b, Monotone (fun a => f (a, b))) :
    ScottContinuousOn D f
proof:
:= fun d hX hd₁ hd₂ ⟨p1, p2⟩ hdp => by
  rw [isLUB_congr ((monotone_prod_iff.mpr ⟨h₁', h₂'⟩).upperBounds_image_of_directedOn_prod hd₂),
    ← iUnion_of_singleton_coe (Prod.fst '' d), iUnion_prod_const, image_iUnion,
    ← isLUB_iUnion_iff_of_isLUB (fun a => by
      rw [singleton_prod, image_image f (fun b ↦ (a, b))]
      exact h₁ _ (mem_image_of_mem (fun d ↦ Prod.snd '' d) hX) (Nonempty.image Prod.snd hd₁)
        (DirectedOn.snd hd₂) (isLUB_prod.mp hdp).2) _, Set.range]
  convert!
    (h₂ _ (mem_image_of_mem (fun d ↦ Prod.fst '' d) hX) (Nonempty.image Prod.fst hd₁)
      (DirectedOn.fst hd₂) (isLUB_prod.mp hdp).1)
  ext : 1
  simp_all only [Subtype.exists, mem_image, Prod.exists,
    exists_and_right, exists_eq_right, exists_prop, mem_ofPred_eq]

name: ScottContinuous.fromProd
statement:
lemma ScottContinuous.fromProd {γ : Type*} [Preorder α] [Preorder β] [Preorder γ]
    {f : α × β → γ} (h₁ : ∀ a, ScottContinuous (fun b => f (a, b)))
    (h₂ : ∀ b, ScottContinuous (fun a => f (a, b))) : ScottContinuous f
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← scottContinuousOn_univ] at ⊢
  exact .fromProd (fun a ↦ (h₁ a).scottContinuousOn) (fun b ↦ (h₂ b).scottContinuousOn)
    (fun a ↦ (h₁ a).monotone) (fun b ↦ (h₂ b).monotone)

name: ScottContinuous.prod
statement:
lemma ScottContinuous.prod {α' β' : Type*} [Preorder α] [Preorder β] [Preorder α'] [Preorder β']
    {f : α → α'} {g : β → β'} (hf : ScottContinuous f) (hg : ScottContinuous g) :
    ScottContinuous (Prod.map f g)
proof:
:= by
  refine .fromProd (fun a d hd₁ hd₂ c hdc ↦ ?_) (fun b d hd₁ hd₂ c hdc ↦ ?_)
  · have e1 : (fun b ↦ (f a, g b)) '' d = {f a} ×ˢ (g '' d) := by aesop
    simp_rw [Prod.map_apply, e1]
    exact .prod (singleton_nonempty _) (hd₁.image _) isLUB_singleton (hg hd₁ hd₂ hdc)
  · have e2 : ((fun a ↦ (f a, g b)) '' d) = (f '' d) ×ˢ {g b} := by aesop
    simp_rw [Prod.map_apply, e2]
    exact .prod (hd₁.image _) (singleton_nonempty _) (hf hd₁ hd₂ hdc) isLUB_singleton

statement:
theorem injective_of_increasing (r : α → α → Prop) (s : β → β → Prop) [Std.Trichotomous r]
    [Std.Irrefl s] (f : α → β) (hf : ∀ {x y}, r x y → s (f x) (f y)) : Injective f
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  rcases trichotomous_of r x y with (h | h | h)
  · have := hf h
    rw [hxy] at this
    exfalso
    exact irrefl_of s (f y) this
  · exact h
  · have := hf h
    rw [hxy] at this
    exfalso
    exact irrefl_of s (f y) this
