name: acc_lift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem acc_lift₂_iff {_ : Setoid α} {r : α → α → Prop}
    {H : ∀ (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : α), a₁ ≈ a₂ → b₁ ≈ b₂ → r a₁ b₁ = r a₂ b₂} {a} :
    Acc (Quotient.lift₂ r H) ⟦a⟧ ↔ Acc r a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact RelHomClass.acc (Quotient.mkRelHom H) a
  · intro ac
    induction ac with | intro _ _ IH => ?_
    refine ⟨_, fun q h => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := q.exists_rep
    exact IH a' h

name: acc_liftOn
statement:
@[simp]
theorem acc_liftOn₂'_iff {s : Setoid α} {r : α → α → Prop} {H} {a} :
    Acc (fun x y => Quotient.liftOn₂' x y r H) (Quotient.mk'' a : Quotient s) ↔ Acc r a

name: wellFounded_lift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wellFounded_lift₂_iff {_ : Setoid α} {r : α → α → Prop}
    {H : ∀ (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : α), a₁ ≈ a₂ → b₁ ≈ b₂ → r a₁ b₁ = r a₂ b₂} :
    WellFounded (Quotient.lift₂ r H) ↔ WellFounded r
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact RelHomClass.wellFounded (Quotient.mkRelHom H)
  · refine fun wf => ⟨fun q => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := q.exists_rep
    exact acc_lift₂_iff.2 (wf.apply a)

statement:

theorem WellFoundedGT.induction_top [Preorder α] [WellFoundedGT α] [OrderTop α]
    {P : α → Prop} (hexists : ∃ M, P M) (hind : ∀ N ≠ ⊤, P N → ∃ M > N, P M) : P ⊤
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! hexists
  intro M
  induction M using WellFoundedGT.induction with
  | ind x IH =>
    by_cases hx : x = ⊤
    · exact hx ▸ hexists
    · intro hx'
      obtain ⟨M, hM, hM'⟩ := hind x hx hx'
      exact IH _ hM hM'

name: sdiff_unique
statement: theorem sdiff_unique (s : x ⊓ y ⊔ z = x) (i : x ⊓ y ⊓ z = ⊥) : x \ y = z
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs at s => rw [← sup_inf_sdiff x y, sup_comm]
  rw [sup_comm] at s
  conv_rhs at i => rw [← inf_inf_sdiff x y, inf_comm]
  rw [inf_comm] at i
  exact (eq_of_inf_eq_sup_eq i s).symm

name: sdiff_le'
statement: private theorem sdiff_le' : x \ y ≤ x
proof:
:=
  calc
    x \ y ≤ x ⊓ y ⊔ x \ y := le_sup_right
    _ = x := sup_inf_sdiff x y

name: sdiff_sup_self'
statement: private theorem sdiff_sup_self' : y \ x ⊔ x = y ⊔ x
proof:
:=
  calc
    y \ x ⊔ x = y \ x ⊔ (x ⊔ x ⊓ y) := by rw [sup_inf_self]
    _ = y ⊓ x ⊔ y \ x ⊔ x := by ac_rfl
    _ = y ⊔ x := by rw [sup_inf_sdiff]

name: sdiff_inf_sdiff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sdiff_inf_sdiff : x \ y ⊓ y \ x = ⊥
proof:
:=
  Eq.symm <|
    calc
      ⊥ = x ⊓ (y ⊓ x ⊔ y \ x) ⊓ x \ y := by rw [← inf_inf_sdiff, sup_inf_sdiff]
      _ = (x ⊓ (y ⊓ x) ⊔ x ⊓ y \ x) ⊓ x \ y := by rw [inf_sup_left]
      _ = (y ⊓ (x ⊓ x) ⊔ x ⊓ y \ x) ⊓ x \ y := by ac_rfl
      _ = x ⊓ y \ x ⊓ x \ y := by
          rw [inf_idem, inf_sup_right, ← inf_comm x y, inf_inf_sdiff, bot_sup_eq]
      _ = x ⊓ x \ y ⊓ y \ x := by ac_rfl
      _ = x \ y ⊓ y \ x := by rw [inf_of_le_right sdiff_le']

    _ = ⊥ := by rw [inf_sup_right, inf_comm x y, inf_inf_sdiff, sdiff_inf_sdiff, bot_sup_eq]

:=
  have h : y ⊓ x = x := inf_eq_right.2 <| le_sup_left.trans hs.le
  sdiff_unique (by rw [h, hs]) (by rw [h, hi.eq_bot])

name: Disjoint.sdiff_unique
statement:
protected theorem Disjoint.sdiff_unique (hd : Disjoint x z) (hz : z ≤ y) (hs : y ≤ x ⊔ z) :
    y \ x = z
proof:
:=
  sdiff_unique
    (by
      rw [← inf_eq_right] at hs
      rwa [sup_inf_right, inf_sup_right, sup_comm x, inf_sup_self, inf_comm, sup_comm z,
        hs, sup_eq_left])
    (by rw [inf_assoc, hd.eq_bot, inf_bot_eq])

name: disjoint_sdiff_iff_le
statement: theorem disjoint_sdiff_iff_le (hz : z ≤ y) (hx : x ≤ y) : Disjoint z (y \ x) ↔ z ≤ x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun H =>
    le_of_inf_le_sup_le (le_trans H.le_bot bot_le)
      (by
        rw [sup_sdiff_cancel_right hx]
        grw [sdiff_le]
        rw [sup_eq_right.2 hz]),
    fun H => disjoint_sdiff_self_right.mono_left H⟩

name: le_iff_eq_sup_sdiff

proof:
:=
  ⟨fun H => (sup_sdiff_cancel' H hz).symm,
    fun H => by
    conv_lhs at H => rw [← sup_sdiff_cancel_right hx]
    refine le_of_inf_le_sup_le ?_ H.le
    rw [inf_sdiff_self_right]
    exact bot_le⟩

name: sdiff_sup
statement: theorem sdiff_sup : y \ (x ⊔ z) = y \ x ⊓ y \ z
proof:
:=
  sdiff_unique
    (calc
      y ⊓ (x ⊔ z) ⊔ y \ x ⊓ y \ z = (y ⊓ x ⊔ y ⊓ z ⊔ y \ x) ⊓ (y ⊓ x ⊔ y ⊓ z ⊔ y \ z) := by
          rw [sup_inf_left, inf_sup_left y]
      _ = (y ⊓ z ⊔ (y ⊓ x ⊔ y \ x)) ⊓ (y ⊓ x ⊔ (y ⊓ z ⊔ y \ z)) := by ac_rfl
      _ = (y ⊓ z ⊔ y) ⊓ (y ⊓ x ⊔ y) := by rw [sup_inf_sdiff, sup_inf_sdiff]
      _ = (y ⊔ y ⊓ z) ⊓ (y ⊔ y ⊓ x) := by ac_rfl
      _ = y := by rw [sup_inf_self, sup_inf_self, inf_idem])
    (calc
      y ⊓ (x ⊔ z) ⊓ (y \ x ⊓ y \ z) = y ⊓ x ⊓ (y \ x ⊓ y \ z) ⊔ y ⊓ z ⊓ (y \ x ⊓ y \ z) := by
          rw [inf_sup_left, inf_sup_right]
      _ = y ⊓ x ⊓ y \ x ⊓ y \ z ⊔ y \ x ⊓ (y \ z ⊓ (y ⊓ z)) := by ac_rfl
      _ = ⊥ := by simp)

name: sdiff_eq_sdiff_iff_inf_eq_inf
statement: theorem sdiff_eq_sdiff_iff_inf_eq_inf : y \ x = y \ z ↔ y ⊓ x = y ⊓ z

  ⟨fun h => eq_of_inf_eq_sup_eq (a := y \ x) (by rw [inf_inf_sdiff, h, inf_inf_sdiff])
    (by rw [sup_inf_sdiff, h, sup_inf_sdiff]),
    fun h => by rw [← sdiff_inf_self_right, ← sdiff_inf_self_right z y, inf_comm, h, inf_comm]⟩

  rw [← h, inf_eq_right.mpr hx]

statement: theorem sup_inf_inf_sdiff : x ⊓ y ⊓ z ⊔ y \ z = x ⊓ y ⊔ y \ z

name: sdiff_sdiff_right
statement: theorem sdiff_sdiff_right : x \ (y \ z) = x \ y ⊔ x ⊓ y ⊓ z
proof:
:= by
  rw [sup_comm, inf_comm, ← inf_assoc, sup_inf_inf_sdiff]
  apply sdiff_unique
  · calc
      x ⊓ y \ z ⊔ (z ⊓ x ⊔ x \ y) = (x ⊔ (z ⊓ x ⊔ x \ y)) ⊓ (y \ z ⊔ (z ⊓ x ⊔ x \ y)) := by
          rw [sup_inf_right]
      _ = (x ⊔ x ⊓ z ⊔ x \ y) ⊓ (y \ z ⊔ (x ⊓ z ⊔ x \ y)) := by ac_rfl
      _ = x ⊓ (y \ z ⊔ (x ⊓ z ⊔ x ⊓ y) ⊔ x \ y) := by
          rw [sup_inf_self, sup_sdiff_left, ← sup_assoc, sup_inf_left, sdiff_sup_self',
            inf_sup_right, sup_comm y, inf_sdiff_sup_right, inf_sup_left x z y]
      _ = x ⊓ (y \ z ⊔ (x ⊓ z ⊔ (x ⊓ y ⊔ x \ y))) := by ac_rfl
      _ = x := by simp
  · calc
      x ⊓ y \ z ⊓ (z ⊓ x ⊔ x \ y) = x ⊓ y \ z ⊓ (z ⊓ x) ⊔ x ⊓ y \ z ⊓ x \ y := by rw [inf_sup_left]
      _ = x ⊓ (y \ z ⊓ z ⊓ x) ⊔ x ⊓ y \ z ⊓ x \ y := by ac_rfl
      _ = x ⊓ y \ z ⊓ x \ y := by rw [inf_sdiff_self_left, bot_inf_eq, inf_bot_eq, bot_sup_eq]
      _ = x ⊓ (y \ z ⊓ y) ⊓ x \ y := by conv_lhs => rw [← inf_sdiff_left]
      _ = x ⊓ (y \ z ⊓ (y ⊓ x \ y)) := by ac_rfl
      _ = ⊥ := by rw [inf_sdiff_self_right, inf_bot_eq, inf_bot_eq]

name: sdiff_sdiff_right'

proof:
:=
  calc
    x \ (y \ z) = x \ y ⊔ x ⊓ y ⊓ z := sdiff_sdiff_right
    _ = z ⊓ x ⊓ y ⊔ x \ y := by ac_rfl
    _ = x \ y ⊔ x ⊓ z := by rw [sup_inf_inf_sdiff, sup_comm, inf_comm]

name: sdiff_sdiff_sup_sdiff
statement: theorem sdiff_sdiff_sup_sdiff : z \ (x \ y ⊔ y \ x) = z ⊓ (z \ x ⊔ y) ⊓ (z \ y ⊔ x)
proof:
:=
  calc
    z \ (x \ y ⊔ y \ x) = z ⊓ (z \ x ⊔ y) ⊓ (z ⊓ (z \ y ⊔ x)) := by
        rw [sdiff_sup, sdiff_sdiff_right, sdiff_sdiff_right, sup_inf_left, sup_comm, sup_inf_sdiff,
          sup_inf_left, sup_comm (z \ y), sup_inf_sdiff]
    _ = z ⊓ z ⊓ (z \ x ⊔ y) ⊓ (z \ y ⊔ x) := by ac_rfl
    _ = z ⊓ (z \ x ⊔ y) ⊓ (z \ y ⊔ x) := by rw [inf_idem]

proof:
:=
  calc
    z \ (x \ y ⊔ y \ x) = z \ (x \ y) ⊓ z \ (y \ x) := sdiff_sup
    _ = (z \ x ⊔ z ⊓ x ⊓ y) ⊓ (z \ y ⊔ z ⊓ y ⊓ x) := by rw [sdiff_sdiff_right, sdiff_sdiff_right]
    _ = (z \ x ⊔ z ⊓ y ⊓ x) ⊓ (z \ y ⊔ z ⊓ y ⊓ x) := by ac_rfl
    _ = z \ x ⊓ z \ y ⊔ z ⊓ y ⊓ x := by rw [← sup_inf_right]
    _ = z ⊓ x ⊓ y ⊔ z \ x ⊓ z \ y := by ac_rfl

name: sdiff_sdiff_sdiff_cancel_right

  exact ⟨sdiff_sdiff_sdiff_le_sdiff,
    (disjoint_sdiff_self_left.mono_right sdiff_le).le_sdiff_of_le_left <| sdiff_le_sdiff_left hcb⟩

name: inf_sdiff
statement: theorem inf_sdiff : (x ⊓ y) \ z = x \ z ⊓ y \ z
proof:
:=
  sdiff_unique
    (calc
      _ = (x ⊓ y ⊓ (z ⊔ x) ⊔ x \ z) ⊓ (x ⊓ y ⊓ z ⊔ y \ z) := by
          rw [sup_inf_left, sup_inf_right, sup_sdiff_self_right, inf_sup_right, inf_sdiff_sup_right]
      _ = (y ⊓ (x ⊓ (x ⊔ z)) ⊔ x \ z) ⊓ (x ⊓ y ⊓ z ⊔ y \ z) := by ac_rfl
      _ = x ⊓ y ⊔ x \ z ⊓ y \ z := by rw [inf_sup_self, sup_inf_inf_sdiff, inf_comm y, sup_inf_left]
      _ = x ⊓ y := sup_eq_left.2 (inf_le_inf sdiff_le sdiff_le))
    (calc
      x ⊓ y ⊓ z ⊓ (x \ z ⊓ y \ z) = x ⊓ y ⊓ (z ⊓ x \ z) ⊓ y \ z := by ac_rfl
      _ = ⊥ := by rw [inf_sdiff_self_right, inf_bot_eq, bot_inf_eq])

name: inf_sdiff_assoc

    x ⊓ y ⊓ z ⊓ (x ⊓ y \ z) = x ⊓ x ⊓ (y ⊓ z ⊓ y \ z) := by ac_rfl
    _ = ⊥ := by rw [inf_inf_sdiff, inf_bot_eq]

  rw [← sup_sdiff_cancel_right hxz]
  refine (sup_le_sup_left h.le _).lt_of_not_ge fun h' => h.not_ge ?_

  refine lt_of_le_not_ge (by grw [h]) fun h' => h.not_ge ?_

theorem Finset.ciSup_eq_max'_image {s : Finset ι} (h : ∃ x ∈ s, sSup ∅ ≤ f x)
    (h' : (s.image f).Nonempty := by exact image_nonempty.mpr (h.imp fun _ ↦ And.left)) :
    ⨆ i ∈ s, f i = (s.image f).max' h'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [iSup, ← h'.csSup_eq_max', coe_image]
  refine csSup_eq_csSup_of_forall_exists_le ?_ ?_
  · simp only [ciSup_eq_ite, dite_eq_ite, Set.mem_range, Set.mem_image, mem_coe,
      exists_exists_and_eq_and, forall_exists_index, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff]
    intro i
    split_ifs
    · exact ⟨_, by assumption, le_rfl⟩
    · assumption
  · simp only [Set.mem_image, mem_coe, ciSup_eq_ite, dite_eq_ite, Set.mem_range,
      exists_exists_eq_and, forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂]
    intro i hi
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    simp [hi]

proof:

name: Set.Finite.ciSup_mem_image
statement:

theorem Set.Finite.ciSup_mem_image {s : Set ι} (hs : s.Finite) (h : ∃ x ∈ s, sSup ∅ ≤ f x) :
    ⨆ i ∈ s, f i ∈ f '' s

:= by
  lift s to Finset ι using hs
  simp only [Finset.mem_coe] at h
  simpa using Finset.ciSup_mem_image f h

name: Set.Finite.ciSup_lt_iff
statement:
@[to_dual lt_ciInf_iff]
theorem Set.Finite.ciSup_lt_iff {s : Set ι} {f : ι → α} (hs : s.Finite)
    (h : ∃ x ∈ s, sSup ∅ ≤ f x) :
    ⨆ i ∈ s, f i < a ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, f x < a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h x hx
    refine h.trans_le' (le_csSup ?_ ?_)
    · classical
      refine (((hs.image f).union (finite_singleton (sSup ∅))).subset ?_).bddAbove
      intro
      simp only [ciSup_eq_ite, dite_eq_ite, mem_range, union_singleton, mem_insert_iff, mem_image,
        forall_exists_index]
      grind
    · simp only [mem_range]
      refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
      simp [hx]
  · have := hs.ciSup_mem_image _ h
    grind

proof:
:= by
  classical
  change _ = ite _ _ _
  rw [ite_eq_right, preimage_image_eq, ite_eq_left hs]

proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs
  change _ = ite _ _ _
  split_ifs with h
  · rcases h with h1 | h2
    · cases h1 (mem_image_of_mem _ hx)
    · exact (h2 (Monotone.map_bddBelow coe_mono h's)).elim
  · rw [preimage_image_eq]
    exact Option.some_injective _

@[to_dual csInf_eq_of_forall_ge_of_forall_gt_exists_lt
/
is smaller than all elements of `s`, and that this is not the case of any `w>b`.
See `sInf_eq_of_forall_ge_of_forall_gt_exists_lt` for a version in complete lattices. -/]
theorem csSup_eq_of_forall_le_of_forall_lt_exists_gt (hs : s.Nonempty) (H : ∀ a ∈ s, a ≤ b)

name: csSup_eq_csSup_of_forall_exists_le
statement:
@[to_dual
/
`s` and `t` have the same infimum. This holds even when the sets may be empty or unbounded. -/]
theorem csSup_eq_csSup_of_forall_exists_le {s t : Set α}
    (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, ∃ y ∈ t, x ≤ y) (ht : ∀ y ∈ t, ∃ x ∈ s, y ≤ x) :
    sSup s = sSup t
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_empty_or_nonempty s with rfl | s_ne
  · have : t = ∅ := eq_empty_of_forall_notMem (fun y yt ↦ by simpa using ht y yt)
    rw [this]
  rcases eq_empty_or_nonempty t with rfl | t_ne
  · have : s = ∅ := eq_empty_of_forall_notMem (fun x xs ↦ by simpa using hs x xs)
    rw [this]
  by_cases B : BddAbove s ∨ BddAbove t
  · have Bs : BddAbove s := by
      rcases B with hB | ⟨b, hb⟩
      · exact hB
      · refine ⟨b, fun x hx ↦ ?_⟩
        rcases hs x hx with ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
        exact hxy.trans (hb hy)
    have Bt : BddAbove t := by
      rcases B with ⟨b, hb⟩ | hB
      · refine ⟨b, fun y hy ↦ ?_⟩
        rcases ht y hy with ⟨x, hx, hyx⟩
        exact hyx.trans (hb hx)
      · exact hB
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply csSup_le s_ne (fun x hx ↦ ?_)
      rcases hs x hx with ⟨y, yt, hxy⟩
      exact hxy.trans (le_csSup Bt yt)
    · apply csSup_le t_ne (fun y hy ↦ ?_)
      rcases ht y hy with ⟨x, xs, hyx⟩
      exact hyx.trans (le_csSup Bs xs)
  · simp [csSup_of_not_bddAbove, (not_or.1 B).1, (not_or.1 B).2]

name: isLUB_sSup'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · change ite _ _ _ ∈ _
    split_ifs with h₁ h₂
    · intro _ _
      exact le_top
    · rintro (⟨⟩ | a) ha
      · contradiction
      apply coe_le_coe.2
      exact le_csSup h₂ ha
    · intro _ _
      exact le_top
  · change ite _ _ _ ∈ _
    split_ifs with h₁ h₂
    · rintro (⟨⟩ | a) ha
      · exact le_rfl
      · exact False.elim (not_top_le_coe a (ha h₁))
    · rintro (⟨⟩ | b) hb
      · exact le_top
      refine coe_le_coe.2 (csSup_le ?_ ?_)
      · rcases hs with ⟨⟨⟩ | b, hb⟩
        · exact absurd hb h₁
        · exact ⟨b, hb⟩
      · intro a ha
        exact coe_le_coe.1 (hb ha)
    · rintro (⟨⟩ | b) hb
      · exact le_rfl
      · exfalso
        apply h₂
        use b
        intro a ha
        exact coe_le_coe.1 (hb ha)

name: isGLB_sInf'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · change ite _ _ _ ∈ _
    simp only [hs, not_true_eq_false, or_false]
    split_ifs with h
    · intro a ha
      exact top_le_iff.2 (Set.mem_singleton_iff.1 (h ha))
    · rintro (⟨⟩ | a) ha
      · exact le_top
      refine coe_le_coe.2 (csInf_le ?_ ha)
      rcases hs with ⟨⟨⟩ | b, hb⟩
      · exfalso
        apply h
        intro c hc
        rw [mem_singleton_iff, ← top_le_iff]
        exact hb hc
      use b
      intro c hc
      exact coe_le_coe.1 (hb hc)
  · change ite _ _ _ ∈ _
    simp only [hs, not_true_eq_false, or_false]
    split_ifs with h
    · intro _ _
      exact le_top
    · rintro (⟨⟩ | a) ha
      · exfalso
        apply h
        intro b hb
        exact Set.mem_singleton_iff.2 (top_le_iff.1 (ha hb))
      · refine coe_le_coe.2 (le_csInf ?_ ?_)
        · classical
            contrapose! h
            rintro (⟨⟩ | a) ha
            · exact mem_singleton ⊤
            · exact (not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.2 h ⟨a, ha⟩).elim
        · intro b hb
          rw [← coe_le_coe]
          exact ha hb

name: MonotoneOn.csInf_eq_of_subset_of_forall_exists_le
statement:
@[to_dual]
lemma MonotoneOn.csInf_eq_of_subset_of_forall_exists_le
    [Preorder α] [ConditionallyCompleteLattice β] {f : α → β}
    {s t : Set α} (ht : BddBelow (f '' t)) (hf : MonotoneOn f t)
    (hst : s ⊆ t) (h : ∀ y ∈ t, ∃ x ∈ s, x ≤ y) :
    sInf (f '' s) = sInf (f '' t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hs := Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty s
  · obtain rfl : t = ∅ := by simpa [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem] using h
    rfl
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (by gcongr; exact hs.image f)
  refine le_csInf ((hs.mono hst).image f) ?_
  simp only [mem_image, forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂]
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨x, hxs, hxa⟩ := h a ha
  exact csInf_le_of_le (ht.mono (image_mono hst)) ⟨x, hxs, rfl⟩ (hf (hst hxs) ha hxa)

name: MonotoneOn.sInf_image_Icc
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem MonotoneOn.sInf_image_Icc [Preorder α] [ConditionallyCompleteLattice β]

    (h' : MonotoneOn f (Icc a b)) : sInf (f '' Icc a b) = f a
proof:
:= by
  refine IsGLB.csInf_eq ?_ ((nonempty_Icc.mpr hab).image f)
  refine isGLB_iff_le_iff.mpr (fun b' ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩)
  · intro hb'
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact hb'.trans <| h' (left_mem_Icc.mpr hab) hx hx.1
  · exact fun hb' ↦ hb' ⟨a, by simp [hab]⟩

proof:

  have : Icc a b = Icc (α := αᵒᵈ) (toDual b) (toDual a) := by rw [Icc_toDual]; rfl
  rw [this] at h' ⊢
  exact h'.dual_left.sInf_image_Icc (α := αᵒᵈ) hab

statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem WithBot.coe_biSup {ι : Type*} {s : Set ι} (hs : s.Nonempty)
    {α : Type*} [CompleteLattice α] (f : ι → α) :
    ⨆ i ∈ s, f i = ⨆ i ∈ s, (f i : WithBot α)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hs with ⟨j, hj⟩
  have : Nonempty ι := Nonempty.intro j
  refine le_antisymm ((WithBot.coe_iSup (OrderTop.bddAbove _)).trans_le <|
    iSup_le_iff.mpr fun i ↦ ?_) <| iSup_le_iff.mpr <| fun _ ↦ iSup_le_iff.mpr <|
      fun hi ↦ WithBot.coe_le_coe.mpr (le_biSup _ hi)
  by_cases h : i ∈ s
  · simpa only [iSup_pos h] using by apply le_biSup _ h
  · simpa only [iSup_neg h] using le_trans (by simp) (le_biSup _ hj)

every row -/]
theorem BddAbove.range_iSup_of_iUnion_range {κ : ι → Sort*} {f : ∀ i, κ i → α}

  have ⟨a, h⟩ := H

  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty <| κ i

  · simp [iSup_of_empty']
  apply le_antisymm <| ciSup_le fun x ↦ sup_le_sup (le_ciSup Hf x) (le_ciSup Hg x)
  have := bbdAbove_range_sup Hf Hg
  exact sup_le (ciSup_mono this fun _ ↦ le_sup_left) (ciSup_mono this fun _ ↦ le_sup_right)

name: ciSup_prod
statement:
@[to_dual]
lemma ciSup_prod {f : β × γ → α} (hf : BddAbove (Set.range f)) :
    ⨆ p, f p = ⨆ b, ⨆ c, f (b, c)
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty β
  · simp [iSup_of_empty']
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty γ
  · simp [iSup_of_empty']
  have h₁ : BddAbove (Set.range fun b ↦ ⨆ c, f (b, c)) := by
    rw [bddAbove_def] at hf ⊢
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hf
    refine ⟨B, fun y hy ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_range.mp hy
    exact ciSup_le fun c ↦ by grind
  have h₂ b : BddAbove (Set.range fun c ↦ f (b, c)) := by
    rw [bddAbove_def] at hf ⊢
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hf
    exact ⟨B, by grind⟩
  refine eq_of_forall_ge_iff fun c ↦ ?_
  rw [ciSup_le_iff (bddAbove_iff_subset_Iic.mpr hf), ciSup_le_iff h₁]
  conv_rhs => enter [b]; rw [ciSup_le_iff (h₂ b)]
  simp [Prod.forall]

name: ciSup_eq_of_forall_le_of_forall_lt_exists_gt
statement:
@[to_dual ciInf_eq_of_forall_ge_of_forall_gt_exists_lt /
the infimum of `f`: it suffices to check that `b` is smaller than `f i` for all `i`, and that this
is not the case of any `w>b`. See `iInf_eq_of_forall_ge_of_forall_gt_exists_lt` for a version in
complete lattices. -/]
theorem ciSup_eq_of_forall_le_of_forall_lt_exists_gt [Nonempty ι] {f : ι → α} (h₁ : ∀ i, f i ≤ b)
    (h₂ : ∀ w, w < b → ∃ i, w < f i) : ⨆ i : ι, f i = b
proof:
:=
  csSup_eq_of_forall_le_of_forall_lt_exists_gt (range_nonempty f) (forall_mem_range.mpr h₁)
    fun w hw => exists_range_iff.mpr <| h₂ w hw

name: Set.Iic_ciInf
statement:
@[to_dual]
lemma Set.Iic_ciInf [Nonempty ι] {f : ι → α} (hf : BddBelow (range f)) :
    Iic (⨅ i, f i) = ⋂ i, Iic (f i)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simpa using le_ciInf_iff hf

name: ciSup_subtype
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem ciSup_subtype {p : ι → Prop} {f : Subtype p → α}
    (hf : BddAbove (Set.range f)) (hf' : sSup ∅ ≤ iSup f) :
    iSup f = ⨆ (i) (h : p i), f ⟨i, h⟩
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty (Subtype p)
  · rw [iSup_of_empty', cbiSup_eq_of_forall_not fun i h ↦ isEmptyElim (⟨i, h⟩ : Subtype p)]
  have : Nonempty ι := (nonempty_subtype.mp ‹_›).nonempty
  classical
  refine le_antisymm (ciSup_le ?_) ?_
  · intro ⟨i, h⟩
    have : f ⟨i, h⟩ = (fun i : ι ↦ ⨆ (h : p i), f ⟨i, h⟩) i := by simp [h]
    rw [this]
    refine le_ciSup (f := (fun i : ι ↦ ⨆ (h : p i), f ⟨i, h⟩)) ?_ i
    simp_rw [ciSup_eq_ite]
    refine (hf.union (bddAbove_singleton (a := sSup ∅))).mono ?_
    grind
  · refine ciSup_le fun i ↦ ?_
    simp_rw [ciSup_eq_ite]
    split_ifs
    · exact le_ciSup hf ?_
    · exact hf'

name: cbiSup_eq_ciSup_subtype
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem cbiSup_eq_ciSup_subtype {p : ι → Prop} {f : ∀ i, p i → α}
    (hf : BddAbove (Set.range (fun i : Subtype p ↦ f i i.prop)))
    (hf' : sSup ∅ ≤ ⨆ (i : Subtype p), f i i.prop) :
    ⨆ (i) (h), f i h = ⨆ x : Subtype p, f x x.property
proof:
:=
  (ciSup_subtype (f := fun x => f x.val x.property) hf hf').symm

name: ciSup_subtype_fun
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem ciSup_subtype_fun {ι} {s : Set ι} {f : ι → α}
    (hf : BddAbove (Set.range fun i : s ↦ f i)) (hf' : sSup ∅ ≤ ⨆ i : s, f i) :
    ⨆ i : s, f i = ⨆ (t : ι) (_ : t ∈ s), f t

name: csSup_image
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem csSup_image {s : Set β} {f : β → α}
    (hf : BddAbove (Set.range fun i : s ↦ f i)) (hf' : sSup ∅ ≤ ⨆ i : s, f i) :
    sSup (f '' s) = ⨆ a ∈ s, f a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ciSup_subtype_fun hf hf', iSup, Set.image_eq_range]

name: cbiSup_id
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem cbiSup_id {s : Set α} (hs : BddAbove s) (h : sSup ∅ ≤ sSup s) : ⨆ i ∈ s, i = sSup s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← csSup_image (Subtype.range_coe ▸ hs), Set.image_id']
  · convert! h
    rw [← sSup_range, Subtype.range_coe]

name: ciSup_image
statement:
@[to_dual]
lemma ciSup_image {ι ι' : Type*} {s : Set ι} {f : ι → ι'} {g : ι' → α}
    (hf : BddAbove (Set.range fun i : s ↦ g (f i))) (hg' : sSup ∅ ≤ ⨆ i : s, g (f i)) :
    ⨆ i ∈ (f '' s), g i = ⨆ x ∈ s, g (f x)
proof:
:= by
  rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with (rfl | hs)
  · rw [Set.image_empty, cbiSup_empty, cbiSup_empty]
  have hg : BddAbove (Set.range fun i : f '' s ↦ g i) := by
    simpa [bddAbove_def] using hf
  have hf' : sSup ∅ ≤ ⨆ i : f '' s, g i := by
    refine hg'.trans ?_
    have : Nonempty s := Set.Nonempty.to_subtype hs
    refine ciSup_le ?_
    intro ⟨i, h⟩
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t : f '' s, g t = g (f (Subtype.mk i h)) := by
      have : f i ∈ f '' s := Set.mem_image_of_mem _ h
      exact ⟨⟨f i, this⟩, by simp⟩
    rw [← ht]
    refine le_ciSup_set ?_ t.prop
    simpa [bddAbove_def] using hf
  rw [← csSup_image hg hf', ← csSup_image hf hg', ← Set.image_comp, comp_def]

name: le_ciSup_ciSup_eq_left
statement:
@[to_dual ciInf_ciInf_eq_left_le]
theorem le_ciSup_ciSup_eq_left {b : β} {f : ∀ x : β, x = b → α} :
    f b rfl ≤ ⨆ x, ⨆ h : x = b, f x h
proof:
:= by
  refine le_ciSup₂ (f := f) ⟨f b rfl, ?_⟩ b rfl
  rintro a ⟨_, ⟨b, rfl⟩, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  rfl

name: le_ciSup_ciSup_eq_right
statement:
@[to_dual ciInf_ciInf_eq_right_le]
theorem le_ciSup_ciSup_eq_right {b : β} {f : ∀ x : β, b = x → α} :
    f b rfl ≤ ⨆ x, ⨆ h : b = x, f x h
proof:
:= by
  refine le_ciSup₂ ⟨f b rfl, ?_⟩ b rfl
  rintro a ⟨_, ⟨b, rfl⟩, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  rfl

name: ciSup_exists_le
statement:
@[to_dual le_ciInf_exists]
theorem ciSup_exists_le {p : ι → Prop} {f : Exists p → α} : ⨆ ih, f ih ≤ ⨆ (i) (h), f ⟨i, h⟩
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! h : Exists p
  · have : Nonempty <| Exists p := ⟨h⟩
    refine ciSup_le fun ⟨i, hi⟩ ↦ le_ciSup₂ (f := fun _ _ ↦ _) ⟨f ⟨i, hi⟩, ?_⟩ i hi
    rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨j, rfl⟩, ⟨hj, rfl⟩⟩
    rfl
  · cases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι <;>
      simp [h, iSup_of_empty', ciSup_const]

name: ciSup_and
statement:

theorem ciSup_and {p q : Prop} {f : p ∧ q → α} : ⨆ ih, f ih = ⨆ (h₁) (h₂), f ⟨h₁, h₂⟩

name: ciSup_sup_le
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem ciSup_sup_le {f g : ι → α} : ⨆ x, f x ⊔ g x ≤ (⨆ x, f x) ⊔ (⨆ x, g x)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hf : ¬BddAbove (range f)
  · rw [ciSup_of_not_bddAbove hf, ciSup_of_not_bddAbove <| mt bbdAbove_range_left_of_sup hf]
    exact le_sup_left
  by_cases! hg : ¬BddAbove (range g)
  · rw [ciSup_of_not_bddAbove hg, ciSup_of_not_bddAbove <| mt bbdAbove_range_right_of_sup hg]
    exact le_sup_right
  exact ciSup_sup_eq hf hg |>.le

name: exists_lt_of_lt_ciSup
statement:
@[to_dual exists_lt_of_ciInf_lt /
When `iInf f < a`, there is an element `i` such that `f i < a`. -/]

name: cbiSup_of_not_bddAbove
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem cbiSup_of_not_bddAbove {p : ι → Prop} {f : ∀ i, p i → α}
    (h : ¬BddAbove (range fun i : Subtype p ↦ f i i.prop)) :
    ⨆ (i : ι), ⨆ (h : p i), f i h = sSup ∅
proof:
:=
  ciSup_of_not_bddAbove fun ⟨u, hu⟩ ↦ h ⟨u, fun _ ⟨x, hx⟩ ↦ hx ▸ hu ⟨x, ciSup_pos x.prop⟩⟩

name: cbiSup_eq_of_not_forall
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem cbiSup_eq_of_not_forall {p : ι → Prop} {f : Subtype p → α} (hp : ¬ (∀ i, p i)) :
    ⨆ (i) (h : p i), f ⟨i, h⟩ = iSup f ⊔ sSup ∅
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt (sSup ∅) (iSup f) with le | gt
  · rw [max_eq_left le]
    by_cases bdd : BddAbove (range f)
    · rw [← ciSup_subtype bdd le]
    · rw [ciSup_of_not_bddAbove bdd, cbiSup_of_not_bddAbove bdd]
  have ⟨i, hi⟩ := not_forall.mp hp
  have : Nonempty ι := ⟨i⟩
  have bdd : BddAbove (range f) := not_not.mp fun h ↦ gt.ne (ciSup_of_not_bddAbove h)
  rw [max_eq_right gt.le]
  refine ciSup_eq_of_forall_le_of_forall_lt_exists_gt (fun j ↦ ?_) ?_
  · by_cases hj : p j
    · exact ((ciSup_pos hj).trans_le (le_ciSup bdd ⟨j, hj⟩)).trans gt.le
    · exact (ciSup_neg hj).le
  · exact fun w hw ↦ ⟨i, hw.trans_eq (ciSup_neg hi).symm⟩

name: mem_generate_iff
statement:
theorem mem_generate_iff {s : Set <| Set α} {U : Set α} :
    U ∈ generate s ↔ ∃ t ⊆ s, Set.Finite t ∧ ⋂₀ t ⊆ U
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · induction h with
    | @basic V V_in =>
      exact ⟨{V}, singleton_subset_iff.2 V_in, finite_singleton _, (sInter_singleton _).subset⟩
    | univ => exact ⟨∅, empty_subset _, finite_empty, subset_univ _⟩
    | superset _ hVW hV =>
      rcases hV with ⟨t, hts, ht, htV⟩
      exact ⟨t, hts, ht, htV.trans hVW⟩
    | inter _ _ hV hW =>
      rcases hV, hW with ⟨⟨t, hts, ht, htV⟩, u, hus, hu, huW⟩
      exact
        ⟨t ∪ u, union_subset hts hus, ht.union hu,
          (sInter_union _ _).subset.trans <| inter_subset_inter htV huW⟩
  · rcases h with ⟨t, hts, tfin, h⟩
    exact mem_of_superset ((sInter_mem tfin).2 fun V hV => GenerateSets.basic <| hts hV) h

name: mem_iInf_of_iInter
statement:
theorem mem_iInf_of_iInter {ι} {s : ι → Filter α} {U : Set α} {I : Set ι} (I_fin : I.Finite)
    {V : I → Set α} (hV : ∀ (i : I), V i ∈ s i) (hU : ⋂ i, V i ⊆ U) : U ∈ ⨅ i, s i
proof:
:= by
  have := I_fin.fintype
  refine mem_of_superset (iInter_mem.2 fun i => ?_) hU
  exact mem_iInf_of_mem (i : ι) (hV _)

name: mem_iInf
statement:
theorem mem_iInf {ι} {s : ι → Filter α} {U : Set α} :
    (U ∈ ⨅ i, s i) ↔
      ∃ I : Set ι, I.Finite ∧ ∃ V : I → Set α, (∀ (i : I), V i ∈ s i) ∧ U = ⋂ i, V i
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [iInf_eq_generate, mem_generate_iff]
    rintro ⟨t, tsub, tfin, tinter⟩
    rcases eq_finite_iUnion_of_finite_subset_iUnion tfin tsub with ⟨I, Ifin, σ, σfin, σsub, rfl⟩
    rw [sInter_iUnion] at tinter
    set V := fun i => U ∪ ⋂₀ σ i with hV
    have V_in : ∀ (i : I), V i ∈ s i := by
      rintro i
      have : ⋂₀ σ i ∈ s i := by
        rw [sInter_mem (σfin _)]
        apply σsub
      exact mem_of_superset this subset_union_right
    refine ⟨I, Ifin, V, V_in, ?_⟩
    rwa [hV, ← union_iInter, union_eq_self_of_subset_right]
  · rintro ⟨I, Ifin, V, V_in, rfl⟩
    exact mem_iInf_of_iInter Ifin V_in Subset.rfl

name: mem_iInf'
statement:
theorem mem_iInf' {ι} {s : ι → Filter α} {U : Set α} :
    (U ∈ ⨅ i, s i) ↔
      ∃ I : Set ι, I.Finite ∧ ∃ V : ι → Set α, (∀ i, V i ∈ s i) ∧
        (∀ i ∉ I, V i = univ) ∧ (U = ⋂ i ∈ I, V i) ∧ U = ⋂ i, V i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [mem_iInf, biInter_eq_iInter]
  refine ⟨?_, fun ⟨I, If, V, hVs, _, hVU, _⟩ => ⟨I, If, fun i => V i, fun i => hVs i, hVU⟩⟩
  rintro ⟨I, If, V, hV, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨I, If, fun i => if hi : i ∈ I then V ⟨i, hi⟩ else univ, fun i => ?_, fun i hi => ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp only
    split_ifs
    exacts [hV ⟨i,_⟩, univ_mem]
  · exact dite_eq_right hi
  · simp only [iInter_dite, biInter_eq_iInter, dite_eq_left (Subtype.coe_prop _), Subtype.coe_eta,
      iInter_univ, inter_univ, true_and]

name: exists_iInter_of_mem_iInf
statement:
theorem exists_iInter_of_mem_iInf {ι : Sort*} {α : Type*} {f : ι → Filter α} {s}
    (hs : s ∈ ⨅ i, f i) : ∃ t : ι → Set α, (∀ i, t i ∈ f i) ∧ s = ⋂ i, t i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← iInf_range' (g := (·))] at hs
  let ⟨_, _, V, hVs, _, _, hVU'⟩ := mem_iInf'.1 hs
  use V ∘ rangeFactorization f, fun i ↦ hVs (rangeFactorization f i)
  rw [hVU', ← rangeFactorization_surjective.iInter_comp, comp_def]

name: mem_iInf_of_finite
statement:
theorem mem_iInf_of_finite {ι : Sort*} [Finite ι] {α : Type*} {f : ι → Filter α} (s) :
    (s ∈ ⨅ i, f i) ↔ ∃ t : ι → Set α, (∀ i, t i ∈ f i) ∧ s = ⋂ i, t i
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨exists_iInter_of_mem_iInf, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
  exact iInter_mem.2 fun i => mem_iInf_of_mem i (ht i)

name: mem_biInf_principal
statement:
theorem mem_biInf_principal {ι : Type*} {p : ι → Prop} {s : ι → Set α} {t : Set α} :
    t ∈ ⨅ (i : ι) (_ : p i), 𝓟 (s i) ↔
      ∃ I : Set ι, I.Finite ∧ (∀ i ∈ I, p i) ∧ ⋂ i ∈ I, s i ⊆ t
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp only [mem_iInf (ι := ι), mem_iInf_of_finite, mem_principal]
    rintro ⟨I, hIf, V, hV₁, hV₂, rfl⟩
    choose! t ht₁ ht₂ using hV₁
    refine ⟨I ∩ {i | p i}, hIf.inter_of_left _, fun i ↦ And.right, ?_⟩
    simp only [mem_inter_iff, iInter_and, biInter_eq_iInter, ht₂, mem_ofPred_eq]
    gcongr with i hpi
    exact ht₁ i hpi
  · rintro ⟨I, hIf, hpI, hst⟩
    rw [biInter_eq_iInter] at hst
    refine mem_iInf_of_iInter hIf (fun i ↦ ?_) hst
    simp [hpI i i.2]

name: _root_.Pairwise.exists_mem_filter_of_disjoint
proof:
:= by
  have : Pairwise fun i j => ∃ (s : {s // s ∈ l i}) (t : {t // t ∈ l j}), Disjoint s.1 t.1 := by
    simpa only [Pairwise, Function.onFun, Filter.disjoint_iff, exists_prop, Subtype.exists] using hd
  choose! s t hst using this
  refine ⟨fun i => ⋂ j, @s i j ∩ @t j i, fun i => ?_, fun i j hij => ?_⟩
  exacts [iInter_mem.2 fun j => inter_mem (@s i j).2 (@t j i).2,
    (hst hij).mono ((iInter_subset _ j).trans inter_subset_left)
      ((iInter_subset _ i).trans inter_subset_right)]

name: _root_.Set.PairwiseDisjoint.exists_mem_filter
proof:
:= by
  have := ht.to_subtype
  rcases (hd.subtype _ _).exists_mem_filter_of_disjoint with ⟨s, hsl, hsd⟩
  lift s to (i : t) → {s // s ∈ l i} using hsl
  rcases @Subtype.exists_pi_extension ι (fun i => { s // s ∈ l i }) _ _ s with ⟨s, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨fun i => s i, fun i => (s i).2, hsd.set_of_subtype _ _⟩

name: mem_iInf_finset
statement:
theorem mem_iInf_finset {s : Finset α} {f : α → Filter β} {t : Set β} :
    (t ∈ ⨅ a ∈ s, f a) ↔ ∃ p : α → Set β, (∀ a ∈ s, p a ∈ f a) ∧ t = ⋂ a ∈ s, p a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [← Finset.set_biInter_coe, biInter_eq_iInter, iInf_subtype']
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases (mem_iInf_of_finite _).1 h with ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨fun a => if h : a ∈ s then p ⟨a, h⟩ else univ,
            fun a ha => by simpa [ha] using hp ⟨a, ha⟩, ?_⟩
    refine iInter_congr_of_surjective id surjective_id ?_
    rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    simp [ha]
  · rintro ⟨p, hpf, rfl⟩
    exact iInter_mem.2 fun a => mem_iInf_of_mem a (hpf a a.2)

name: iInf_principal_finset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iInf_principal_finset {ι : Type w} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Set α) :

proof:

  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert i s _ hs => rw [Finset.iInf_insert, Finset.set_biInter_insert, hs, inf_principal]

name: iInf_principal
statement: theorem iInf_principal {ι : Sort w} [Finite ι] (f : ι → Set α) : ⨅ i, 𝓟 (f i) = 𝓟 (⋂ i, f i)
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_fintype (PLift ι)
  rw [← iInf_plift_down, ← iInter_plift_down]
  simpa using iInf_principal_finset Finset.univ (f <| PLift.down ·)

name: EventuallySubset.iUnion

proof:
:=
  (eventually_all.2 h).mono fun _x hx hx' ↦
    let ⟨i, hi⟩ := mem_iUnion.1 hx'; mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, hx i hi⟩

name: exists_countable_separating
statement:
theorem exists_countable_separating (α : Type*) (p : Set α → Prop) (t : Set α)
    [h : HasCountableSeparatingOn α p t] :
    ∃ S : Set (Set α), S.Countable ∧ (∀ s ∈ S, p s) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ t, ∀ y ∈ t, (∀ s ∈ S, x ∈ s ↔ y ∈ s) → x = y

name: exists_nonempty_countable_separating
statement:
theorem exists_nonempty_countable_separating (α : Type*) {p : Set α → Prop} {s₀} (hp : p s₀)
    (t : Set α) [HasCountableSeparatingOn α p t] :
    ∃ S : Set (Set α), S.Nonempty ∧ S.Countable ∧ (∀ s ∈ S, p s) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ t, ∀ y ∈ t, (∀ s ∈ S, x ∈ s ↔ y ∈ s) → x = y
proof:
:=
  let ⟨S, hSc, hSp, hSt⟩ := exists_countable_separating α p t
  ⟨insert s₀ S, insert_nonempty _ _, hSc.insert _, forall_insert_of_forall hSp hp,
    fun x hx y hy hxy ↦ hSt x hx y hy <| forall_of_forall_insert hxy⟩

name: exists_seq_separating
statement:
theorem exists_seq_separating (α : Type*) {p : Set α → Prop} {s₀} (hp : p s₀) (t : Set α)
    [HasCountableSeparatingOn α p t] :
    ∃ S : ℕ → Set α, (∀ n, p (S n)) ∧ ∀ x ∈ t, ∀ y ∈ t, (∀ n, x ∈ S n ↔ y ∈ S n) → x = y
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_nonempty_countable_separating α hp t with ⟨S, hSne, hSc, hS⟩
  rcases hSc.exists_eq_range hSne with ⟨S, rfl⟩
  use S
  simpa only [forall_mem_range] using hS

name: HasCountableSeparatingOn.mono
statement:
theorem HasCountableSeparatingOn.mono {α} {p₁ p₂ : Set α → Prop} {t₁ t₂ : Set α}
    [h : HasCountableSeparatingOn α p₁ t₁] (hp : ∀ s, p₁ s → p₂ s) (ht : t₂ ⊆ t₁) :
    HasCountableSeparatingOn α p₂ t₂ where
  exists_countable_separating
proof:
:=
    let ⟨S, hSc, hSp, hSt⟩ := h.1
    ⟨S, hSc, fun s hs ↦ hp s (hSp s hs), fun x hx y hy ↦ hSt x (ht hx) y (ht hy)⟩

name: HasCountableSeparatingOn.of_subtype
proof:
:= by
  rcases h.1 with ⟨S, hSc, hSq, hS⟩
  choose! V hpV hV using fun s hs ↦ hpq s (hSq s hs)
  refine ⟨⟨V '' S, hSc.image _, forall_mem_image.2 hpV, fun x hx y hy h ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  refine congr_arg Subtype.val (hS ⟨x, hx⟩ trivial ⟨y, hy⟩ trivial fun U hU ↦ ?_)
  rw [← hV U hU]
  exact h _ (mem_image_of_mem _ hU)

name: HasCountableSeparatingOn.subtype_iff
statement:
theorem HasCountableSeparatingOn.subtype_iff {α : Type*} {p : Set α → Prop} {t : Set α} :
    HasCountableSeparatingOn t (fun u ↦ ∃ v, p v ∧ (↑) ⁻¹' v = u) univ ↔
    HasCountableSeparatingOn α p t
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · exact h.of_subtype <| fun s ↦ id
  rcases h with ⟨S, Sct, Sp, hS⟩
  use {Subtype.val ⁻¹' s | s ∈ S}, Sct.image _, ?_, ?_
  · rintro u ⟨t, tS, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨t, Sp _ tS, rfl⟩
  rintro x - y - hxy
  exact Subtype.val_injective <| hS _ (Subtype.coe_prop _) _ (Subtype.coe_prop _)
    fun s hs ↦ hxy (Subtype.val ⁻¹' s) ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩

name: exists_subset_subsingleton_mem_of_forall_separating
statement:
theorem exists_subset_subsingleton_mem_of_forall_separating (p : Set α → Prop)
    {s : Set α} [h : HasCountableSeparatingOn α p s] (hs : s ∈ l)
    (hl : ∀ U, p U → U ∈ l ∨ Uᶜ ∈ l) : ∃ t, t ⊆ s ∧ t.Subsingleton ∧ t ∈ l
proof:
:= by
  rcases h.1 with ⟨S, hSc, hSp, hS⟩
  refine ⟨s ∩ ⋂₀ (S ∩ l.sets) ∩ ⋂ (U ∈ S) (_ : Uᶜ ∈ l), Uᶜ, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact fun _ h ↦ h.1.1
  · intro x hx y hy
    simp only [mem_sInter, mem_inter_iff, mem_iInter, mem_compl_iff] at hx hy
    refine hS x hx.1.1 y hy.1.1 (fun s hsS ↦ ?_)
    cases hl s (hSp s hsS) with
    | inl hsl => simp only [hx.1.2 s ⟨hsS, hsl⟩, hy.1.2 s ⟨hsS, hsl⟩]
    | inr hsl => simp only [hx.2 s hsS hsl, hy.2 s hsS hsl]
  · exact inter_mem
      (inter_mem hs ((countable_sInter_mem (hSc.mono inter_subset_left)).2 fun _ h ↦ h.2))
      ((countable_bInter_mem hSc).2 fun U hU ↦ iInter_mem'.2 id)

name: exists_mem_singleton_mem_of_mem_of_nonempty_of_forall_separating
statement:
theorem exists_mem_singleton_mem_of_mem_of_nonempty_of_forall_separating (p : Set α → Prop)
    {s : Set α} [HasCountableSeparatingOn α p s] (hs : s ∈ l) (hne : s.Nonempty)
    (hl : ∀ U, p U → U ∈ l ∨ Uᶜ ∈ l) : ∃ a ∈ s, {a} ∈ l
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_subset_subsingleton_mem_of_forall_separating p hs hl with ⟨t, hts, ht, htl⟩
  rcases ht.eq_empty_or_singleton with rfl | ⟨x, rfl⟩
  · exact hne.imp fun a ha ↦ ⟨ha, mem_of_superset htl (empty_subset _)⟩
  · exact ⟨x, hts rfl, htl⟩

name: exists_singleton_mem_of_mem_of_forall_separating
statement:
theorem exists_singleton_mem_of_mem_of_forall_separating [Nonempty α] (p : Set α → Prop)
    {s : Set α} [HasCountableSeparatingOn α p s] (hs : s ∈ l) (hl : ∀ U, p U → U ∈ l ∨ Uᶜ ∈ l) :
    ∃ a, {a} ∈ l
proof:
:= by
  rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hne
  · exact ‹Nonempty α›.elim fun a ↦ ⟨a, mem_of_superset hs (empty_subset _)⟩
  · exact (exists_mem_singleton_mem_of_mem_of_nonempty_of_forall_separating p hs hne hl).imp fun _ ↦
      And.right

name: exists_subsingleton_mem_of_forall_separating
statement:
theorem exists_subsingleton_mem_of_forall_separating (p : Set α → Prop)

proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [pi_mem_pi hfin fun i _ ↦ h i] with a ha i _
  if hi : s i = univ then
    simp [hi]

    exact ha i hi

name: map_piMap_pi
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (tendsto_piMap_pi fun _ ↦ tendsto_map) ?_
  refine ((hasBasis_pi fun i ↦ (l i).basis_sets).map _).ge_iff.2 ?_
  rintro ⟨I, s⟩ ⟨hI : I.Finite, hs : ∀ i ∈ I, s i ∈ l i⟩
  classical
  rw [← univ_pi_piecewise_univ, piMap_image_univ_pi]
  refine univ_pi_mem_pi (fun i ↦ ?_) ?_
  · by_cases hi : i ∈ I
    · simpa [hi] using image_mem_map (hs i hi)
    · simp [hi]
  · filter_upwards [hf, hI.compl_mem_cofinite] with i hsurj (hiI : i ∉ I)
    simp [hiI, hsurj.range_eq]

name: Filter.Tendsto.exists_within_forall_le
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! all_top : ∃ y ∈ s, ∃ x, f y < x
  · 
    rcases all_top with ⟨y, hys, x, hx⟩
    have : { y | ¬x ≤ f y }.Finite := Filter.eventually_cofinite.mp (tendsto_atTop.1 hf x)
    simp only [not_le] at this
    obtain ⟨a₀, ⟨ha₀ : f a₀ < x, ha₀s⟩, others_bigger⟩ :=
      exists_min_image _ f (this.inter_of_left s) ⟨y, hx, hys⟩
    refine ⟨a₀, ha₀s, fun a has => (lt_or_ge (f a) x).elim ?_ (le_trans ha₀.le)⟩
    exact fun h => others_bigger a ⟨h, has⟩
  · 
    obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀s⟩ := hs
    exact ⟨a₀, ha₀s, fun a ha => all_top a ha (f a₀)⟩

name: existsUnique_eq_principal_sup_free
statement:
theorem existsUnique_eq_principal_sup_free :
    ∃! p : Set α × Filter α, p.2 ≤ cofinite ∧ Disjoint (𝓟 p.1) p.2 ∧ f = 𝓟 p.1 ⊔ p.2
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(f.ker, Coheyting.boundary f), ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, fun q hq => ?_⟩
  · exact boundary_le_cofinite f
  · rw [disjoint_principal_left]
    exact mem_inf_of_right (mem_principal_self f.kerᶜ)
  · rw [← compl_compl f.ker, ← hnot_principal, ← Filter.hnot_def,
      Coheyting.hnot_hnot_sup_boundary]
  · have hqk := congrArg Filter.ker hq.2.2
    rw [ker_sup, ker_principal, le_cofinite_iff_ker.mp hq.1, union_empty] at hqk
    refine congrArg₂ Prod.mk hqk.symm (le_antisymm (le_inf ?_ ?_) ?_)
    · rw [hq.2.2]
      exact le_sup_right
    · rw [Filter.hnot_def, le_principal_iff, ← disjoint_principal_left, hqk]
      exact hq.2.1
    · grw [hq.2.2, Coheyting.boundary_sup_le, boundary_principal, bot_sup_eq]
      exact Coheyting.boundary_le

name: toReal_liminf
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
lemma toReal_liminf : liminf (fun i ↦ (u i : ℝ)) f = liminf u f
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : f.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≥ ·) u; swap
  · simp [*]
  refine eq_of_forall_le_iff fun c ↦ ?_
  rw [← Real.toNNReal_le_iff_le_coe, le_liminf_iff (by simpa) ⟨0, by simp⟩, le_liminf_iff]
  simp only [← coe_lt_coe, Real.coe_toNNReal', lt_sup_iff, or_imp, isEmpty_Prop, not_lt,
    zero_le_coe, IsEmpty.forall_iff, and_true, NNReal.forall, coe_mk, forall_comm (α := _ ≤ _)]
  refine forall₂_congr fun r hr ↦ ?_
  simpa using (le_or_gt 0 r).imp_right fun hr ↦ .of_forall fun i ↦ hr.trans_le (by simp)

name: toReal_limsup
statement:

lemma toReal_limsup : limsup (fun i ↦ (u i : ℝ)) f = limsup u f
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hf := f.eq_or_neBot
  · simp [limsup, limsSup]
  by_cases hf : f.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) u; swap
  · simp [*]
  have : f.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) u := by isBoundedDefault
  refine eq_of_forall_le_iff fun c ↦ ?_
  rw [← Real.toNNReal_le_iff_le_coe, le_limsup_iff (by simpa) (by simpa), le_limsup_iff ‹_›]
  simp only [← coe_lt_coe, Real.coe_toNNReal', lt_sup_iff, or_imp, isEmpty_Prop, not_lt,
    zero_le_coe, IsEmpty.forall_iff, and_true, NNReal.forall, coe_mk, forall_comm (α := _ ≤ _)]
  refine forall₂_congr fun r hr ↦ ?_
  simpa using (le_or_gt 0 r).imp_right fun hr ↦ .of_forall fun i ↦ hr.trans_le (by simp)

name: limsup_const_mul_of_ne_top
statement:
theorem limsup_const_mul_of_ne_top {u : α → ℝ≥0∞} {a : ℝ≥0∞} (ha_top : a ≠ ⊤) :
    (f.limsup fun x : α => a * u x) = a * f.limsup u
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha₀ : a = 0
  · simp_rw [ha₀, zero_mul, ← ENNReal.bot_eq_zero]
    exact limsup_const_bot
  let g_iso := (ENNReal.mul_right_strictMono ha₀ ha_top).orderIsoOfSurjective _ fun x ↦
    ⟨a⁻¹ * x, ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel_left ha₀ ha_top⟩
  exact g_iso.limsup_apply.symm

name: liminf_const_mul_of_ne_zero_of_ne_top
proof:

name: liminf_mul_const_of_ne_zero_of_ne_top

name: liminf_const_mul_of_ne_top
statement:
theorem liminf_const_mul_of_ne_top [f.NeBot] {u : α → ℝ≥0∞} {a : ℝ≥0∞} (ha_top : a ≠ ⊤) :

name: limsup_const_mul
statement:
theorem limsup_const_mul [CountableInterFilter f] {u : α → ℝ≥0∞} {a : ℝ≥0∞} :
    f.limsup (a * u ·) = a * f.limsup u
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! ha_top : a ≠ ⊤
  · exact limsup_const_mul_of_ne_top ha_top
  by_cases hu : u =ᶠ[f] 0
  · have hau : (a * u ·) =ᶠ[f] 0 := hu.mono fun x hx => by simp [hx]
    simp only [limsup_congr hu, limsup_congr hau, Pi.zero_def, ← ENNReal.bot_eq_zero,
      limsup_const_bot]
    simp
  · have hu_mul : ∃ᶠ x : α in f, ⊤ ≤ ite (u x = 0) (0 : ℝ≥0∞) ⊤ := by
      rw [EventuallyEq, not_eventually] at hu
      exact hu.mono fun x hx => by simpa
    have h_top_le : (f.limsup fun x : α => ite (u x = 0) (0 : ℝ≥0∞) ⊤) = ⊤ :=
      eq_top_iff.mpr (le_limsup_of_frequently_le hu_mul)
    have hfu : f.limsup u ≠ 0 := mt limsup_eq_bot.1 hu
    simp [ha_top, top_mul', h_top_le, hfu]

name: limsup_mul_const
statement:
theorem limsup_mul_const [CountableInterFilter f] {u : α → ℝ≥0∞} {a : ℝ≥0∞} :

name: limsup_mul_le
statement:
theorem limsup_mul_le [CountableInterFilter f] (u v : α → ℝ≥0∞) :
    f.limsup (u * v) ≤ f.limsup u * f.limsup v
proof:
:=
  calc
    f.limsup (u * v) ≤ f.limsup fun x => f.limsup u * v x := by
      refine limsup_le_limsup ?_
      filter_upwards [@eventually_le_limsup _ f _ u] with x hx using mul_le_mul' hx le_rfl
    _ = f.limsup u * f.limsup v := limsup_const_mul

name: limsup_add_le
statement:
theorem limsup_add_le [CountableInterFilter f] (u v : α → ℝ≥0∞) :
    f.limsup (u + v) ≤ f.limsup u + f.limsup v
proof:
:=
  sInf_le ((eventually_le_limsup u).mp
    ((eventually_le_limsup v).mono fun _ hxg hxf => add_le_add hxf hxg))

name: limsup_liminf_le_liminf_limsup
statement:
theorem limsup_liminf_le_liminf_limsup {β} [Countable β] {f : Filter α} [CountableInterFilter f]
    {g : Filter β} (u : α → β → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (f.limsup fun a : α => g.liminf fun b : β => u a b) ≤
      g.liminf fun b => f.limsup fun a => u a b
proof:
:=
  have h1 : ∀ᶠ a in f, ∀ b, u a b ≤ f.limsup fun a' => u a' b := by
    rw [eventually_countable_forall]
    exact fun b => ENNReal.eventually_le_limsup fun a => u a b
  sInf_le <| h1.mono fun x hx => Filter.liminf_le_liminf (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hx)

name: ofReal_limsup
statement:
lemma ofReal_limsup {u : α → ℝ}
    (h₁ : IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) f u := by isBoundedDefault)
    (h₂ : IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) f u := by isBoundedDefault) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (limsup u f) = limsup (fun a ↦ .ofReal (u a)) f
proof:
:= by
  refine ENNReal.eq_of_forall_le_nnreal_iff fun r ↦ ?_
  simp only [ofReal_le_coe]
  rw [limsup_le_iff, limsup_le_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro h (_ | x) hx
    · simp
    filter_upwards [h x (by simpa using hx)] with a ha
    obtain ha₀ | ha₀ := le_total (u a) 0
    · simpa [ofReal_of_nonpos, *] using hx.bot_lt
    · simp [ofReal_lt_coe_iff, *]
  · rintro h x hx
    have : 0 < x := hx.trans_le' (by simp)
    filter_upwards [h (.ofReal x) (by simpa [this] using hx)] with a ha
    exact (toReal_lt_of_lt_ofReal ha).trans_le' (by simp [toReal_ofReal'])

name: ofReal_limsup_toReal
statement:
lemma ofReal_limsup_toReal [f.NeBot] {u : α → ℝ≥0∞} {C : ℝ≥0} (hf : ∀ᶠ a in f, u a ≤ C) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (limsup (fun a ↦ (u a).toReal) f) = limsup u f
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) f (fun a ↦ (u a).toReal) :=
    IsCoboundedUnder.of_frequently_ge <| .of_forall fun _ ↦ by positivity
  have h₂ : IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) f (fun a ↦ (u a).toReal) := by
    refine isBoundedUnder_of_eventually_le (a := C) ?_
    filter_upwards [hf] with a ha
    exact ENNReal.toReal_le_coe_of_le_coe ha
  refine (ENNReal.ofReal_limsup h₁ h₂).trans (limsup_congr ?_)
  filter_upwards [hf] with x hx
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (ne_top_of_le_ne_top (by simp : C ≠ ∞) hx)

name: toReal_limsup
statement:
lemma toReal_limsup {u : α → ℝ≥0∞} (h₁ : ∀ᶠ a in f, u a ≠ ∞)
    (h₂ : IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) f fun a ↦ (u a).toReal := by isBoundedDefault) :
    (limsup u f).toReal = limsup (fun a ↦ (u a).toReal) f
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hf := f.eq_or_neBot
  · simp [limsup, limsSup]
  have : IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) f fun a ↦ (u a).toReal := .of_frequently_ge (a := 0) (by simpa)
  refine eq_of_forall_ge_iff fun r ↦ ?_
  obtain hr | hr := lt_or_ge r 0
  · exact iff_of_false (hr.trans_le toReal_nonneg).not_ge
      (hr.trans_le <| le_limsup_of_frequently_le (by simpa)).not_ge
  rw [← le_ofReal_iff_toReal_le _ hr, limsup_le_iff, limsup_le_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro h x hx
    have : 0 < x := hx.trans_le' hr
    filter_upwards [h (.ofReal x) (by simpa [this] using hx)] with i hi
    exact toReal_lt_of_lt_ofReal hi
  · rintro h (_ | x) hx
    · simpa [lt_top_iff_ne_top]
    filter_upwards [h₁, h x (by simpa [ofReal_lt_coe_iff hr] using hx)] with i hi
    simp [← lt_ofReal_iff_toReal_lt hi]
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h₂
  rw [eventually_map] at hx
  have hx₀ : 0 ≤ x := by obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hx.exists; exact toReal_nonneg.trans hi
  simp only [limsup, limsSup, eventually_map, ne_eq, sInf_eq_top, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_forall]
  refine ⟨.ofReal x, ?_, by simp⟩
  filter_upwards [h₁, hx] with i hi
  simp [le_ofReal_iff_toReal_le, *]

name: EventuallyLE.mul_le_mul

theorem EventuallyLE.mul_le_mul [MulZeroClass β] [Preorder β] [PosMulMono β] [MulPosMono β]

name: antitone_seq_of_seq
statement:
theorem antitone_seq_of_seq (s : ℕ → Set α) :
    ∃ t : ℕ → Set α, Antitone t ∧ ⨅ i, 𝓟 (s i) = ⨅ i, 𝓟 (t i)
proof:
:= by
  use fun n => ⋂ m ≤ n, s m; constructor
  · exact fun i j hij => biInter_mono (Iic_subset_Iic.2 hij) fun n _ => Subset.rfl
  apply le_antisymm <;> rw [le_iInf_iff] <;> intro i
  · rw [le_principal_iff]
    refine (biInter_mem (finite_le_nat _)).2 fun j _ => ?_
    exact mem_iInf_of_mem j (mem_principal_self _)
  · refine iInf_le_of_le i (principal_mono.2 <| iInter₂_subset i ?_)
    rfl

name: countable_biInf_eq_iInf_seq
statement:
theorem countable_biInf_eq_iInf_seq [CompleteLattice α] {B : Set ι} (Bcbl : B.Countable)
    (Bne : B.Nonempty) (f : ι → α) : ∃ x : ℕ → ι, ⨅ t ∈ B, f t = ⨅ i, f (x i)
proof:
:=
  let ⟨g, hg⟩ := Bcbl.exists_eq_range Bne
  ⟨g, hg.symm ▸ iInf_range⟩

name: countable_biInf_eq_iInf_seq'
statement:
theorem countable_biInf_eq_iInf_seq' [CompleteLattice α] {B : Set ι} (Bcbl : B.Countable)
    (f : ι → α) {i₀ : ι} (h : f i₀ = ⊤) : ∃ x : ℕ → ι, ⨅ t ∈ B, f t = ⨅ i, f (x i)
proof:
:= by
  rcases B.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hB | Bnonempty
  · rw [hB, iInf_emptyset]
    use fun _ => i₀

proof:
:=
  hs.1.to_hasBasis (fun j _ => (exists_ge_ge i j).imp fun _k hk => ⟨hk.1, hs.2 hk.2⟩) fun j _ =>
    ⟨j, trivial, Subset.rfl⟩

name: HasBasis.exists_antitone_subbasis
statement:
theorem HasBasis.exists_antitone_subbasis {f : Filter α} [h : f.IsCountablyGenerated]
    {p : ι' → Prop} {s : ι' → Set α} (hs : f.HasBasis p s) :
    ∃ x : ℕ → ι', (∀ i, p (x i)) ∧ f.HasAntitoneBasis fun i => s (x i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ : ∃ x : ℕ → Set α, f = ⨅ i, 𝓟 (x i) := by
    rcases h with ⟨s, hsc, rfl⟩
    rw [generate_eq_biInf]
    exact countable_biInf_principal_eq_seq_iInf hsc
  have : ∀ i, x' i ∈ f := fun i => hx'.symm ▸ (iInf_le (fun i => 𝓟 (x' i)) i) (mem_principal_self _)
  let x : ℕ → { i : ι' // p i } := fun n =>
    Nat.recOn n (hs.index _ <| this 0) fun n xn =>
      hs.index _ <| inter_mem (this <| n + 1) (hs.mem_of_mem xn.2)
  have x_anti : Antitone fun i => s (x i).1 :=
    antitone_nat_of_succ_le fun i => (hs.set_index_subset _).trans inter_subset_right
  have x_subset : ∀ i, s (x i).1 ⊆ x' i := by
    rintro (_ | i)
    exacts [hs.set_index_subset _, (hs.set_index_subset _).trans inter_subset_left]
  refine ⟨fun i => (x i).1, fun i => (x i).2, ?_⟩
  have : (⨅ i, 𝓟 (s (x i).1)).HasAntitoneBasis fun i => s (x i).1 := .iInf_principal x_anti
  convert! this
  exact
    le_antisymm (le_iInf fun i => le_principal_iff.2 <| by cases i <;> apply hs.set_index_mem)
      (hx'.symm ▸
        le_iInf fun i => le_principal_iff.2 <| this.1.mem_iff.2 ⟨i, trivial, x_subset i⟩)

proof:
:= by
  rw [tendsto_iff_comap] at hfg ⊢
  calc
    a ≤ comap (g ∘ f) c := hfg

  refine ((comap_mono <| map_le_iff_le_comap.1 hψ).trans ?_).antisymm (map_le_iff_le_comap.1 hφ)
  rw [comap_comap, eq, comap_id]

    let ⟨_s', hs', _t', ht', H⟩ := mem_prod_iff.1 h
    (prod_subset_prod_iff.1 H).elim
      (fun ⟨hs's, ht't⟩ => ⟨mem_of_superset hs' hs's, mem_of_superset ht' ht't⟩) fun h =>
      h.elim (fun hs'e => absurd hs'e (nonempty_of_mem hs').ne_empty) fun ht'e =>
        absurd ht'e (nonempty_of_mem ht').ne_empty,
    fun h => prod_mem_prod h.1 h.2⟩

name: mem_prod_principal
statement:
theorem mem_prod_principal {s : Set (α × β)} :
    s ∈ f ×ˢ 𝓟 t ↔ { a | ∀ b ∈ t, (a, b) ∈ s } ∈ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← @exists_mem_subset_iff _ f, mem_prod_iff]
  refine exists_congr fun u => Iff.rfl.and ⟨?_, fun h => ⟨t, mem_principal_self t, ?_⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨v, v_in, hv⟩ a a_in b b_in
    exact hv (mk_mem_prod a_in <| v_in b_in)
  · rintro ⟨x, y⟩ ⟨hx, hy⟩
    exact h hx y hy

name: mem_prod_top
statement:
theorem mem_prod_top {s : Set (α × β)} :
    s ∈ f ×ˢ (⊤ : Filter β) ↔ { a | ∀ b, (a, b) ∈ s } ∈ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← principal_univ, mem_prod_principal]
  simp only [mem_univ, forall_true_left]

name: eventually_prod_principal_iff
statement:
theorem eventually_prod_principal_iff {p : α × β → Prop} {s : Set β} :
    (∀ᶠ x : α × β in f ×ˢ 𝓟 s, p x) ↔ ∀ᶠ x : α in f, ∀ y : β, y ∈ s → p (x, y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eventually_iff, eventually_iff, mem_prod_principal]
  simp only [mem_ofPred_eq]

name: comap_prod
statement:
theorem comap_prod (f : α → β × γ) (b : Filter β) (c : Filter γ) :
    comap f (b ×ˢ c) = comap (Prod.fst ∘ f) b ⊓ comap (Prod.snd ∘ f) c

name: comap_prodMap_prod

theorem comap_prodMap_prod (f : α → β) (g : γ → δ) (lb : Filter β) (ld : Filter δ) :
    comap (Prod.map f g) (lb ×ˢ ld) = comap f lb ×ˢ comap g ld

name: prod_top
statement: theorem prod_top : f ×ˢ (⊤ : Filter β) = f.comap Prod.fst

name: top_prod
statement: theorem top_prod : (⊤ : Filter α) ×ˢ g = g.comap Prod.snd

name: sup_prod
statement: theorem sup_prod (f₁ f₂ : Filter α) (g : Filter β) : (f₁ ⊔ f₂) ×ˢ g = (f₁ ×ˢ g) ⊔ (f₂ ×ˢ g)

name: prod_sup
statement: theorem prod_sup (f : Filter α) (g₁ g₂ : Filter β) : f ×ˢ (g₁ ⊔ g₂) = (f ×ˢ g₁) ⊔ (f ×ˢ g₂)

name: eventually_prod_iff
statement:
theorem eventually_prod_iff {p : α × β → Prop} :
    (∀ᶠ x in f ×ˢ g, p x) ↔
      ∃ pa : α → Prop, (∀ᶠ x in f, pa x) ∧ ∃ pb : β → Prop, (∀ᶠ y in g, pb y) ∧
        ∀ {x}, pa x → ∀ {y}, pb y → p (x, y)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Set.prod_subset_iff] using! @mem_prod_iff α β p f g

name: tendsto_snd

name: Tendsto.fst

theorem Tendsto.fst {h : Filter γ} {m : α → β × γ} (H : Tendsto m f (g ×ˢ h)) :

theorem Tendsto.prodMk {h : Filter γ} {m₁ : α → β} {m₂ : α → γ}

name: Eventually.prod_inl
statement:
theorem Eventually.prod_inl {la : Filter α} {p : α → Prop} (h : ∀ᶠ x in la, p x) (lb : Filter β) :

name: Eventually.prod_inr
statement:
theorem Eventually.prod_inr {lb : Filter β} {p : β → Prop} (h : ∀ᶠ x in lb, p x) (la : Filter α) :

name: Eventually.prod_mk
statement:
theorem Eventually.prod_mk {la : Filter α} {pa : α → Prop} (ha : ∀ᶠ x in la, pa x) {lb : Filter β}
    {pb : β → Prop} (hb : ∀ᶠ y in lb, pb y) : ∀ᶠ p in la ×ˢ lb, pa (p : α × β).1 ∧ pb p.2

name: EventuallyEq.prodMap
statement:
theorem EventuallyEq.prodMap {δ} {la : Filter α} {fa ga : α → γ} (ha : fa =ᶠ[la] ga)
    {lb : Filter β} {fb gb : β → δ} (hb : fb =ᶠ[lb] gb) :
    Prod.map fa fb =ᶠ[la ×ˢ lb] Prod.map ga gb
proof:
:=
  (Eventually.prod_mk ha hb).mono fun _ h => Prod.ext h.1 h.2

name: EventuallyLE.prodMap
statement:
theorem EventuallyLE.prodMap {δ} [LE γ] [LE δ] {la : Filter α} {fa ga : α → γ} (ha : fa ≤ᶠ[la] ga)
    {lb : Filter β} {fb gb : β → δ} (hb : fb ≤ᶠ[lb] gb) :
    Prod.map fa fb ≤ᶠ[la ×ˢ lb] Prod.map ga gb

name: Eventually.curry
statement:
theorem Eventually.curry {la : Filter α} {lb : Filter β} {p : α × β → Prop}
    (h : ∀ᶠ x in la ×ˢ lb, p x) : ∀ᶠ x in la, ∀ᶠ y in lb, p (x, y)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eventually_prod_iff.1 h with ⟨pa, ha, pb, hb, h⟩
  exact ha.mono fun a ha => hb.mono fun b hb => h ha hb

name: Frequently.uncurry
statement:
protected lemma Frequently.uncurry {la : Filter α} {lb : Filter β} {p : α → β → Prop}
    (h : ∃ᶠ x in la, ∃ᶠ y in lb, p x y) : ∃ᶠ xy in la ×ˢ lb, p xy.1 xy.2

name: Frequently.of_curry
statement:
lemma Frequently.of_curry {la : Filter α} {lb : Filter β} {p : α × β → Prop}
    (h : ∃ᶠ x in la, ∃ᶠ y in lb, p (x, y)) : ∃ᶠ xy in la ×ˢ lb, p xy

name: Eventually.image_of_prod
statement:
theorem Eventually.image_of_prod {y : α → β} {r : α → β → Prop}
    (hy : Tendsto y f g) (hr : ∀ᶠ p in f ×ˢ g, r p.1 p.2) : ∀ᶠ x in f, r x (y x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, q, hq, hr⟩ := eventually_prod_iff.mp hr
  filter_upwards [hp, hy.eventually hq] with _ hp hq using hr hp hq

name: Eventually.diag_of_prod
statement:
theorem Eventually.diag_of_prod {p : α × α → Prop} (h : ∀ᶠ i in f ×ˢ f, p i) :
    ∀ᶠ i in f, p (i, i)

name: Eventually.diag_of_prod_left
statement:
theorem Eventually.diag_of_prod_left {f : Filter α} {g : Filter γ} {p : (α × α) × γ → Prop} :
    (∀ᶠ x in (f ×ˢ f) ×ˢ g, p x) → ∀ᶠ x : α × γ in f ×ˢ g, p ((x.1, x.1), x.2)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨t, ht, s, hs, hst⟩ := eventually_prod_iff.1 h
  exact (ht.diag_of_prod.prod_mk hs).mono fun x hx => by simp only [hst hx.1 hx.2]

name: Eventually.diag_of_prod_right
statement:
theorem Eventually.diag_of_prod_right {f : Filter α} {g : Filter γ} {p : α × γ × γ → Prop} :
    (∀ᶠ x in f ×ˢ (g ×ˢ g), p x) → ∀ᶠ x : α × γ in f ×ˢ g, p (x.1, x.2, x.2)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨t, ht, s, hs, hst⟩ := eventually_prod_iff.1 h
  exact (ht.prod_mk hs.diag_of_prod).mono fun x hx => by simp only [hst hx.1 hx.2]

theorem prod_iInf_right [Nonempty ι] {f : Filter α} {g : ι → Filter β} :

name: prod_mono
statement:
@[mono, gcongr]
theorem prod_mono {f₁ f₂ : Filter α} {g₁ g₂ : Filter β} (hf : f₁ ≤ f₂) (hg : g₁ ≤ g₂) :

name: prod_mono_left

statement: theorem prod_mono_right (f : Filter α) {g₁ g₂ : Filter β} (hf : g₁ ≤ g₂) : f ×ˢ g₁ ≤ f ×ˢ g₂

proof:
:= by

name: prod_comm'

proof:

name: prod_comm
statement: theorem prod_comm : f ×ˢ g = map Prod.swap (g ×ˢ f)

name: mem_prod_iff_left
statement:
theorem mem_prod_iff_left {s : Set (α × β)} :
    s ∈ f ×ˢ g ↔ ∃ t ∈ f, ∀ᶠ y in g, ∀ x ∈ t, (x, y) ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_prod_iff, prod_subset_iff]
  refine exists_congr fun _ => Iff.rfl.and <| Iff.trans ?_ exists_mem_subset_iff
  exact exists_congr fun _ => Iff.rfl.and forall₂_comm

name: map_fst_prod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_fst_prod (f : Filter α) (g : Filter β) [NeBot g] : map Prod.fst (f ×ˢ g) = f
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  simp only [mem_map, mem_prod_iff_left, mem_preimage, eventually_const, ← subset_def,
    exists_mem_subset_iff]

name: map_snd_prod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_snd_prod (f : Filter α) (g : Filter β) [NeBot f] : map Prod.snd (f ×ˢ g) = g

name: prod_le_prod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prod_le_prod {f₁ f₂ : Filter α} {g₁ g₂ : Filter β} [NeBot f₁] [NeBot g₁] :
    f₁ ×ˢ g₁ ≤ f₂ ×ˢ g₂ ↔ f₁ ≤ f₂ ∧ g₁ ≤ g₂
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h =>
    ⟨map_fst_prod f₁ g₁ ▸ tendsto_fst.mono_left h, map_snd_prod f₁ g₁ ▸ tendsto_snd.mono_left h⟩,
    fun h => prod_mono h.1 h.2⟩

name: prod_inj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prod_inj {f₁ f₂ : Filter α} {g₁ g₂ : Filter β} [NeBot f₁] [NeBot g₁] :
    f₁ ×ˢ g₁ = f₂ ×ˢ g₂ ↔ f₁ = f₂ ∧ g₁ = g₂
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => h.1 ▸ h.2 ▸ rfl⟩
  have hle : f₁ ≤ f₂ ∧ g₁ ≤ g₂ := prod_le_prod.1 h.le
  have := neBot_of_le hle.1; have := neBot_of_le hle.2
  exact ⟨hle.1.antisymm <| (prod_le_prod.1 h.ge).1, hle.2.antisymm <| (prod_le_prod.1 h.ge).2⟩

name: eventually_swap_iff
statement:
theorem eventually_swap_iff {p : α × β → Prop} :

name: Eventually.eventually_prod_of_eventually_swap
proof:
:= by
  refine eventually_prod_iff.mpr ⟨_, hp, _, hq, fun {x} hx {z} hz ↦ ?_⟩
  rcases (hx.and hz).exists with ⟨y, hpy, hqy⟩
  exact hpqr x y z hpy hqy

name: Eventually.trans_prod
prod_assoc

theorem prod_assoc (f : Filter α) (g : Filter β) (h : Filter γ) :

name: prod_map_map_eq.
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm
    (fun s hs =>
      let ⟨s₁, hs₁, s₂, hs₂, h⟩ := mem_prod_iff.mp hs
      mem_of_superset (prod_mem_prod (image_mem_map hs₁) (image_mem_map hs₂)) <|
        by rwa [prod_image_image_eq, image_subset_iff])
    ((tendsto_map.comp tendsto_fst).prodMk (tendsto_map.comp tendsto_snd))

name: map_prod

protected theorem map_prod (m : α × β → γ) (f : Filter α) (g : Filter β) :

:= by
  simp only [Filter.ext_iff, mem_map, mem_prod_iff, mem_map_seq_iff, exists_and_left]

  constructor
  · exact fun ⟨t, ht, s, hs, h⟩ => ⟨s, hs, t, ht, fun x hx y hy => @h ⟨x, y⟩ ⟨hx, hy⟩⟩
  · exact fun ⟨s, hs, t, ht, h⟩ => ⟨t, ht, s, hs, fun ⟨x, y⟩ ⟨hx, hy⟩ => h x hx y hy⟩

name: coprod_inf_prod_le
statement:
theorem coprod_inf_prod_le (f₁ f₂ : Filter α) (g₁ g₂ : Filter β) :
    f₁.coprod g₁ ⊓ f₂ ×ˢ g₂ ≤ f₁ ×ˢ g₂ ⊔ f₂ ×ˢ g₁
proof:
:= calc
  f₁.coprod g₁ ⊓ f₂ ×ˢ g₂
  _ = (f₁ ×ˢ ⊤ ⊔ ⊤ ×ˢ g₁) ⊓ f₂ ×ˢ g₂            := by rw [coprod_eq_prod_top_sup_top_prod]
  _ = f₁ ×ˢ ⊤ ⊓ f₂ ×ˢ g₂ ⊔ ⊤ ×ˢ g₁ ⊓ f₂ ×ˢ g₂   := inf_sup_right _ _ _
  _ = (f₁ ⊓ f₂) ×ˢ g₂ ⊔ f₂ ×ˢ (g₁ ⊓ g₂)         := by simp [prod_inf_prod]
  _ ≤ f₁ ×ˢ g₂ ⊔ f₂ ×ˢ g₁                       :=
    sup_le_sup (prod_mono inf_le_left le_rfl) (prod_mono le_rfl inf_le_left)

theorem map_const_principal_coprod_map_id_principal {α β ι : Type*} (a : α) (b : β) (i : ι) :
    (map (fun _ => b) (𝓟 {a})).coprod (map id (𝓟 {i})) =
      𝓟 ((({b} : Set β) ×ˢ univ) ∪ (univ ×ˢ ({i} : Set ι)))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [map_principal, Filter.coprod, comap_principal, sup_principal, image_singleton,

    map (Prod.map (fun _ : α => b) id) ((𝓟 {a}).coprod (𝓟 {i})) =
      𝓟 (({b} : Set β) ×ˢ (univ : Set ι))
proof:
:= by
  rw [principal_coprod_principal, map_principal]
  congr
  ext ⟨b', i'⟩
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨a'', i''⟩, _, h₂, h₃⟩
    simp
  · rintro ⟨h₁, _⟩
    use (a, i')
    simpa using h₁.symm

name: rcomap_rcomap
statement:
theorem rcomap_rcomap (r : SetRel α β) (s : SetRel β γ) (l : Filter γ) :
    rcomap r (rcomap s l) = rcomap (r.comp s) l
proof:
:=
  filter_eq <| by
    ext t
    simp only [rcomap_sets, SetRel.image, Filter.mem_sets, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, SetRel.core_comp]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨u, ⟨v, vsets, hv⟩, h⟩
      exact ⟨v, vsets, Set.Subset.trans (SetRel.core_mono hv) h⟩
    rintro ⟨t, tsets, ht⟩
    exact ⟨SetRel.core s t, ⟨t, tsets, Set.Subset.rfl⟩, ht⟩

    RTendsto r l₁ l₂ ↔ l₁ ≤ l₂.rcomap r
proof:
:= by
  rw [rtendsto_def]
  simp_rw [← l₂.mem_sets]
  constructor
  · simpa [Filter.le_def, rcomap, SetRel.mem_image]
      using fun h s t tl₂ => mem_of_superset (h t tl₂)
  · simpa [Filter.le_def, rcomap, SetRel.mem_image]
      using fun h t tl₂ => h _ t tl₂ Set.Subset.rfl

proof:
:=
  Filter.ext fun t => by
    simp only [mem_rcomap', SetRel.preimage_comp]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨u, ⟨v, vsets, hv⟩, h⟩
      exact ⟨v, vsets, (SetRel.preimage_mono hv).trans h⟩
    rintro ⟨t, tsets, ht⟩
    exact ⟨s.preimage t, ⟨t, tsets, Set.Subset.rfl⟩, ht⟩

statement:
@[to_additive]
protected theorem mul_eq_one_iff : f * g = 1 ↔ ∃ a b, f = pure a ∧ g = pure b ∧ a * b = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hfg => ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨t₁, h₁, t₂, h₂, h⟩ : (1 : Set α) ∈ f * g := hfg.symm ▸ one_mem_one
    have hfg : (f * g).NeBot := hfg.symm.subst one_neBot
    rw [(hfg.nonempty_of_mem <| mul_mem_mul h₁ h₂).subset_one_iff, Set.mul_eq_one_iff] at h
    obtain ⟨a, b, rfl, rfl, h⟩ := h
    refine ⟨a, b, ?_, ?_, h⟩
    · rwa [← hfg.of_mul_left.le_pure_iff, le_pure_iff]
    · rwa [← hfg.of_mul_right.le_pure_iff, le_pure_iff]
  · rintro ⟨a, b, rfl, rfl, h⟩
    rw [pure_mul_pure, h, pure_one]

    exact u.inv_mul

theorem map_map : Filter.map m' (Filter.map m f) = Filter.map (m' ∘ m) f

name: map_congr
statement: theorem map_congr {m₁ m₂ : α → β} {f : Filter α} (h : m₁ =ᶠ[f] m₂) : map m₁ f = map m₂ f
proof:
:=
  Filter.ext' fun _ => eventually_congr (h.mono fun _ hx => hx ▸ Iff.rfl)

name: mem_comap'
statement: theorem mem_comap' : s ∈ comap f l ↔ { y | ∀ ⦃x⦄, f x = y → x ∈ s } ∈ l
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨t, ht, hts⟩ => mem_of_superset ht fun y hy x hx => hts <| mem_preimage.2 <| by rwa [hx],
    fun h => ⟨_, h, fun _ hx => hx rfl⟩⟩

name: mem_comap''
statement: theorem mem_comap'' : s ∈ comap f l ↔ kernImage f s ∈ l

name: mem_comap_prodMk
statement:
lemma mem_comap_prodMk {x : α} {s : Set β} {F : Filter (α × β)} :
    s ∈ comap (Prod.mk x) F ↔ {p : α × β | p.fst = x → p.snd ∈ s} ∈ F
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [mem_comap', Prod.ext_iff, and_imp, @forall_comm β (_ = _), forall_eq, eq_comm]

name: eventually_comap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eventually_comap : (∀ᶠ a in comap f l, p a) ↔ ∀ᶠ b in l, ∀ a, f a = b → p a

name: frequently_comap

@[simp]
theorem frequently_comap : (∃ᶠ a in comap f l, p a) ↔ ∃ᶠ b in l, ∃ a, f a = b ∧ p a

name: mem_comap_iff_compl
statement: theorem mem_comap_iff_compl : s ∈ comap f l ↔ (f '' sᶜ)ᶜ ∈ l

name: pure_sets

name: eventually_pure

theorem eventually_pure {a : α} {p : α → Prop} : (∀ᶠ x in pure a, p x) ↔ p a

name: frequently_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem frequently_pure {a : α} {p : α → Prop} : (∃ᶠ x in pure a, p x) ↔ p a

name: principal_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem principal_singleton (a : α) : 𝓟 {a} = pure a
proof:
:=
  Filter.ext fun s => by simp only [mem_pure, mem_principal, singleton_subset_iff]

name: biSup_pure_eq_principal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem biSup_pure_eq_principal (s : Set α) : ⨆ a ∈ s, pure a = 𝓟 s

name: iSup_pure_eq_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iSup_pure_eq_top : ⨆ a, pure a = (⊤ : Filter α)

name: map_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_pure (f : α → β) (a : α) : map f (pure a) = pure (f a)

name: pure_le_principal
statement: theorem pure_le_principal {s : Set α} (a : α) : pure a ≤ 𝓟 s ↔ a ∈ s

name: join_pure
statement: @[simp] theorem join_pure (f : Filter α) : join (pure f) = f

name: pure_bind

theorem pure_bind (a : α) (m : α → Filter β) : bind (pure a) m = m a

name: map_bind

theorem map_bind {α β} (m : β → γ) (f : Filter α) (g : α → Filter β) :

name: bind_map

name: lawfulMonad
statement:
protected theorem lawfulMonad : LawfulMonad Filter where
  map_const
proof:
:= rfl
  id_map _ := rfl
  seqLeft_eq _ _ := rfl
  seqRight_eq _ _ := rfl
  pure_seq _ _ := rfl
  bind_pure_comp _ _ := rfl
  bind_map _ _ := rfl
  pure_bind _ _ := rfl
  bind_assoc _ _ _ := rfl

name: map_def
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_def {α β} (m : α → β) (f : Filter α) : m <$> f = map m f

name: bind_def
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bind_def {α β} (f : Filter α) (m : α → Filter β) : f >>= m = bind f m

theorem Eventually.comap {p : β → Prop} (hf : ∀ᶠ b in g, p b) (f : α → β) :

name: EventuallyEq.comp_comap
statement:
@[simp]
lemma EventuallyEq.comp_comap {F : Filter β} {f g : β → γ} (h : α → β)
    (hfg : f =ᶠ[F] g) : f.comp h =ᶠ[comap h F] g.comp h

name: comap_id
statement: theorem comap_id : comap id f = f
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (fun _ => preimage_mem_comap) fun _ ⟨_, ht, hst⟩ => mem_of_superset ht hst

name: comap_id'
statement: theorem comap_id' : comap (fun x => x) f = f

name: comap_const_of_notMem
statement: theorem comap_const_of_notMem {x : β} (ht : t ∈ g) (hx : x ∉ t) : comap (fun _ : α => x) g = ⊥
proof:
:=
  empty_mem_iff_bot.1 <| mem_comap'.2 <| mem_of_superset ht fun _ hx' _ h => hx <| h.symm ▸ hx'

name: comap_const_of_mem
statement: theorem comap_const_of_mem {x : β} (h : ∀ t ∈ g, x ∈ t) : comap (fun _ : α => x) g = ⊤
proof:
:=
  top_unique fun _ hs => univ_mem' fun _ => h _ (mem_comap'.1 hs) rfl

name: map_const
statement: theorem map_const [NeBot f] {c : β} : (f.map fun _ => c) = pure c
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  by_cases h : c ∈ s <;> simp [h]

name: comap_comap
statement: theorem comap_comap {m : γ → β} {n : β → α} : comap m (comap n f) = comap (n ∘ m) f
proof:
:=
  Filter.coext fun s => by simp only [compl_mem_comap, image_image, (· ∘ ·)]

name: map_comm
statement:
theorem map_comm (H : ψ ∘ φ = ρ ∘ θ) (F : Filter α) :
    map ψ (map φ F) = map ρ (map θ F)

name: comap_comm
statement:
theorem comap_comm (H : ψ ∘ φ = ρ ∘ θ) (G : Filter δ) :
    comap φ (comap ψ G) = comap θ (comap ρ G)

name: _root_.Function.Semiconj.filter_map
statement:
theorem _root_.Function.Semiconj.filter_map {f : α → β} {ga : α → α} {gb : β → β}
    (h : Function.Semiconj f ga gb) : Function.Semiconj (map f) (map ga) (map gb)

name: _root_.Function.Commute.filter_map
statement:
theorem _root_.Function.Commute.filter_map {f g : α → α} (h : Function.Commute f g) :
    Function.Commute (map f) (map g)

name: _root_.Function.Semiconj.filter_comap
statement:
theorem _root_.Function.Semiconj.filter_comap {f : α → β} {ga : α → α} {gb : β → β}
    (h : Function.Semiconj f ga gb) : Function.Semiconj (comap f) (comap gb) (comap ga)

name: _root_.Function.Commute.filter_comap
statement:
theorem _root_.Function.Commute.filter_comap {f g : α → α} (h : Function.Commute f g) :
    Function.Commute (comap f) (comap g)

name: _root_.Function.LeftInverse.filter_map
statement:
theorem _root_.Function.LeftInverse.filter_map {f : α → β} {g : β → α} (hfg : LeftInverse g f) :
    LeftInverse (map g) (map f)
proof:
:= fun F ↦ by
  rw [map_map, hfg.comp_eq_id, map_id]

name: _root_.Function.LeftInverse.filter_comap
statement:
theorem _root_.Function.LeftInverse.filter_comap {f : α → β} {g : β → α} (hfg : LeftInverse g f) :
    RightInverse (comap g) (comap f)
proof:
:= fun F ↦ by
  rw [comap_comap, hfg.comp_eq_id, comap_id]

name: _root_.Set.LeftInvOn.filter_map_Iic
statement:
theorem _root_.Set.LeftInvOn.filter_map_Iic {f : α → β} {g : β → α} (hfg : LeftInvOn g f s) :
    LeftInvOn (map g) (map f) (Iic <| 𝓟 s)
proof:
:= fun F (hF : F ≤ 𝓟 s) ↦ by
  have : (g ∘ f) =ᶠ[𝓟 s] id := by simpa only [eventuallyEq_principal] using! hfg
  rw [map_map, map_congr (this.filter_mono hF), map_id]

name: mem_kernMap
statement: theorem mem_kernMap {s : Set β} : s ∈ kernMap m f ↔ ∃ t ∈ f, kernImage m t = s

name: mem_kernMap_iff_compl
statement: theorem mem_kernMap_iff_compl {s : Set β} : s ∈ kernMap m f ↔ ∃ t, tᶜ ∈ f ∧ m '' t = sᶜ
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_kernMap, compl_surjective.exists]
  refine exists_congr (fun x ↦ and_congr_right fun _ ↦ ?_)
  rw [kernImage_compl, compl_eq_comm, eq_comm]

name: compl_mem_kernMap
statement: theorem compl_mem_kernMap {s : Set β} : sᶜ ∈ kernMap m f ↔ ∃ t, tᶜ ∈ f ∧ m '' t = s

name: comap_le_iff_le_kernMap
statement: theorem comap_le_iff_le_kernMap : comap m g ≤ f ↔ g ≤ kernMap m f

name: gc_comap_kernMap
statement: theorem gc_comap_kernMap (m : α → β) : GaloisConnection (comap m) (kernMap m)

name: kernMap_principal
statement: theorem kernMap_principal {s : Set α} : kernMap m (𝓟 s) = 𝓟 (kernImage m s)
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_of_forall_le_iff (fun g ↦ ?_)
  rw [← comap_le_iff_le_kernMap, le_principal_iff, le_principal_iff, mem_comap'']

name: comap_principal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comap_principal {t : Set β} : comap m (𝓟 t) = 𝓟 (m ⁻¹' t)
proof:
:=
  Filter.ext fun _ => ⟨fun ⟨_u, hu, b⟩ => (preimage_mono hu).trans b,
    fun h => ⟨t, Subset.rfl, h⟩⟩

name: principal_subtype
statement:
theorem principal_subtype {α : Type*} (s : Set α) (t : Set s) :
    𝓟 t = comap (↑) (𝓟 (((↑) : s → α) '' t))

name: comap_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comap_pure {b : β} : comap m (pure b) = 𝓟 (m ⁻¹' {b})

name: map_le_iff_le_comap
statement: theorem map_le_iff_le_comap : map m f ≤ g ↔ f ≤ comap m g
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _ ⟨_, ht, hts⟩ => mem_of_superset (h ht) hts, fun h _ ht => h ⟨_, ht, Subset.rfl⟩⟩

name: gc_map_comap
statement: theorem gc_map_comap (m : α → β) : GaloisConnection (map m) (comap m)

theorem map_mono : Monotone (map m)

name: comap_mono
statement:
@[gcongr, mono]
theorem comap_mono : Monotone (comap m)

name: map_bot
statement: @[simp] theorem map_bot : map m ⊥ = ⊥

name: map_sup
statement: @[simp] theorem map_sup : map m (f₁ ⊔ f₂) = map m f₁ ⊔ map m f₂

name: map_iSup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_iSup {f : ι → Filter α} : map m (⨆ i, f i) = ⨆ i, map m (f i)

name: map_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_top (f : α → β) : map f ⊤ = 𝓟 (range f)

name: comap_top
statement: @[simp] theorem comap_top : comap m ⊤ = ⊤

statement: @[simp] theorem comap_inf : comap m (g₁ ⊓ g₂) = comap m g₁ ⊓ comap m g₂

@[simp]
theorem comap_iInf {f : ι → Filter β} : comap m (⨅ i, f i) = ⨅ i, comap m (f i)

statement: theorem le_comap_top (f : α → β) (l : Filter α) : l ≤ comap f ⊤

statement: theorem map_comap_le : map m (comap m g) ≤ g

statement: theorem le_comap_map : f ≤ comap m (map m f)

name: comap_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comap_bot : comap m ⊥ = ⊥
proof:
:=
  bot_unique fun s _ => ⟨∅, mem_bot, by simp only [empty_subset, preimage_empty]⟩

name: neBot_of_comap
statement: theorem neBot_of_comap (h : (comap m g).NeBot) : g.NeBot
proof:
:= by
  rw [neBot_iff] at *
  contrapose h
  rw [h]
  exact comap_bot

name: comap_inf_principal_range
statement: theorem comap_inf_principal_range : comap m (g ⊓ 𝓟 (range m)) = comap m g

name: disjoint_comap
statement: theorem disjoint_comap (h : Disjoint g₁ g₂) : Disjoint (comap m g₁) (comap m g₂)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [disjoint_iff, ← comap_inf, h.eq_bot, comap_bot]

name: comap_iSup
statement: theorem comap_iSup {ι} {f : ι → Filter β} {m : α → β} : comap m (iSup f) = ⨆ i, comap m (f i)

name: comap_sSup
statement: theorem comap_sSup {s : Set (Filter β)} {m : α → β} : comap m (sSup s) = ⨆ f ∈ s, comap m f

name: comap_sup
statement: theorem comap_sup : comap m (g₁ ⊔ g₂) = comap m g₁ ⊔ comap m g₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [sup_eq_iSup, comap_iSup, iSup_bool_eq, Bool.cond_true, Bool.cond_false]

name: map_comap
statement: theorem map_comap (f : Filter β) (m : α → β) : (f.comap m).map m = f ⊓ 𝓟 (range m)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (le_inf map_comap_le <| le_principal_iff.2 range_mem_map) ?_
  rintro t' ⟨t, ht, sub⟩
  refine mem_inf_principal.2 (mem_of_superset ht ?_)
  rintro _ hxt ⟨x, rfl⟩
  exact sub hxt

name: map_comap_setCoe_val
statement:
theorem map_comap_setCoe_val (f : Filter β) (s : Set β) :
    (f.comap ((↑) : s → β)).map (↑) = f ⊓ 𝓟 s

name: map_comap_of_mem
statement: theorem map_comap_of_mem {f : Filter β} {m : α → β} (hf : range m ∈ f) : (f.comap m).map m = f

name: comap_le_comap_iff
statement:
theorem comap_le_comap_iff {f g : Filter β} {m : α → β} (hf : range m ∈ f) :
    comap m f ≤ comap m g ↔ f ≤ g
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => map_comap_of_mem hf ▸ (map_mono h).trans map_comap_le, fun h => comap_mono h⟩

name: map_comap_of_surjective
statement:
theorem map_comap_of_surjective {f : α → β} (hf : Surjective f) (l : Filter β) :
    map f (comap f l) = l

name: comap_injective
statement: theorem comap_injective {f : α → β} (hf : Surjective f) : Injective (comap f)

name: _root_.Function.Surjective.filter_map_top
statement: theorem _root_.Function.Surjective.filter_map_top {f : α → β} (hf : Surjective f) : map f ⊤ = ⊤

name: subtype_coe_map_comap
statement:
theorem subtype_coe_map_comap (s : Set α) (f : Filter α) :
    map ((↑) : s → α) (comap ((↑) : s → α) f) = f ⊓ 𝓟 s

name: image_mem_of_mem_comap
statement:
theorem image_mem_of_mem_comap {f : Filter α} {c : β → α} (h : range c ∈ f) {W : Set β}
    (W_in : W ∈ comap c f) : c '' W ∈ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_comap_of_mem h]
  exact image_mem_map W_in

name: image_coe_mem_of_mem_comap
statement:
theorem image_coe_mem_of_mem_comap {f : Filter α} {U : Set α} (h : U ∈ f) {W : Set U}
    (W_in : W ∈ comap ((↑) : U → α) f) : (↑) '' W ∈ f

name: comap_map
statement: theorem comap_map {f : Filter α} {m : α → β} (h : Injective m) : comap m (map m f) = f
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm
    (fun s hs =>
      mem_of_superset (preimage_mem_comap <| image_mem_map hs) <| by
        simp only [preimage_image_eq s h, Subset.rfl])
    le_comap_map

name: mem_comap_iff
statement:
theorem mem_comap_iff {f : Filter β} {m : α → β} (inj : Injective m) (large : Set.range m ∈ f)
    {S : Set α} : S ∈ comap m f ↔ m '' S ∈ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← image_mem_map_iff inj, map_comap_of_mem large]

name: map_le_map_iff_of_injOn
statement:
theorem map_le_map_iff_of_injOn {l₁ l₂ : Filter α} {f : α → β} {s : Set α} (h₁ : s ∈ l₁)
    (h₂ : s ∈ l₂) (hinj : InjOn f s) : map f l₁ ≤ map f l₂ ↔ l₁ ≤ l₂
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _t ht =>
    mp_mem h₁ <|
      mem_of_superset (h <| image_mem_map (inter_mem h₂ ht)) fun _y ⟨_x, ⟨hxs, hxt⟩, hxy⟩ hys =>
        hinj hxs hys hxy ▸ hxt,
    fun h => map_mono h⟩

name: map_le_map_iff
statement:
theorem map_le_map_iff {f g : Filter α} {m : α → β} (hm : Injective m) :
    map m f ≤ map m g ↔ f ≤ g

name: map_eq_map_iff_of_injOn
statement:
theorem map_eq_map_iff_of_injOn {f g : Filter α} {m : α → β} {s : Set α} (hsf : s ∈ f) (hsg : s ∈ g)
    (hm : InjOn m s) : map m f = map m g ↔ f = g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [le_antisymm_iff, map_le_map_iff_of_injOn hsf hsg hm,
    map_le_map_iff_of_injOn hsg hsf hm]

name: map_inj
statement: theorem map_inj {f g : Filter α} {m : α → β} (hm : Injective m) : map m f = map m g ↔ f = g

name: map_injective
statement: theorem map_injective {m : α → β} (hm : Injective m) : Injective (map m)

name: comap_neBot_iff
statement: theorem comap_neBot_iff {f : Filter β} {m : α → β} : NeBot (comap m f) ↔ ∀ t ∈ f, ∃ a, m a ∈ t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← forall_mem_nonempty_iff_neBot, mem_comap, forall_exists_index, and_imp]
  exact ⟨fun h t t_in => h (m ⁻¹' t) t t_in Subset.rfl, fun h s t ht hst => (h t ht).imp hst⟩

name: comap_neBot
statement: theorem comap_neBot {f : Filter β} {m : α → β} (hm : ∀ t ∈ f, ∃ a, m a ∈ t) : NeBot (comap m f)

name: comap_neBot_iff_frequently
statement:
theorem comap_neBot_iff_frequently {f : Filter β} {m : α → β} :
    NeBot (comap m f) ↔ ∃ᶠ y in f, y ∈ range m
proof:
:= by
  simp only [comap_neBot_iff, frequently_iff, mem_range, @and_comm (_ ∈ _), exists_exists_eq_and]

name: comap_neBot_iff_compl_range
statement:
theorem comap_neBot_iff_compl_range {f : Filter β} {m : α → β} :
    NeBot (comap m f) ↔ (range m)ᶜ ∉ f

name: comap_eq_bot_iff_compl_range
statement: theorem comap_eq_bot_iff_compl_range {f : Filter β} {m : α → β} : comap m f = ⊥ ↔ (range m)ᶜ ∈ f

name: comap_surjective_eq_bot
statement:
theorem comap_surjective_eq_bot {f : Filter β} {m : α → β} (hm : Surjective m) :

name: disjoint_comap_iff
statement:
theorem disjoint_comap_iff (h : Surjective m) :
    Disjoint (comap m g₁) (comap m g₂) ↔ Disjoint g₁ g₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [disjoint_iff, disjoint_iff, ← comap_inf, comap_surjective_eq_bot h]

name: NeBot.comap_of_range_mem
statement:
theorem NeBot.comap_of_range_mem {f : Filter β} {m : α → β} (_ : NeBot f) (hm : range m ∈ f) :
    NeBot (comap m f)

name: comap_inl_map_inr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comap_inl_map_inr : comap inl (map (@inr α β) g) = ⊥

name: comap_inr_map_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comap_inr_map_inl : comap inr (map (@inl α β) f) = ⊥

name: map_inl_inf_map_inr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_inl_inf_map_inr : map inl f ⊓ map inr g = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_bot_iff.mp
  trans map inl ⊤ ⊓ map inr ⊤
  · apply inf_le_inf <;> simp
  · simp

name: map_inr_inf_map_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_inr_inf_map_inl : map inr f ⊓ map inl g = ⊥

name: comap_sumElim_eq
statement:
theorem comap_sumElim_eq (l : Filter γ) (m₁ : α → γ) (m₂ : β → γ) :
    comap (Sum.elim m₁ m₂) l = map inl (comap m₁ l) ⊔ map inr (comap m₂ l)
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  simp_rw [mem_sup, mem_map, mem_comap_iff_compl]
  simp [image_sumElim]

name: map_comap_inl_sup_map_comap_inr
statement:
theorem map_comap_inl_sup_map_comap_inr (l : Filter (α ⊕ β)) :
    map inl (comap inl l) ⊔ map inr (comap inr l) = l

name: map_sumElim_eq
statement:
theorem map_sumElim_eq (l : Filter (α ⊕ β)) (m₁ : α → γ) (m₂ : β → γ) :
    map (Sum.elim m₁ m₂) l = map m₁ (comap inl l) ⊔ map m₂ (comap inr l)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_comap_inl_sup_map_comap_inr l]
  simp [map_sup, map_map, comap_sup, (gc_map_comap _).u_l_u_eq_u]

name: comap_fst_neBot_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comap_fst_neBot_iff {f : Filter α} :
    (f.comap (Prod.fst : α × β → α)).NeBot ↔ f.NeBot ∧ Nonempty β
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty β
  · rw [filter_eq_bot_of_isEmpty (f.comap _), ← not_iff_not]; simp [*]
  · simp [comap_neBot_iff_frequently, *]

name: comap_fst_neBot
statement:
@[instance]
theorem comap_fst_neBot [Nonempty β] {f : Filter α} [NeBot f] :
    (f.comap (Prod.fst : α × β → α)).NeBot

name: comap_snd_neBot_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comap_snd_neBot_iff {f : Filter β} :
    (f.comap (Prod.snd : α × β → β)).NeBot ↔ Nonempty α ∧ f.NeBot
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty α with hα | hα
  · rw [filter_eq_bot_of_isEmpty (f.comap _), ← not_iff_not]; simp
  · simp [comap_neBot_iff_frequently, hα]

name: comap_snd_neBot
statement:
@[instance]
theorem comap_snd_neBot [Nonempty α] {f : Filter β} [NeBot f] :
    (f.comap (Prod.snd : α × β → β)).NeBot

name: comap_eval_neBot_iff'
statement:
theorem comap_eval_neBot_iff' {ι : Type*} {α : ι → Type*} {i : ι} {f : Filter (α i)} :
    (comap (eval i) f).NeBot ↔ (∀ j, Nonempty (α j)) ∧ NeBot f
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty (∀ j, α j) with H | H
  · rw [filter_eq_bot_of_isEmpty (f.comap _), ← not_iff_not]
    simp [← Classical.nonempty_pi]
  · have : ∀ j, Nonempty (α j) := Classical.nonempty_pi.1 H
    simp [comap_neBot_iff_frequently, *]

name: comap_eval_neBot_iff
comap_eval_neBot
statement:
@[instance]
theorem comap_eval_neBot {ι : Type*} {α : ι → Type*} [∀ j, Nonempty (α j)] (i : ι)
    (f : Filter (α i)) [NeBot f] : (comap (eval i) f).NeBot

theorem comap_coe_neBot_of_le_principal {s : Set γ} {l : Filter γ} [h : NeBot l] (h' : l ≤ 𝓟 s) :

theorem NeBot.comap_of_surj {f : Filter β} {m : α → β} (hf : NeBot f) (hm : Surjective m) :

theorem NeBot.comap_of_image_mem {f : Filter β} {m : α → β} (hf : NeBot f) {s : Set α}
