name: map_eq_bot_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_eq_bot_iff : map m f = ⊥ ↔ f = ⊥
proof:
:=
  ⟨by
    rw [← empty_mem_iff_bot, ← empty_mem_iff_bot]
    exact id, fun h => by simp only [h, map_bot]⟩

name: bot_eq_map_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bot_eq_map_iff : ⊥ = map m f ↔ f = ⊥

name: map_neBot_iff
statement: theorem map_neBot_iff (f : α → β) {F : Filter α} : NeBot (map f F) ↔ NeBot F

name: NeBot.map
statement: theorem NeBot.map (hf : NeBot f) (m : α → β) : NeBot (map m f)

name: NeBot.of_map
statement: theorem NeBot.of_map : NeBot (f.map m) → NeBot f

name: sInter_comap_sets
statement: theorem sInter_comap_sets (f : α → β) (F : Filter β) : ⋂₀ (comap f F).sets = ⋂ U ∈ F, f ⁻¹' U
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  suffices (∀ (A : Set α) (B : Set β), B ∈ F → f ⁻¹' B ⊆ A → x ∈ A) ↔
      ∀ B : Set β, B ∈ F → f x ∈ B by
    simp only [mem_sInter, mem_iInter, Filter.mem_sets, mem_comap, this, and_imp,
      mem_preimage, exists_imp]
  constructor
  · intro h U U_in
    simpa only [Subset.rfl, forall_prop_of_true, mem_preimage] using h (f ⁻¹' U) U U_in
  · intro h V U U_in f_U_V
    exact f_U_V (h U U_in)

name: map_iInf_le
statement: theorem map_iInf_le {f : ι → Filter α} {m : α → β} : map m (iInf f) ≤ ⨅ i, map m (f i)

name: map_iInf_eq
statement:
theorem map_iInf_eq {f : ι → Filter α} {m : α → β} (hf : Directed (· ≥ ·) f) [Nonempty ι] :
    map m (iInf f) = ⨅ i, map m (f i)
proof:
:=
  map_iInf_le.antisymm fun s (hs : m ⁻¹' s ∈ iInf f) =>
    let ⟨i, hi⟩ := (mem_iInf_of_directed hf _).1 hs
    have : ⨅ i, map m (f i) ≤ 𝓟 s :=
      iInf_le_of_le i <| by simpa only [le_principal_iff, mem_map]
    Filter.le_principal_iff.1 this

name: map_biInf_eq
proof:
:= by
  have := nonempty_subtype.2 ne
  simp only [iInf_subtype']
  exact map_iInf_eq h.directed_val

name: map_inf_le
statement: theorem map_inf_le {f g : Filter α} {m : α → β} : map m (f ⊓ g) ≤ map m f ⊓ map m g

name: map_inf
statement:
theorem map_inf {f g : Filter α} {m : α → β} (h : Injective m) :
    map m (f ⊓ g) = map m f ⊓ map m g
proof:
:= by
  refine map_inf_le.antisymm ?_
  rintro t ⟨s₁, hs₁, s₂, hs₂, ht : m ⁻¹' t = s₁ ∩ s₂⟩
  refine mem_inf_of_inter (image_mem_map hs₁) (image_mem_map hs₂) ?_
  rw [← image_inter h, image_subset_iff, ht]

name: map_inf'
statement:
theorem map_inf' {f g : Filter α} {m : α → β} {t : Set α} (htf : t ∈ f) (htg : t ∈ g)
    (h : InjOn m t) : map m (f ⊓ g) = map m f ⊓ map m g
proof:
:= by
  lift f to Filter t using htf; lift g to Filter t using htg
  replace h : Injective (m ∘ ((↑) : t → α)) := h.injective
  simp only [map_map, ← map_inf Subtype.coe_injective, map_inf h]

name: disjoint_of_map
statement:
lemma disjoint_of_map {α β : Type*} {F G : Filter α} {f : α → β}
    (h : Disjoint (map f F) (map f G)) : Disjoint F G
proof:
:=
  disjoint_iff.mpr <| map_eq_bot_iff.mp <| le_bot_iff.mp <| trans map_inf_le (disjoint_iff.mp h)

name: disjoint_map
statement:
theorem disjoint_map {m : α → β} (hm : Injective m) {f₁ f₂ : Filter α} :
    Disjoint (map m f₁) (map m f₂) ↔ Disjoint f₁ f₂
proof:
:= by
  simp only [disjoint_iff, ← map_inf hm, map_eq_bot_iff]

name: map_equiv_symm
statement: theorem map_equiv_symm (e : α ≃ β) (f : Filter β) : map e.symm f = comap e f
proof:
:=
  map_injective e.injective <| by
    rw [map_map, e.self_comp_symm, map_id, map_comap_of_surjective e.surjective]

name: map_eq_comap_of_inverse
statement:
theorem map_eq_comap_of_inverse {f : Filter α} {m : α → β} {n : β → α} (h₁ : m ∘ n = id)
    (h₂ : n ∘ m = id) : map m f = comap n f
proof:
:=
  map_equiv_symm ⟨n, m, congr_fun h₁, congr_fun h₂⟩ f

name: comap_equiv_symm
statement: theorem comap_equiv_symm (e : α ≃ β) (f : Filter α) : comap e.symm f = map e f

name: map_swap_eq_comap_swap
statement: theorem map_swap_eq_comap_swap {f : Filter (α × β)} : map Prod.swap f = comap Prod.swap f

name: map_swap4_eq_comap
statement:
theorem map_swap4_eq_comap {f : Filter ((α × β) × γ × δ)} :
    map (fun p : (α × β) × γ × δ => ((p.1.1, p.2.1), (p.1.2, p.2.2))) f =
      comap (fun p : (α × γ) × β × δ => ((p.1.1, p.2.1), (p.1.2, p.2.2))) f

name: le_map
statement: theorem le_map {f : Filter α} {m : α → β} {g : Filter β} (h : ∀ s ∈ f, m '' s ∈ g) : g ≤ f.map m

name: le_map_iff
statement: theorem le_map_iff {f : Filter α} {m : α → β} {g : Filter β} : g ≤ f.map m ↔ ∀ s ∈ f, m '' s ∈ g

name: push_pull
statement:
protected theorem push_pull (f : α → β) (F : Filter α) (G : Filter β) :
    map f (F ⊓ comap f G) = map f F ⊓ G
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · calc
      map f (F ⊓ comap f G) ≤ map f F ⊓ (map f <| comap f G) := map_inf_le
      _ ≤ map f F ⊓ G := inf_le_inf_left (map f F) map_comap_le
  · rintro U ⟨V, V_in, W, ⟨Z, Z_in, hZ⟩, h⟩
    apply mem_inf_of_inter (image_mem_map V_in) Z_in
    calc
      f '' V ∩ Z = f '' (V ∩ f ⁻¹' Z) := by rw [image_inter_preimage]
      _ ⊆ f '' (V ∩ W) := by gcongr
      _ = f '' f ⁻¹' U := by rw [h]
      _ ⊆ U := image_preimage_subset f U

name: push_pull'
statement:
protected theorem push_pull' (f : α → β) (F : Filter α) (G : Filter β) :
    map f (comap f G ⊓ F) = G ⊓ map f F

name: disjoint_comap_iff_map
statement:
theorem disjoint_comap_iff_map {f : α → β} {F : Filter α} {G : Filter β} :
    Disjoint F (comap f G) ↔ Disjoint (map f F) G

statement:
theorem disjoint_comap_iff_map' {f : α → β} {F : Filter α} {G : Filter β} :
    Disjoint (comap f G) F ↔ Disjoint G (map f F)

statement:
theorem neBot_inf_comap_iff_map {f : α → β} {F : Filter α} {G : Filter β} :
    NeBot (F ⊓ comap f G) ↔ NeBot (map f F ⊓ G)

name: neBot_inf_comap_iff_map'
statement:
theorem neBot_inf_comap_iff_map' {f : α → β} {F : Filter α} {G : Filter β} :
    NeBot (comap f G ⊓ F) ↔ NeBot (G ⊓ map f F)

name: comap_inf_principal_neBot_of_image_mem
statement:
theorem comap_inf_principal_neBot_of_image_mem {f : Filter β} {m : α → β} (hf : NeBot f) {s : Set α}
    (hs : m '' s ∈ f) : NeBot (comap m f ⊓ 𝓟 s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [neBot_inf_comap_iff_map', map_principal, ← frequently_mem_iff_neBot]
  exact Eventually.frequently hs

name: principal_eq_map_coe_top
statement: theorem principal_eq_map_coe_top (s : Set α) : 𝓟 s = map ((↑) : s → α) ⊤

statement:
theorem inf_principal_eq_bot_iff_comap {F : Filter α} {s : Set α} :
    F ⊓ 𝓟 s = ⊥ ↔ comap ((↑) : s → α) F = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [principal_eq_map_coe_top s, ← Filter.push_pull', inf_top_eq, map_eq_bot_iff]

name: map_generate_le_generate_preimage_preimage
statement:
lemma map_generate_le_generate_preimage_preimage (U : Set (Set β)) (f : β → α) :
    map f (generate U) ≤ generate ((f ⁻¹' ·) ⁻¹' U)
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_generate_iff]
  exact fun u hu ↦ mem_generate_of_mem hu

name: generate_image_preimage_le_comap
statement:
lemma generate_image_preimage_le_comap (U : Set (Set α)) (f : β → α) :

proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_le_iff_le_comap, le_generate_iff]

name: singleton_mem_pure
statement: theorem singleton_mem_pure {a : α} : {a} ∈ (pure a : Filter α)

name: pure_injective
statement: theorem pure_injective : Injective (pure : α → Filter α)
proof:
:= fun a _ hab =>
  (Filter.ext_iff.1 hab { x | a = x }).1 rfl

name: le_pure_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem le_pure_iff {f : Filter α} {a : α} : f ≤ pure a ↔ {a} ∈ f

name: mem_seq_def
statement:
theorem mem_seq_def {f : Filter (α → β)} {g : Filter α} {s : Set β} :
    s ∈ f.seq g ↔ ∃ u ∈ f, ∃ t ∈ g, ∀ x ∈ u, ∀ y ∈ t, (x : α → β) y ∈ s

name: mem_seq_iff
statement:
theorem mem_seq_iff {f : Filter (α → β)} {g : Filter α} {s : Set β} :
    s ∈ f.seq g ↔ ∃ u ∈ f, ∃ t ∈ g, Set.seq u t ⊆ s

name: mem_map_seq_iff
statement:
theorem mem_map_seq_iff {f : Filter α} {g : Filter β} {m : α → β → γ} {s : Set γ} :
    s ∈ (f.map m).seq g ↔ ∃ t u, t ∈ g ∧ u ∈ f ∧ ∀ x ∈ u, ∀ y ∈ t, m x y ∈ s
proof:
:=
  Iff.intro (fun ⟨t, ht, s, hs, hts⟩ => ⟨s, m ⁻¹' t, hs, ht, fun _ => hts _⟩)
    fun ⟨t, s, ht, hs, hts⟩ =>
    ⟨m '' s, image_mem_map hs, t, ht, fun _ ⟨_, has, Eq⟩ => Eq ▸ hts _ has⟩

name: seq_mem_seq
statement:
theorem seq_mem_seq {f : Filter (α → β)} {g : Filter α} {s : Set (α → β)} {t : Set α} (hs : s ∈ f)
    (ht : t ∈ g) : s.seq t ∈ f.seq g
proof:
:=
  ⟨s, hs, t, ht, fun f hf a ha => ⟨f, hf, a, ha, rfl⟩⟩

name: le_seq
statement:
theorem le_seq {f : Filter (α → β)} {g : Filter α} {h : Filter β}
    (hh : ∀ t ∈ f, ∀ u ∈ g, Set.seq t u ∈ h) : h ≤ seq f g
proof:
:= fun _ ⟨_, ht, _, hu, hs⟩ =>
  mem_of_superset (hh _ ht _ hu) fun _ ⟨_, hm, _, ha, eq⟩ => eq ▸ hs _ hm _ ha

name: seq_mono
statement:
@[gcongr, mono]
theorem seq_mono {f₁ f₂ : Filter (α → β)} {g₁ g₂ : Filter α} (hf : f₁ ≤ f₂) (hg : g₁ ≤ g₂) :
    f₁.seq g₁ ≤ f₂.seq g₂
proof:
:=
  le_seq fun _ hs _ ht => seq_mem_seq (hf hs) (hg ht)

name: pure_seq_eq_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pure_seq_eq_map (g : α → β) (f : Filter α) : seq (pure g) f = f.map g
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (le_map fun s hs => ?_) (le_seq fun s hs t ht => ?_)
  · rw [← singleton_seq]
    apply seq_mem_seq _ hs
    exact singleton_mem_pure
  · refine sets_of_superset (map g f) (image_mem_map ht) ?_
    rintro b ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨g, hs, a, ha, rfl⟩

name: seq_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem seq_pure (f : Filter (α → β)) (a : α) : seq f (pure a) = map (fun g : α → β => g a) f
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (le_map fun s hs => ?_) (le_seq fun s hs t ht => ?_)
  · rw [← seq_singleton]
    exact seq_mem_seq hs singleton_mem_pure
  · refine sets_of_superset (map (fun g : α → β => g a) f) (image_mem_map hs) ?_
    rintro b ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨g, hg, a, ht, rfl⟩

name: seq_assoc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem seq_assoc (x : Filter α) (g : Filter (α → β)) (h : Filter (β → γ)) :
    seq h (seq g x) = seq (seq (map (· ∘ ·) h) g) x
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (le_seq fun s hs t ht => ?_) (le_seq fun s hs t ht => ?_)
  · rcases mem_seq_iff.1 hs with ⟨u, hu, v, hv, hs⟩
    rcases mem_map_iff_exists_image.1 hu with ⟨w, hw, hu⟩
    grw [← hs, ← hu]
    rw [← Set.seq_seq]
    exact seq_mem_seq hw (seq_mem_seq hv ht)
  · rcases mem_seq_iff.1 ht with ⟨u, hu, v, hv, ht⟩
    grw [← ht]
    rw [Set.seq_seq]
    exact seq_mem_seq (seq_mem_seq (image_mem_map hs) hu) hv

name: prod_map_seq_comm
statement:
theorem prod_map_seq_comm (f : Filter α) (g : Filter β) :
    (map Prod.mk f).seq g = seq (map (fun b a => (a, b)) g) f
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (le_seq fun s hs t ht => ?_) (le_seq fun s hs t ht => ?_)
  · rcases mem_map_iff_exists_image.1 hs with ⟨u, hu, hs⟩
    grw [← hs]
    rw [← Set.prod_image_seq_comm]
    exact seq_mem_seq (image_mem_map ht) hu
  · rcases mem_map_iff_exists_image.1 hs with ⟨u, hu, hs⟩
    grw [← hs]
    rw [Set.prod_image_seq_comm]
    exact seq_mem_seq (image_mem_map ht) hu

name: seq_eq_filter_seq
statement:
theorem seq_eq_filter_seq {α β : Type u} (f : Filter (α → β)) (g : Filter α) :
    f <*> g = seq f g

name: eventually_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eventually_bind {f : Filter α} {m : α → Filter β} {p : β → Prop} :
    (∀ᶠ y in bind f m, p y) ↔ ∀ᶠ x in f, ∀ᶠ y in m x, p y

name: frequently_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem frequently_bind {f : Filter α} {m : α → Filter β} {p : β → Prop} :
    (∃ᶠ y in bind f m, p y) ↔ ∃ᶠ x in f, ∃ᶠ y in m x, p y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_iff_not]
  simp only [not_frequently, eventually_bind]

name: eventuallyEq_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eventuallyEq_bind {f : Filter α} {m : α → Filter β} {g₁ g₂ : β → γ} :
    g₁ =ᶠ[bind f m] g₂ ↔ ∀ᶠ x in f, g₁ =ᶠ[m x] g₂

name: eventuallyLE_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eventuallyLE_bind [LE γ] {f : Filter α} {m : α → Filter β} {g₁ g₂ : β → γ} :
    g₁ ≤ᶠ[bind f m] g₂ ↔ ∀ᶠ x in f, g₁ ≤ᶠ[m x] g₂

name: mem_bind'
statement:
theorem mem_bind' {s : Set β} {f : Filter α} {m : α → Filter β} :
    s ∈ bind f m ↔ { a | s ∈ m a } ∈ f

name: mem_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_bind {s : Set β} {f : Filter α} {m : α → Filter β} :
    s ∈ bind f m ↔ ∃ t ∈ f, ∀ x ∈ t, s ∈ m x
proof:
:=
  calc
    s ∈ bind f m ↔ { a | s ∈ m a } ∈ f := Iff.rfl
    _ ↔ ∃ t ∈ f, t ⊆ { a | s ∈ m a } := exists_mem_subset_iff.symm
    _ ↔ ∃ t ∈ f, ∀ x ∈ t, s ∈ m x := Iff.rfl

name: bind_le
statement:
theorem bind_le {f : Filter α} {g : α → Filter β} {l : Filter β} (h : ∀ᶠ x in f, g x ≤ l) :
    f.bind g ≤ l

name: bind_mono
statement:
@[gcongr, mono]
theorem bind_mono {f₁ f₂ : Filter α} {g₁ g₂ : α → Filter β} (hf : f₁ ≤ f₂) (hg : g₁ ≤ᶠ[f₁] g₂) :
    bind f₁ g₁ ≤ bind f₂ g₂
proof:
:= by
  refine le_trans (fun s hs => ?_) (join_mono <| map_mono hf)
  simp only [mem_join, mem_bind', mem_map] at hs ⊢
  filter_upwards [hg, hs] with _ hx hs using hx hs

name: bind_inf_principal
statement:
theorem bind_inf_principal {f : Filter α} {g : α → Filter β} {s : Set β} :
    (f.bind fun x => g x ⊓ 𝓟 s) = f.bind g ⊓ 𝓟 s
proof:
:=
  Filter.ext fun s => by simp only [mem_bind, mem_inf_principal]

name: sup_bind
statement: theorem sup_bind {f g : Filter α} {h : α → Filter β} : bind (f ⊔ g) h = bind f h ⊔ bind g h

name: principal_bind
statement: theorem principal_bind {s : Set α} {f : α → Filter β} : bind (𝓟 s) f = ⨆ x ∈ s, f x
proof:
:=
  show join (map f (𝓟 s)) = ⨆ x ∈ s, f x by
    simp only [sSup_image, join_principal_eq_sSup, map_principal]

name: Filter.map_surjOn_Iic_iff_le_map
statement:
theorem Filter.map_surjOn_Iic_iff_le_map {m : α → β} :
    SurjOn (map m) (Iic F) (Iic G) ↔ G ≤ map m F
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hm ↦ ?_, fun hm ↦ ?_⟩
  · rcases hm self_mem_Iic with ⟨H, (hHF : H ≤ F), rfl⟩
    exact map_mono hHF
  · have : RightInvOn (F ⊓ comap m ·) (map m) (Iic G) :=
      fun H (hHG : H ≤ G) ↦ by simpa [Filter.push_pull] using hHG.trans hm
    exact this.surjOn fun H _ ↦ mem_Iic.mpr inf_le_left

name: Filter.map_surjOn_Iic_iff_surjOn
statement:
theorem Filter.map_surjOn_Iic_iff_surjOn {s : Set α} {t : Set β} {m : α → β} :
    SurjOn (map m) (Iic <| 𝓟 s) (Iic <| 𝓟 t) ↔ SurjOn m s t

name: Filter.filter_injOn_Iic_iff_injOn
statement:
theorem Filter.filter_injOn_Iic_iff_injOn {s : Set α} {m : α → β} :
    InjOn (map m) (Iic <| 𝓟 s) ↔ InjOn m s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hm x hx y hy hxy ↦ ?_, fun hm F hF G hG ↦ ?_⟩
  · rwa [← pure_injective.eq_iff, ← map_pure, ← map_pure, hm.eq_iff, pure_injective.eq_iff]
      at hxy <;> rwa [mem_Iic, pure_le_principal]
  · simp [map_eq_map_iff_of_injOn (le_principal_iff.mp hF) (le_principal_iff.mp hG) hm]

name: tendsto_eval_pi
statement: theorem tendsto_eval_pi (f : ∀ i, Filter (α i)) (i : ι) : Tendsto (eval i) (pi f) (f i)

name: tendsto_pi
statement:
theorem tendsto_pi {β : Type*} {m : β → ∀ i, α i} {l : Filter β} :
    Tendsto m l (pi f) ↔ ∀ i, Tendsto (fun x => m x i) l (f i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pi, tendsto_iInf, tendsto_comap_iff]; rfl

name: le_pi
statement: theorem le_pi {g : Filter (∀ i, α i)} : g ≤ pi f ↔ ∀ i, Tendsto (eval i) g (f i)

name: pi_mono
statement:
@[gcongr, mono]
theorem pi_mono (h : ∀ i, f₁ i ≤ f₂ i) : pi f₁ ≤ pi f₂
proof:
:=
  iInf_mono fun i => comap_mono <| h i

name: mem_pi_of_mem
statement: theorem mem_pi_of_mem (i : ι) {s : Set (α i)} (hs : s ∈ f i) : eval i ⁻¹' s ∈ pi f

name: pi_mem_pi
statement: theorem pi_mem_pi {I : Set ι} (hI : I.Finite) (h : ∀ i ∈ I, s i ∈ f i) : I.pi s ∈ pi f
proof:
:= by
  rw [pi_def, biInter_eq_iInter]
  refine mem_iInf_of_iInter hI (fun i => ?_) Subset.rfl
  exact preimage_mem_comap (h i i.2)

name: mem_pi
statement:
theorem mem_pi {s : Set (∀ i, α i)} :
    s ∈ pi f ↔ ∃ I : Set ι, I.Finite ∧ ∃ t : ∀ i, Set (α i), (∀ i, t i ∈ f i) ∧ I.pi t ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp only [pi, mem_iInf', mem_comap, pi_def]
    rintro ⟨I, If, V, hVf, -, rfl, -⟩
    choose t htf htV using hVf
    exact ⟨I, If, t, htf, iInter₂_mono fun i _ => htV i⟩
  · rintro ⟨I, If, t, htf, hts⟩
    exact mem_of_superset (pi_mem_pi If fun i _ => htf i) hts

name: mem_pi'
statement:
theorem mem_pi' {s : Set (∀ i, α i)} :
    s ∈ pi f ↔ ∃ I : Finset ι, ∃ t : ∀ i, Set (α i), (∀ i, t i ∈ f i) ∧ Set.pi (↑I) t ⊆ s

name: mem_of_pi_mem_pi
statement:
theorem mem_of_pi_mem_pi [∀ i, NeBot (f i)] {I : Set ι} (h : I.pi s ∈ pi f) {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ I) :
    s i ∈ f i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases mem_pi.1 h with ⟨I', -, t, htf, hts⟩
  refine mem_of_superset (htf i) fun x hx => ?_
  have : ∀ i, (t i).Nonempty := fun i => nonempty_of_mem (htf i)
  choose g hg using this
  have : update g i x ∈ I'.pi t := fun j _ => by
    rcases eq_or_ne j i with (rfl | hne) <;> simp [*]
  simpa using hts this i hi

name: pi_mem_pi_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pi_mem_pi_iff [∀ i, NeBot (f i)] {I : Set ι} (hI : I.Finite) :
    I.pi s ∈ pi f ↔ ∀ i ∈ I, s i ∈ f i
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _i hi => mem_of_pi_mem_pi h hi, pi_mem_pi hI⟩

name: Eventually.eval_pi
statement:
theorem Eventually.eval_pi {i : ι} (hf : ∀ᶠ x : α i in f i, p i x) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ∀ i : ι, α i in pi f, p i (x i)

name: eventually_pi
statement:
theorem eventually_pi [Finite ι] (hf : ∀ i, ∀ᶠ x in f i, p i x) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ∀ i, α i in pi f, ∀ i, p i (x i)

name: hasBasis_pi
statement:
theorem hasBasis_pi {ι' : ι → Type*} {s : ∀ i, ι' i → Set (α i)} {p : ∀ i, ι' i → Prop}
    (h : ∀ i, (f i).HasBasis (p i) (s i)) :
    (pi f).HasBasis (fun If : Set ι × ∀ i, ι' i => If.1.Finite ∧ ∀ i ∈ If.1, p i (If.2 i))
      fun If : Set ι × ∀ i, ι' i => If.1.pi fun i => s i <| If.2 i
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Set.pi_def] using! HasBasis.iInf' fun i => (h i).comap (eval i : (∀ j, α j) → α i)

name: hasBasis_pi_same_index
statement:
theorem hasBasis_pi_same_index {κ : Type*} {p : κ → Prop} {s : Π i : ι, κ → Set (α i)}
    (h : ∀ i : ι, (f i).HasBasis p (s i))
    (h_dir : ∀ I : Set ι, ∀ k : ι → κ, I.Finite → (∀ i ∈ I, p (k i)) →
      ∃ k₀, p k₀ ∧ ∀ i ∈ I, s i k₀ ⊆ s i (k i)) :
    (pi f).HasBasis (fun Ik : Set ι × κ ↦ Ik.1.Finite ∧ p Ik.2)
      (fun Ik ↦ Ik.1.pi (fun i ↦ s i Ik.2))
proof:
:= by
  refine hasBasis_pi h |>.to_hasBasis ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨I, k⟩ ⟨hI, hk⟩
    rcases h_dir I k hI hk with ⟨k₀, hk₀, hk₀'⟩
    exact ⟨⟨I, k₀⟩, ⟨hI, hk₀⟩, Set.pi_mono hk₀'⟩
  · rintro ⟨I, k⟩ ⟨hI, hk⟩
    exact ⟨⟨I, fun _ ↦ k⟩, ⟨hI, fun _ _ ↦ hk⟩, subset_rfl⟩

name: HasBasis.pi_self
statement:
theorem HasBasis.pi_self {α : Type*} {κ : Type*} {f : Filter α} {p : κ → Prop} {s : κ → Set α}
    (h : f.HasBasis p s) :
    (pi fun _ ↦ f).HasBasis (fun Ik : Set ι × κ ↦ Ik.1.Finite ∧ p Ik.2)
      (fun Ik ↦ Ik.1.pi (fun _ ↦ s Ik.2))
proof:
:= by
  refine hasBasis_pi_same_index (fun _ ↦ h) (fun I k hI hk ↦ ?_)
  rcases h.mem_iff.mp (biInter_mem hI |>.mpr fun i hi ↦ h.mem_of_mem (hk i hi))
    with ⟨k₀, hk₀, hk₀'⟩
  exact ⟨k₀, hk₀, fun i hi ↦ hk₀'.trans (biInter_subset_of_mem hi)⟩

name: le_pi_principal
statement:
theorem le_pi_principal (s : (i : ι) → Set (α i)) :
    𝓟 (univ.pi s) ≤ pi fun i ↦ 𝓟 (s i)
proof:
:=
  le_pi.2 fun i ↦ tendsto_principal_principal.2 fun _f hf ↦ hf i trivial

name: pi_principal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pi_principal [Finite ι] (s : (i : ι) → Set (α i)) :
    pi (fun i ↦ 𝓟 (s i)) = 𝓟 (univ.pi s)

theorem mem_pi_principal {t : Set ((i : ι) → α i)} :

theorem hasBasis_pi_principal (s : (i : ι) → Set (α i)) :

name: pi_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pi_pure [Finite ι] (f : (i : ι) → α i) : pi (pure <| f ·) = pure f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← principal_singleton, pi_principal, univ_pi_singleton]

name: mem_pi_pure
statement:
theorem mem_pi_pure {f : (i : ι) → α i} {s : Set ((i : ι) → α i)} :
    s ∈ pi (fun i ↦ pure (f i)) ↔ ∃ I : Set ι, I.Finite ∧ ∀ g, (∀ i ∈ I, g i = f i) → g ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← principal_singleton, mem_pi_principal]
  simp [subset_def]

name: hasBasis_pi_pure
statement:
theorem hasBasis_pi_pure (f : (i : ι) → α i) :
    HasBasis (pi fun i ↦ pure (f i)) Set.Finite (fun I ↦ {g | ∀ i ∈ I, g i = f i})

name: pi_inf_principal_univ_pi_eq_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pi_inf_principal_univ_pi_eq_bot :
    pi f ⊓ 𝓟 (Set.pi univ s) = ⊥ ↔ ∃ i, f i ⊓ 𝓟 (s i) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp only [inf_principal_eq_bot, mem_pi]
    contrapose!
    rintro (hsf : ∀ i, ∃ᶠ x in f i, x ∈ s i) I - t htf hts
    have : ∀ i, (s i ∩ t i).Nonempty := fun i => ((hsf i).and_eventually (htf i)).exists
    choose x hxs hxt using this
    exact hts (fun i _ => hxt i) (mem_univ_pi.2 hxs)
  · simp only [inf_principal_eq_bot]
    rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    filter_upwards [mem_pi_of_mem i hi] with x using mt fun h => h i trivial

name: pi_inf_principal_pi_eq_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pi_inf_principal_pi_eq_bot [∀ i, NeBot (f i)] {I : Set ι} :
    pi f ⊓ 𝓟 (Set.pi I s) = ⊥ ↔ ∃ i ∈ I, f i ⊓ 𝓟 (s i) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← univ_pi_piecewise_univ I, pi_inf_principal_univ_pi_eq_bot]
  refine exists_congr fun i => ?_
  by_cases hi : i ∈ I <;> simp [hi, NeBot.ne']

@[simp]
theorem pi_inf_principal_univ_pi_neBot :

name: pi_eq_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pi_eq_bot : pi f = ⊥ ↔ ∃ i, f i = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  simpa using @pi_inf_principal_univ_pi_eq_bot ι α f fun _ => univ

name: pi_neBot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pi_neBot : NeBot (pi f) ↔ ∀ i, NeBot (f i)

name: map_eval_pi
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_eval_pi (f : ∀ i, Filter (α i)) [∀ i, NeBot (f i)] (i : ι) :
    map (eval i) (pi f) = f i
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (tendsto_eval_pi f i) fun s hs => ?_
  rcases mem_pi.1 (mem_map.1 hs) with ⟨I, hIf, t, htf, hI⟩
  rw [← image_subset_iff] at hI
  refine mem_of_superset (htf i) ((subset_eval_image_pi ?_ _).trans hI)
  exact nonempty_of_mem (pi_mem_pi hIf fun i _ => htf i)

name: pi_le_pi
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pi_le_pi [∀ i, NeBot (f₁ i)] : pi f₁ ≤ pi f₂ ↔ ∀ i, f₁ i ≤ f₂ i
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h i => map_eval_pi f₁ i ▸ (tendsto_eval_pi _ _).mono_left h, pi_mono⟩

name: pi_inj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pi_inj [∀ i, NeBot (f₁ i)] : pi f₁ = pi f₂ ↔ f₁ = f₂
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, congr_arg pi⟩
  have hle : f₁ ≤ f₂ := pi_le_pi.1 h.le
  have : ∀ i, NeBot (f₂ i) := fun i => neBot_of_le (hle i)
  exact hle.antisymm (pi_le_pi.1 h.ge)

    map (fun k : ∀ i, α i => fun i => m i (k i)) (Filter.coprodᵢ f) ≤
      Filter.coprodᵢ fun i => map (m i) (f i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [le_def, mem_map, mem_coprodᵢ_iff]
  intro s h i
  obtain ⟨t, H, hH⟩ := h i

name: exists_mem_and_iff
statement:
theorem exists_mem_and_iff {P : Set α → Prop} {Q : Set α → Prop} (hP : Antitone P)
    (hQ : Antitone Q) : ((∃ u ∈ f, P u) ∧ ∃ u ∈ f, Q u) ↔ ∃ u ∈ f, P u ∧ Q u
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨u, huf, hPu⟩, v, hvf, hQv⟩
    exact
      ⟨u ∩ v, inter_mem huf hvf, hP inter_subset_left hPu, hQ inter_subset_right hQv⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, huf, hPu, hQu⟩
    exact ⟨⟨u, huf, hPu⟩, u, huf, hQu⟩

  Iff.intro (fun h _ hu => h <| GenerateSets.basic <| hu) fun h _ hu =>
    hu.recOn (fun h' => h h') univ_mem (fun _ hxy ↦ by gcongr) fun _ _ hx hy =>
      inter_mem hx hy

name: generate_singleton

proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (fun _t ht ↦ mem_of_superset (mem_generate_of_mem <| mem_singleton _) ht) <|
    le_generate_iff.2 <| singleton_subset_iff.2 Subset.rfl

proof:
:=
  Filter.ext fun u =>
    show u ∈ (Filter.mkOfClosure s hs).sets ↔ u ∈ (generate s).sets from hs.symm ▸ Iff.rfl

name: iInf_sets_induct
proof:
:= by
  have p_of_f : ∀ i, ∀ s ∈ f i, p s := fun i s hs ↦ by simpa using ins hs uni
  let q : Set α → Prop := fun t ↦ t ∈ iInf f ∧ ∀ t', t ⊆ t' → p t'
  have q_mono : Monotone q := fun a b hab ha ↦
    ⟨mem_of_superset ha.1 hab, fun t hbt ↦ ha.2 _ (hab.trans hbt)⟩
  have A : ∀ i, ∀ s ∈ f i, ∀ t, q t → q (s ∩ t) := fun i s hs t ht ↦ by
    use inter_mem (mem_iInf_of_mem _ hs) ht.1
    intro u hu
    have : u = (u ∪ s) ∩ (u ∪ t) := by
      rwa [← union_eq_left, union_inter_distrib_left, eq_comm] at hu
    rw [this]
    exact ins (mem_of_superset hs subset_union_right) (ht.2 _ subset_union_right)
  have B : ∀ s t, q s → q t → q (s ∩ t) := fun s t hqs hqt ↦ by
    let 𝓕 : Filter α :=
    { sets := {s | ∀ t, q t → q (s ∩ t)}
      univ_sets := by simp
      sets_of_superset ha hab t ht := q_mono (inter_subset_inter_left _ hab) (ha t ht)
      inter_sets ha hb t ht := by simpa [inter_assoc] using ha _ (hb _ ht) }
    exact (le_iInf_iff.mpr A : 𝓕 ≤ iInf f) hqs.1 _ hqt
  have C : ∀ i, ∀ s ∈ f i, q s := fun i s hs ↦
    ⟨mem_iInf_of_mem _ hs, fun t hst ↦ p_of_f _ _ (mem_of_superset hs hst)⟩
  let 𝓖 : Filter α :=
  { sets := {t | q t}
    univ_sets := by simpa [q] using uni
    sets_of_superset ha hab :=
      ⟨mem_of_superset ha.1 hab, fun t hbt ↦ ha.2 _ (hab.trans hbt)⟩
    inter_sets := B _ _ }
  have : 𝓖 ≤ iInf f := le_iInf_iff.mpr C
  exact (this hs).2 s subset_rfl

proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (le_sInf fun f hf _ hs => h.2 ⟨f, hf, hs⟩)

statement:
theorem eq_biInf_of_mem_iff_exists_mem {f : ι → Filter α} {p : ι → Prop} {l : Filter α}

proof:
:= by
  rw [iInf_subtype']
  exact eq_iInf_of_mem_iff_exists_mem fun {_} => by simp only [Subtype.exists, h, exists_prop]

name: iInf_sets_eq
statement:
theorem iInf_sets_eq {f : ι → Filter α} (h : Directed (· ≥ ·) f) [ne : Nonempty ι] :
    (iInf f).sets = ⋃ i, (f i).sets
proof:
:=
  let ⟨i⟩ := ne
  let u :=
    { sets := ⋃ i, (f i).sets
      univ_sets := mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, univ_mem⟩
      sets_of_superset := by
        simp only [mem_iUnion, exists_imp]
        exact fun i hx hxy => ⟨i, mem_of_superset hx hxy⟩
      inter_sets := by
        simp only [mem_iUnion, exists_imp]
        intro x y a hx b hy
        rcases h a b with ⟨c, ha, hb⟩
        exact ⟨c, inter_mem (ha hx) (hb hy)⟩ }
  have : u = iInf f := eq_iInf_of_mem_iff_exists_mem mem_iUnion
  congr_arg Filter.sets this.symm

:=

:= by

proof:
:=
  (sInf_eq_iInf' s).symm ▸
    @iInf_neBot_of_directed' _ _ _ hne.to_subtype hd.directed_val fun ⟨_, hf⟩ =>
      ⟨ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hf hbot⟩

proof:
:=
  (sInf_eq_iInf' s).symm ▸
    iInf_neBot_of_directed hd.directed_val fun ⟨_, hf⟩ => ⟨ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hf hbot⟩

name: Eventually.choice
statement:
theorem Eventually.choice {r : α → β → Prop} {l : Filter α} [l.NeBot] (h : ∀ᶠ x in l, ∃ y, r x y) :
    ∃ f : α → β, ∀ᶠ x in l, r x (f x)
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty β := let ⟨_, hx⟩ := h.exists; hx.nonempty
  choose! f hf using fun x (hx : ∃ y, r x y) => hx
  exact ⟨f, h.mono hf⟩

name: skolem
statement:
lemma skolem {ι : Type*} {α : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Nonempty (α i)]
    {P : ∀ i : ι, α i → Prop} {F : Filter ι} :
    (∀ᶠ i in F, ∃ b, P i b) ↔ ∃ b : (Π i, α i), ∀ᶠ i in F, P i (b i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun H ↦ ?_, fun ⟨b, hb⟩ ↦ hb.mp (.of_forall fun x a ↦ ⟨_, a⟩)⟩
  refine ⟨fun i ↦ if h : ∃ b, P i b then h.choose else Nonempty.some inferInstance, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [H] with i hi
  exact dite_eq_left hi ▸ hi.choose_spec

lemma isBoundedUnder_sum {κ : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R] {r : R → R → Prop}
    (hr : ∀ (v₁ v₂ : α → R), f.IsBoundedUnder r v₁ → f.IsBoundedUnder r v₂
      → f.IsBoundedUnder r (v₁ + v₂)) (hr₀ : r 0 0)
    {u : κ → α → R} (s : Finset κ) (h : ∀ k ∈ s, f.IsBoundedUnder r (u k)) :
    f.IsBoundedUnder r (∑ k ∈ s, u k)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction
  case empty =>
    rw [Finset.sum_empty]
    exact ⟨0, by simp_all only [eventually_map, Pi.zero_apply, eventually_true]⟩
  case cons k₀ s k₀_notin_s ih =>
    simp only [Finset.forall_mem_cons] at *
    simpa only [Finset.sum_cons] using hr _ _ h.1 (ih h.2)

proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := u_bdd_le

lemma isBoundedUnder_le_sum {κ : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R] [AddLeftMono R] [AddRightMono R]

    (∀ k ∈ s, f.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (u k)) → f.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (∑ k ∈ s, u k)
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ isBoundedUnder_sum (fun _ _ ↦ isBoundedUnder_le_add) le_rfl s h

name: isCoboundedUnder_le_add
statement:
@[to_dual isCoboundedUnder_ge_add]
lemma isCoboundedUnder_le_add (hu : f.IsBoundedUnder (fun x1 x2 ↦ x2 ≤ x1) u)
    (hv : f.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) v) :
    f.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (u + v)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := hu.eventually_ge
  obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := hv.frequently_ge
  apply IsCoboundedUnder.of_frequently_ge (a := U + V)
  exact (hV.and_eventually hU).mono fun x hx ↦ add_le_add hx.2 hx.1

name: isBoundedUnder_le_mul_of_nonneg
statement:
lemma isBoundedUnder_le_mul_of_nonneg [Preorder α] [Mul α] [Zero α] [PosMulMono α]
    [MulPosMono α] {f : Filter ι} {u v : ι → α} (h₁ : ∃ᶠ x in f, 0 ≤ u x)
    (h₂ : IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) f u) (h₃ : 0 ≤ᶠ[f] v)
    (h₄ : IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) f v) :
    IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) f (u * v)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := h₂.eventually_le
  obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := h₄.eventually_le
  refine isBoundedUnder_of_eventually_le (a := U * V) ?_
  filter_upwards [hU, hV, h₃] with x x_U x_V v_0
  have U_0 : 0 ≤ U := by
    obtain ⟨y, y_0, y_U⟩ := (h₁.and_eventually hU).exists
    exact y_0.trans y_U
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right x_U v_0).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left x_V U_0)

name: isCoboundedUnder_ge_mul_of_nonneg
statement:
lemma isCoboundedUnder_ge_mul_of_nonneg [LinearOrder α] [Mul α] [Zero α] [PosMulMono α]
    [MulPosMono α] {f : Filter ι} [f.NeBot] {u v : ι → α} (h₁ : 0 ≤ᶠ[f] u)
    (h₂ : IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) f u)
    (h₃ : 0 ≤ᶠ[f] v)
    (h₄ : IsCoboundedUnder (fun x1 x2 ↦ x2 ≤ x1) f v) :
    IsCoboundedUnder (fun x1 x2 ↦ x2 ≤ x1) f (u * v)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := h₂.eventually_le
  obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := h₄.frequently_le
  refine IsCoboundedUnder.of_frequently_le (a := U * V) ?_
  apply (hV.and_eventually (hU.and (h₁.and h₃))).mono
  intro x ⟨x_V, x_U, u_0, v_0⟩
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right x_U v_0).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left x_V (u_0.trans x_U))

name: isBoundedUnder_le_sup
statement:

name: Monotone.isBoundedUnder_le_comp_iff
statement:
@[to_dual isBoundedUnder_ge_comp_iff]
theorem Monotone.isBoundedUnder_le_comp_iff [Nonempty β] [LinearOrder β] [Preorder γ] [NoMaxOrder γ]
    {g : β → γ} {f : α → β} {l : Filter α} (hg : Monotone g) (hg' : Tendsto g atTop atTop) :
    IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) l (g ∘ f) ↔ IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) l f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun h => h.isBoundedUnder (α := β) hg⟩
  rintro ⟨c, hc⟩; rw [eventually_map] at hc
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b, ∀ a ≥ b, c < g a := eventually_atTop.1 (hg'.eventually_gt_atTop c)
  exact ⟨b, hc.mono fun x hx => not_lt.1 fun h => (hb _ h.le).not_ge hx⟩

name: isCoboundedUnder_le_max
statement:
@[to_dual isCoboundedUnder_ge_min]
theorem isCoboundedUnder_le_max [LinearOrder β] {f : Filter α} {u v : α → β}
    (h : f.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) u ∨ f.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) v) :
    f.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (fun a ↦ max (u a) (v a))
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with (h' | h') <;>
  · rcases h' with ⟨b, hb⟩
    use b
    intro c hc
    apply hb c
    rw [eventually_map] at hc ⊢
    refine hc.mono (fun _ ↦ ?_)
    simp +contextual only [implies_true, max_le_iff]

name: isBoundedUnder_le_finset_sup'
statement:
@[to_dual isBoundedUnder_ge_finset_inf']
theorem isBoundedUnder_le_finset_sup' [LinearOrder β] [Nonempty β] {f : Filter α} {F : ι → α → β}
    {s : Finset ι} (hs : s.Nonempty) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, f.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (F i)) :
    f.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (fun a ↦ sup' s hs (fun i ↦ F i a))
proof:
:= by
  choose! m hm using h
  use sup' s hs m
  simp only [eventually_map] at hm ⊢
  rw [← eventually_all_finset s] at hm
  refine hm.mono fun a h ↦ ?_
  simp only [sup'_le_iff]
  exact fun i i_s ↦ le_trans (h i i_s) (le_sup' m i_s)

name: isCoboundedUnder_le_finset_sup'
statement:
@[to_dual isCoboundedUnder_ge_finset_inf']
theorem isCoboundedUnder_le_finset_sup' [LinearOrder β] {f : Filter α} {F : ι → α → β}
    {s : Finset ι} (hs : s.Nonempty) (h : ∃ i ∈ s, f.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (F i)) :
    f.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (fun a ↦ sup' s hs (fun i ↦ F i a))
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨i, i_s, b, hb⟩
  use b
  refine fun c hc ↦ hb c ?_
  rw [eventually_map] at hc ⊢
  refine hc.mono fun a h ↦ ?_
  simp only [sup'_le_iff] at h ⊢
  exact h i i_s

name: isBoundedUnder_le_finset_sup
statement:

theorem isBoundedUnder_le_finset_sup [LinearOrder β] [OrderBot β] {f : Filter α} {F : ι → α → β}

  rw [← eventually_all_finset s] at hm

name: Monotone.frequently_ge_map_of_frequently_ge
statement:
@[to_dual frequently_le_map_of_frequently_le]
lemma Monotone.frequently_ge_map_of_frequently_ge {f : R → S} (f_incr : Monotone f)
    {l : R} (freq_ge : ∃ᶠ x in F, l ≤ x) :
    ∃ᶠ x' in F.map f, f l ≤ x'
proof:
:= by
  refine fun ev ↦ freq_ge ?_
  simp only [not_le] at ev freq_ge ⊢
  filter_upwards [ev] with z hz
  by_contra con
  exact lt_irrefl (f l) <| lt_of_le_of_lt (f_incr <| not_lt.mp con) hz

name: Finsupp.mapDomain_tendstoCofinite
statement:
@[instance]
theorem Finsupp.mapDomain_tendstoCofinite [TendstoCofinite f] :
    TendstoCofinite (mapDomain (M := ℕ) f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine (tendstoCofinite_iff_finite_preimage_singleton _).mpr fun x ↦ ?_
  let s := Finset.sup x.support (fun t ↦ (TendstoCofinite.finite_preimage_singleton f t).toFinset)
  let e : s ↪ α := Function.Embedding.subtype (fun u ↦ u ∈ s)
  refine Set.Finite.subset (Set.Finite.image (embDomain e) <| finite_of_degree_le (degree x)) ?_
  simp only [Set.subset_def, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_image,
    Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  refine fun y hy ↦ ⟨y.comapDomain e e.injective.injOn, ?_, embDomain_comapDomain ?_⟩
  · rw [← hy, degree_mapDomain]
    exact degree_comapDomain_le_of_canonicallyOrderedAdd ..
  · suffices y.support ⊆ s by simpa [e]
    simpa [← hy, mapDomain, sum, Finset.subset_iff, single_apply, s] using
      fun i hi ↦ ⟨i, by simp [hi]⟩

name: mem_countableGenerate_iff
statement:
theorem mem_countableGenerate_iff {s : Set α} :
    s ∈ countableGenerate g ↔ ∃ S : Set (Set α), S ⊆ g ∧ S.Countable ∧ ⋂₀ S ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · induction h with
    | @basic s hs => exact ⟨{s}, by simp [hs]⟩
    | univ => exact ⟨∅, by simp⟩
    | superset _ _ ih => refine Exists.imp (fun S => ?_) ih; tauto
    | @sInter S Sct _ ih =>
      choose T Tg Tct hT using ih
      refine ⟨⋃ (s) (H : s ∈ S), T s H, by simpa, Sct.biUnion Tct, ?_⟩
      apply subset_sInter
      intro s H
      exact subset_trans (sInter_subset_sInter (subset_iUnion₂ s H)) (hT s H)
  rcases h with ⟨S, Sg, Sct, hS⟩
  refine mem_of_superset ((countable_sInter_mem Sct).mpr ?_) hS
  intro s H
  exact CountableGenerateSets.basic (Sg H)

name: le_countableGenerate_iff_of_countableInterFilter
statement:
theorem le_countableGenerate_iff_of_countableInterFilter {f : Filter α} [CountableInterFilter f] :
    f ≤ countableGenerate g ↔ g ⊆ f.sets
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · exact subset_trans (fun s => CountableGenerateSets.basic) h
  intro s hs
  induction hs with
  | basic hs => exact h hs
  | univ => exact univ_mem
  | superset _ st ih => exact mem_of_superset ih st
  | sInter Sct _ ih => exact (countable_sInter_mem Sct).mpr ih

  rintro f ⟨fct, hf⟩
  rwa [@le_countableGenerate_iff_of_countableInterFilter _ _ _ fct]

name: mem_cardinalGenerate_iff
statement:
theorem mem_cardinalGenerate_iff {s : Set α} {hreg : c.IsRegular} :
    s ∈ cardinalGenerate g (IsRegular.nat_lt hreg 2) ↔
    ∃ S : Set (Set α), S ⊆ g ∧ (#S < c) ∧ ⋂₀ S ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · induction h with
    | @basic s hs =>
      refine ⟨{s}, singleton_subset_iff.mpr hs, ?_⟩
      simpa [subset_refl] using IsRegular.nat_lt hreg 1
    | univ =>
      exact ⟨∅, ⟨empty_subset g, mk_eq_zero (∅ : Set <| Set α) ▸ IsRegular.nat_lt hreg 0, by simp⟩⟩
    | superset _ _ ih => exact Exists.imp (by tauto) ih
    | @sInter S Sct _ ih =>
      choose T Tg Tct hT using ih
      refine ⟨⋃ (s) (H : s ∈ S), T s H, by simpa,
        (Cardinal.card_biUnion_lt_iff_forall_of_isRegular hreg Sct).2 Tct, ?_⟩
      apply subset_sInter
      apply fun s H => subset_trans (sInter_subset_sInter (subset_iUnion₂ s H)) (hT s H)
  rcases h with ⟨S, Sg, Sct, hS⟩
  have : CardinalInterFilter (cardinalGenerate g (IsRegular.nat_lt hreg 2)) c :=
    cardinalInter_ofCardinalGenerate _ _
  exact mem_of_superset ((cardinal_sInter_mem Sct).mpr
    (fun s H => CardinalGenerateSets.basic (Sg H))) hS

  · exact subset_trans (fun s => CardinalGenerateSets.basic) h

  induction hs with
  | basic hs => exact h hs
  | univ => exact univ_mem
  | superset _ st ih => exact mem_of_superset ih st
  | sInter Sct _ ih => exact (cardinal_sInter_mem Sct).mpr ih

  rintro f ⟨fct, hf⟩
  rwa [le_cardinalGenerate_iff_of_cardinalInterFilter]

@[simp]
theorem ker_iSup (f : ι → Filter α) : ker (⨆ i, f i) = ⋃ i, ker (f i)
proof:
:= by
  refine subset_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) ker_mono.le_map_iSup
  simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_ker] at hx ⊢
  contrapose! hx
  choose s hsf hxs using hx
  refine ⟨⋃ i, s i, ?_, by simpa⟩
  exact mem_iSup.2 fun i ↦ mem_of_superset (hsf i) (subset_iUnion s i)

name: ker_sSup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ker_sSup (S : Set (Filter α)) : ker (sSup S) = ⋃ f ∈ S, ker f

name: ker_sup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ker_sup (f g : Filter α) : ker (f ⊔ g) = ker f ∪ ker g

name: ker_prod
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ker_prod (f : Filter α) (g : Filter β) : ker (f ×ˢ g) = ker f ×ˢ ker g

name: ker_pi
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ker_pi {ι : Type*} {α : ι → Type*} (f : (i : ι) → Filter (α i)) :
    ker (Filter.pi f) = univ.pi (fun i => ker (f i))

name: sequence_mono
statement:
theorem sequence_mono : ∀ as bs : List (Filter α), Forall₂ (· ≤ ·) as bs → sequence as ≤ sequence bs
  | [], [], Forall₂.nil => le_rfl
  | _::as, _::bs, Forall₂.cons h hs => seq_mono (map_mono h) (sequence_mono as bs hs)

name: mem_traverse
statement:
theorem mem_traverse :
    ∀ (fs : List β) (us : List γ),
      Forall₂ (fun b c => s c ∈ f b) fs us → traverse s us ∈ traverse f fs
  | [], [], Forall₂.nil => mem_pure.2 <| mem_singleton _
  | _::fs, _::us, Forall₂.cons h hs => seq_mem_seq (image_mem_map h) (mem_traverse fs us hs)

name: mem_traverse_iff
statement:
theorem mem_traverse_iff (fs : List β) (t : Set (List α)) :
    t ∈ traverse f fs ↔
      ∃ us : List (Set α), Forall₂ (fun b (s : Set α) => s ∈ f b) fs us ∧ sequence us ⊆ t
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · induction fs generalizing t with
    | nil =>
      simp only [sequence, mem_pure, imp_self, forall₂_nil_left_iff, exists_eq_left, Set.pure_def,
        singleton_subset_iff, traverse_nil]
    | cons b fs ih =>
      intro ht
      rcases mem_seq_iff.1 ht with ⟨u, hu, v, hv, ht⟩
      rcases mem_map_iff_exists_image.1 hu with ⟨w, hw, hwu⟩
      rcases ih v hv with ⟨us, hus, hu⟩
      exact ⟨w::us, Forall₂.cons hw hus, (Set.seq_mono hwu hu).trans ht⟩
  · rintro ⟨us, hus, hs⟩
    exact mem_of_superset (mem_traverse _ _ hus) hs

name: HasBasis.subsingleton_iff
statement:
theorem HasBasis.subsingleton_iff {ι : Sort*} {p : ι → Prop} {s : ι → Set α} (h : l.HasBasis p s) :
    l.Subsingleton ↔ ∃ i, p i ∧ (s i).Subsingleton
proof:
:=
  h.exists_iff fun _ _ hsub h ↦ h.anti hsub

name: Subsingleton.anti
statement: theorem Subsingleton.anti {l'} (hl : l.Subsingleton) (hl' : l' ≤ l) : l'.Subsingleton
proof:
:=
  let ⟨s, hsl, hs⟩ := hl; ⟨s, hl' hsl, hs⟩

name: Subsingleton.of_subsingleton
statement:
@[nontriviality]
theorem Subsingleton.of_subsingleton [Subsingleton α] : l.Subsingleton

name: Subsingleton.map
statement: theorem Subsingleton.map (hl : l.Subsingleton) (f : α → β) : (map f l).Subsingleton
proof:
:=
  let ⟨s, hsl, hs⟩ := hl; ⟨f '' s, image_mem_map hsl, hs.image f⟩

name: Subsingleton.prod
statement:
theorem Subsingleton.prod (hl : l.Subsingleton) {l' : Filter β} (hl' : l'.Subsingleton) :
    (l ×ˢ l').Subsingleton
proof:
:=
  let ⟨s, hsl, hs⟩ := hl; let ⟨t, htl', ht⟩ := hl'; ⟨s ×ˢ t, prod_mem_prod hsl htl', hs.prod ht⟩

name: subsingleton_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem subsingleton_pure {a : α} : Filter.Subsingleton (pure a)

name: subsingleton_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem subsingleton_bot : Filter.Subsingleton (⊥ : Filter α)

name: Subsingleton.exists_eq_pure
statement: theorem Subsingleton.exists_eq_pure [l.NeBot] (hl : l.Subsingleton) : ∃ a, l = pure a
proof:
:= by
  rcases hl with ⟨s, hsl, hs⟩
  rcases exists_eq_singleton_iff_nonempty_subsingleton.2 ⟨nonempty_of_mem hsl, hs⟩ with ⟨a, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨a, (NeBot.le_pure_iff ‹_›).1 ?_⟩
  rwa [le_pure_iff]

name: subsingleton_iff_bot_or_pure
statement: theorem subsingleton_iff_bot_or_pure : l.Subsingleton ↔ l = ⊥ ∨ ∃ a, l = pure a
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hl ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (eq_or_neBot l).imp_right (@Subsingleton.exists_eq_pure _ _ · hl)
  · rintro (rfl | ⟨a, rfl⟩) <;> simp

name: subsingleton_iff_exists_le_pure
statement: theorem subsingleton_iff_exists_le_pure [Nonempty α] : l.Subsingleton ↔ ∃ a, l ≤ pure a
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_neBot l with rfl | hbot
  · simp
  · simp [subsingleton_iff_bot_or_pure, ← hbot.le_pure_iff, hbot.ne]

name: subsingleton_iff_exists_singleton_mem
statement: theorem subsingleton_iff_exists_singleton_mem [Nonempty α] : l.Subsingleton ↔ ∃ a, {a} ∈ l

name: Subsingleton.isCountablyGenerated
statement: lemma Subsingleton.isCountablyGenerated (hl : l.Subsingleton) : IsCountablyGenerated l
proof:
:= by
  rcases subsingleton_iff_bot_or_pure.1 hl with rfl | ⟨x, rfl⟩
  · exact isCountablyGenerated_bot
  · exact isCountablyGenerated_pure x

name: lift_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_top (g : Set α → Filter β) : (⊤ : Filter α).lift g = g univ

name: HasBasis.mem_lift_iff
proof:
:= by
  refine (mem_biInf_of_directed ?_ ⟨univ, univ_sets _⟩).trans ?_
  · intro t₁ ht₁ t₂ ht₂
    exact ⟨t₁ ∩ t₂, inter_mem ht₁ ht₂, gm inter_subset_left, gm inter_subset_right⟩
  · simp only [← (hg _).mem_iff]
    exact hf.exists_iff fun t₁ t₂ ht H => gm ht H

name: HasBasis.lift
statement:
theorem HasBasis.lift {ι} {p : ι → Prop} {s : ι → Set α} {f : Filter α} (hf : f.HasBasis p s)
    {β : ι → Type*} {pg : ∀ i, β i → Prop} {sg : ∀ i, β i → Set γ} {g : Set α → Filter γ}
    (hg : ∀ i, (g (s i)).HasBasis (pg i) (sg i)) (gm : Monotone g) :
    (f.lift g).HasBasis
      (fun i : Σ i, β i => p i.1 ∧ pg i.1 i.2)
      fun i : Σ i, β i => sg i.1 i.2
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun t => (hf.mem_lift_iff hg gm).trans ?_⟩
  simp [Sigma.exists, and_assoc, exists_and_left]

name: mem_lift_sets
statement: theorem mem_lift_sets (hg : Monotone g) {s : Set β} : s ∈ f.lift g ↔ ∃ t ∈ f, s ∈ g t
proof:
:=
  (f.basis_sets.mem_lift_iff (fun s => (g s).basis_sets) hg).trans <| by
    simp only [id, exists_mem_subset_iff]

name: sInter_lift_sets
statement:
theorem sInter_lift_sets (hg : Monotone g) :
    ⋂₀ { s | s ∈ f.lift g } = ⋂ s ∈ f, ⋂₀ { t | t ∈ g s }
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sInter_eq_biInter, mem_ofPred_eq, mem_lift_sets hg, iInter_exists,
    iInter_and, @iInter_comm _ (Set β)]

name: mem_lift
statement: theorem mem_lift {s : Set β} {t : Set α} (ht : t ∈ f) (hs : s ∈ g t) : s ∈ f.lift g
proof:
:=
  le_principal_iff.mp <|
    show f.lift g ≤ 𝓟 s from iInf_le_of_le t <| iInf_le_of_le ht <| le_principal_iff.mpr hs

name: lift_le
statement:
theorem lift_le {f : Filter α} {g : Set α → Filter β} {h : Filter β} {s : Set α} (hs : s ∈ f)
    (hg : g s ≤ h) : f.lift g ≤ h

name: le_lift
statement:
theorem le_lift {f : Filter α} {g : Set α → Filter β} {h : Filter β} :
    h ≤ f.lift g ↔ ∀ s ∈ f, h ≤ g s

name: lift_mono
statement: theorem lift_mono (hf : f₁ ≤ f₂) (hg : g₁ ≤ g₂) : f₁.lift g₁ ≤ f₂.lift g₂
proof:
:=
  iInf_mono fun s => iInf_mono' fun hs => ⟨hf hs, hg s⟩

name: lift_mono'
statement: theorem lift_mono' (hg : ∀ s ∈ f, g₁ s ≤ g₂ s) : f.lift g₁ ≤ f.lift g₂

name: tendsto_lift
statement:
theorem tendsto_lift {m : γ → β} {l : Filter γ} :
    Tendsto m l (f.lift g) ↔ ∀ s ∈ f, Tendsto m l (g s)

name: map_lift_eq
statement: theorem map_lift_eq {m : β → γ} (hg : Monotone g) : map m (f.lift g) = f.lift (map m ∘ g)
proof:
:=
  have : Monotone (map m ∘ g) := map_mono.comp hg
  Filter.ext fun s => by
    simp only [mem_lift_sets hg, mem_lift_sets this, mem_map, Function.comp_apply]

name: comap_lift_eq
statement: theorem comap_lift_eq {m : γ → β} : comap m (f.lift g) = f.lift (comap m ∘ g)

name: comap_lift_eq2
statement:
theorem comap_lift_eq2 {m : β → α} {g : Set β → Filter γ} (hg : Monotone g) :
    (comap m f).lift g = f.lift (g ∘ preimage m)
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (le_iInf₂ fun s hs => iInf₂_le (m ⁻¹' s) ⟨s, hs, Subset.rfl⟩)
    (le_iInf₂ fun _s ⟨s', hs', h_sub⟩ => iInf₂_le_of_le s' hs' <| hg h_sub)

name: lift_map_le
statement: theorem lift_map_le {g : Set β → Filter γ} {m : α → β} : (map m f).lift g ≤ f.lift (g ∘ image m)
proof:
:=
  le_lift.2 fun _s hs => lift_le (image_mem_map hs) le_rfl

name: map_lift_eq2
statement:
theorem map_lift_eq2 {g : Set β → Filter γ} {m : α → β} (hg : Monotone g) :
    (map m f).lift g = f.lift (g ∘ image m)
proof:
:=
  lift_map_le.antisymm <| le_lift.2 fun _s hs => lift_le hs <| hg <| image_preimage_subset _ _

name: lift_comm
statement:
theorem lift_comm {g : Filter β} {h : Set α → Set β → Filter γ} :
    (f.lift fun s => g.lift (h s)) = g.lift fun t => f.lift fun s => h s t
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm
    (le_iInf fun i => le_iInf fun hi => le_iInf fun j => le_iInf fun hj =>
      iInf_le_of_le j <| iInf_le_of_le hj <| iInf_le_of_le i <| iInf_le _ hi)
    (le_iInf fun i => le_iInf fun hi => le_iInf fun j => le_iInf fun hj =>
      iInf_le_of_le j <| iInf_le_of_le hj <| iInf_le_of_le i <| iInf_le _ hi)

name: lift_assoc
statement:
theorem lift_assoc {h : Set β → Filter γ} (hg : Monotone g) :
    (f.lift g).lift h = f.lift fun s => (g s).lift h
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm
    (le_iInf₂ fun _s hs => le_iInf₂ fun t ht =>
      iInf_le_of_le t <| iInf_le _ <| (mem_lift_sets hg).mpr ⟨_, hs, ht⟩)
    (le_iInf₂ fun t ht =>
      let ⟨s, hs, h'⟩ := (mem_lift_sets hg).mp ht
      iInf_le_of_le s <| iInf_le_of_le hs <| iInf_le_of_le t <| iInf_le _ h')

name: lift_lift_same_le_lift
statement:
theorem lift_lift_same_le_lift {g : Set α → Set α → Filter β} :
    (f.lift fun s => f.lift (g s)) ≤ f.lift fun s => g s s
proof:
:=
  le_lift.2 fun _s hs => lift_le hs <| lift_le hs le_rfl

name: lift_lift_same_eq_lift
statement:
theorem lift_lift_same_eq_lift {g : Set α → Set α → Filter β} (hg₁ : ∀ s, Monotone fun t => g s t)
    (hg₂ : ∀ t, Monotone fun s => g s t) : (f.lift fun s => f.lift (g s)) = f.lift fun s => g s s
proof:
:=
  lift_lift_same_le_lift.antisymm <|
    le_lift.2 fun s hs => le_lift.2 fun t ht => lift_le (inter_mem hs ht) <|
      calc
        g (s ∩ t) (s ∩ t) ≤ g s (s ∩ t) := hg₂ (s ∩ t) inter_subset_left
        _ ≤ g s t := hg₁ s inter_subset_right

name: lift_principal
statement: theorem lift_principal {s : Set α} (hg : Monotone g) : (𝓟 s).lift g = g s

name: monotone_lift
statement:
theorem monotone_lift [Preorder γ] {f : γ → Filter α} {g : γ → Set α → Filter β} (hf : Monotone f)
    (hg : Monotone g) : Monotone fun c => (f c).lift (g c)

name: lift_neBot_iff
statement: theorem lift_neBot_iff (hm : Monotone g) : (NeBot (f.lift g)) ↔ ∀ s ∈ f, NeBot (g s)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [neBot_iff, Ne, ← empty_mem_iff_bot, mem_lift_sets hm, not_exists, not_and]

name: lift_const
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_const {f : Filter α} {g : Filter β} : (f.lift fun _ => g) = g

name: lift_inf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_inf {f : Filter α} {g h : Set α → Filter β} :
    (f.lift fun x => g x ⊓ h x) = f.lift g ⊓ f.lift h

name: lift_principal2
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_principal2 {f : Filter α} : f.lift 𝓟 = f
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (fun s hs => mem_lift hs (mem_principal_self s))
    (le_iInf fun s => le_iInf fun hs => by simp only [hs, le_principal_iff])

name: lift_iInf_le
statement:
theorem lift_iInf_le {f : ι → Filter α} {g : Set α → Filter β} :
    (iInf f).lift g ≤ ⨅ i, (f i).lift g

name: lift_iInf
statement:
theorem lift_iInf [Nonempty ι] {f : ι → Filter α} {g : Set α → Filter β}
    (hg : ∀ s t, g (s ∩ t) = g s ⊓ g t) : (iInf f).lift g = ⨅ i, (f i).lift g
proof:
:= by
  refine lift_iInf_le.antisymm fun s => ?_
  have H : ∀ t ∈ iInf f, ⨅ i, (f i).lift g ≤ g t := by
    intro t ht
    refine iInf_sets_induct ht ?_ fun hs ht => ?_
    · inhabit ι
      exact iInf₂_le_of_le default univ (iInf_le _ univ_mem)
    · rw [hg]
      exact le_inf (iInf₂_le_of_le _ _ <| iInf_le _ hs) ht
  simp only [mem_lift_sets (Monotone.of_map_inf hg), exists_imp, and_imp]
  exact fun t ht hs => H t ht hs

name: lift_iInf_of_directed
statement:
theorem lift_iInf_of_directed [Nonempty ι] {f : ι → Filter α} {g : Set α → Filter β}
    (hf : Directed (· ≥ ·) f) (hg : Monotone g) : (iInf f).lift g = ⨅ i, (f i).lift g
proof:
:=
  lift_iInf_le.antisymm fun s => by
    simp only [mem_lift_sets hg, exists_imp, and_imp, mem_iInf_of_directed hf]
    exact fun t i ht hs => mem_iInf_of_mem i <| mem_lift ht hs

name: lift_iInf_of_map_univ
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι
  · simp [hg']
  · exact lift_iInf hg

name: lift'_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift'_top (h : Set α → Set β) : (⊤ : Filter α).lift' h = 𝓟 (h univ)

name: mem_lift'
statement: theorem mem_lift' {t : Set α} (ht : t ∈ f) : h t ∈ f.lift' h
proof:
:=
  le_principal_iff.mp <| show f.lift' h ≤ 𝓟 (h t) from iInf_le_of_le t <| iInf_le_of_le ht <| le_rfl

name: tendsto_lift'
statement:
theorem tendsto_lift' {m : γ → β} {l : Filter γ} :
    Tendsto m l (f.lift' h) ↔ ∀ s ∈ f, ∀ᶠ a in l, m a ∈ h s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Filter.lift', tendsto_lift, tendsto_principal, comp]

name: HasBasis.lift'
statement:
theorem HasBasis.lift' {ι} {p : ι → Prop} {s} (hf : f.HasBasis p s) (hh : Monotone h) :
    (f.lift' h).HasBasis p (h ∘ s)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun t => (hf.mem_lift_iff (fun i => hasBasis_principal (h (s i)))
    (monotone_principal.comp hh)).trans <| by simp only [exists_const, true_and, comp]⟩

name: mem_lift'_sets
statement: theorem mem_lift'_sets (hh : Monotone h) {s : Set β} : s ∈ f.lift' h ↔ ∃ t ∈ f, h t ⊆ s

name: eventually_lift'_iff
statement:
theorem eventually_lift'_iff (hh : Monotone h) {p : β → Prop} :
    (∀ᶠ y in f.lift' h, p y) ↔ ∃ t ∈ f, ∀ y ∈ h t, p y

name: sInter_lift'_sets
statement: theorem sInter_lift'_sets (hh : Monotone h) : ⋂₀ { s | s ∈ f.lift' h } = ⋂ s ∈ f, h s

name: lift'_le
statement:
theorem lift'_le {f : Filter α} {g : Set α → Set β} {h : Filter β} {s : Set α} (hs : s ∈ f)
    (hg : 𝓟 (g s) ≤ h) : f.lift' g ≤ h

name: lift'_mono
statement: theorem lift'_mono (hf : f₁ ≤ f₂) (hh : h₁ ≤ h₂) : f₁.lift' h₁ ≤ f₂.lift' h₂
proof:
:=
  lift_mono hf fun s => principal_mono.mpr <| hh s

name: lift'_mono'
statement: theorem lift'_mono' (hh : ∀ s ∈ f, h₁ s ⊆ h₂ s) : f.lift' h₁ ≤ f.lift' h₂
proof:
:=
  iInf₂_mono fun s hs => principal_mono.mpr <| hh s hs

name: lift'_cong
statement: theorem lift'_cong (hh : ∀ s ∈ f, h₁ s = h₂ s) : f.lift' h₁ = f.lift' h₂
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (lift'_mono' fun s hs => le_of_eq <| hh s hs)
    (lift'_mono' fun s hs => le_of_eq <| (hh s hs).symm)

name: map_lift'_eq
statement: theorem map_lift'_eq {m : β → γ} (hh : Monotone h) : map m (f.lift' h) = f.lift' (image m ∘ h)
proof:
:=
  calc
    map m (f.lift' h) = f.lift (map m ∘ 𝓟 ∘ h) := map_lift_eq <| monotone_principal.comp hh
    _ = f.lift' (image m ∘ h) := by simp only [comp_def, Filter.lift', map_principal]

name: lift'_map_le
statement: theorem lift'_map_le {g : Set β → Set γ} {m : α → β} : (map m f).lift' g ≤ f.lift' (g ∘ image m)

name: map_lift'_eq2
statement:
theorem map_lift'_eq2 {g : Set β → Set γ} {m : α → β} (hg : Monotone g) :
    (map m f).lift' g = f.lift' (g ∘ image m)

name: comap_lift'_eq
statement: theorem comap_lift'_eq {m : γ → β} : comap m (f.lift' h) = f.lift' (preimage m ∘ h)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Filter.lift', comap_lift_eq, comp_def, comap_principal]

name: comap_lift'_eq2
statement:
theorem comap_lift'_eq2 {m : β → α} {g : Set β → Set γ} (hg : Monotone g) :
    (comap m f).lift' g = f.lift' (g ∘ preimage m)

name: lift'_principal
statement: theorem lift'_principal {s : Set α} (hh : Monotone h) : (𝓟 s).lift' h = 𝓟 (h s)

name: lift'_pure
statement: theorem lift'_pure {a : α} (hh : Monotone h) : (pure a : Filter α).lift' h = 𝓟 (h {a})

name: lift'_bot
statement: theorem lift'_bot (hh : Monotone h) : (⊥ : Filter α).lift' h = 𝓟 (h ∅)

name: le_lift'
statement:
theorem le_lift' {f : Filter α} {h : Set α → Set β} {g : Filter β} :
    g ≤ f.lift' h ↔ ∀ s ∈ f, h s ∈ g

name: principal_le_lift'
statement: theorem principal_le_lift' {t : Set β} : 𝓟 t ≤ f.lift' h ↔ ∀ s ∈ f, t ⊆ h s

name: monotone_lift'
statement:
theorem monotone_lift' [Preorder γ] {f : γ → Filter α} {g : γ → Set α → Set β} (hf : Monotone f)
    (hg : Monotone g) : Monotone fun c => (f c).lift' (g c)

name: lift_lift'_assoc
statement:
theorem lift_lift'_assoc {g : Set α → Set β} {h : Set β → Filter γ} (hg : Monotone g)
    (hh : Monotone h) : (f.lift' g).lift h = f.lift fun s => h (g s)
proof:
:=
  calc
    (f.lift' g).lift h = f.lift fun s => (𝓟 (g s)).lift h := lift_assoc (monotone_principal.comp hg)
    _ = f.lift fun s => h (g s) := by simp only [lift_principal, hh]

name: lift'_lift'_assoc
statement:
theorem lift'_lift'_assoc {g : Set α → Set β} {h : Set β → Set γ} (hg : Monotone g)
    (hh : Monotone h) : (f.lift' g).lift' h = f.lift' fun s => h (g s)

name: lift'_lift_assoc
statement:
theorem lift'_lift_assoc {g : Set α → Filter β} {h : Set β → Set γ} (hg : Monotone g) :
    (f.lift g).lift' h = f.lift fun s => (g s).lift' h

name: lift_lift'_same_le_lift'
statement:
theorem lift_lift'_same_le_lift' {g : Set α → Set α → Set β} :
    (f.lift fun s => f.lift' (g s)) ≤ f.lift' fun s => g s s

name: lift_lift'_same_eq_lift'
statement:
theorem lift_lift'_same_eq_lift' {g : Set α → Set α → Set β} (hg₁ : ∀ s, Monotone fun t => g s t)
    (hg₂ : ∀ t, Monotone fun s => g s t) :
    (f.lift fun s => f.lift' (g s)) = f.lift' fun s => g s s
proof:
:=
  lift_lift_same_eq_lift (fun s => monotone_principal.comp (hg₁ s)) fun t =>
    monotone_principal.comp (hg₂ t)

name: lift'_inf_principal_eq
statement:
theorem lift'_inf_principal_eq {h : Set α → Set β} {s : Set β} :
    f.lift' h ⊓ 𝓟 s = f.lift' fun t => h t ∩ s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Filter.lift', Filter.lift, (· ∘ ·), ← inf_principal, iInf_subtype', ← iInf_inf]

name: lift'_neBot_iff
statement: theorem lift'_neBot_iff (hh : Monotone h) : NeBot (f.lift' h) ↔ ∀ s ∈ f, (h s).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  calc

name: prod_lift_lift
proof:
:= by
  simp only [prod_def, lift_assoc hg₁]
  apply congr_arg; funext x
  rw [lift_comm]
  apply congr_arg; funext y
  apply lift'_lift_assoc hg₂

name: prod_lift'_lift'
proof:
:=
  calc
    f₁.lift' g₁ ×ˢ f₂.lift' g₂ = f₁.lift fun s => f₂.lift fun t => 𝓟 (g₁ s) ×ˢ 𝓟 (g₂ t) :=
      prod_lift_lift (monotone_principal.comp hg₁) (monotone_principal.comp hg₂)
    _ = f₁.lift fun s => f₂.lift fun t => 𝓟 (g₁ s ×ˢ g₂ t) := by
      { simp only [prod_principal_principal] }

name: eventually_smallSets_eventually
statement:

theorem eventually_smallSets_eventually {p : α → Prop} :
    (∀ᶠ s in l.smallSets, ∀ᶠ x in l', x ∈ s → p x) ↔ ∀ᶠ x in l ⊓ l', p x
proof:
:=
  calc
    _ ↔ ∃ s ∈ l, ∀ᶠ x in l', x ∈ s → p x :=
      eventually_smallSets' fun _ _ hst ht => ht.mono fun _ hx hs => hx (hst hs)
    _ ↔ ∃ s ∈ l, ∃ t ∈ l', ∀ x, x ∈ t → x ∈ s → p x := by simp only [eventually_iff_exists_mem]
    _ ↔ ∀ᶠ x in l ⊓ l', p x := by simp only [eventually_inf, and_comm, mem_inter_iff, ← and_imp]

name: exists_le_of_le
statement:
theorem exists_le_of_le {a b : α} {P Q : Finpartition a} (h : P ≤ Q) (hb : b ∈ Q.parts) :
    ∃ c ∈ P.parts, c ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra H
  refine Q.ne_bot hb (disjoint_self.1 <| Disjoint.mono_right (Q.le hb) ?_)
  have : ∀ p ∈ P.parts, ∃ q ∈ Q.parts.erase b, p ≤ q := by grind [h _]
  have : P.parts.sup id ≤ (Q.parts.erase b).sup id := by grind [Finset.le_sup, Finset.sup_le_iff]
  grw [← P.sup_parts, this]
  exact Q.supIndep (erase_subset _ _) hb (notMem_erase _ _)

name: card_mono
statement: theorem card_mono {a : α} {P Q : Finpartition a} (h : P ≤ Q) : #Q.parts ≤ #P.parts
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ b ∈ Q.parts, ∃ c ∈ P.parts, c ≤ b := fun b ↦ exists_le_of_le h
  choose f hP hf using this
  rw [← card_attach]
  refine card_le_card_of_injOn (fun b ↦ f _ b.2) (fun b _ ↦ hP _ b.2) fun b _ c _ h ↦ ?_
  exact
    Subtype.coe_injective
      (Q.disjoint.elim b.2 c.2 fun H ↦
        P.ne_bot (hP _ b.2) <| disjoint_self.1 <| H.mono (hf _ b.2) <| h.le.trans <| hf _ c.2)

:= Subtype.lattice Prsup Prinf

    p ∈ (toSubtype P Prsup Prinf Prbot hs hP).parts ↔ p.val ∈ P.parts := by simp [toSubtype]
