proof:
:= Subtype.lattice Prsup Prinf
    letI : OrderBot (Subtype Pr) := Subtype.orderBot Prbot
    ∑ p ∈ P.parts, f p = ∑ p ∈ (Finpartition.toSubtype P Prsup Prinf Prbot hs hP).parts, f p := by
  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun p hpP => ⟨p, hP p hpP⟩) <;> simp

name: parts_inf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem parts_inf (P Q : Finpartition a) :
    (P ⊓ Q).parts = ((P.parts ×ˢ Q.parts).image fun bc : α × α ↦ bc.1 ⊓ bc.2).erase ⊥

name: parts_restrict
statement:
@[simp]
theorem parts_restrict (P : Finpartition a) (hb : b ≤ a) :
    (P.restrict hb).parts = (P.parts.image (· ⊓ b)).erase ⊥

name: restrict_mono
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem restrict_mono {P Q : Finpartition a} (hb : b ≤ a) (hPQ : P ≤ Q) :
    P.restrict hb ≤ Q.restrict hb
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  simp_rw [parts_restrict, mem_erase, mem_image] at hx ⊢
  obtain ⟨h, x, hx, rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hPQ hx
  exact ⟨y ⊓ b, ⟨ne_bot_of_le_ne_bot h (by gcongr), y, hy, rfl⟩, by gcongr⟩

name: restrict_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem restrict_top (hb : b ≤ a) : restrict ⊤ hb = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Top.top]
  rcases eq_or_ne b ⊥ with rfl | hb'
  · exact Subsingleton.elim ..
  rw [dite_eq_right (ne_bot_of_le_ne_bot hb' hb), dite_eq_right hb']
  ext1
  simp_rw [parts_restrict, indiscrete_parts, image_singleton, inf_eq_right.mpr hb,
    erase_eq_of_notMem (mem_singleton.not.mpr hb'.symm)]

name: restrict_inf
statement:
theorem restrict_inf (P Q : Finpartition a) (hb : b ≤ a) :
    (P ⊓ Q).restrict hb = P.restrict hb ⊓ Q.restrict hb
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Monotone.map_inf_le (fun _ _ => restrict_mono hb) _ _) (fun x => ?_)
  simp only [parts_inf, parts_restrict, mem_erase, mem_image, mem_product, Prod.exists]
  rintro ⟨h, -, -, ⟨⟨-, y, hy, rfl⟩, ⟨-, z, hz, rfl⟩⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨y ⊓ z ⊓ b, ⟨by ac_nf at h ⊢, y ⊓ z,
    ⟨ne_bot_of_le_ne_bot h <| inf_le_inf inf_le_left inf_le_left, y, z, ⟨hy, hz⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩,
    by ac_nf⟩

name: sum_restrict
statement:
lemma sum_restrict (P : Finpartition a) (hb : b ≤ a) {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (f : α → M) (hf : f ⊥ = 0) :
    ∑ p ∈ (P.restrict hb).parts, f p = ∑ q ∈ P.parts, f (q ⊓ b)
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : ∀ x ∈ P.parts.filter (· ⊓ b ≠ ⊥), ∀ y ∈ P.parts.filter (· ⊓ b ≠ ⊥),
      x ⊓ b = y ⊓ b → x = y := fun x hx y hy hxy => by
    by_contra hne
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hx hy
    have : Disjoint (x ⊓ b) (y ⊓ b) := (P.disjoint hx.1 hy.1 hne).mono inf_le_left inf_le_left
    grind
  have heq : (P.parts.image (· ⊓ b)).erase ⊥ = (P.parts.filter (· ⊓ b ≠ ⊥)).image (· ⊓ b) := by
    grind
  have hz : ∑ x ∈ P.parts.filter (¬ · ⊓ b ≠ ⊥), f (x ⊓ b) = 0 := Finset.sum_eq_zero fun x hx => by
    simp only [ne_eq, Decidable.not_not, Finset.mem_filter] at hx
    rw [hx.2, hf]
  simp only [parts_restrict, heq, ← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not P.parts (· ⊓ b ≠ ⊥), hz,
    Finset.sum_image hinj, add_zero]

name: sum_ofPairwiseDisjoint_eq_sum
statement:
lemma sum_ofPairwiseDisjoint_eq_sum {parts : Finset α}
    (hdisjoint : (parts : Set α).PairwiseDisjoint id)
    {X : Type*} [AddCommMonoid X] {f : α → X} (hf : f ⊥ = 0) :
    ∑ p ∈ (ofPairwiseDisjoint parts hdisjoint).parts, f p = ∑ p ∈ parts, f p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hbot : ⊥ ∈ parts
  · simp only [Finpartition.ofPairwiseDisjoint]
    rw [← erase_union_eq ⊥ parts hbot, union_comm, sum_union_eq_right]
    · simp
    grind
  · simp_all

name: sum_combine
statement:
lemma sum_combine {ι : Type*} {I : Finset ι} {s : ι → α} (P : ∀ i, Finpartition (s i))
    (ha : I.SupIndep s) {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : α → M) :
    ∑ p ∈ (Finpartition.combine P ha).parts, f p = ∑ i ∈ I, ∑ p ∈ (P i).parts, f p
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [combine]
  refine Finset.sum_biUnion fun i hi j hj hij => ?_
  rw [Function.onFun, Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro p hpi hpj
  have hp_disj : Disjoint p p := (ha.pairwiseDisjoint hi hj hij).mono ((P i).le hpi) ((P j).le hpj)
  exact (P i).ne_bot hpi (disjoint_self.mp hp_disj)

name: mem_bind
statement: theorem mem_bind : b ∈ (P.bind Q).parts ↔ ∃ A hA, b ∈ (Q A hA).parts
proof:
:= by
  rw [bind_parts, mem_biUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨A, hA⟩, -, h⟩
    exact ⟨A, hA, h⟩
  · rintro ⟨A, hA, h⟩
    exact ⟨⟨A, hA⟩, mem_attach _ ⟨A, hA⟩, h⟩

name: card_bind
statement:
theorem card_bind (Q : ∀ i ∈ P.parts, Finpartition i) :
    #(P.bind Q).parts = ∑ A ∈ P.parts.attach, #(Q _ A.2).parts
proof:
:= by
  apply card_biUnion
  rintro ⟨b, hb⟩ - ⟨c, hc⟩ - hbc
  rw [Function.onFun, Finset.disjoint_left]
  rintro d hdb hdc
  rw [Ne, Subtype.mk_eq_mk] at hbc
  exact
    (Q b hb).ne_bot hdb
      (eq_bot_iff.2 <|
        (le_inf ((Q b hb).le hdb) <| (Q c hc).le hdc).trans <| (P.disjoint hb hc hbc).le_bot)

name: card_extend
statement:
theorem card_extend (P : Finpartition a) (b c : α) {hb : b ≠ ⊥} {hab : Disjoint a b}
    {hc : a ⊔ b = c} : #(P.extend hb hab hc).parts = #P.parts + 1
proof:
:=
  card_insert_of_notMem fun h ↦ hb <| hab.symm.eq_bot_of_le <| P.le h

name: mem_avoid
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_avoid : c ∈ (P.avoid b).parts ↔ ∃ d ∈ P.parts, ¬d ≤ b ∧ d \ b = c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [avoid, ofErase, mem_erase, Ne, mem_image, ← exists_and_left,
    @and_left_comm (c ≠ ⊥)]
  refine exists_congr fun d ↦ and_congr_right' <| and_congr_left ?_
  rintro rfl
  rw [sdiff_eq_bot_iff]

name: parts_extendOfLE_of_eq
statement: lemma parts_extendOfLE_of_eq (hab : a = b) : (P.extendOfLE hab.le).parts = P.parts

name: parts_extendOfLE_of_lt
statement:
lemma parts_extendOfLE_of_lt (hab : a < b) :
    (P.extendOfLE (le_of_lt hab)).parts = insert (b \ a) P.parts

name: parts_subset_extendOfLE
statement: lemma parts_subset_extendOfLE (hab : a ≤ b) : P.parts ⊆ (P.extendOfLE hab).parts
proof:
:= by
  unfold extendOfLE
  split_ifs with hr
  · cases le_antisymm (sdiff_eq_bot_iff.mp hr) hab; rfl
  · exact Finset.subset_insert _ _

name: mem_parts_or_eq_sdiff_of_mem_extendOfLE
statement:
lemma mem_parts_or_eq_sdiff_of_mem_extendOfLE (hab : a ≤ b) {p : α}
    (hp : p ∈ (P.extendOfLE hab).parts) : p ∈ P.parts ∨ p = b \ a
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a < b
  · simp_all [parts_extendOfLE_of_lt _ h, mem_insert, Or.comm]
  · left
    simpa [parts_extendOfLE_of_eq _ (LE.le.eq_of_not_lt hab h)] using hp

name: subset
statement: lemma subset {a : Finset α} (ha : a ∈ P.parts) : a ⊆ s

name: nonempty_of_mem_parts
statement: theorem nonempty_of_mem_parts {a : Finset α} (ha : a ∈ P.parts) : a.Nonempty

name: empty_notMem_parts
statement:
@[simp]
theorem empty_notMem_parts : ∅ ∉ P.parts

name: ne_empty
statement: theorem ne_empty (h : t ∈ P.parts) : t ≠ ∅

name: eq_of_mem_parts
statement: lemma eq_of_mem_parts (ht : t ∈ P.parts) (hu : u ∈ P.parts) (hat : a ∈ t) (hau : a ∈ u) : t = u
proof:
:=
  P.disjoint.elim ht hu <| not_disjoint_iff.2 ⟨a, hat, hau⟩

name: exists_mem
statement: theorem exists_mem (ha : a ∈ s) : ∃ t ∈ P.parts, a ∈ t
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← P.sup_parts] at ha
  exact mem_sup.1 ha

name: biUnion_parts
statement: theorem biUnion_parts : P.parts.biUnion id = s

name: existsUnique_mem
statement: theorem existsUnique_mem (ha : a ∈ s) : ∃! t, t ∈ P.parts ∧ a ∈ t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, ht'⟩ := P.exists_mem ha
  refine ⟨t, ⟨ht, ht'⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro u ⟨hu, hu'⟩
  exact P.eq_of_mem_parts hu ht hu' ht'

name: part_mem
statement:
@[simp]
lemma part_mem : P.part a ∈ P.parts ↔ a ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : a ∈ s <;> simp [part, ha, choose_mem]

name: part_eq_empty
statement:
@[simp]
lemma part_eq_empty : P.part a = ∅ ↔ a ∉ s
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h has ↦ P.ne_empty (P.part_mem.2 has) h, fun h ↦ by simp [part, h]⟩

name: part_nonempty
statement:
@[simp]
lemma part_nonempty : (P.part a).Nonempty ↔ a ∈ s

name: part_subset
statement:
@[simp]
lemma part_subset (a : α) : P.part a ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : a ∈ s
  · exact P.le <| P.part_mem.2 ha
  · simp [P.part_eq_empty.2 ha]

name: mem_part_self
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_part_self : a ∈ P.part a ↔ a ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : a ∈ s
  · simp [part, ha, choose_property (p := fun s => a ∈ s) P.parts (P.existsUnique_mem ha)]
  · simp [P.part_eq_empty.2, ha]

name: part_eq_iff_mem
statement: lemma part_eq_iff_mem (ht : t ∈ P.parts) : P.part a = t ↔ a ∈ t
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    simp_all
  · intro hat
    apply P.eq_of_mem_parts (a := a) <;> simp [*, P.le ht hat]

name: part_eq_of_mem
statement: lemma part_eq_of_mem (ht : t ∈ P.parts) (hat : a ∈ t) : P.part a = t

name: mem_part_iff_part_eq_part
statement:
lemma mem_part_iff_part_eq_part {b : α} (ha : a ∈ s) (hb : b ∈ s) :
    a ∈ P.part b ↔ P.part a = P.part b
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun c ↦ (P.part_eq_of_mem (P.part_mem.2 hb) c), fun c ↦ c ▸ P.mem_part ha⟩

name: part_surjOn
statement: theorem part_surjOn : Set.SurjOn P.part s P.parts
proof:
:= fun p hp ↦ by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := P.nonempty_of_mem_parts hp
  have hx' := mem_of_subset (P.le hp) hx
  use x, hx', (P.existsUnique_mem hx').unique ⟨P.part_mem.2 hx', P.mem_part hx'⟩ ⟨hp, hx⟩

name: exists_subset_part_bijOn
statement: theorem exists_subset_part_bijOn : ∃ r ⊆ s, Set.BijOn P.part r P.parts
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hrs, hr⟩ := P.part_surjOn.exists_bijOn_subset
  lift r to Finset α using s.finite_toSet.subset hrs
  exact ⟨r, mod_cast hrs, hr⟩

name: mem_part_iff_exists
statement: theorem mem_part_iff_exists {b} : a ∈ P.part b ↔ ∃ p ∈ P.parts, a ∈ p ∧ b ∈ p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : b ∈ s := P.part_nonempty.1 ⟨a, h⟩
    refine ⟨_, ?_, h, ?_⟩ <;> simp [this]
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, hap, hbp⟩
    obtain rfl : P.part b = p := P.part_eq_of_mem hp hbp
    exact hap

name: exists_enumeration
statement:
lemma exists_enumeration : ∃ f : s ≃ Σ t : P.parts, Fin #t.1,
    ∀ a b : s, P.part a = P.part b ↔ (f a).1 = (f b).1
proof:
:= by
  use P.equivSigmaParts.trans ((Equiv.refl _).sigmaCongr (fun t ↦ t.1.equivFin))
  simp [equivSigmaParts, Equiv.sigmaCongr, Equiv.sigmaCongrLeft]

name: sum_card_parts
statement: theorem sum_card_parts : ∑ i ∈ P.parts, #i = #s
proof:
:= by
  convert! congr_arg Finset.card P.biUnion_parts
  rw [card_biUnion P.supIndep.pairwiseDisjoint]
  rfl

name: parts_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem parts_bot (s : Finset α) :
    (⊥ : Finpartition s).parts = s.map ⟨singleton, singleton_injective⟩

name: card_bot
statement: theorem card_bot (s : Finset α) : #(⊥ : Finpartition s).parts = #s

name: mem_bot_iff
statement: theorem mem_bot_iff : t ∈ (⊥ : Finpartition s).parts ↔ ∃ a ∈ s, {a} = t

name: card_parts_le_card
statement: theorem card_parts_le_card : #P.parts ≤ #s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← card_bot s]
  exact card_mono bot_le

name: card_mod_card_parts_le
statement: lemma card_mod_card_parts_le : #s % #P.parts ≤ #P.parts
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h := (#P.parts).eq_zero_or_pos
  · rw [h]
    rw [Finset.card_eq_zero, parts_eq_empty_iff, bot_eq_empty, ← Finset.card_eq_zero] at h
    rw [h]
  · exact (Nat.mod_lt _ h).le

name: mem_part_ofSetSetoid_iff_rel
statement:
theorem mem_part_ofSetSetoid_iff_rel {s : Setoid α} (x : Finset α) [DecidableRel s.r] {b : α} :
    b ∈ (ofSetSetoid s x).part a ↔ a ∈ x ∧ b ∈ x ∧ s a b
proof:
:= by
  suffices (∃ a₁ ∈ x, (b ∈ x ∧ s a₁ b) ∧ a ∈ x ∧ s a₁ a) ↔ a ∈ x ∧ b ∈ x ∧ s a b by
    simpa [mem_part_iff_exists, ofSetSetoid_parts]
  exact ⟨
    fun ⟨c, _, ⟨hb, hcb⟩, ⟨ha, hca⟩⟩ ↦ ⟨ha, hb, s.trans' (s.symm' hca) hcb⟩,
    fun h ↦ ⟨a, ⟨h.1, ⟨⟨h.2.1, h.2.2⟩, ⟨h.1, s.refl _⟩⟩⟩⟩
  ⟩

name: mem_part_ofSetoid_iff_rel
statement:
theorem mem_part_ofSetoid_iff_rel {s : Setoid α} [DecidableRel s.r] {b : α} :
    b ∈ (ofSetoid s).part a ↔ s a b
proof:
:= by
  suffices b ∈ (ofSetSetoid s univ).part a ↔ a ∈ univ ∧ b ∈ univ ∧ s a b by simpa
  exact mem_part_ofSetSetoid_iff_rel univ

name: mem_atomise
statement:
theorem mem_atomise :
    t ∈ (atomise s F).parts ↔
      t.Nonempty ∧ ∃ Q ⊆ F, {i ∈ s | ∀ u ∈ F, u ∈ Q ↔ i ∈ u} = t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [atomise, ofErase, bot_eq_empty, mem_erase, mem_image, nonempty_iff_ne_empty,
    mem_powerset]

name: atomise_empty
statement: theorem atomise_empty (hs : s.Nonempty) : (atomise s ∅).parts = {s}
proof:
:= by
  simp only [atomise, powerset_empty, image_singleton, notMem_empty, IsEmpty.forall_iff,
    imp_true_iff, filter_true]
  exact erase_eq_of_notMem (notMem_singleton.2 hs.ne_empty.symm)

name: card_atomise_le
statement: theorem card_atomise_le : #(atomise s F).parts ≤ 2 ^ #F

name: biUnion_filter_atomise
statement:
theorem biUnion_filter_atomise (ht : t ∈ F) (hts : t ⊆ s) :
    {u ∈ (atomise s F).parts | u ⊆ t ∧ u.Nonempty}.biUnion id = t
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  refine mem_biUnion.trans ⟨fun ⟨u, hu, ha⟩ ↦ (mem_filter.1 hu).2.1 ha, fun ha ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hau⟩ := (atomise s F).exists_mem (hts ha)
  refine ⟨u, mem_filter.2 ⟨hu, fun b hb ↦ ?_, _, hau⟩, hau⟩
  obtain ⟨Q, _hQ, rfl⟩ := (mem_atomise.1 hu).2
  rw [mem_filter] at hau hb
  rwa [← hb.2 _ ht, hau.2 _ ht]

name: card_filter_atomise_le_two_pow
statement:
theorem card_filter_atomise_le_two_pow (ht : t ∈ F) :
    #{u ∈ (atomise s F).parts | u ⊆ t ∧ u.Nonempty} ≤ 2 ^ (#F - 1)
proof:
:= by
  suffices h :
    {u ∈ (atomise s F).parts | u ⊆ t ∧ u.Nonempty} ⊆
      (F.erase t).powerset.image fun P ↦ {i ∈ s | ∀ x ∈ F, x ∈ insert t P ↔ i ∈ x} by
    refine (card_le_card h).trans (card_image_le.trans ?_)
    rw [card_powerset, card_erase_of_mem ht]
  rw [subset_iff]
  simp_rw [mem_image, mem_powerset, mem_filter, and_imp, Finset.Nonempty, exists_imp, mem_atomise,
    and_imp, Finset.Nonempty, exists_imp, and_imp]
  rintro P' i hi P PQ rfl hy₂ j _hj
  refine ⟨P.erase t, erase_subset_erase _ PQ, ?_⟩
  simp only [insert_erase (((mem_filter.1 hi).2 _ ht).2 <| hy₂ hi)]

name: coe_parts
statement: @[simp] lemma coe_parts : P.parts = P

name: ext
statement: @[ext] lemma ext (hP : ∀ x, x ∈ P ↔ x ∈ Q) : P = Q

name: sSupIndep
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sSupIndep (P : Partition s) : sSupIndep (P : Set α)

name: disjoint
statement: lemma disjoint (hx : x ∈ P) (hy : y ∈ P) (hxy : x ≠ y) : Disjoint x y

name: pairwiseDisjoint
statement: lemma pairwiseDisjoint : Set.PairwiseDisjoint (P : Set α) id

name: eq_or_disjoint
statement: lemma eq_or_disjoint (hx : x ∈ P) (hy : y ∈ P) : x = y ∨ Disjoint x y

name: eq_of_not_disjoint
statement: lemma eq_of_not_disjoint (hx : x ∈ P) (hy : y ∈ P) (hxy : ¬ Disjoint x y) : x = y

name: sSup_eq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sSup_eq (P : Partition s) : sSup P = s

name: iSup_eq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma iSup_eq (P : Partition s) : ⨆ x ∈ P, x = s

name: le_of_mem
statement: lemma le_of_mem (P : Partition s) (hx : x ∈ P) : x ≤ s

name: parts_nonempty
statement: lemma parts_nonempty (P : Partition s) (hs : s ≠ ⊥) : (P : Set α).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 fun hP ↦ by simp [← P.sSup_eq, hP, sSup_empty] at hs

name: bot_notMem
statement:
@[simp]
lemma bot_notMem (P : Partition s) : ⊥ ∉ P

name: ne_bot_of_mem
statement: lemma ne_bot_of_mem (hx : x ∈ P) : x ≠ ⊥

name: bot_lt_of_mem
statement: lemma bot_lt_of_mem (hx : x ∈ P) : ⊥ < x

name: mem_copy_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_copy_iff (hst : s = t) : x ∈ P.copy hst ↔ x ∈ P

name: mem_removeBot
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_removeBot (P : Set α) (indep : _root_.sSupIndep P) (hsSup : sSup P = s) :
    x ∈ removeBot P indep hsSup ↔ x ∈ P ∧ x ≠ ⊥

name: notMem_of_bot
statement:
@[simp]
lemma notMem_of_bot (P : Partition (⊥ : α)) (x : α) : x ∉ P
proof:
:= by
  rintro hxP
  obtain rfl := le_bot_iff.mp <| P.le_of_mem hxP
  exact P.bot_notMem hxP

name: ne_bot_of_mem'
statement: lemma ne_bot_of_mem' (hxP : x ∈ P) : s ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl
  exact P.notMem_of_bot _ hxP

name: le_def
statement: lemma le_def : P ≤ Q ↔ ∀ x ∈ P, ∃ y ∈ Q, x ≤ y

name: exists_le_of_mem_le
statement: lemma exists_le_of_mem_le (h : P ≤ Q) (hx : x ∈ P) : ∃ y ∈ Q, x ≤ y

name: existsUnique_of_mem_le
statement: lemma existsUnique_of_mem_le (h : P ≤ Q) (hx : x ∈ P) : ∃! y ∈ Q, x ≤ y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := h hx
  refine ⟨y, ⟨hy, hxy⟩, fun z ⟨hz, hxz⟩ ↦ Q.eq_of_not_disjoint hz hy ?_⟩
  have := P.ne_bot_of_mem hx
  contrapose this
  exact le_bot_iff.mp (this hxz hxy)

name: top_def
statement: lemma top_def : (⊤ : Partition s) = removeBot {s} (sSupIndep_singleton s) sSup_singleton

name: parts_top
statement: @[simp] lemma parts_top (hs : s ≠ ⊥) : ((⊤ : Partition s) : Set α) = {s}

name: mem_top_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma mem_top_iff {a : α} : a ∈ (⊤ : Partition s) ↔ a = s ∧ a ≠ ⊥

name: parts_top_subset
statement: lemma parts_top_subset : ((⊤ : Partition s) : Set α) ⊆ {s}

name: mem_inf_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_inf_iff {α : Type*} [Order.Frame α] {s a : α} {P Q : Partition s} :
    a ∈ P ⊓ Q ↔ a ≠ ⊥ ∧ ∃ p ∈ P, ∃ q ∈ Q, a = p ⊓ q

name: sUnion_eq
statement: @[simp] protected lemma sUnion_eq (P : Partition s) : ⋃₀ P = s

name: nonempty_of_mem
statement: lemma nonempty_of_mem (ht : t ∈ P) : t.Nonempty

name: empty_notMem
statement: lemma empty_notMem : ∅ ∉ P

name: subset_of_mem
statement: lemma subset_of_mem (ht : t ∈ P) : t ⊆ u

name: mem_iff_exists
statement: lemma mem_iff_exists : x ∈ u ↔ ∃ t ∈ P, x ∈ t
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hx ↦ ?_, fun ⟨t, htP, hxt⟩ ↦ subset_of_mem htP hxt⟩
  rwa [← P.sUnion_eq, mem_sUnion] at hx

name: eq_of_mem_inter
statement: lemma eq_of_mem_inter (ht : t ∈ P) (hs : s ∈ P) (hx : x ∈ t ∩ s) : t = s
proof:
:=
  P.pairwiseDisjoint.elim ht hs fun (hdj : Disjoint t s) ↦ by simp [hdj.inter_eq] at hx

name: eq_of_mem_of_mem
statement: lemma eq_of_mem_of_mem (ht : t ∈ P) (hus : s ∈ P) (hxt : x ∈ t) (hxs : x ∈ s) : t = s

name: mem_iff_unique
statement: lemma mem_iff_unique : x ∈ u ↔ ∃! t, t ∈ P ∧ x ∈ t
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hx ↦ ?_, fun ⟨_, ⟨htP, hxt⟩, _⟩ ↦ subset_of_mem htP hxt⟩
  rw [← P.sUnion_eq, mem_sUnion] at hx
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hxt⟩ := hx
  exact ⟨t, ⟨ht, hxt⟩, fun s ⟨hsP, hxs⟩ ↦ P.eq_of_mem_of_mem hsP ht hxs hxt⟩

name: subset_sUnion_and_mem_iff_mem
statement: lemma subset_sUnion_and_mem_iff_mem (hSP : S ⊆ P) : t ⊆ ⋃₀ S ∧ t ∈ P ↔ t ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨htsu, htP⟩ ↦ ?_, fun htS ↦ ⟨subset_sUnion_of_mem htS, hSP htS⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hxt⟩ := nonempty_of_mem htP
  obtain ⟨s, hsS, hxs⟩ := htsu hxt
  exact eq_of_mem_of_mem htP (hSP hsS) hxt hxs ▸ hsS

name: subset_sUnion_iff_mem
statement: lemma subset_sUnion_iff_mem (ht : t ∈ P) (hSP : S ⊆ P.parts) : t ⊆ ⋃₀ S ↔ t ∈ S

name: rep_mem
statement: @[simp] lemma rep_mem (ht : t ∈ P) : P.rep ht ∈ t

name: rep_mem_supp
statement: @[simp] lemma rep_mem_supp (ht : t ∈ P) : P.rep ht ∈ u

name: rel_le_iff_le
statement: lemma rel_le_iff_le : P.Rel ≤ Q.Rel ↔ P ≤ Q
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h S hS ↦ ?_, fun h a b ⟨t, ht, ha, hb⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨x, hxS⟩ := nonempty_of_mem hS
    obtain ⟨T, hT, hxT, -⟩ := h x x ⟨S, hS, hxS, hxS⟩
    refine ⟨T, hT, fun a haS ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨T', hT', haT', hxT'⟩ := h a x ⟨S, hS, haS, hxS⟩
    exact eq_of_mem_of_mem hT hT' hxT hxT' ▸ haT'
  obtain ⟨t', ht', htt'⟩ := h ht
  use t', ht', htt' ha, htt' hb

name: Rel.exists
statement: lemma Rel.exists (h : P.Rel x y) : ∃ t ∈ P, x ∈ t ∧ y ∈ t

name: Rel.forall
statement: lemma Rel.forall (h : P.Rel x y) (ht : t ∈ P) : x ∈ t ↔ y ∈ t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht', hx, hy⟩ := h
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ by rwa [P.eq_of_mem_of_mem ht ht' h hx],
    fun h ↦ by rwa [P.eq_of_mem_of_mem ht ht' h hy]⟩

name: rel_rfl_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma rel_rfl_iff : P.Rel x x ↔ x ∈ u
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨t, ht, hxP, _⟩ ↦ subset_of_mem ht hxP, fun hx ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ⟨ht, hxt⟩, -⟩ := P.mem_iff_unique.mp hx
  exact ⟨t, ht, hxt, hxt⟩

name: Rel.symm
statement: @[symm] lemma Rel.symm (h : P.Rel x y) : P.Rel y x

name: rel_comm
statement: lemma rel_comm : P.Rel x y ↔ P.Rel y x

name: Rel.trans
statement: lemma Rel.trans (hxy : P.Rel x y) (hyz : P.Rel y z) : P.Rel x z

name: Rel.left_mem
statement: lemma Rel.left_mem (h : P.Rel x y) : x ∈ u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, htP, hxt, -⟩ := h
  exact subset_of_mem htP hxt

name: Rel.right_mem
statement: lemma Rel.right_mem (h : P.Rel x y) : y ∈ u

name: rep_rel
statement: lemma rep_rel (ht : t ∈ P) (hx : x ∈ t) : P.Rel x (P.rep ht)

name: partOf_subset
statement: lemma partOf_subset : P.partOf x ⊆ u
proof: := fun _ ⟨_, ht, _, hyt⟩ ↦ subset_of_mem ht hyt

name: mem_partOf_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma mem_partOf_iff : x ∈ P.partOf y ↔ P.Rel y x

name: eq_partOf_of_mem
statement: lemma eq_partOf_of_mem (ht : t ∈ P) (hxt : x ∈ t) : t = P.partOf x
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  exact ⟨(⟨t, ht, hxt, ·⟩), fun ⟨s, hsP, hxs, hys⟩ ↦ (P.eq_of_mem_of_mem ht hsP hxt hxs) ▸ hys⟩

name: mem_iff_mem_partOf_mem
statement: lemma mem_iff_mem_partOf_mem : x ∈ u ↔ x ∈ P.partOf x ∧ P.partOf x ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hx ↦ ?_, fun ⟨hx, hP⟩ ↦ subset_of_mem hP hx⟩
  obtain ⟨t, htP, hxt⟩ := P.mem_iff_exists.mp hx
  exact P.eq_partOf_of_mem htP hxt ▸ ⟨hxt, htP⟩

name: mem_partOf
statement: lemma mem_partOf (hxu : x ∈ u) : x ∈ P.partOf x

name: partOf_mem
statement: lemma partOf_mem (hxu : x ∈ u) : P.partOf x ∈ P

name: partOf_rep
statement:
@[simp]
lemma partOf_rep (hs : s ∈ P) : P.partOf (P.rep hs) = s

name: mem_iff_exists_partOf
statement: lemma mem_iff_exists_partOf : s ∈ P ↔ ∃ x ∈ u, partOf P x = s
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hs ↦ ⟨P.rep hs, rep_mem_supp hs, partOf_rep hs⟩, fun ⟨_, hxu, h⟩ ↦ h ▸ partOf_mem hxu⟩

name: partOf_nonempty_iff
statement: lemma partOf_nonempty_iff : (P.partOf x).Nonempty ↔ x ∈ u
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨y, hy⟩ ↦ hy.left_mem, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  simpa [nonempty_iff_ne_empty] using P.ne_bot_of_mem (partOf_mem h)

name: partOf_eq_empty_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma partOf_eq_empty_iff : P.partOf x = ∅ ↔ x ∉ u

name: rel_iff_partOf_eq_partOf_of_mem
statement:
lemma rel_iff_partOf_eq_partOf_of_mem (P : Partition u) (hx : x ∈ u) (hy : y ∈ u) :
    P.Rel x y ↔ P.partOf x = P.partOf y
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨t, htP, hxt, hyt⟩ ↦ eq_partOf_of_mem (P.partOf_mem hx) ?_,
    fun h ↦ ⟨P.partOf x, P.partOf_mem hx, P.mem_partOf hx, h ▸ mem_partOf hy⟩⟩
  rwa [← eq_partOf_of_mem htP hxt]

name: rel_iff_partOf_eq_partOf
statement:
lemma rel_iff_partOf_eq_partOf (P : Partition u) :
    P.Rel x y ↔ ∃ (_ : x ∈ u) (_ : y ∈ u), P.partOf x = P.partOf y

name: apply_mem
statement: lemma apply_mem (hf : IsRepFun P f) (ha : a ∈ u) : f a ∈ u

name: image_subset
statement: lemma image_subset (hf : IsRepFun P f) (hs : u ⊆ s) : f '' s ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨a, haS, rfl⟩
  by_cases ha : a ∈ u
  · exact hs <| hf.apply_mem ha
  exact (hf.apply_of_notMem ha).symm ▸ haS

name: mapsTo
statement: lemma mapsTo (hf : IsRepFun P f) (hs : u ⊆ s) : Set.MapsTo f s s
proof:
:=
  fun x h ↦ hf.image_subset hs ⟨x, h, rfl⟩

name: mapsTo_of_disjoint
statement: lemma mapsTo_of_disjoint (hf : IsRepFun P f) (hs : Disjoint u s) : Set.MapsTo f s s

name: apply_mem_iff
statement: lemma apply_mem_iff (hf : IsRepFun P f) (hs : u ⊆ s) : f a ∈ s ↔ a ∈ s

name: apply_eq_apply_iff_rel
statement: lemma apply_eq_apply_iff_rel (hf : IsRepFun P f) (ha : a ∈ u) : f a = f b ↔ P.Rel a b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hab ↦ (hf.rel_apply ha).trans ?_, (hf.apply_eq_apply ·)⟩
  rw [hab, P.rel_comm]
  refine hf.rel_apply <| by_contra fun hb ↦ ?_
  rw [hf.apply_of_notMem hb] at hab
  exact hab ▸ hb <| hf.apply_mem ha

name: apply_eq_apply_iff
statement: lemma apply_eq_apply_iff (hf : IsRepFun P f) : f a = f b ↔ a = b ∨ P.Rel a b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [or_iff_not_imp_left, ← ne_eq]
  refine ⟨fun hab hne ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain (ha | ha) := em (a ∈ u)
    · exact hf.apply_eq_apply_iff_rel ha |>.mp hab
    obtain (hb | hb) := em (b ∈ u)
    · exact (hf.apply_eq_apply_iff_rel hb |>.mp hab.symm).symm
    rw [hf.apply_of_notMem ha, hf.apply_of_notMem hb] at hab
    contradiction
  obtain rfl | hne := eq_or_ne a b
  · rfl
  exact hf.apply_eq_apply (h hne)

name: forall_apply_eq_apply_iff
statement:
lemma forall_apply_eq_apply_iff (hf : IsRepFun P f) (a) :
    (∀ (x : α), f a = f x ↔ a = x) ∨ (∀ (x : α), f a = f x ↔ P.Rel a x)
proof:
:= by
  refine (em (a ∈ u)).elim (fun ha ↦ Or.inr fun b ↦ ?_) (fun ha ↦ Or.inl fun b ↦ ?_)
  · rw [hf.apply_eq_apply_iff_rel ha]
  rw [hf.apply_of_notMem ha]
  constructor <;> rintro rfl
  · exact hf.apply_of_notMem <| hf.apply_mem_iff le_rfl |>.not.mp ha
  exact hf.apply_of_notMem ha |>.symm

name: apply_eq_apply_iff'
statement:
lemma apply_eq_apply_iff' (hf : IsRepFun P f) :
    f a = f b ↔ (a = b ∧ ∀ c, f a = f c ↔ a = c) ∨ P.Rel a b
proof:
:= by
  obtain h1 | h2 := hf.forall_apply_eq_apply_iff a
  · refine ⟨by grind, ?_⟩
    rintro (h | h)
    · exact congrArg _ h.1
    exact hf.apply_eq_apply h
  grind

name: idem
statement: lemma idem (hf : IsRepFun P f) : f (f a) = f a
proof:
:= by
  obtain (ha | ha) := em (a ∈ u)
  · rw [eq_comm, hf.apply_eq_apply_iff_rel ha]
    exact hf.rel_apply ha
  simp_rw [hf.apply_of_notMem ha]

name: apply_apply
statement: theorem apply_apply (hf : IsRepFun P f) (hg : IsRepFun P g) (x : α) : f (g x) = f x
proof:
:= by
  obtain (hx | hx) := em (x ∈ u)
  · exact hf.apply_eq_apply (hg.rel_apply hx).symm
  rw [hg.apply_of_notMem hx, hf.apply_of_notMem hx]

name: exists_extend_partial
statement:
lemma exists_extend_partial (P : Partition u) (f₀ : t → α)
    (h_notMem : ∀ x : t, x.1 ∉ u → f₀ x = x) (h_mem : ∀ x : t, x.1 ∈ u → P.Rel x (f₀ x))
    (h_eq : ∀ x y : t, P.Rel x y → f₀ x = f₀ y) : ∃ f, IsRepFun P f ∧ ∀ x : t, f x = f₀ x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set f : α → α := fun a ↦ if ha : a ∈ u then
    (if hb : ∃ b : t, P.Rel a b then f₀ hb.choose else P.rep (P.partOf_mem ha)) else a with hfdef
  refine ⟨f, ⟨fun a ha ↦ by simp [hfdef, ha], fun a ha ↦ ?_, fun a b hab ↦ ?_⟩, fun a ↦ ?_⟩
  · simp only [hfdef, ha, ↓reduceDIte]
    split_ifs with h
    · exact h.choose_spec.trans <| h_mem h.choose h.choose_spec.right_mem
    push Not at h
    exact P.rep_rel (P.partOf_mem ha) (P.mem_partOf ha)
  · simp_rw [hfdef, dite_eq_left hab.left_mem, dite_eq_left hab.right_mem]
    split_ifs with h₁ h₂ h₂
    · exact h_eq _ _ <| (hab.symm.trans h₁.choose_spec).symm.trans h₂.choose_spec
    · exact h₂ ⟨_, hab.symm.trans h₁.choose_spec⟩ |>.elim
    · exact h₁ ⟨_, hab.trans h₂.choose_spec⟩ |>.elim
    congr 1
    rwa [← rel_iff_partOf_eq_partOf_of_mem _ hab.left_mem hab.right_mem]
  obtain (ha | ha) := em (a.1 ∈ u) |>.symm
  · simp [hfdef, ha, h_notMem _ ha]
  simp only [hfdef, ha, ↓reduceDIte]
  split_ifs with h
  · exact h_eq _ _ h.choose_spec |>.symm
  exact h ⟨a, rel_rfl_iff.mpr ha⟩ |>.elim

name: exists_extend_partial'
statement:
lemma exists_extend_partial' (P : Partition u)
    (h : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, x ∈ t → y ∈ t → P.Rel x y → x = y) : ∃ f, IsRepFun P f ∧ EqOn f id t
proof:
:= by
  simpa using! exists_extend_partial P (fun x : t ↦ x) (by simp) (by simp) (fun x y ↦ h x.2 y.2)

name: nonempty
statement: lemma nonempty (P : Partition u) : ∃ f, IsRepFun P f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, -⟩ := exists_extend_partial' P (t := ∅) (by simp)
  exact ⟨f, hf⟩

name: isEquipartition_iff_card_parts_eq_average
statement:
theorem isEquipartition_iff_card_parts_eq_average :
    P.IsEquipartition ↔
      ∀ a : Finset α, a ∈ P.parts → #a = #s / #P.parts ∨ #a = #s / #P.parts + 1

name: not_isEquipartition
statement:
lemma not_isEquipartition :
    ¬P.IsEquipartition ↔ ∃ a ∈ P.parts, ∃ b ∈ P.parts, #b + 1 < #a

name: _root_.Set.Subsingleton.isEquipartition
statement:
theorem _root_.Set.Subsingleton.isEquipartition (h : (P.parts : Set (Finset α)).Subsingleton) :
    P.IsEquipartition

name: IsEquipartition.card_parts_eq_average
statement:
theorem IsEquipartition.card_parts_eq_average (hP : P.IsEquipartition) (ht : t ∈ P.parts) :
    #t = #s / #P.parts ∨ #t = #s / #P.parts + 1

name: IsEquipartition.card_part_eq_average_iff
statement:
theorem IsEquipartition.card_part_eq_average_iff (hP : P.IsEquipartition) (ht : t ∈ P.parts) :
    #t = #s / #P.parts ↔ #t ≠ #s / #P.parts + 1
proof:
:= by
  have a := hP.card_parts_eq_average ht
  lia

name: IsEquipartition.average_le_card_part
statement:
theorem IsEquipartition.average_le_card_part (hP : P.IsEquipartition) (ht : t ∈ P.parts) :
    #s / #P.parts ≤ #t
proof:
:= by
  rw [← P.sum_card_parts]
  exact Finset.EquitableOn.le hP ht

name: IsEquipartition.card_part_le_average_add_one
statement:
theorem IsEquipartition.card_part_le_average_add_one (hP : P.IsEquipartition) (ht : t ∈ P.parts) :
    #t ≤ #s / #P.parts + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← P.sum_card_parts]
  exact Finset.EquitableOn.le_add_one hP ht

name: IsEquipartition.filter_ne_average_add_one_eq_average
statement:
theorem IsEquipartition.filter_ne_average_add_one_eq_average (hP : P.IsEquipartition) :
    {p ∈ P.parts | ¬#p = #s / #P.parts + 1} = {p ∈ P.parts | #p = #s / #P.parts}
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp only [mem_filter, and_congr_right_iff]
  exact fun hp ↦ (hP.card_part_eq_average_iff hp).symm

name: IsEquipartition.card_large_parts_eq_mod
statement:
theorem IsEquipartition.card_large_parts_eq_mod (hP : P.IsEquipartition) :
    #{p ∈ P.parts | #p = #s / #P.parts + 1} = #s % #P.parts
proof:
:= by
  have z := P.sum_card_parts
  rw [← sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (s := P.parts) (p := fun x ↦ #x = #s / #P.parts + 1),
    hP.filter_ne_average_add_one_eq_average, sum_const_nat (m := #s / #P.parts + 1) (by simp),
    sum_const_nat (m := #s / #P.parts) (by simp), ← hP.filter_ne_average_add_one_eq_average,
    mul_add, add_comm, ← add_assoc, ← add_mul, mul_one, add_comm #_,
    card_filter_add_card_filter_not, add_comm] at z
  rw [← add_left_inj, Nat.mod_add_div, z]

name: IsEquipartition.card_small_parts_eq_mod
statement:
theorem IsEquipartition.card_small_parts_eq_mod (hP : P.IsEquipartition) :
    #{p ∈ P.parts | #p = #s / #P.parts} = #P.parts - #s % #P.parts
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs =>
    arg 1
    rw [← card_filter_add_card_filter_not (p := fun p ↦ #p = #s / #P.parts + 1)]
  rw [hP.card_large_parts_eq_mod, add_tsub_cancel_left, hP.filter_ne_average_add_one_eq_average]

name: IsEquipartition.exists_partsEquiv
statement:
theorem IsEquipartition.exists_partsEquiv (hP : P.IsEquipartition) :
    ∃ f : P.parts ≃ Fin #P.parts, ∀ t, #t.1 = #s / #P.parts + 1 ↔ f t < #s % #P.parts
proof:
:= by
  let el := {p ∈ P.parts | #p = #s / #P.parts + 1}.equivFin
  let es := {p ∈ P.parts | #p = #s / #P.parts}.equivFin
  simp_rw [mem_filter, hP.card_large_parts_eq_mod] at el
  simp_rw [mem_filter, hP.card_small_parts_eq_mod] at es
  let sneg :
      {x // x ∈ P.parts ∧ ¬#x = #s / #P.parts + 1} ≃ {x // x ∈ P.parts ∧ #x = #s / #P.parts} := by
    apply (Equiv.refl _).subtypeEquiv
    simp only [Equiv.refl_apply, and_congr_right_iff]
    exact fun _ ha ↦ by rw [hP.card_part_eq_average_iff ha, ne_eq]
  replace el : { x : P.parts // #x.1 = #s / #P.parts + 1 } ≃
      Fin (#s % #P.parts) := (Equiv.Set.sep ..).symm.trans el
  replace es : { x : P.parts // ¬#x.1 = #s / #P.parts + 1 } ≃
      Fin (#P.parts - #s % #P.parts) := (Equiv.Set.sep ..).symm.trans (sneg.trans es)
  let f := (Equiv.sumCompl _).symm.trans ((el.sumCongr es).trans finSumFinEquiv)
  use f.trans (finCongr (Nat.add_sub_of_le P.card_mod_card_parts_le))
  intro ⟨p, _⟩
  simp_rw [f, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.sumCongr_apply, finCongr_apply, Fin.val_cast]
  by_cases hc : #p = #s / #P.parts + 1 <;> simp [hc]

name: IsEquipartition.exists_partPreservingEquiv
statement:
theorem IsEquipartition.exists_partPreservingEquiv (hP : P.IsEquipartition) : ∃ f : s ≃ Fin #s,
    ∀ a b : s, P.part a = P.part b ↔ f a % #P.parts = f b % #P.parts
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := P.exists_enumeration
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hP.exists_partsEquiv
  let z := fun a ↦ #P.parts * (f a).2 + g (f a).1
  have gl := fun a ↦ (g (f a).1).2
  have less : ∀ a, z a < #s := fun a ↦ by
    rcases hP.card_parts_eq_average (f a).1.2 with (c | c)
    · calc
        _ < #P.parts * ((f a).2 + 1) := by simp only [z, mul_add_one]; gcongr; exact gl a
        _ ≤ #P.parts * (#s / #P.parts) := by gcongr; exact c ▸ (f a).2.2
        _ ≤ #P.parts * (#s / #P.parts) + #s % #P.parts := Nat.le_add_right ..
        _ = _ := Nat.div_add_mod ..
    · rw [← Nat.div_add_mod #s #P.parts]
      exact add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_right (by lia) _) ((hg (f a).1).mp c)
  let z' : s → Fin #s := fun a ↦ ⟨z a, less a⟩
  have bij : z'.Bijective := by
    refine (bijective_iff_injective_and_card z').mpr ⟨fun a b e ↦ ?_, by simp⟩
    simp_rw [z', z, Fin.mk.injEq, mul_comm #P.parts] at e
    have : NeZero #P.parts := ⟨((Nat.zero_le _).trans_lt (gl a)).ne'⟩
    change (#P.parts).divModEquiv.symm (_, _) = (#P.parts).divModEquiv.symm (_, _) at e
    simp only [Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq, Prod.mk.injEq] at e
    apply_fun f
    exact Sigma.ext e.2 <| (Fin.heq_ext_iff (by rw [e.2])).mpr e.1
  use Equiv.ofBijective _ bij
  intro a b
  simp_rw [z', z, Equiv.ofBijective_apply, hf a b, Nat.mul_add_mod,
    Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (gl a), Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (gl b), Fin.val_eq_val, g.apply_eq_iff_eq]

name: bot_isEquipartition
statement: theorem bot_isEquipartition : (⊥ : Finpartition s).IsEquipartition

name: top_isEquipartition
statement: theorem top_isEquipartition [Decidable (s = ∅)] : (⊤ : Finpartition s).IsEquipartition

name: indiscrete_isEquipartition
statement: theorem indiscrete_isEquipartition {hs : s ≠ ∅} : (indiscrete hs).IsEquipartition
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsEquipartition, indiscrete_parts, coe_singleton]
  exact Set.equitableOn_singleton s _

  have : ChainClosure r (⋃₀ ∅) := ChainClosure.union fun a h => (notMem_empty _ h).elim

name: chainClosure_succ_total_aux
proof:
:= by
  induction hc₁ with
  | @succ c₃ hc₃ ih =>
    obtain ih | ih := ih
    · exact Or.inl (ih.trans subset_succChain)
    · exact (h hc₃ ih).imp_left fun (h : c₂ = c₃) => h ▸ Subset.rfl
  | union _ ih =>
    refine or_iff_not_imp_left.2 fun hn => sUnion_subset fun a ha => ?_
    exact (ih a ha).resolve_left fun h => hn <| h.trans <| subset_sUnion_of_mem ha

name: chainClosure_succ_total
statement:
private lemma chainClosure_succ_total (hc₁ : ChainClosure r c₁) (hc₂ : ChainClosure r c₂)
    (h : c₁ ⊆ c₂) : c₂ = c₁ ∨ SuccChain r c₁ ⊆ c₂
proof:
:= by
  induction hc₂ generalizing c₁ hc₁ with
  | succ _ ih =>
    refine ((chainClosure_succ_total_aux hc₁) fun c₁ => ih).imp h.antisymm' fun h₁ => ?_
    obtain rfl | h₂ := ih hc₁ h₁
    · exact Subset.rfl
    · exact h₂.trans subset_succChain
  | union _ ih =>
    apply Or.imp_left h.antisymm'
    apply by_contradiction
    simp only [sUnion_subset_iff, not_or, not_forall, exists_prop, and_imp, forall_exists_index]
    intro c₃ hc₃ h₁ h₂
    obtain h | h := chainClosure_succ_total_aux hc₁ fun c₄ => ih _ hc₃
    · exact h₁ (subset_succChain.trans h)
    obtain h' | h' := ih c₃ hc₃ hc₁ h
    · exact h₁ h'.subset
    · exact h₂ (h'.trans <| subset_sUnion_of_mem hc₃)

name: ChainClosure.total
statement:
lemma ChainClosure.total (hc₁ : ChainClosure r c₁) (hc₂ : ChainClosure r c₂) :
    c₁ ⊆ c₂ ∨ c₂ ⊆ c₁
proof:
:=
  ((chainClosure_succ_total_aux hc₂) fun _ hc₃ => chainClosure_succ_total hc₃ hc₁).imp_left
    subset_succChain.trans

name: ChainClosure.succ_fixpoint
statement:
lemma ChainClosure.succ_fixpoint (hc₁ : ChainClosure r c₁) (hc₂ : ChainClosure r c₂)
    (hc : SuccChain r c₂ = c₂) : c₁ ⊆ c₂
proof:
:= by
  induction hc₁ with
  | succ hc₁ h => exact (chainClosure_succ_total hc₁ hc₂ h).elim (fun h => h ▸ hc.subset) id
  | union _ ih => exact sUnion_subset ih

name: ChainClosure.succ_fixpoint_iff
statement:
lemma ChainClosure.succ_fixpoint_iff (hc : ChainClosure r c) :
    SuccChain r c = c ↔ c = maxChain r
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => (subset_sUnion_of_mem hc).antisymm <| chainClosure_maxChain.succ_fixpoint hc h,
    fun h => subset_succChain.antisymm' <| (subset_sUnion_of_mem hc.succ).trans h.symm.subset⟩

name: ChainClosure.isChain
statement: lemma ChainClosure.isChain (hc : ChainClosure r c) : IsChain r c
proof:
:= by
  induction hc with
  | succ _ h => exact h.succ
  | union hs h =>
    exact fun c₁ ⟨t₁, ht₁, (hc₁ : c₁ ∈ t₁)⟩ c₂ ⟨t₂, ht₂, (hc₂ : c₂ ∈ t₂)⟩ hneq =>
      ((hs _ ht₁).total <| hs _ ht₂).elim (fun ht => h t₂ ht₂ (ht hc₁) hc₂ hneq) fun ht =>
        h t₁ ht₁ hc₁ (ht hc₂) hneq

name: maxChain_spec
statement: theorem maxChain_spec : IsMaxChain r (maxChain r)
proof:
:=
  by_contradiction fun h =>
    let ⟨_, H⟩ := chainClosure_maxChain.isChain.superChain_succChain h
    H.ne (chainClosure_maxChain.succ_fixpoint_iff.mpr rfl).symm

proof:
:= by
  simp only [Maximal, and_congr_right_iff]
  exact fun _ ↦ ⟨fun h x hxs hx ↦ hxs <| h hx (subset_insert _ _) (mem_insert_self x s),

  mp h

:= ⟨h.prop, fun x hxs hx ↦ by simpa using h.le_of_le hx (erase_subset _ _) hxs⟩
  mpr h := ⟨h.1, fun t ht hts x hxs ↦ by_contra fun hxt ↦

statement:

is smaller than all elements of `s`, and that this is not the case of any `w > b`.
See `csInf_eq_of_forall_ge_of_forall_gt_exists_lt` for a version in conditionally complete

theorem sSup_eq_of_forall_le_of_forall_lt_exists_gt (h₁ : ∀ a ∈ s, a ≤ b)

proof:
:=
  (sSup_le h₁).eq_of_not_lt fun h =>
    let ⟨_, ha, ha'⟩ := h₂ _ h
    ((le_sSup ha).trans_lt ha').false

lemma biSup_lt_eq_iSup {ι : Type*} [LT ι] [NoMaxOrder ι] {f : ι → α} :
    ⨆ (i) (j < i), f j = ⨆ i, f i
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact iSup_le fun _ ↦ iSup₂_le fun _ _ ↦ le_iSup _ _
  · refine iSup_le fun j ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨i, jlt⟩ := exists_gt j
    exact le_iSup_of_le i (le_iSup₂_of_le j jlt le_rfl)

name: biSup_le_eq_iSup
statement:
@[to_dual (dont_translate := ι)]
lemma biSup_le_eq_iSup {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι] {f : ι → α} :
    ⨆ (i) (j ≤ i), f j = ⨆ i, f i
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact iSup_le fun _ ↦ iSup₂_le fun _ _ ↦ le_iSup _ _
  · exact iSup_le fun j ↦ le_iSup_of_le j (le_iSup₂_of_le j le_rfl le_rfl)

name: biSup_gt_eq_iSup
statement:
@[to_dual (dont_translate := ι)]
lemma biSup_gt_eq_iSup {ι : Type*} [LT ι] [NoMinOrder ι] {f : ι → α} :
    ⨆ (i) (j > i), f j = ⨆ i, f i
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact iSup_le fun _ ↦ iSup₂_le fun _ _ ↦ le_iSup _ _
  · refine iSup_le fun j ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨i, jlt⟩ := exists_lt j
    exact le_iSup_of_le i (le_iSup₂_of_le j jlt le_rfl)

name: biSup_ge_eq_iSup
statement:
@[to_dual (dont_translate := ι)]
lemma biSup_ge_eq_iSup {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι] {f : ι → α} : ⨆ (i) (j ≥ i), f j = ⨆ i, f i
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact iSup_le fun _ ↦ iSup₂_le fun _ _ ↦ le_iSup _ _
  · exact iSup_le fun j ↦ le_iSup_of_le j (le_iSup₂_of_le j le_rfl le_rfl)

name: biSup_le_eq_of_monotone
statement:
@[to_dual biInf_ge_eq_of_monotone]
lemma biSup_le_eq_of_monotone [Preorder β] {f : β → α} (hf : Monotone f) (b : β) :
    ⨆ (b' ≤ b), f b' = f b
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (iSup₂_le_iff.2 (fun _ hji ↦ hf hji))
    (le_iSup_of_le b (ge_of_eq (iSup_pos le_rfl)))

name: biInf_le_eq_of_antitone
statement:
@[to_dual biSup_ge_eq_of_antitone]
lemma biInf_le_eq_of_antitone [Preorder β] {f : β → α} (hf : Antitone f) (b : β) :
    ⨅ (b' ≤ b), f b' = f b
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (iInf₂_le_of_le b le_rfl le_rfl)
    (le_iInf₂ fun _ hji ↦ hf hji)

name: iSup_false
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem iSup_false {s : False → α} : iSup s = ⊥

name: iSup_true
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem iSup_true {s : True → α} : iSup s = s trivial

name: iSup_exists
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
theorem iSup_exists {p : ι → Prop} {f : Exists p → α} : ⨆ x, f x = ⨆ (i) (h), f ⟨i, h⟩
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (iSup_le fun ⟨i, h⟩ => @le_iSup₂ _ _ _ _ (fun _ _ => _) i h)
    (iSup₂_le fun _ _ => le_iSup _ _)

name: iSup_and
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem iSup_and {p q : Prop} {s : p ∧ q → α} : iSup s = ⨆ (h₁) (h₂), s ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (iSup_le fun ⟨i, h⟩ => @le_iSup₂ _ _ _ _ (fun _ _ => _) i h)
    (iSup₂_le fun _ _ => le_iSup _ _)

name: iSup_and'
statement:
@[to_dual /
useful for rewriting into an infimum over a conjunction. -/]
theorem iSup_and' {p q : Prop} {s : p → q → α} :
    ⨆ (h₁ : p) (h₂ : q), s h₁ h₂ = ⨆ h : p ∧ q, s h.1 h.2

name: iSup_or
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem iSup_or {p q : Prop} {s : p ∨ q → α} :
    ⨆ x, s x = (⨆ i, s (Or.inl i)) ⊔ ⨆ j, s (Or.inr j)
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm
    (iSup_le fun i =>
      match i with
      | Or.inl _ => le_sup_of_le_left <| le_iSup (fun _ => s _) _
      | Or.inr _ => le_sup_of_le_right <| le_iSup (fun _ => s _) _)
    (sup_le (iSup_comp_le _ _) (iSup_comp_le _ _))

name: iSup_dite
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem iSup_dite (f : ∀ i, p i → α) (g : ∀ i, ¬p i → α) :
    ⨆ i, (if h : p i then f i h else g i h) = (⨆ (i) (h : p i), f i h) ⊔ ⨆ (i) (h : ¬p i),
    g i h
proof:
:= by
  rw [← iSup_sup_eq]
  congr 1 with i
  split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]

name: iSup_ite

theorem iSup_ite (f g : ι → α) :

theorem iSup_range {g : β → α} {f : ι → β} : ⨆ b ∈ range f, g b = ⨆ i, g (f i)

name: iSup_split
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem iSup_split (f : β → α) (p : β → Prop) :

name: iSup_split_single
statement:

theorem iSup_split_single (f : β → α) (i₀ : β) : ⨆ i, f i = f i₀ ⊔ ⨆ (i) (_ : i ≠ i₀), f i

name: iSup_image
statement:

theorem iSup_image {γ} {f : β → γ} {g : γ → α} {t : Set β} :

name: iSup_extend_bot

theorem iSup_extend_bot {e : ι → β} (he : Injective e) (f : ι → α) :

proof:

proof:

name: biSup_le_eq_sup
statement:
@[to_dual (dont_translate := ι)]
theorem biSup_le_eq_sup : (⨆ j ≤ i, f j) = (⨆ j < i, f j) ⊔ f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [iSup_split_single _ i]
  
  simp only [le_refl, iSup_pos, iSup_and', lt_iff_le_and_ne, and_comm, sup_comm]

  simp only [ge_iff_le, le_refl, iSup_pos, ne_comm, iSup_and', gt_iff_lt, lt_iff_le_and_ne,
    and_comm]

name: iSup_ne_bot_subtype
statement:
@[to_dual /
can be dropped, without changing the result. -/, simp]
theorem iSup_ne_bot_subtype (f : ι → α) : ⨆ i : { i // f i ≠ ⊥ }, f i = ⨆ i, f i
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! htriv : ∀ i, f i = ⊥
  · simp only [iSup_bot, (funext htriv : f = _)]
  refine (iSup_comp_le f _).antisymm (iSup_mono' fun i => ?_)
  by_cases hi : f i = ⊥
  · rw [hi]
    obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := htriv
    exact ⟨⟨i₀, hi₀⟩, bot_le⟩
  · exact ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, rfl.le⟩

proof:
:= by

  · by_contra! hs

    exact ha.2.not_ge (sInf_apply_le he ha.1)
  · by_contra! hs
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hs

name: isLUB_sSup

  · by_contra! hs

    exact ha.2.not_ge (le_sSup_apply he fun j hj ↦ (ha.1 j hj).symm)
  · by_contra! hs

name: isCompactElement_iff_le_of_directed_sSup_le
statement:
theorem isCompactElement_iff_le_of_directed_sSup_le (k : α) :
    IsCompactElement k ↔
      ∀ s : Set α, s.Nonempty → DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) s → k ≤ sSup s → ∃ x : α, x ∈ s ∧ k ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hk s hs hs' h_le
    exact hk s (sSup s) hs hs' (isLUB_sSup s) h_le
  · intro h s u hs hs' hu h_le
    rw [isLUB_iff_sSup_eq] at hu
    rw [← hu] at h_le
    exact h s hs hs' h_le

name: isCompactElement_iff_exists_le_sSup_of_le_sSup
statement:
theorem isCompactElement_iff_exists_le_sSup_of_le_sSup (k : α) :
    IsCompactElement k ↔ ∀ s : Set α, k ≤ sSup s → ∃ t : Finset α, ↑t ⊆ s ∧ k ≤ t.sup id
proof:
:= by
  classical
    rw [isCompactElement_iff_le_of_directed_sSup_le]
    constructor
    · intro hk s hsup
      
      let S : Set α := { x | ∃ t : Finset α, ↑t ⊆ s ∧ x = t.sup id }
      
      have dir_US : DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) S := by
        rintro x ⟨c, hc⟩ y ⟨d, hd⟩
        use x ⊔ y
        constructor
        · use c ∪ d
          constructor
          · simp only [hc.left, hd.left, Set.union_subset_iff, Finset.coe_union, and_self_iff]
          · simp only [hc.right, hd.right, Finset.sup_union]
        simp only [and_self_iff, le_sup_left, le_sup_right]
      have sup_S : sSup s ≤ sSup S := by
        apply sSup_le_sSup
        intro x hx
        use {x}
        simpa only [and_true, id, Finset.coe_singleton, eq_self_iff_true,
          Finset.sup_singleton, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
      have Sne : S.Nonempty := by
        suffices ⊥ ∈ S from Set.nonempty_of_mem this
        use ∅
        simp
      
      obtain ⟨j, ⟨hjS, hjk⟩⟩ := hk S Sne dir_US (le_trans hsup sup_S)
      obtain ⟨t, ⟨htS, htsup⟩⟩ := hjS
      use t
      exact ⟨htS, by rwa [← htsup]⟩
    · intro hk s hne hdir hsup
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hk s hsup
      
      have t_below_s : ∀ x ∈ t, ∃ y ∈ s, x ≤ y := fun x hxt => ⟨x, ht.left hxt, le_rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨x, ⟨hxs, hsupx⟩⟩ := Finset.sup_le_of_le_directed s hne hdir t t_below_s
      exact ⟨x, ⟨hxs, le_trans ht.right hsupx⟩⟩

name: isCompactElement_iff_exists_le_iSup_of_le_iSup.
statement:
theorem isCompactElement_iff_exists_le_iSup_of_le_iSup.{u} {α : Type u} [CompleteLattice α]
    (k : α) : IsCompactElement k ↔
      ∀ (ι : Type u) (s : ι → α), k ≤ iSup s → ∃ t : Finset ι, k ≤ t.sup s
proof:
:= by
  classical
    rw [isCompactElement_iff_exists_le_sSup_of_le_sSup]
    constructor
    · intro H ι s hs
      obtain ⟨t, ht, ht'⟩ := H (Set.range s) hs
      have : ∀ x : t, ∃ i, s i = x := fun x => ht x.prop
      choose f hf using this
      refine ⟨Finset.univ.image f, ht'.trans ?_⟩
      rw [Finset.sup_le_iff]
      intro b hb
      rw [← show s (f ⟨b, hb⟩) = id b from hf _]
      exact Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_image_of_mem f <| Finset.mem_univ (Subtype.mk b hb))
    · intro H s hs
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ :=
        H s Subtype.val
          (by
            delta iSup
            rwa [Subtype.range_coe])
      refine ⟨t.image Subtype.val, by simp, ht.trans ?_⟩
      rw [Finset.sup_le_iff]
      exact fun x hx => @Finset.le_sup _ _ _ _ _ id _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem Subtype.val hx)

name: IsCompactElement.exists_finset_of_le_iSup
statement:
theorem IsCompactElement.exists_finset_of_le_iSup {k : α} (hk : IsCompactElement k) {ι : Type*}
    (f : ι → α) (h : k ≤ ⨆ i, f i) : ∃ s : Finset ι, k ≤ ⨆ i ∈ s, f i
proof:
:= by
  classical
    rw [isCompactElement_iff_le_of_directed_sSup_le] at hk
    let g : Finset ι → α := fun s => ⨆ i ∈ s, f i
    have h1 : DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) (Set.range g) := by
      rintro - ⟨s, rfl⟩ - ⟨t, rfl⟩
      exact
        ⟨g (s ∪ t), ⟨s ∪ t, rfl⟩, iSup_le_iSup_of_subset Finset.subset_union_left,
          iSup_le_iSup_of_subset Finset.subset_union_right⟩
    have h2 : k ≤ sSup (Set.range g) :=
      h.trans
        (iSup_le fun i =>
          le_sSup_of_le ⟨{i}, rfl⟩
            (le_iSup_of_le i (le_iSup_of_le (Finset.mem_singleton_self i) le_rfl)))
    obtain ⟨-, ⟨s, rfl⟩, hs⟩ := hk (Set.range g) (Set.range_nonempty g) h1 h2
    exact ⟨s, hs⟩

name: IsCompactElement.directed_sSup_lt_of_lt
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCompactElement_iff_le_of_directed_sSup_le] at hk
  by_contra h
  have sSup' : sSup s ≤ k := sSup_le fun s hs => (hbelow s hs).le
  replace sSup : sSup s = k := eq_iff_le_not_lt.mpr ⟨sSup', h⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hxs, hkx⟩ := hk s hemp hdir sSup.symm.le
  obtain hxk := hbelow x hxs
  exact hxk.ne (hxk.le.antisymm hkx)

name: isCompactElement_finsetSup
statement:
theorem isCompactElement_finsetSup {α β : Type*} [CompleteLattice α] {f : β → α} (s : Finset β)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ s, IsCompactElement (f x)) : IsCompactElement (s.sup f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
    simp_rw [isCompactElement_iff_le_of_directed_sSup_le] at ⊢ h
    intro d hemp hdir hsup
    rw [← Function.id_comp f]
    rw [← Finset.sup_image]
    apply Finset.sup_le_of_le_directed d hemp hdir
    rintro x hx
    obtain ⟨p, ⟨hps, rfl⟩⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    specialize h p hps
    specialize h d hemp hdir (le_trans (Finset.le_sup hps) hsup)
    simpa only [exists_prop]

name: IsCompactElement.iSup
statement:
protected lemma IsCompactElement.iSup [Finite ι] (h : ∀ i, IsCompactElement (f i)) :
    IsCompactElement (⨆ i, f i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← iSup_plift_down]
  cases nonempty_fintype (PLift ι)
  simpa [Finset.sup_eq_iSup] using isCompactElement_finsetSup .univ fun i _ ↦ h i.down

statement:

name: WellFoundedGT.isSupFiniteCompact
statement:
theorem WellFoundedGT.isSupFiniteCompact [WellFoundedGT α] :
    IsSupFiniteCompact α
proof:
:= fun s => by
  let S := { x | ∃ t : Finset α, ↑t ⊆ s ∧ t.sup id = x }
  obtain ⟨m, ⟨t, ⟨ht₁, rfl⟩⟩, hm⟩ := wellFounded_gt.has_min S ⟨⊥, ∅, by simp⟩
  refine ⟨t, ht₁, (sSup_le fun y hy => ?_).antisymm ?_⟩
  · classical
    rw [eq_of_le_of_not_lt (Finset.sup_mono (t.subset_insert y))
        (hm _ ⟨insert y t, by simp [Set.insert_subset_iff, hy, ht₁]⟩)]
    simp
  · rw [Finset.sup_id_eq_sSup]
    exact sSup_le_sSup ht₁

name: IsSupFiniteCompact.isSupClosedCompact
statement:
theorem IsSupFiniteCompact.isSupClosedCompact (h : IsSupFiniteCompact α) :
    IsSupClosedCompact α
proof:
:= by
  intro s hne hsc; obtain ⟨t, ht₁, ht₂⟩ := h s; clear h
  rcases t.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | h
  · rw [Finset.sup_empty] at ht₂
    rw [ht₂]
    simp [eq_singleton_bot_of_sSup_eq_bot_of_nonempty ht₂ hne]
  · rw [ht₂]
    exact hsc.finsetSup_mem h ht₁

name: IsSupClosedCompact.wellFoundedGT
statement: theorem IsSupClosedCompact.wellFoundedGT (h : IsSupClosedCompact α) : WellFoundedGT α
proof:
:= by
  rw [wellFoundedGT_iff_monotone_chain_condition']
  intro a
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : sSup (range a) ∈ range a := by
    apply h _ (range_nonempty a)
    rintro x ⟨m, rfl⟩ y ⟨n, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, map_sup a m n⟩
  refine ⟨n, fun m hm ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [hn]
  exact (le_sSup (mem_range_self m)).not_gt

name: isSupFiniteCompact_iff_all_elements_compact
statement:
theorem isSupFiniteCompact_iff_all_elements_compact :
    IsSupFiniteCompact α ↔ ∀ k : α, IsCompactElement k
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isCompactElement_iff_exists_le_sSup_of_le_sSup]
  refine ⟨fun h k s hs => ?_, fun h s => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨t, ⟨hts, htsup⟩⟩ := h s
    use t, hts
    rwa [← htsup]
  · obtain ⟨t, ⟨hts, htsup⟩⟩ := h (sSup s) s (by rfl)
    have : sSup s = t.sup id := by
      suffices t.sup id ≤ sSup s by apply le_antisymm <;> assumption
      simp only [id, Finset.sup_le_iff]
      intro x hx
      exact le_sSup (hts hx)
    exact ⟨t, hts, this⟩

name: wellFoundedGT_characterisations
statement:
theorem wellFoundedGT_characterisations : List.TFAE
    [WellFoundedGT α, IsSupFiniteCompact α, IsSupClosedCompact α, ∀ k : α, IsCompactElement k]
proof:
:= by
  tfae_have 1 → 2 := @WellFoundedGT.isSupFiniteCompact α _
  tfae_have 2 → 3 := IsSupFiniteCompact.isSupClosedCompact
  tfae_have 3 → 1 := IsSupClosedCompact.wellFoundedGT

name: WellFoundedGT.finite_of_sSupIndep
statement:
theorem WellFoundedGT.finite_of_sSupIndep [WellFoundedGT α] {s : Set α}
    (hs : sSupIndep s) : s.Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
    by_contra! contra
    obtain ⟨t, ht₁, ht₂⟩ := WellFoundedGT.isSupFiniteCompact s
    replace contra : ∃ x : α, x ∈ s ∧ x ≠ ⊥ ∧ x ∉ t := by
      have : (s \ (insert ⊥ t : Finset α)).Infinite := contra.sdiff (Finset.finite_toSet _)
      obtain ⟨x, hx₁, hx₂⟩ := this.nonempty
      exact ⟨x, hx₁, by simpa [not_or] using hx₂⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx₀, hx₁, hx₂⟩ := contra
    replace hs : x ⊓ sSup s = ⊥ := by
      have := hs.mono (by simp [ht₁, hx₀, -Set.union_singleton] : ↑t ∪ {x} ≤ s) (by simp : x ∈ _)
      simpa [Disjoint, hx₂, ← t.sup_id_eq_sSup, ← ht₂] using this.eq_bot
    apply hx₁
    rw [← hs, eq_comm, inf_eq_left]
    exact le_sSup hx₀

statement:
theorem WellFoundedLT.finite_of_sSupIndep [WellFoundedLT α] {s : Set α}
    (hs : sSupIndep s) : s.Finite
proof:
:= by
  by_contra inf
  let e := (Infinite.sdiff inf <| finite_singleton ⊥).to_subtype.natEmbedding
  let a n := ⨆ i ≥ n, (e i).1
  have sup_le n : (e n).1 ⊔ a (n + 1) ≤ a n := sup_le_iff.mpr ⟨le_iSup₂_of_le n le_rfl le_rfl,
    iSup₂_le fun i hi ↦ le_iSup₂_of_le i (n.le_succ.trans hi) le_rfl⟩
  have lt n : a (n + 1) < a n := (Disjoint.right_lt_sup_of_left_ne_bot
    ((hs (e n).2.1).mono_right <| iSup₂_le fun i hi ↦ le_sSup ?_) (e n).2.2).trans_le (sup_le n)
  · exact (RelEmbedding.natGT a lt).not_wellFounded wellFounded_lt
  exact ⟨(e i).2.1, fun h ↦ n.lt_succ_self.not_ge <| hi.trans_eq <| e.2 <| Subtype.val_injective h⟩

name: inf_sSup_eq_iSup_inf_sup_finset
statement:
theorem inf_sSup_eq_iSup_inf_sup_finset :
    a ⊓ sSup s = ⨆ (t : Finset α) (_ : ↑t ⊆ s), a ⊓ t.sup id
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm
    (by
      rw [le_iff_compact_le_imp]
      intro c hc hcinf
      rw [isCompactElement_iff_exists_le_sSup_of_le_sSup] at hc
      rw [le_inf_iff] at hcinf
      rcases hc s hcinf.2 with ⟨t, ht1, ht2⟩
      refine (le_inf hcinf.1 ht2).trans ?_
      exact le_iSup₂ (f := fun (t' : Finset α) (ht' : ↑t' ⊆ s) => a ⊓ t'.sup id) t ht1)
    (iSup_le fun t =>
      iSup_le fun h => inf_le_inf_left _ ((Finset.sup_id_eq_sSup t).symm ▸ sSup_le_sSup h))

name: sSupIndep_iff_finite
statement:
theorem sSupIndep_iff_finite {s : Set α} :
    sSupIndep s ↔
      ∀ t : Finset α, ↑t ⊆ s → sSupIndep (↑t : Set α)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hs _ ht => hs.mono ht, fun h a ha => by
    rw [disjoint_iff, inf_sSup_eq_iSup_inf_sup_finset, iSup_eq_bot]
    intro t
    rw [iSup_eq_bot, Finset.sup_id_eq_sSup]
    intro ht
    classical
      have h' := (h (insert a t) ?_ (t.mem_insert_self a)).eq_bot
      · rwa [Finset.coe_insert, Set.insert_sdiff_self_of_notMem] at h'
        exact fun con => ((Set.mem_sdiff a).1 (ht con)).2 (Set.mem_singleton a)
      · rw [Finset.coe_insert, Set.insert_subset_iff]
        exact ⟨ha, Set.Subset.trans ht sdiff_subset⟩⟩

name: iSupIndep_iff_supIndep
statement:
lemma iSupIndep_iff_supIndep {ι : Type*} {f : ι → α} :
    iSupIndep f ↔ ∀ (s : Finset ι), s.SupIndep f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ h.supIndep', fun h ↦ iSupIndep_def'.mpr fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  classical
  have hf : Set.InjOn f {i : ι | f i ≠ ⊥} := by
    by_contra! hf
    simp_all only [Set.InjOn, ne_eq, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_forall]
    obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁, x₂, hx₂, hfeq, hneq⟩ := hf
    specialize h ({x₁, x₂} : Finset ι)
    rw [Finset.supIndep_pair hneq, disjoint_iff, hfeq, inf_idem (f x₂)] at h
    contradiction
  simp_rw [disjoint_iff, inf_sSup_eq_iSup_inf_sup_finset, iSup_eq_bot, ← disjoint_iff]
  intro s hs
  rw [← Finset.sup_erase_bot]
  set t := s.erase ⊥
  replace hf : InjOn f (f ⁻¹' t) := fun i hi j _ hij ↦ by
    refine hf ?_ ?_ hij <;> aesop (add norm simp [t])
  have : (Finset.erase (insert i (t.preimage _ hf)) i).image f = t := by
    ext a
    simp only [Finset.mem_preimage, Finset.mem_erase, ne_eq,
      Finset.erase_insert_eq_erase, Finset.mem_image, t]
    refine ⟨by aesop, fun ⟨ha, has⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := hs has
    exact ⟨j, ⟨hj, ha, has⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [← this, Finset.sup_image]
  specialize h (insert i (t.preimage _ hf))
  rw [Finset.supIndep_iff_disjoint_erase] at h
  exact h i (Finset.mem_insert_self i _)

name: sSupIndep_iUnion_of_directed
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hη : Nonempty η
  · rw [sSupIndep_iff_finite]
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨I, fi, hI⟩ := Set.finite_subset_iUnion t.finite_toSet ht
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hs.finset_le fi.toFinset
    exact (h i).mono
        (Set.Subset.trans hI <| Set.iUnion₂_subset fun j hj => hi j (fi.mem_toFinset.2 hj))
  · rintro a ⟨_, ⟨i, _⟩, _⟩
    exfalso
    exact hη ⟨i⟩

name: iSupIndep_sUnion_of_directed
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_sUnion_of_directed {s : Set (Set α)} (hs : DirectedOn (· ⊆ ·) s)
    (h : ∀ a ∈ s, sSupIndep a) : sSupIndep (⋃₀ s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.sUnion_eq_iUnion]
  exact sSupIndep_iUnion_of_directed hs.directed_val (by simpa using h)

name: disjoint_biSup_of_finite_disjoint_biSup
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [disjoint_iff, iSup_subtype', ← sSup_range, inf_comm, inf_sSup_eq_iSup_inf_sup_finset,
    iSup_eq_bot]
  intro u hu
  obtain ⟨t, ht, ht', htu⟩ : ∃ᵉ (t ⊆ s) (hu : t.Finite), f '' t = u :=
    Set.Finite.exists_subset_finite_image_eq u.finite_toSet <| by rwa [Set.image_eq_range f s]
  replace htu : u.sup id = ⨆ i ∈ t, f i := by
    simp only [Finset.sup_eq_iSup, id_eq, ← Finset.mem_coe, ← htu, iSup_image]
  rw [inf_comm, ← disjoint_iff, htu]
  exact hs t ht ht'

name: iSupIndep.disjoint_biSup_biSup
statement:
lemma iSupIndep.disjoint_biSup_biSup {ι : Type*} [IsModularLattice α]
    {f : ι → α} {s t : Set ι} (hf : iSupIndep f) (hst : Disjoint s t) :
    Disjoint (⨆ i ∈ s, f i) (⨆ i ∈ t, f i)
proof:
:=
  disjoint_biSup_of_finite_disjoint_biSup fun _ h₁ h₂ ↦
    disjoint_biSup_biSup' hf (Set.disjoint_of_subset_left h₁ hst) h₂

name: IsAtom.isCompactElement
statement: lemma IsAtom.isCompactElement (ha : IsAtom a) : IsCompactElement a
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  refine ha.1 ?_
  rw [← sSup_compact_le_eq a, sSup_eq_bot]
  rintro c ⟨hc, hca⟩
  exact (ha.le_iff.1 hca).resolve_right (by rintro rfl; exact h hc)

name: IsCompactElement.exists_finite_isAtom
statement:
lemma IsCompactElement.exists_finite_isAtom (ha : IsCompactElement a) :
    ∃ s : Set α, s.Finite ∧ (∀ b ∈ s, IsAtom b) ∧ sSup s = a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, hts, hat⟩ := (isCompactElement_iff_exists_le_sSup_of_le_sSup a).1 ha
    {b | IsAtom b ∧ b ≤ a} (sSup_atoms_le_eq a).ge
  refine ⟨t, t.finite_toSet, fun b hb ↦ (hts hb).1, (sSup_le fun b hb ↦ (hts hb).2).antisymm ?_⟩
  rwa [← Finset.sup_id_eq_sSup]

name: isCompactElement_iff_exists_finite_isAtom
statement:
lemma isCompactElement_iff_exists_finite_isAtom [IsCompactlyGenerated α] :
    IsCompactElement a ↔ ∃ s : Set α, s.Finite ∧ (∀ b ∈ s, IsAtom b) ∧ sSup s = a where
  mp ha
proof:
:= ha.exists_finite_isAtom
  mpr := by rintro ⟨s, hs, hatom, rfl⟩; exact .sSup hs fun b hb ↦ (hatom b hb).isCompactElement

name: isCompactlyGenerated_of_wellFoundedGT
statement:

name: Iic_coatomic_of_compact_element
statement:
theorem Iic_coatomic_of_compact_element {k : α} (h : IsCompactElement k) :
    IsCoatomic (Set.Iic k)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  rintro ⟨b, hbk⟩
  obtain rfl | H := eq_or_ne b k
  · left; ext; simp only [Set.Iic.coe_top]
  right
  have ⟨a, ba, h⟩ := zorn_le_nonempty₀ (Set.Iio k) ?_ b (lt_of_le_of_ne hbk H)
  · refine ⟨⟨a, le_of_lt h.prop⟩, ⟨ne_of_lt h.prop, fun c hck => by_contradiction fun c₀ => ?_⟩, ba⟩
    cases h.eq_of_le (y := c.1) (lt_of_le_of_ne c.2 fun con ↦ c₀ (Subtype.ext con)) hck.le
    exact lt_irrefl _ hck
  · intro S SC cC I _
    by_cases hS : S.Nonempty
    · refine ⟨sSup S, IsCompactElement.directed_sSup_lt_of_lt h hS cC.directedOn SC, ?_⟩
      intro; apply le_sSup
    exact
      ⟨b, lt_of_le_of_ne hbk H, by
        simp only [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hS, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, forall_const,
          forall_prop_of_false, not_false_iff]⟩

name: iSupIndep.iInf
statement:
theorem iSupIndep.iInf {ι : Type*} {κ : ι → Type*} (f : (i : ι) → κ i → α)
    (h_indep : ∀ i : ι, iSupIndep (f i)) : iSupIndep (fun k : (i : ι) → κ i ↦ ⨅ i, f i (k i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [iSupIndep_iff_supIndep]
  intro s
  induction s using Finset.strongInduction with
  | H s ih =>
    by_cases hs : 1 < s.card; swap
    · by_cases hcard0 : s.card = 0 <;> grind [Finset.card_eq_zero, Finset.card_eq_one]
    · obtain ⟨k₁, k₂, _, _, h⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card_iff.mp hs
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i : ι, k₁ i ≠ k₂ i := Function.ne_iff.mp h
      classical
      rw [← Finset.image_biUnion_filter_eq s (· i)]
      refine Finset.SupIndep.biUnion ?_ (by grind)
      apply ((h_indep i).supIndep' _).mono
      simp_rw [Finset.sup_le_iff, Finset.mem_filter, and_imp]
      rintro _ _ _ _ rfl
      exact iInf_le _ _

name: exists_sSupIndep_disjoint_sSup_atoms
statement:
theorem exists_sSupIndep_disjoint_sSup_atoms (b c : α) (hbc : b ≤ c)
    (h : sSup {a ≤ c | IsAtom a} = c) :
    ∃ s : Set α, sSupIndep s ∧ Disjoint b (sSup s) ∧ b ⊔ sSup s = c ∧ ∀ ⦃a⦄, a ∈ s → IsAtom a
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have zorn := zorn_subset
    (S := {s : Set α | sSupIndep s ∧ Disjoint b (sSup s) ∧ ∀ a ∈ s, IsAtom a ∧ a ≤ c})
    fun c hc1 hc2 =>
      ⟨⋃₀ c,
        ⟨iSupIndep_sUnion_of_directed hc2.directedOn fun s hs => (hc1 hs).1, ?_,
          fun a ⟨s, sc, as⟩ => (hc1 sc).2.2 a as⟩,
        fun _ => Set.subset_sUnion_of_mem⟩
  swap
  · rw [sSup_sUnion, ← sSup_image, DirectedOn.disjoint_sSup_right]
    · rintro _ ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
      exact (hc1 hs).2.1
    · rw [directedOn_image]
      exact hc2.directedOn.mono @fun s t => sSup_le_sSup
  simp_rw [maximal_subset_iff] at zorn
  obtain ⟨s, ⟨s_ind, b_inf_Sup_s, s_atoms⟩, s_max⟩ := zorn
  refine ⟨s, s_ind, b_inf_Sup_s, le_antisymm ?_ ?_, fun a ha ↦ (s_atoms a ha).1⟩
  · simp_all
  rw [← h, sSup_le_iff]
  intro a ha
  rw [← inf_eq_left]
  refine (ha.2.le_iff.mp inf_le_left).resolve_left fun con => ha.2.1 ?_
  rw [← con, eq_comm, inf_eq_left]
  refine (le_sSup ?_).trans le_sup_right
  rw [← disjoint_iff] at con
  have a_dis_Sup_s : Disjoint a (sSup s) := con.mono_right le_sup_right
  rw [s_max ⟨fun x hx => ?_, ?_, fun x hx => ?_⟩ Set.subset_union_left]
  · exact Set.mem_union_right _ (Set.mem_singleton _)
  · rw [sSup_union, sSup_singleton]
    exact b_inf_Sup_s.disjoint_sup_right_of_disjoint_sup_left con.symm
  · rw [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    obtain rfl | xa := eq_or_ne x a
    · simp only [Set.mem_singleton, Set.insert_sdiff_of_mem, Set.union_singleton]
      exact con.mono_right ((sSup_le_sSup Set.sdiff_subset).trans le_sup_right)
    · have h : (s ∪ {a}) \ {x} = s \ {x} ∪ {a} := by
        simp only [Set.union_singleton]
        rw [Set.insert_sdiff_of_notMem]
        rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        exact Ne.symm xa
      rw [h, sSup_union, sSup_singleton]
      apply
        (s_ind (hx.resolve_right xa)).disjoint_sup_right_of_disjoint_sup_left
          (a_dis_Sup_s.mono_right _).symm
      rw [← sSup_insert, Set.insert_sdiff_singleton, Set.insert_eq_of_mem (hx.resolve_right xa)]
  · rw [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    obtain hx | rfl := hx
    · exact s_atoms x hx
    · exact ha.symm

name: exists_sSupIndep_isCompl_sSup_atoms
statement:
theorem exists_sSupIndep_isCompl_sSup_atoms (h : sSup { a : α | IsAtom a } = ⊤) (b : α) :
    ∃ s : Set α, sSupIndep s ∧ IsCompl b (sSup s) ∧ ∀ ⦃a⦄, a ∈ s → IsAtom a
proof:
:= by
  simpa [isCompl_iff, codisjoint_iff, and_assoc]
    using exists_sSupIndep_disjoint_sSup_atoms b ⊤ le_top <| by simpa using h

name: exists_sSupIndep_of_sSup_atoms
statement:
theorem exists_sSupIndep_of_sSup_atoms (b : α) (h : sSup {a ≤ b | IsAtom a} = b) :
    ∃ s : Set α, sSupIndep s ∧ sSup s = b ∧ ∀ ⦃a⦄, a ∈ s → IsAtom a
proof:
:=
  let ⟨s, s_ind, _, s_atoms⟩ := exists_sSupIndep_disjoint_sSup_atoms ⊥ b bot_le h
  ⟨s, s_ind, by simpa using s_atoms⟩

name: complementedLattice_of_sSup_atoms_eq_top
statement:
theorem complementedLattice_of_sSup_atoms_eq_top (h : sSup { a : α | IsAtom a } = ⊤) :
    ComplementedLattice α where
  exists_isCompl b
proof:
:=
    let ⟨s, _, hcompl, _⟩ := exists_sSupIndep_isCompl_sSup_atoms (by simpa) b
    ⟨sSup s, hcompl⟩

name: isCompactElement
statement:
theorem isCompactElement {a : α} {b : Iic a} (h : IsCompactElement (b : α)) :
    IsCompactElement b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [isCompactElement_iff_exists_le_iSup_of_le_iSup, Finset.sup_eq_iSup] at h ⊢
  intro ι s hb
  replace hb : (b : α) ≤ iSup ((↑) ∘ s) := le_trans hb <| (coe_iSup s) ▸ le_refl _
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := h ι ((↑) ∘ s) hb
  exact ⟨t, (by simpa using ht : (b : α) ≤ _)⟩

name: complementedLattice_of_complementedLattice_Iic
statement:
theorem complementedLattice_of_complementedLattice_Iic
    [IsModularLattice α] [IsCompactlyGenerated α]
    {s : Set ι} {f : ι → α}
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, ComplementedLattice <| Iic (f i))
    (h' : ⨆ i ∈ s, f i = ⊤) :
    ComplementedLattice α
proof:
:= by
  apply complementedLattice_of_sSup_atoms_eq_top
  have : ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ t : Set α, f i = sSup t ∧ ∀ a ∈ t, IsAtom a := fun i hi ↦ by
    replace h := complementedLattice_iff_isAtomistic.mp (h i hi)
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hu'⟩ := eq_sSup_atoms (⊤ : Iic (f i))
    refine ⟨(↑) '' u, ?_, ?_⟩
    · replace hu : f i = ↑(sSup u) := Subtype.ext_iff.mp hu
      simp_rw [hu, Iic.coe_sSup]
    · rintro b ⟨⟨a, ha'⟩, ha, rfl⟩
      exact IsAtom.of_isAtom_coe_Iic (hu' _ ha)
  choose t ht ht' using this
  let u : Set α := ⋃ i, ⋃ hi : i ∈ s, t i hi
  have hu₁ : u ⊆ {a | IsAtom a} := by
    rintro a ⟨-, ⟨i, rfl⟩, ⟨-, ⟨hi, rfl⟩, ha : a ∈ t i hi⟩⟩
    exact ht' i hi a ha
  have hu₂ : sSup u = ⨆ i ∈ s, f i := by simp_rw [u, sSup_iUnion, biSup_congr' ht]
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← h', ← hu₂]
  exact sSup_le_sSup hu₁

name: strictMono_of_odd_strictMonoOn_nonneg

name: StrictMonoOn.union
statement:
protected theorem StrictMonoOn.union {s t : Set α} {c : α} (h₁ : StrictMonoOn f s)
    (h₂ : StrictMonoOn f t) (hs : IsGreatest s c) (ht : IsLeast t c) : StrictMonoOn f (s ∪ t)
proof:
:= by
  have A : ∀ x, x ∈ s ∪ t → x ≤ c → x ∈ s := by
    intro x hx hxc
    cases hx
    · assumption
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hxc with (rfl | h'x)
    · exact hs.1
    exact (lt_irrefl _ (h'x.trans_le (ht.2 (by assumption)))).elim
  have B : ∀ x, x ∈ s ∪ t → c ≤ x → x ∈ t := by
    intro x hx hxc
    match hx with
    | Or.inr hx => exact hx
    | Or.inl hx =>
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hxc with (rfl | h'x)
      · exact ht.1
      exact (lt_irrefl _ (h'x.trans_le (hs.2 hx))).elim
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  rcases lt_or_ge x c with (hxc | hcx)
  · have xs : x ∈ s := A _ hx hxc.le
    rcases lt_or_ge y c with (hyc | hcy)
    · exact h₁ xs (A _ hy hyc.le) hxy
    · exact (h₁ xs hs.1 hxc).trans_le (h₂.monotoneOn ht.1 (B _ hy hcy) hcy)
  · have xt : x ∈ t := B _ hx hcx
    have yt : y ∈ t := B _ hy (hcx.trans hxy.le)
    exact h₂ xt yt hxy

name: MonotoneOn.exists_monotone_extension
statement:
theorem MonotoneOn.exists_monotone_extension (h : MonotoneOn f s) (hl : BddBelow (f '' s))
    (hu : BddAbove (f '' s)) : ∃ g : α → β, Monotone g ∧ EqOn f g s
proof:
:= by
  classical
    /- The extension is defined by `f x = f a` for `x ≤ a`, and `f x` is the supremum of the values
      of `f` to the left of `x` for `x ≥ a`. -/
    rcases hl with ⟨a, ha⟩
    have hu' : ∀ x, BddAbove (f '' (Iic x ∩ s)) := fun x =>
      hu.mono (image_mono inter_subset_right)
    let g : α → β := fun x => if Disjoint (Iic x) s then a else sSup (f '' (Iic x ∩ s))
    have hgs : EqOn f g s := by
      intro x hx
      simp only [g]
      have : IsGreatest (Iic x ∩ s) x := ⟨⟨self_mem_Iic, hx⟩, fun y hy => hy.1⟩
      rw [ite_eq_right this.nonempty.not_disjoint,
        ((h.mono inter_subset_right).map_isGreatest this).csSup_eq]
    refine ⟨g, fun x y hxy => ?_, hgs⟩
    by_cases hx : Disjoint (Iic x) s <;> by_cases hy : Disjoint (Iic y) s <;>
      simp only [g, ite_eq_left, ite_eq_right, not_false_iff, *, refl]
    · rcases not_disjoint_iff_nonempty_inter.1 hy with ⟨z, hz⟩
      exact le_csSup_of_le (hu' _) (mem_image_of_mem _ hz) (ha <| mem_image_of_mem _ hz.2)
    · exact (hx <| hy.mono_left <| Iic_subset_Iic.2 hxy).elim
    · rw [not_disjoint_iff_nonempty_inter] at hx
      gcongr; exacts [hu' _, hx.image _]

name: StrictMono.add_le_nat
statement: lemma StrictMono.add_le_nat {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : StrictMono f) (m n : ℕ) : m + f n ≤ f (m + n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.add_comm m, Nat.add_comm m]
  induction m with
  | zero => rw [Nat.add_zero, Nat.add_zero]
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [← Nat.add_assoc, ← Nat.add_assoc, Nat.succ_le_iff]
    exact ih.trans_lt (hf (n + m).lt_succ_self)

name: StrictMono.ite'
statement:
protected theorem StrictMono.ite' (hf : StrictMono f) (hg : StrictMono g) {p : α → Prop}
    [DecidablePred p]
    (hp : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, x < y → p y → p x) (hfg : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, p x → ¬p y → x < y → f x < g y) :
    StrictMono fun x ↦ if p x then f x else g x
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  by_cases hy : p y
  · have hx : p x := hp h hy
    simpa [hx, hy] using hf h
  by_cases hx : p x
  · simpa [hx, hy] using hfg hx hy h
  · simpa [hx, hy] using hg h

name: StrictMono.ite
proof:
:=
  (hf.ite' hg hp) fun _ y _ _ h ↦ (hf h).trans_le (hfg y)

name: StrictAnti.ite'
statement:
protected theorem StrictAnti.ite' (hf : StrictAnti f) (hg : StrictAnti g) {p : α → Prop}
    [DecidablePred p]
    (hp : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, x < y → p y → p x) (hfg : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, p x → ¬p y → x < y → g y < f x) :
    StrictAnti fun x ↦ if p x then f x else g x

name: StrictAnti.ite
proof:
:=
  (hf.ite' hg hp) fun _ y _ _ h ↦ (hfg y).trans_lt (hf h)

name: foldl_monotone
statement:
theorem foldl_monotone [Preorder α] {f : α → β → α} (H : ∀ b, Monotone fun a ↦ f a b)

proof:
:=
  List.recOn l (fun _ _ ↦ id) fun _ _ hl _ _ h ↦ hl (H _ h)

proof: := fun _ _ h ↦ List.recOn l h fun i _ hl ↦ H i hl

name: StrictMonoOn.le_iff_le
statement:
@[to_dual self (reorder := a b, ha hb)]
theorem StrictMonoOn.le_iff_le (hf : StrictMonoOn f s) {a b : α} (ha : a ∈ s) (hb : b ∈ s) :
    f a ≤ f b ↔ a ≤ b
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ le_of_not_gt fun h' ↦ (hf hb ha h').not_ge h, fun h ↦
    h.lt_or_eq_dec.elim (fun h' ↦ (hf ha hb h').le) fun h' ↦ h' ▸ le_rfl⟩

name: StrictAntiOn.le_iff_ge
statement:

theorem StrictAntiOn.le_iff_ge (hf : StrictAntiOn f s) {a b : α} (ha : a ∈ s) (hb : b ∈ s) :

name: StrictMonoOn.eq_iff_eq
statement:
theorem StrictMonoOn.eq_iff_eq (hf : StrictMonoOn f s) {a b : α} (ha : a ∈ s) (hb : b ∈ s) :
    f a = f b ↔ a = b
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ le_antisymm ((hf.le_iff_le ha hb).mp h.le) ((hf.le_iff_le hb ha).mp h.ge), by
    rintro rfl
    rfl⟩

name: StrictMonoOn.compares
statement:
protected theorem StrictMonoOn.compares (hf : StrictMonoOn f s) {a b : α} (ha : a ∈ s)
    (hb : b ∈ s) : ∀ {o : Ordering}, o.Compares (f a) (f b) ↔ o.Compares a b
  | Ordering.lt => hf.lt_iff_lt ha hb
  | Ordering.eq => ⟨fun h ↦ ((hf.le_iff_le ha hb).1 h.le).antisymm
                      ((hf.le_iff_le hb ha).1 h.symm.le), congr_arg _⟩
  | Ordering.gt => hf.lt_iff_lt hb ha

protected theorem StrictAntiOn.compares (hf : StrictAntiOn f s) {a b : α} (ha : a ∈ s)
    (hb : b ∈ s) {o : Ordering} : o.Compares (f a) (f b) ↔ o.Compares b a

statement:
theorem Monotone.eq_of_ge_of_le {a₁ a₂ : α} (h_mon : Monotone f) (h_fa : f a₁ = f a₂) {i : α}
    (h₁ : a₁ ≤ i) (h₂ : i ≤ a₂) : f i = f a₁
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [h_fa]; exact h_mon h₂
  · exact h_mon h₁

name: not_monotone_not_antitone_iff_exists_le_le
statement:
lemma not_monotone_not_antitone_iff_exists_le_le :
    ¬ Monotone f ∧ ¬ Antitone f ↔
      ∃ a b c, a ≤ b ∧ b ≤ c ∧ ((f a < f b ∧ f c < f b) ∨ (f b < f a ∧ f b < f c))

name: not_monotone_not_antitone_iff_exists_lt_lt
statement:
lemma not_monotone_not_antitone_iff_exists_lt_lt :
    ¬ Monotone f ∧ ¬ Antitone f ↔ ∃ a b c, a < b ∧ b < c ∧
    (f a < f b ∧ f c < f b ∨ f b < f a ∧ f b < f c)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [not_monotone_not_antitone_iff_exists_le_le, ← and_assoc]
  refine exists₃_congr (fun a b c ↦ and_congr_left <|
    fun h ↦ (Ne.le_iff_lt ?_).and <| Ne.le_iff_lt ?_) <;>
  (rintro rfl; simp at h)

name: Nat.rel_of_forall_rel_succ_of_le_of_lt
proof:
:= by
  induction hbc with
  | refl => exact h _ hab
  | step b_lt_k r_b_k => exact _root_.trans r_b_k (h _ (hab.trans_lt b_lt_k).le)

name: Nat.rel_of_forall_rel_succ_of_le_of_le
statement:
theorem Nat.rel_of_forall_rel_succ_of_le_of_le (r : β → β → Prop) [Std.Refl r] [IsTrans β r]
    {f : ℕ → β} {a : ℕ} (h : ∀ n, a ≤ n → r (f n) (f (n + 1)))
    ⦃b c : ℕ⦄ (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) : r (f b) (f c)
proof:
:=
  hbc.eq_or_lt.elim (fun h ↦ h ▸ refl _) (Nat.rel_of_forall_rel_succ_of_le_of_lt r h hab)

name: Nat.rel_of_forall_rel_succ_of_lt
statement:
theorem Nat.rel_of_forall_rel_succ_of_lt (r : β → β → Prop) [IsTrans β r] {f : ℕ → β}
    (h : ∀ n, r (f n) (f (n + 1))) ⦃a b : ℕ⦄ (hab : a < b) : r (f a) (f b)
proof:
:=
  Nat.rel_of_forall_rel_succ_of_le_of_lt r (fun n _ ↦ h n) le_rfl hab

name: Nat.rel_of_forall_rel_succ_of_le
statement:
theorem Nat.rel_of_forall_rel_succ_of_le (r : β → β → Prop) [Std.Refl r] [IsTrans β r] {f : ℕ → β}

theorem monotone_add_nat_of_le_succ {f : ℕ → α} {k : ℕ} (hf : ∀ n ≥ k, f n ≤ f (n + 1)) :
    Monotone (fun n ↦ f (n + k))
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ hle ↦ Nat.rel_of_forall_rel_succ_of_le_of_le (· ≤ ·) hf
    (Nat.le_add_left k _) (Nat.add_le_add_iff_right.mpr hle)

proof:
:=

name: monotone_add_nat_iff_monotoneOn_nat_Ici
statement:
theorem monotone_add_nat_iff_monotoneOn_nat_Ici {f : ℕ → α} {k : ℕ} :
    Monotone (fun n ↦ f (n + k)) ↔ MonotoneOn f { x | k ≤ x }
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h x hx y hy hle ↦ ?_, fun h x y hle ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel hx, ← Nat.sub_add_cancel hy]
    rw [← Nat.sub_le_sub_iff_right hy] at hle
    exact h hle
  · rw [← Nat.add_le_add_iff_right] at hle
    exact h (Nat.le_add_left k x) (Nat.le_add_left k y) hle

name: exists_strictMono'
statement: theorem exists_strictMono' [NoMaxOrder α] (a : α) : ∃ f : ℕ → α, StrictMono f ∧ f 0 = a
proof:
:= by
  choose g hg using fun x : α ↦ exists_gt x
  exact ⟨fun n ↦ Nat.recOn n a fun _ ↦ g, strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ fun n ↦ hg _, rfl⟩

name: exists_strictMono_subsequence
statement:
theorem exists_strictMono_subsequence {P : ℕ → Prop} (h : ∀ N, ∃ n > N, P n) :
    ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ n, P (φ n)
proof:
:= by
  have : NoMaxOrder {n // P n} :=
    ⟨fun n ↦ Exists.intro ⟨(h n.1).choose, (h n.1).choose_spec.2⟩ (h n.1).choose_spec.1⟩
  obtain ⟨f, hf, _⟩ := Nat.exists_strictMono' (⟨(h 0).choose, (h 0).choose_spec.2⟩ : {n // P n})
  exact Exists.intro (fun n ↦ (f n).1) ⟨hf, fun n ↦ (f n).2⟩

name: exists_strictMono
statement: theorem exists_strictMono [Nonempty α] [NoMaxOrder α] : ∃ f : ℕ → α, StrictMono f
proof:
:=
  let ⟨a⟩ := ‹Nonempty α›
  let ⟨f, hf, _⟩ := exists_strictMono' a
  ⟨f, hf⟩

name: pow_self_mono
statement: lemma pow_self_mono : Monotone fun n : ℕ ↦ n ^ n
proof:
:= by
  refine monotone_nat_of_le_succ fun n ↦ ?_
  rw [Nat.pow_succ]
  exact (Nat.pow_le_pow_left n.le_succ _).trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ n.succ_pos)

name: pow_monotoneOn
statement: lemma pow_monotoneOn : MonotoneOn (fun p : ℕ × ℕ ↦ p.1 ^ p.2) {p | p.1 ≠ 0}
proof:
:= fun _p _ _q hq hpq ↦
  (Nat.pow_le_pow_left hpq.1 _).trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.2 hq) hpq.2)

name: pow_self_strictMonoOn
statement: lemma pow_self_strictMonoOn : StrictMonoOn (fun n : ℕ ↦ n ^ n) {n : ℕ | n ≠ 0}
proof:
:=
  fun _m hm _n hn hmn ↦
    (Nat.pow_lt_pow_left hmn hm).trans_le (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.2 hn) hmn.le)

name: Int.rel_of_forall_rel_succ_of_lt
statement:
theorem Int.rel_of_forall_rel_succ_of_lt (r : β → β → Prop) [IsTrans β r] {f : ℤ → β}
    (h : ∀ n, r (f n) (f (n + 1))) ⦃a b : ℤ⦄ (hab : a < b) : r (f a) (f b)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt.dest hab with ⟨n, rfl⟩
  clear hab
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [Int.ofNat_one]; apply h
  | succ n ihn => rw [Int.natCast_succ, ← Int.add_assoc]; exact _root_.trans ihn (h _)

name: Int.rel_of_forall_rel_succ_of_le
statement:
theorem Int.rel_of_forall_rel_succ_of_le (r : β → β → Prop) [Std.Refl r] [IsTrans β r] {f : ℤ → β}
    (h : ∀ n, r (f n) (f (n + 1))) ⦃a b : ℤ⦄ (hab : a ≤ b) : r (f a) (f b)
proof:
:=
  hab.eq_or_lt.elim (fun h ↦ h ▸ refl _) fun h' ↦ Int.rel_of_forall_rel_succ_of_lt r h h'

name: exists_strictMono
statement: theorem exists_strictMono : ∃ f : ℤ → α, StrictMono f
proof:
:= by
  inhabit α
  rcases Nat.exists_strictMono' (default : α) with ⟨f, hf, hf₀⟩
  rcases Nat.exists_strictAnti' (default : α) with ⟨g, hg, hg₀⟩
  refine ⟨fun n ↦ Int.casesOn n f fun n ↦ g (n + 1), strictMono_int_of_lt_succ ?_⟩
  rintro (n | _ | n)
  · exact hf n.lt_succ_self
  · change g 1 < f 0
    rw [hf₀, ← hg₀]
    exact hg Nat.zero_lt_one
  · exact hg (Nat.lt_succ_self _)

name: Nat.stabilises_of_monotone
statement:
lemma Nat.stabilises_of_monotone {f : ℕ → ℕ} {b n : ℕ} (hfmono : Monotone f) (hfb : ∀ m, f m ≤ b)
    (hfstab : ∀ m, f m = f (m + 1) → f (m + 1) = f (m + 2)) (hbn : b ≤ n) : f n = f b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hmb, hm⟩ : ∃ m ≤ b, f m = f (m + 1) := by
    contrapose! hfb
    let rec strictMono : ∀ m ≤ b + 1, m ≤ f m
    | 0, _ => Nat.zero_le _
    | m + 1, hmb => (strictMono _ <| m.le_succ.trans hmb).trans_lt <| (hfmono m.le_succ).lt_of_ne <|
        hfb _ <| Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hmb
    exact ⟨b + 1, strictMono _ le_rfl⟩
  replace key : ∀ k : ℕ, f (m + k) = f (m + k + 1) ∧ f (m + k) = f m := fun k =>
    Nat.rec ⟨hm, rfl⟩ (fun k ih => ⟨hfstab _ ih.1, ih.1.symm.trans ih.2⟩) k
  replace key : ∀ k ≥ m, f k = f m := fun k hk =>
    (congr_arg f (Nat.add_sub_of_le hk)).symm.trans (key (k - m)).2
  exact (key n (hmb.trans hbn)).trans (key b hmb).symm

name: Nat.stabilises_of_antitone
statement:
lemma Nat.stabilises_of_antitone {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hfmono : Antitone f)
    (hfstab : ∀ m, f m = f (m + 1) → f (m + 1) = f (m + 2)) :
    ∃ n ≤ f 0, ∀ m, n ≤ m → f m = f n
proof:
:= by
  induction h : f 0 using Nat.strongRecOn generalizing f with
  | ind n ih =>
    by_cases heq : f 0 = f 1
    · have flat (j : ℕ) : f j = f (j + 1) := by induction j with grind
      exact ⟨0, Nat.zero_le _, fun m _ => by induction m with grind⟩
    · have hlt : f 1 < f 0 := (hfmono (Nat.le_succ 0)).lt_of_ne' heq
      let g (i : ℕ) := f (i + 1)
      have hg_anti : Antitone g := by grind [Antitone]
      obtain ⟨p, hp, hp'⟩ := ih (f 1) (by grind) hg_anti (by grind) rfl
      refine ⟨p + 1, by omega, fun m hm => ?_⟩
      specialize hp' (m - 1) (by lia)
      grind

name: converges_of_monotone_of_bounded
statement:
lemma converges_of_monotone_of_bounded {f : ℕ → ℕ} (mono_f : Monotone f)
    {c : ℕ} (hc : ∀ n, f n ≤ c) : ∃ b N, ∀ n ≥ N, f n = b
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | zero => use 0, 0, fun n _ ↦ Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (hc n)
  | succ c ih =>
    by_cases! h : ∀ n, f n ≤ c
    · exact ih h
    · obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := h
      replace hN : f N = c + 1 := by specialize hc N; lia
      use c + 1, N; intro n hn
      specialize mono_f hn; specialize hc n; lia

name: monovaryOn_iff_exists_monotoneOn
statement:
lemma monovaryOn_iff_exists_monotoneOn :
    MonovaryOn f g s ↔ ∃ (_ : LinearOrder ι), MonotoneOn f s ∧ MonotoneOn g s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := linearOrderOfSTO (MonovaryOrder f g)
  refine ⟨fun hfg => ⟨‹_›, monotoneOn_iff_forall_lt.2 fun i hi j hj hij => ?_,
    monotoneOn_iff_forall_lt.2 fun i hi j hj hij => ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · obtain h | ⟨h, -⟩ := Prod.lex_iff.1 hij <;> exact h.le
  · obtain h | ⟨-, h⟩ := Prod.lex_iff.1 hij
    · exact hfg.symm hi hj h
    obtain h | ⟨h, -⟩ := Prod.lex_iff.1 h <;> exact h.le
  · rintro ⟨_, hf, hg⟩
    exact hf.monovaryOn hg

proof:

  mp h

    fun _ _ _ hab => h (Prod.mk_le_mk_iff_left.mpr hab)⟩

proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ h.mono fun x hx ↦ hx x le_rfl, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  rcases (hasBasis_iInf_principal_finite _).eventually_iff.1 h with ⟨S, hSf, hS⟩
  refine mem_iInf_of_iInter hSf (V := fun x ↦ Ici x.1) (fun _ ↦ Subset.rfl) fun x hx y hy ↦ ?_
  simp only [mem_iInter] at hS hx

name: high_scores
statement:
@[to_dual low_scores
/
then after any point, it reaches a value strictly smaller than all previous values.
-/]
theorem high_scores [LinearOrder β] [NoMaxOrder β] {u : ℕ → β} (hu : Tendsto u atTop atTop) :
    ∀ N, ∃ n ≥ N, ∀ k < n, u k < u n
proof:
:= by
  intro N
  obtain ⟨k : ℕ, - : k ≤ N, hku : ∀ l ≤ N, u l ≤ u k⟩ : ∃ k ≤ N, ∀ l ≤ N, u l ≤ u k :=
    exists_max_image _ u (finite_le_nat N) ⟨N, le_refl N⟩
  have ex : ∃ n ≥ N, u k < u n := exists_lt_of_tendsto_atTop hu _ _
  obtain ⟨n : ℕ, hnN : n ≥ N, hnk : u k < u n, hn_min : ∀ m, m < n → N ≤ m → u m ≤ u k⟩ :
      ∃ n ≥ N, u k < u n ∧ ∀ m, m < n → N ≤ m → u m ≤ u k := by
    rcases Nat.findX ex with ⟨n, ⟨hnN, hnk⟩, hn_min⟩
    push Not at hn_min
    exact ⟨n, hnN, hnk, hn_min⟩
  use n, hnN
  grind
