name: Eventually.atTop_of_arithmetic
statement:
theorem Eventually.atTop_of_arithmetic {p : ℕ → Prop} {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (hp : ∀ k < n, ∀ᶠ a in atTop, p (n * a + k)) : ∀ᶠ a in atTop, p a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eventually_atTop] at hp ⊢
  choose! N hN using hp
  refine ⟨(Finset.range n).sup (n * N ·), fun b hb => ?_⟩
  rw [← Nat.div_add_mod b n]
  have hlt := Nat.mod_lt b hn.bot_lt
  refine hN _ hlt _ ?_
  rw [Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hn.bot_lt, mul_comm]
  exact (Finset.le_sup (f := (n * N ·)) (Finset.mem_range.2 hlt)).trans hb

name: HasAntitoneBasis.subbasis_with_rel
proof:
:= by
  rsuffices ⟨φ, hφ, hrφ⟩ : ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ m n, m < n → r (φ m) (φ n)
  · exact ⟨φ, hφ, hrφ, hs.comp_strictMono hφ⟩
  have : ∀ t : Set ℕ, t.Finite → ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ m ∈ t, m < n ∧ r m n := fun t ht =>
    (eventually_all_finite ht).2 fun m _ => (eventually_gt_atTop m).and (hr _)
  rcases seq_of_forall_finite_exists fun t ht => (this t ht).exists with ⟨φ, hφ⟩
  simp only [forall_mem_image, forall_and, mem_Iio] at hφ
  exact ⟨φ, forall_comm.2 hφ.1, forall_comm.2 hφ.2⟩

name: eventually_pow_lt_factorial_sub
statement: theorem eventually_pow_lt_factorial_sub (c d : ℕ) : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, c ^ n < (n - d)!
proof:
:= by
  rw [eventually_atTop]
  refine ⟨2 * (c ^ 2 + d + 1), ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  obtain ⟨d', rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
  obtain (rfl | c0) := c.eq_zero_or_pos
  · simp [Nat.two_mul, ← Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_right_comm _ 1, Nat.factorial_pos]
  refine (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (Nat.pow_pos (n := d') c0)).trans_lt ?_
  convert_to! (c ^ 2) ^ (c ^ 2 + d' + d + 1) < (c ^ 2 + (c ^ 2 + d' + d + 1) + 1)!
  · rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_add]
    congr 1
    lia
  · congr 1
    lia
  refine (lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ Nat.factorial_mul_pow_le_factorial).trans_le <|
    (factorial_le (Nat.le_succ _))
  rw [← one_mul (_ ^ _ : ℕ)]
  apply Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_le_of_lt
  · exact Nat.one_le_of_lt (Nat.factorial_pos _)
  · exact Nat.pow_lt_pow_left (Nat.lt_succ_self _) (Nat.succ_ne_zero _)
  · exact (Nat.factorial_pos _)

name: eventually_mul_pow_lt_factorial_sub
statement:
theorem eventually_mul_pow_lt_factorial_sub (a c d : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, a * c ^ n < (n - d)!
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [Nat.eventually_pow_lt_factorial_sub (a * c) d, Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0]
    with n hn hn0
  rw [mul_pow] at hn
  exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_self_pow hn0.ne' _)).trans_lt hn

proof:
:= by
  refine tendsto_atTop_mono' _ ((hf.eventually_ge_atTop 1).mono fun x hx ↦ ?_) hf

name: Tendsto.atTop_of_isBoundedUnder_le_mul
statement:
@[to_additive /
then `g` tends to `+∞`. -/]
theorem Tendsto.atTop_of_isBoundedUnder_le_mul (hf : IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) l f)
    (hfg : Tendsto (fun x => f x * g x) l atTop) : Tendsto g l atTop
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hf
  refine .atTop_of_const_mul C <| tendsto_atTop_mono' l ?_ hfg
  exact (eventually_map.mp hC).mono fun _ _ ↦ by dsimp; gcongr

statement:
theorem Tendsto.atTop_mul_atTop₀ (hf : Tendsto f l atTop) (hg : Tendsto g l atTop) :

proof:
:= by
  refine tendsto_atTop_mono' _ ?_ hg
  filter_upwards [hg.eventually (eventually_ge_atTop 0),
    hf.eventually (eventually_ge_atTop 1)] with _ using le_mul_of_one_le_left

name: zero_pow_eventuallyEq
statement:
theorem zero_pow_eventuallyEq [MonoidWithZero α] :
    (fun n : ℕ => (0 : α) ^ n) =ᶠ[atTop] fun _ => 0

name: Tendsto.atTop_mul_atBot
statement:
theorem Tendsto.atTop_mul_atBot₀ (hf : Tendsto f l atTop) (hg : Tendsto g l atBot) :
    Tendsto (fun x => f x * g x) l atBot
proof:
:= by
  have := hf.atTop_mul_atTop₀ <| tendsto_neg_atBot_atTop.comp hg
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, neg_mul_eq_mul_neg, neg_neg] using
    tendsto_neg_atTop_atBot.comp this

name: Tendsto.atBot_mul_atTop
statement:
theorem Tendsto.atBot_mul_atTop₀ (hf : Tendsto f l atBot) (hg : Tendsto g l atTop) :
    Tendsto (fun x => f x * g x) l atBot
proof:
:= by
  have : Tendsto (fun x => -f x * g x) l atTop :=
    (tendsto_neg_atBot_atTop.comp hf).atTop_mul_atTop₀ hg
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, neg_mul_eq_neg_mul, neg_neg] using
    tendsto_neg_atTop_atBot.comp this

name: Tendsto.atBot_mul_atBot
statement:
theorem Tendsto.atBot_mul_atBot₀ (hf : Tendsto f l atBot) (hg : Tendsto g l atBot) :
    Tendsto (fun x => f x * g x) l atTop
proof:
:= by
  have : Tendsto (fun x => -f x * -g x) l atTop :=
    (tendsto_neg_atBot_atTop.comp hf).atTop_mul_atTop₀ (tendsto_neg_atBot_atTop.comp hg)
  simpa only [neg_mul_neg] using this

name: tendsto_pow_atTop_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tendsto_pow_atTop_iff {n : ℕ} : Tendsto (fun x : α => x ^ n) atTop atTop ↔ n ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h hn => by simp only [hn, pow_zero, not_tendsto_const_atTop] at h, tendsto_pow_atTop⟩

name: not_tendsto_pow_atTop_atBot
statement:
theorem not_tendsto_pow_atTop_atBot [Ring α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] :
    ∀ {n : ℕ}, ¬Tendsto (fun x : α => x ^ n) atTop atBot
  | 0 => by simp [not_tendsto_const_atBot]
  | n + 1 => (tendsto_pow_atTop n.succ_ne_zero).not_tendsto disjoint_atTop_atBot

open Filter

variable {R : Type*} [Semiring R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R]

name: exists_lt_mul_self
statement: theorem exists_lt_mul_self (a : R) : ∃ x ≥ 0, a < x * x

name: exists_le_mul_self
statement: theorem exists_le_mul_self (a : R) : ∃ x ≥ 0, a ≤ x * x
proof:
:=
  let ⟨x, hx0, hxa⟩ := exists_lt_mul_self a
  ⟨x, hx0, hxa.le⟩

name: atTop_countable_basis
statement:
@[to_dual]
lemma atTop_countable_basis [Preorder α] [IsDirectedOrder α] [Nonempty α] [Countable α] :
    HasCountableBasis (atTop : Filter α) (fun _ => True) Ici

name: exists_seq_tendsto
statement:
theorem exists_seq_tendsto (f : Filter α) [IsCountablyGenerated f] [NeBot f] :
    ∃ x : ℕ → α, Tendsto x atTop f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, h⟩ := f.exists_antitone_basis
  choose x hx using fun n => Filter.nonempty_of_mem (h.mem n)
  exact ⟨x, h.tendsto hx⟩

name: exists_seq_monotone_tendsto_atTop_atTop
statement:
theorem exists_seq_monotone_tendsto_atTop_atTop (α : Type*) [Preorder α] [Nonempty α]
    [IsDirectedOrder α] [(atTop : Filter α).IsCountablyGenerated] :
    ∃ xs : ℕ → α, Monotone xs ∧ Tendsto xs atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ys, h⟩ := exists_seq_tendsto (atTop : Filter α)
  choose c hleft hright using exists_ge_ge (α := α)
  set xs : ℕ → α := fun n => (List.range n).foldl (fun x n ↦ c x (ys n)) (ys 0)
  have hsucc (n : ℕ) : xs (n + 1) = c (xs n) (ys n) := by simp [xs, List.range_succ]
  refine ⟨xs, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine monotone_nat_of_le_succ fun n ↦ ?_
    rw [hsucc]
    apply hleft
  · refine (tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).1 <| tendsto_atTop_mono (fun n ↦ ?_) h
    rw [hsucc]
    apply hright

name: exists_seq_antitone_tendsto_atTop_atBot
statement:
theorem exists_seq_antitone_tendsto_atTop_atBot (α : Type*) [Preorder α] [Nonempty α]
    [IsCodirectedOrder α] [(atBot : Filter α).IsCountablyGenerated] :
    ∃ xs : ℕ → α, Antitone xs ∧ Tendsto xs atTop atBot

name: tendsto_iff_seq_tendsto
statement:
theorem tendsto_iff_seq_tendsto {f : α → β} {k : Filter α} {l : Filter β} [k.IsCountablyGenerated] :
    Tendsto f k l ↔ ∀ x : ℕ → α, Tendsto x atTop k → Tendsto (f ∘ x) atTop l
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h x hx => h.comp hx, fun H s hs => ?_⟩
  contrapose! H
  have : NeBot (k ⊓ 𝓟 (f ⁻¹' sᶜ)) := by simpa [neBot_iff, inf_principal_eq_bot]
  rcases (k ⊓ 𝓟 (f ⁻¹' sᶜ)).exists_seq_tendsto with ⟨x, hx⟩
  rw [tendsto_inf, tendsto_principal] at hx
  refine ⟨x, hx.1, fun h => ?_⟩
  rcases (hx.2.and (h hs)).exists with ⟨N, hnotMem, hmem⟩
  exact hnotMem hmem

name: tendsto_of_seq_tendsto
statement:
theorem tendsto_of_seq_tendsto {f : α → β} {k : Filter α} {l : Filter β} [k.IsCountablyGenerated] :
    (∀ x : ℕ → α, Tendsto x atTop k → Tendsto (f ∘ x) atTop l) → Tendsto f k l

name: eventually_iff_seq_eventually
proof:
:= by
  simpa using tendsto_iff_seq_tendsto (f := id) (l := 𝓟 {x | p x})

name: frequently_iff_seq_frequently
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Filter.Frequently, eventually_iff_seq_eventually (l := l)]
  push Not; rfl

name: exists_seq_forall_of_frequently
proof:
:= by
  rw [frequently_iff_seq_frequently] at h
  obtain ⟨x, hx_tendsto, hx_freq⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨n_to_n, h_tendsto, h_freq⟩ := subseq_forall_of_frequently hx_tendsto hx_freq
  exact ⟨x ∘ n_to_n, h_tendsto, h_freq⟩

name: frequently_iff_seq_forall
proof:
:=
  ⟨exists_seq_forall_of_frequently, fun ⟨_ns, hnsl, hpns⟩ ↦
    hnsl.frequently <| Frequently.of_forall hpns⟩

name: tendsto_of_subseq_tendsto
statement:
theorem tendsto_of_subseq_tendsto {ι : Type*} {x : ι → α} {f : Filter α} {l : Filter ι}
    [l.IsCountablyGenerated]
    (hxy : ∀ ns : ℕ → ι, Tendsto ns atTop l →
      ∃ ms : ℕ → ℕ, Tendsto (fun n => x (ns <| ms n)) atTop f) :
    Tendsto x l f
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! hxy
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hfreq⟩ : ∃ s ∈ f, ∃ᶠ n in l, x n ∉ s := by
    rwa [not_tendsto_iff_exists_frequently_notMem] at hxy
  obtain ⟨y, hy_tendsto, hy_freq⟩ := exists_seq_forall_of_frequently hfreq
  refine ⟨y, hy_tendsto, fun ms hms_tendsto ↦ ?_⟩
  rcases (hms_tendsto.eventually_mem hs).exists with ⟨n, hn⟩
  exact absurd hn <| hy_freq _

name: exists_seq_comp_tendsto
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Filter.push_pull', map_neBot_iff] at hx
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ⟩ := exists_seq_tendsto (comap u f ⊓ g)
  exact ⟨θ, (tendsto_inf.1 hθ).2, tendsto_comap_iff.1 (tendsto_inf.1 hθ).1⟩

name: subseq_tendsto_of_neBot
statement:
theorem subseq_tendsto_of_neBot {f : Filter α} [IsCountablyGenerated f] {u : ℕ → α}
    (hx : NeBot (f ⊓ map u atTop)) : ∃ θ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono θ ∧ Tendsto (u ∘ θ) atTop f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := exists_seq_comp_tendsto hx
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, hψφ⟩ : ∃ ψ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono ψ ∧ StrictMono (φ ∘ ψ) :=
    strictMono_subseq_of_tendsto_atTop hφ.1
  exact ⟨φ ∘ ψ, hψφ, hφ.2.comp hψ.tendsto_atTop⟩

theorem not_tendsto_const_atTop [Preorder α] [NoTopOrder α] (x : α) (l : Filter β) [l.NeBot] :

statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem tendsto_atTop [Preorder β] {m : α → β} {f : Filter α} :
    Tendsto m f atTop ↔ ∀ b, ∀ᶠ a in f, b ≤ m a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [atTop, tendsto_iInf, tendsto_principal, mem_Ici]

name: tendsto_atTop_mono'
statement:

theorem tendsto_atTop_mono' [Preorder β] (l : Filter α) ⦃f₁ f₂ : α → β⦄ (h : f₁ ≤ᶠ[l] f₂)
    (h₁ : Tendsto f₁ l atTop) : Tendsto f₂ l atTop
proof:
:=
  tendsto_atTop.2 fun b => by filter_upwards [tendsto_atTop.1 h₁ b, h] with x using le_trans

theorem tendsto_atTop_mono [Preorder β] {l : Filter α} {f g : α → β} (h : ∀ n, f n ≤ g n) :

statement: theorem _root_.StrictMono.tendsto_atTop {φ : ℕ → ℕ} (h : StrictMono φ) : Tendsto φ atTop atTop

name: _root_.Monotone.upperBounds_range_comp_tendsto_atTop
statement:
@[to_dual
/
then the lower bounds of the range of `f ∘ g`
are the same as the lower bounds of the range of `f`. -/]
theorem _root_.Monotone.upperBounds_range_comp_tendsto_atTop [Preorder β] [Preorder γ]
    {l : Filter α} [l.NeBot] {f : β → γ} (hf : Monotone f) {g : α → β} (hg : Tendsto g l atTop) :
    upperBounds (range (f ∘ g)) = upperBounds (range f)
proof:
:= by
  refine Subset.antisymm ?_ (upperBounds_mono_set <| range_comp_subset_range _ _)
  rintro c hc _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, b ≤ g a := (hg.eventually_ge_atTop b).exists
  exact (hf ha).trans <| hc <| mem_range_self _

name: _root_.Antitone.lowerBounds_range_comp_tendsto_atTop
statement:
@[to_dual
/
then the upper bounds of the range of `f ∘ g`
are the same as the upper bounds of the range of `f`. -/]
theorem _root_.Antitone.lowerBounds_range_comp_tendsto_atTop [Preorder β] [Preorder γ]
    {l : Filter α} [l.NeBot] {f : β → γ} (hf : Antitone f) {g : α → β} (hg : Tendsto g l atTop) :
    lowerBounds (range (f ∘ g)) = lowerBounds (range f)

name: tendsto_atTop_atTop_of_monotone
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem tendsto_atTop_atTop_of_monotone [Preorder α] [Preorder β] {f : α → β} (hf : Monotone f)
    (h : ∀ b, ∃ a, b ≤ f a) : Tendsto f atTop atTop
proof:
:=
  tendsto_iInf.2 fun b =>
    tendsto_principal.2 <|
      let ⟨a, ha⟩ := h b
      mem_of_superset (mem_atTop a) fun _a' ha' => le_trans ha (hf ha')

name: tendsto_atTop_atBot_of_antitone
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem tendsto_atTop_atBot_of_antitone [Preorder α] [Preorder β] {f : α → β} (hf : Antitone f)
    (h : ∀ b, ∃ a, f a ≤ b) : Tendsto f atTop atBot

name: comap_embedding_atTop
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm
    (le_iInf fun b =>
      le_principal_iff.2 <| mem_comap.2 ⟨Ici (e b), mem_atTop _, fun _ => (hm _ _).1⟩)
    (tendsto_atTop_atTop_of_monotone (fun _ _ => (hm _ _).2) hu).le_comap

name: tendsto_atTop_embedding

name: Tendsto.const_mul_atTop'
statement:
theorem Tendsto.const_mul_atTop' (hr : 0 < r) (hf : Tendsto f l atTop) :
    Tendsto (fun x => r * f x) l atTop
proof:
:= by
  refine tendsto_atTop.2 fun b => ?_
  obtain ⟨n : ℕ, hn : 1 ≤ n • r⟩ := Archimedean.arch 1 hr
  rw [nsmul_eq_mul'] at hn
  filter_upwards [tendsto_atTop.1 hf (n * max b 0)] with x hx
  calc
    b ≤ 1 * max b 0 := by
    { rw [one_mul]
      exact le_max_left _ _ }
    _ ≤ r * n * max b 0 := by gcongr
    _ = r * (n * max b 0) := by rw [mul_assoc]
    _ ≤ r * f x := by gcongr

name: Tendsto.atTop_mul_const'
statement:
theorem Tendsto.atTop_mul_const' (hr : 0 < r) (hf : Tendsto f l atTop) :
    Tendsto (fun x => f x * r) l atTop
proof:
:= by
  refine tendsto_atTop.2 fun b => ?_
  obtain ⟨n : ℕ, hn : 1 ≤ n • r⟩ := Archimedean.arch 1 hr
  have hn' : 1 ≤ (n : R) * r := by rwa [nsmul_eq_mul] at hn
  filter_upwards [tendsto_atTop.1 hf (max b 0 * n)] with x hx
  calc
    b ≤ max b 0 * 1 := by
    { rw [mul_one]
      exact le_max_left _ _ }
    _ ≤ max b 0 * (n * r) := by gcongr
    _ = max b 0 * n * r := by rw [mul_assoc]
    _ ≤ f x * r := by gcongr

  simp only [← tendsto_neg_atTop_iff, ← neg_zsmul] at hf ⊢
  exact hf.atTop_zsmul_const hr

name: Tendsto.atBot_zsmul_neg_const
statement:
theorem Tendsto.atBot_zsmul_neg_const {f : α → ℤ} (hr : r < 0) (hf : Tendsto f l atBot) :
    Tendsto (fun x => f x • r) l atTop

name: comap_atTop
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
theorem comap_atTop (e : α ≃o β) : comap e atTop = atTop

name: map_atTop
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
theorem map_atTop (e : α ≃o β) : map (e : α → β) atTop = atTop

name: tendsto_atTop
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem tendsto_atTop (e : α ≃o β) : Tendsto e atTop atTop

name: tendsto_atTop_iff

theorem tendsto_atTop_iff {l : Filter γ} {f : γ → α} (e : α ≃o β) :
    Tendsto (fun x => e (f x)) l atTop ↔ Tendsto f l atTop

name: tendsto_finset_range
statement: theorem tendsto_finset_range : Tendsto Finset.range atTop atTop

name: atTop_finset_eq_iInf
statement: theorem atTop_finset_eq_iInf : (atTop : Filter (Finset α)) = ⨅ x : α, 𝓟 (Ici {x})
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (le_iInf fun i => le_principal_iff.2 <| mem_atTop ({i} : Finset α)) ?_
  refine
    le_iInf fun s =>
      le_principal_iff.2 <| mem_iInf_of_iInter s.finite_toSet (fun i => mem_principal_self _) ?_
  simp only [subset_def, mem_iInter, SetCoe.forall, mem_Ici,
    Finset.mem_singleton, Finset.subset_iff, forall_eq]
  exact fun t => id

name: tendsto_atTop_finset_of_monotone
statement:
theorem tendsto_atTop_finset_of_monotone [Preorder β] {f : β → Finset α} (h : Monotone f)
    (h' : ∀ x : α, ∃ n, x ∈ f n) : Tendsto f atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  simp only [atTop_finset_eq_iInf, tendsto_iInf, tendsto_principal]
  intro a
  rcases h' a with ⟨b, hb⟩
  exact (eventually_ge_atTop b).mono fun b' hb' => (Finset.singleton_subset_iff.2 hb).trans (h hb')

name: tendsto_finset_image_atTop_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_finset_image_atTop_atTop [DecidableEq β] {i : β → γ} {j : γ → β}
    (h : Function.LeftInverse j i) : Tendsto (Finset.image j) atTop atTop
proof:
:=
  (Finset.image_mono j).tendsto_atTop_finset fun a =>
    ⟨{i a}, by simp only [Finset.image_singleton, h a, Finset.mem_singleton]⟩

name: tendsto_finset_preimage_atTop_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_finset_preimage_atTop_atTop {f : α → β} (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Tendsto (fun s : Finset β => s.preimage f (hf.injOn)) atTop atTop
proof:
:=
  (Finset.monotone_preimage hf).tendsto_atTop_finset fun x =>
    ⟨{f x}, Finset.mem_preimage.2 <| Finset.mem_singleton_self _⟩

name: tendsto_toLeft_atTop
statement:
lemma tendsto_toLeft_atTop :
    Tendsto (Finset.toLeft (α := α) (β := β)) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  simp only [mem_atTop_sets, Filter.mem_map, Set.mem_preimage] at hs ⊢
  obtain ⟨t, H⟩ := hs
  exact ⟨t.disjSum ∅, fun b hb ↦ H _ (by simpa [← Finset.coe_subset, Set.subset_def] using hb)⟩

name: tendsto_toRight_atTop
statement:
lemma tendsto_toRight_atTop :
    Tendsto (Finset.toRight (α := α) (β := β)) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  simp only [mem_atTop_sets, Filter.mem_map, Set.mem_preimage] at hs ⊢
  obtain ⟨t, H⟩ := hs
  exact ⟨.disjSum ∅ t, fun b hb ↦ H _ (by simpa [← Finset.coe_subset, Set.subset_def] using hb)⟩

name: tendsto_finset_powerset_atTop_atTop
statement: theorem tendsto_finset_powerset_atTop_atTop : Tendsto (Finset.powerset (α := α)) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine tendsto_atTop_atTop.mpr fun t ↦ ⟨t.sup id, fun _ hu _ hv ↦ ?_⟩
  exact Finset.mem_powerset.mpr <| (Finset.le_sup_of_le hv fun _ h ↦ h).trans hu

name: tendsto_finset_Iic_atTop_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_finset_Iic_atTop_atTop [Preorder α] [LocallyFiniteOrderBot α] :
    Tendsto (Finset.Iic (α := α)) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty α with _ | _
  · exact tendsto_of_isEmpty
  by_cases h : IsDirectedOrder α
  · refine tendsto_atTop_atTop.mpr fun s ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Finset.exists_le s
    exact ⟨a, fun b hb c hc ↦ by simpa using (ha c hc).trans hb⟩
  · obtain h := Filter.atTop_neBot_iff.not.mpr (fun h' ↦ h h'.2)
    simp [not_ne_iff.mp <| Filter.neBot_iff.not.mp h]

name: tendsto_finset_Ici_atBot_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_finset_Ici_atBot_atTop [Preorder α] [LocallyFiniteOrderTop α] :
    Tendsto (Finset.Ici (α := α)) atBot atTop

name: eventually_finset_atTop_subset
statement: lemma eventually_finset_atTop_subset (i : Finset α) : ∀ᶠ s : Finset α in atTop, i ⊆ s

name: eventually_finset_mem_atTop
statement: lemma eventually_finset_mem_atTop (i : α) : ∀ᶠ s : Finset α in atTop, i ∈ s

name: map_card_atTop
statement:
lemma map_card_atTop [Infinite α] :
    map (Finset.card (α := α)) atTop = atTop
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_atTop_eq, atTop]
  refine Function.Surjective.iInf_congr Finset.card Finset.exists_card_eq fun s ↦ congr(𝓟 $(?_))
  ext
  refine ⟨Infinite.exists_superset_card_eq _ _, ?_⟩
  aesop (add safe apply Finset.card_le_card)

name: map_card_atTop_of_fintype
statement:
lemma map_card_atTop_of_fintype [Fintype α] :
    map (Finset.card : Finset α → ℕ) atTop = pure (Fintype.card α)

lemma tendsto_card_atTop_atTop [Infinite α] :

name: tendsto_card_atTop_pure_of_fintype
statement:
lemma tendsto_card_atTop_pure_of_fintype [Fintype α] :
    Tendsto (Finset.card : Finset α → ℕ) atTop (pure (Fintype.card α))

name: tendsto_comp_card_atTop_iff
statement:
lemma tendsto_comp_card_atTop_iff [Infinite α] {f : ℕ → β} {l : Filter β} :
    Tendsto (fun s : Finset α ↦ f s.card) atTop l ↔ Tendsto f atTop l
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_card_atTop (α := α), tendsto_map'_iff]
  rfl

name: tendsto_comp_card_atTop_iff_of_fintype
statement:
lemma tendsto_comp_card_atTop_iff_of_fintype [Fintype α] {f : ℕ → β} {l : Filter β} :
    Tendsto (fun s : Finset α ↦ f s.card) atTop l ↔ Tendsto f (pure (Fintype.card α)) l

statement: theorem hasAntitoneBasis_atTop [Nonempty α] : (@atTop α _).HasAntitoneBasis Ici

name: atTop_basis
statement: theorem atTop_basis [Nonempty α] : (@atTop α _).HasBasis (fun _ => True) Ici

name: atBot_basis
statement:
@[to_dual existing]
lemma atBot_basis {α : Type*} [Preorder α] [IsCodirectedOrder α] [Nonempty α] :
    (@atBot α _).HasBasis (fun _ => True) Iic

name: atTop_basis_Ioi
statement:
@[to_dual]
lemma atTop_basis_Ioi [Nonempty α] [NoMaxOrder α] : (@atTop α _).HasBasis (fun _ => True) Ioi
proof:
:=
  atTop_basis.to_hasBasis (fun a ha => ⟨a, ha, Ioi_subset_Ici_self⟩) fun a ha =>
    (exists_gt a).imp fun _b hb => ⟨ha, Ici_subset_Ioi.2 hb⟩

name: atTop_basis_Ioi'
statement:
@[to_dual]
lemma atTop_basis_Ioi' [NoMaxOrder α] (a : α) : atTop.HasBasis (a < ·) Ioi
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty α := ⟨a⟩
  refine atTop_basis_Ioi.to_hasBasis (fun b _ ↦ ?_) fun b _ ↦ ⟨b, trivial, Subset.rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hac, hbc⟩ := exists_ge_ge a b
  obtain ⟨d, hcd⟩ := exists_gt c
  exact ⟨d, hac.trans_lt hcd, Ioi_subset_Ioi (hbc.trans hcd.le)⟩

name: atTop_basis'
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem atTop_basis' (a : α) : atTop.HasBasis (a ≤ ·) Ici
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty α := ⟨a⟩
  refine atTop_basis.to_hasBasis (fun b _ ↦ ?_) fun b _ ↦ ⟨b, trivial, Subset.rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hac, hbc⟩ := exists_ge_ge a b
  exact ⟨c, hac, Ici_subset_Ici.2 hbc⟩

name: atTop_neBot_iff
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem atTop_neBot_iff {α : Type*} [Preorder α] :
    (atTop : Filter α).NeBot ↔ Nonempty α ∧ IsDirectedOrder α
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨nonempty_of_neBot atTop, ⟨fun x y ↦ ?_⟩⟩, fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ ↦ atTop_neBot⟩
  exact ((eventually_ge_atTop x).and (eventually_ge_atTop y)).exists

name: mem_atTop_sets
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
lemma mem_atTop_sets {s : Set α} : s ∈ (atTop : Filter α) ↔ ∃ a : α, ∀ b, a ≤ b → b ∈ s

name: eventually_atTop
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
lemma eventually_atTop : (∀ᶠ x in atTop, p x) ↔ ∃ a, ∀ b, a ≤ b → p b

name: frequently_atTop
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem frequently_atTop : (∃ᶠ x in atTop, p x) ↔ ∀ a, ∃ b, a ≤ b ∧ p b

name: exists_eventually_atTop
statement:
lemma exists_eventually_atTop {r : α → β → Prop} :
    (∃ b, ∀ᶠ a in atTop, r a b) ↔ ∀ᶠ a₀ in atTop, ∃ b, ∀ a, a₀ ≤ a → r a b
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [eventually_atTop, ← exists_comm (α := α)]
  exact exists_congr fun a ↦ .symm <| forall_ge_iff <| Monotone.exists fun _ _ _ hb H n hn ↦
    H n (hb.trans hn)

name: exists_eventually_atBot
statement:
@[to_dual existing]
lemma exists_eventually_atBot {α : Type*} [Preorder α] [IsCodirectedOrder α] [Nonempty α]
    {r : α → β → Prop} : (∃ b, ∀ᶠ a in atBot, r a b) ↔ ∀ᶠ a₀ in atBot, ∃ b, ∀ a ≤ a₀, r a b

name: map_atTop_eq
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem map_atTop_eq {f : α → β} : atTop.map f = ⨅ a, 𝓟 (f '' { a' | a ≤ a' })

name: frequently_atTop'
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem frequently_atTop' [NoMaxOrder α] : (∃ᶠ x in atTop, p x) ↔ ∀ a, ∃ b > a, p b

name: extraction_of_frequently_atTop
statement:
theorem extraction_of_frequently_atTop {P : ℕ → Prop} (h : ∃ᶠ n in atTop, P n) :
    ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ n, P (φ n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [frequently_atTop'] at h
  exact Nat.exists_strictMono_subsequence h

name: extraction_of_eventually_atTop
statement:
theorem extraction_of_eventually_atTop {P : ℕ → Prop} (h : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, P n) :
    ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ n, P (φ n)

name: extraction_forall_of_frequently
statement:
theorem extraction_forall_of_frequently {P : ℕ → ℕ → Prop} (h : ∀ n, ∃ᶠ k in atTop, P n k) :
    ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ n, P n (φ n)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frequently_atTop'] at h
  choose u hu hu' using h
  use (fun n => Nat.recOn n (u 0 0) fun n v => u (n + 1) v : ℕ → ℕ)
  constructor
  · apply strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ
    intro n
    apply hu
  · intro n
    cases n <;> simp [hu']

name: extraction_forall_of_eventually
statement:
theorem extraction_forall_of_eventually {P : ℕ → ℕ → Prop} (h : ∀ n, ∀ᶠ k in atTop, P n k) :
    ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ n, P n (φ n)

name: extraction_forall_of_eventually'
statement:
theorem extraction_forall_of_eventually' {P : ℕ → ℕ → Prop} (h : ∀ n, ∃ N, ∀ k ≥ N, P n k) :
    ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ n, P n (φ n)

statement:
@[to_dual inf_map_atBot_neBot_iff]
theorem inf_map_atTop_neBot_iff [Nonempty α] :
    NeBot (F ⊓ map u atTop) ↔ ∀ U ∈ F, ∀ N, ∃ n, N ≤ n ∧ u n ∈ U

name: exists_le_of_tendsto_atTop
statement:
@[to_dual (dont_translate := α)]
lemma exists_le_of_tendsto_atTop (h : Tendsto u atTop atTop) (a : α) (b : β) :
    ∃ a', a ≤ a' ∧ b ≤ u a'
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty α := ⟨a⟩
  have : ∀ᶠ x in atTop, a ≤ x ∧ b ≤ u x :=
    (eventually_ge_atTop a).and (h.eventually <| eventually_ge_atTop b)
  exact this.exists

name: exists_lt_of_tendsto_atTop
statement:
@[to_dual (dont_translate := α)]
theorem exists_lt_of_tendsto_atTop [NoMaxOrder β] (h : Tendsto u atTop atTop) (a : α) (b : β) :
    ∃ a', a ≤ a' ∧ b < u a'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := exists_gt b
  rcases exists_le_of_tendsto_atTop h a b' with ⟨a', ha', ha''⟩
  exact ⟨a', ha', lt_of_lt_of_le hb' ha''⟩

name: tendsto_atTop'
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem tendsto_atTop' : Tendsto f atTop l ↔ ∀ s ∈ l, ∃ a, ∀ b, a ≤ b → f b ∈ s

name: tendsto_atTop_principal
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem tendsto_atTop_principal {s : Set β} :
    Tendsto f atTop (𝓟 s) ↔ ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → f n ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [tendsto_iff_comap, comap_principal, le_principal_iff, mem_atTop_sets, mem_preimage]

name: tendsto_atTop_atTop
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem tendsto_atTop_atTop : Tendsto f atTop atTop ↔ ∀ b : β, ∃ i : α, ∀ a : α, i ≤ a → b ≤ f a

name: tendsto_atTop_atBot
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem tendsto_atTop_atBot : Tendsto f atTop atBot ↔ ∀ b : β, ∃ i : α, ∀ a : α, i ≤ a → f a ≤ b

name: tendsto_atTop_atTop_iff_of_monotone
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem tendsto_atTop_atTop_iff_of_monotone (hf : Monotone f) :
    Tendsto f atTop atTop ↔ ∀ b : β, ∃ a, b ≤ f a
proof:
:=
  tendsto_atTop_atTop.trans <| forall_congr' fun _ => exists_congr fun a =>
    ⟨fun h => h a (le_refl a), fun h _a' ha' => le_trans h <| hf ha'⟩

name: tendsto_atTop_atBot_iff_of_antitone
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem tendsto_atTop_atBot_iff_of_antitone (hf : Antitone f) :
    Tendsto f atTop atBot ↔ ∀ b : β, ∃ a, f a ≤ b

name: Tendsto.subseq_mem
statement:
theorem Tendsto.subseq_mem {F : Filter α} {V : ℕ → Set α} (h : ∀ n, V n ∈ F) {u : ℕ → α}
    (hu : Tendsto u atTop F) : ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ n, u (φ n) ∈ V n
proof:
:=
  extraction_forall_of_eventually'
    (fun n => tendsto_atTop'.mp hu _ (h n) : ∀ n, ∃ N, ∀ k ≥ N, u k ∈ V n)

name: map_atTop_eq_of_gc_preorder
statement:
@[to_dual
/
Galois coinsertion. The Galois "coinsertion" and "connection" is weakened to only require it to be
an insertion and a connection below `b`. -/]
theorem map_atTop_eq_of_gc_preorder
    [Preorder α] [IsDirectedOrder α] [Preorder β] [IsDirectedOrder β] {f : α → β}
    (hf : Monotone f) (b : β)
    (hgi : ∀ c, b ≤ c → ∃ x, f x = c ∧ ∀ a, f a ≤ c ↔ a ≤ x) : map f atTop = atTop
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty α := (hgi b le_rfl).nonempty
  choose! g hfg hgle using hgi
  refine le_antisymm (hf.tendsto_atTop_atTop fun c ↦ ?_) ?_
  · rcases exists_ge_ge c b with ⟨d, hcd, hbd⟩
    exact ⟨g d, hcd.trans (hfg d hbd).ge⟩
  · have : Nonempty α := ⟨g b⟩
    rw [(atTop_basis.map f).ge_iff]
    intro a _
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (f a), eventually_ge_atTop b] with c hac hbc
    exact ⟨g c, (hgle _ hbc _).1 hac, hfg _ hbc⟩

name: map_atTop_eq_of_gc
statement:
@[to_dual
/
Galois coinsertion. The Galois "coinsertion" and "connection" is weakened to only require it to be
an insertion and a connection below `b`. -/]
theorem map_atTop_eq_of_gc
    [Preorder α] [IsDirectedOrder α] [PartialOrder β] [IsDirectedOrder β]
    {f : α → β} (g : β → α) (b : β) (hf : Monotone f)
    (gc : ∀ a, ∀ c, b ≤ c → (f a ≤ c ↔ a ≤ g c)) (hgi : ∀ c, b ≤ c → (c ≤ f (g c))) :
    map f atTop = atTop
proof:
:=
  map_atTop_eq_of_gc_preorder hf b fun c hc ↦
    ⟨g c, le_antisymm ((gc _ _ hc).2 le_rfl) (hgi c hc), (gc · c hc)⟩

name: map_val_atTop_of_Ici_subset
proof:
:= by
  choose f hl hr using exists_ge_ge (α := α)
  have : DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) s := fun x _ y _ ↦
    ⟨f a (f x y), h <| hl _ _, (hl x y).trans (hr _ _), (hr x y).trans (hr _ _)⟩
  have : IsDirectedOrder s := by
    rw [directedOn_iff_directed] at this
    rwa [IsDirectedOrder, ← directed_id_iff]
  refine map_atTop_eq_of_gc_preorder (Subtype.mono_coe _) a fun c hc ↦ ?_
  exact ⟨⟨c, h hc⟩, rfl, fun _ ↦ .rfl⟩

name: _root_.Nat.map_cast_int_atTop
statement:
@[simp]
theorem _root_.Nat.map_cast_int_atTop : map ((↑) : ℕ → ℤ) atTop = atTop
proof:
:= by
  refine map_atTop_eq_of_gc_preorder (fun _ _ ↦ Int.ofNat_le.2) 0 fun n hn ↦ ?_
  lift n to ℕ using hn
  exact ⟨n, rfl, fun _ ↦ Int.ofNat_le⟩

name: map_val_Ici_atTop
statement:
theorem map_val_Ici_atTop [Preorder α] [IsDirectedOrder α] (a : α) :
    map ((↑) : Ici a → α) atTop = atTop

name: map_val_Ioi_atTop
statement:
theorem map_val_Ioi_atTop [Preorder α] [IsDirectedOrder α] [NoMaxOrder α] (a : α) :
    map ((↑) : Ioi a → α) atTop = atTop
proof:
:=
  let ⟨_b, hb⟩ := exists_gt a
  map_val_atTop_of_Ici_subset <| Ici_subset_Ioi.2 hb

name: atTop_Ioi_eq
statement:
theorem atTop_Ioi_eq [Preorder α] [IsDirectedOrder α] (a : α) :
    atTop = comap ((↑) : Ioi a → α) atTop
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty (Ioi a) with h | ⟨⟨b, hb⟩⟩
  · subsingleton
  · rw [← map_val_atTop_of_Ici_subset (Ici_subset_Ioi.2 hb), comap_map Subtype.coe_injective]

name: atTop_Ici_eq
statement:
theorem atTop_Ici_eq [Preorder α] [IsDirectedOrder α] (a : α) :
    atTop = comap ((↑) : Ici a → α) atTop
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_val_Ici_atTop a, comap_map Subtype.coe_injective]

name: tendsto_Ioi_atTop
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem tendsto_Ioi_atTop [Preorder α] [IsDirectedOrder α]
    {a : α} {f : β → Ioi a} {l : Filter β} :
    Tendsto f l atTop ↔ Tendsto (fun x => (f x : α)) l atTop

name: tendsto_Ici_atTop
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem tendsto_Ici_atTop [Preorder α] [IsDirectedOrder α]
    {a : α} {f : β → Ici a} {l : Filter β} :
    Tendsto f l atTop ↔ Tendsto (fun x => (f x : α)) l atTop

name: tendsto_comp_val_Ioi_atTop
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
theorem tendsto_comp_val_Ioi_atTop [Preorder α] [IsDirectedOrder α] [NoMaxOrder α]
    {a : α} {f : α → β} {l : Filter β} :
    Tendsto (fun x : Ioi a => f x) atTop l ↔ Tendsto f atTop l
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_val_Ioi_atTop a, tendsto_map'_iff, Function.comp_def]

name: tendsto_comp_val_Ici_atTop
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
theorem tendsto_comp_val_Ici_atTop [Preorder α] [IsDirectedOrder α]
    {a : α} {f : α → β} {l : Filter β} :
    Tendsto (fun x : Ici a => f x) atTop l ↔ Tendsto f atTop l
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_val_Ici_atTop a, tendsto_map'_iff, Function.comp_def]

name: map_add_atTop_eq_nat
statement: theorem map_add_atTop_eq_nat (k : ℕ) : map (fun a => a + k) atTop = atTop
proof:
:=
  map_atTop_eq_of_gc (· - k) k (fun _ _ h => Nat.add_le_add_right h k)
    (fun _ _ h => (Nat.le_sub_iff_add_le h).symm) fun a h => by rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel h]

name: map_sub_atTop_eq_nat
statement: theorem map_sub_atTop_eq_nat (k : ℕ) : map (fun a => a - k) atTop = atTop
proof:
:=
  map_atTop_eq_of_gc (· + k) 0 (fun _ _ h => Nat.sub_le_sub_right h _)
    (fun _ _ _ => Nat.sub_le_iff_le_add) fun b _ => by rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_right]

name: tendsto_add_atTop_nat
statement: theorem tendsto_add_atTop_nat (k : ℕ) : Tendsto (fun a => a + k) atTop atTop

name: tendsto_sub_atTop_nat
statement: theorem tendsto_sub_atTop_nat (k : ℕ) : Tendsto (fun a => a - k) atTop atTop

name: tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat
statement:
theorem tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat {f : ℕ → α} {l : Filter α} (k : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun n => f (n + k)) atTop l ↔ Tendsto f atTop l
proof:
:=
  show Tendsto (f ∘ fun n => n + k) atTop l ↔ Tendsto f atTop l by
    rw [← tendsto_map'_iff, map_add_atTop_eq_nat]

name: map_div_atTop_eq_nat
statement: theorem map_div_atTop_eq_nat (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) : map (fun a => a / k) atTop = atTop
proof:
:=
  map_atTop_eq_of_gc (fun b => k * b + (k - 1)) 1 (fun _ _ h => Nat.div_le_div_right h)
    (fun a b _ => by rw [Nat.div_le_iff_le_mul_add_pred hk])
    fun b _ => by rw [Nat.mul_add_div hk, Nat.div_eq_of_lt, Nat.add_zero]; lia

theorem not_bddAbove_of_tendsto_atTop [NoMaxOrder β] (h : Tendsto f l atTop) :

proof:

  have : ∀ x, f x ≤ M := by aesop
  have : ∅ = f ⁻¹' Ioi M := by aesop (add forward safe not_le_of_gt)
  apply Filter.empty_notMem l
  aesop (add safe Ioi_mem_atTop)

name: HasAntitoneBasis.eventually_subset
statement:
theorem HasAntitoneBasis.eventually_subset [Preorder ι] {l : Filter α} {s : ι → Set α}
    (hl : l.HasAntitoneBasis s) {t : Set α} (ht : t ∈ l) : ∀ᶠ i in atTop, s i ⊆ t
proof:
:=
  let ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := hl.1.mem_iff.1 ht
  (eventually_ge_atTop i).mono fun _j hj => (hl.antitone hj).trans hi

name: HasAntitoneBasis.tendsto
statement:
protected theorem HasAntitoneBasis.tendsto [Preorder ι] {l : Filter α} {s : ι → Set α}
    (hl : l.HasAntitoneBasis s) {φ : ι → α} (h : ∀ i : ι, φ i ∈ s i) : Tendsto φ atTop l
proof:
:=
  fun _t ht => mem_map.2 <| (hl.eventually_subset ht).mono fun i hi => hi (h i)

name: HasAntitoneBasis.comp_mono
statement:
theorem HasAntitoneBasis.comp_mono [Nonempty ι] [Preorder ι] [IsDirectedOrder ι] [Preorder ι']
    {l : Filter α}
    {s : ι' → Set α} (hs : l.HasAntitoneBasis s) {φ : ι → ι'} (φ_mono : Monotone φ)
    (hφ : Tendsto φ atTop atTop) : l.HasAntitoneBasis (s ∘ φ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨hs.1.to_hasBasis
      (fun n _ => (hφ.eventually_ge_atTop n).exists.imp fun _m hm => ⟨trivial, hs.antitone hm⟩)
      fun n _ => ⟨φ n, trivial, Subset.rfl⟩,
    hs.antitone.comp_monotone φ_mono⟩

theorem disjoint_atBot_atTop [PartialOrder α] [Nontrivial α] :

proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_pair_ne α with ⟨x, y, hne⟩
  by_cases hle : x ≤ y
  · refine disjoint_of_disjoint_of_mem ?_ (Iic_mem_atBot x) (Ici_mem_atTop y)
    exact Iic_disjoint_Ici.2 (hle.lt_of_ne hne).not_ge
  · refine disjoint_of_disjoint_of_mem ?_ (Iic_mem_atBot y) (Ici_mem_atTop x)
    exact Iic_disjoint_Ici.2 hle

statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem Ioi_mem_atTop [Preorder α] [NoTopOrder α] (x : α) : Ioi x ∈ (atTop : Filter α)
proof:
:=
  let ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_not_le x
  mem_of_superset (inter_mem (mem_atTop x) (mem_atTop z))
    fun _ ⟨hxy, hzy⟩ => lt_of_le_not_ge hxy fun hyx => hz (hzy.trans hyx)

name: atTop_eq_generate_of_forall_exists_le
statement:
@[to_dual]
lemma atTop_eq_generate_of_forall_exists_le [Preorder α] {s : Set α} (hs : ∀ x, ∃ y ∈ s, x ≤ y) :
    (atTop : Filter α) = generate (Ici '' s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [atTop_eq_generate_Ici]
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [le_generate_iff]
    rintro - ⟨y, -, rfl⟩
    exact mem_generate_of_mem ⟨y, rfl⟩
  · rw [le_generate_iff]
    rintro - ⟨x, -, -, rfl⟩
    rcases hs x with ⟨y, ys, hy⟩
    have A : Ici y ∈ generate (Ici '' s) := mem_generate_of_mem (mem_image_of_mem _ ys)
    have B : Ici y ⊆ Ici x := Ici_subset_Ici.2 hy
    exact sets_of_superset (generate (Ici '' s)) A B

lemma atTop_eq_generate_of_not_bddAbove [LinearOrder α] {s : Set α} (hs : ¬ BddAbove s) :
    (atTop : Filter α) = generate (Ici '' s)
proof:
:= by
  refine atTop_eq_generate_of_forall_exists_le fun x ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := not_bddAbove_iff.mp hs x
  exact ⟨y, hy, hy'.le⟩

name: Monotone.piecewise_eventually_eq_iUnion
statement:
theorem Monotone.piecewise_eventually_eq_iUnion {β : α → Type*} [Preorder ι] {s : ι → Set α}
    [∀ i, DecidablePred (· ∈ s i)] [DecidablePred (· ∈ ⋃ i, s i)]
    (hs : Monotone s) (f g : (a : α) → β a) (a : α) :
    ∀ᶠ i in atTop, (s i).piecewise f g a = (⋃ i, s i).piecewise f g a
proof:
:= by
  rcases em (∃ i, a ∈ s i) with ⟨i, hi⟩ | ha
  · refine (eventually_ge_atTop i).mono fun j hij ↦ ?_
    simp only [Set.piecewise_eq_of_mem, hs hij hi, subset_iUnion _ _ hi]
  · filter_upwards with i
    simp only [Set.piecewise_eq_of_notMem, not_exists.1 ha i, mt mem_iUnion.1 ha,
      not_false_eq_true]

name: Antitone.piecewise_eventually_eq_iInter
statement:
theorem Antitone.piecewise_eventually_eq_iInter {β : α → Type*} [Preorder ι] {s : ι → Set α}
    [∀ i, DecidablePred (· ∈ s i)] [DecidablePred (· ∈ ⋂ i, s i)]
    (hs : Antitone s) (f g : (a : α) → β a) (a : α) :
    ∀ᶠ i in atTop, (s i).piecewise f g a = (⋂ i, s i).piecewise f g a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  convert! ← (compl_anti.comp hs).piecewise_eventually_eq_iUnion g f a using 3
  · convert! congr_fun (Set.piecewise_compl (s _) g f) a
  · simp only [(· ∘ ·), ← compl_iInter, Set.piecewise_compl]

name: FloorSemiring.eventually_mul_pow_lt_factorial_sub
statement:
theorem FloorSemiring.eventually_mul_pow_lt_factorial_sub (a c : K) (d : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, a * c ^ n < (n - d)!
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [Nat.eventually_mul_pow_lt_factorial_sub ⌈|a|⌉₊ ⌈|c|⌉₊ d] with n h
  calc a * c ^ n
    _ ≤ |a * c ^ n| := le_abs_self _
    _ ≤ ⌈|a|⌉₊ * (⌈|c|⌉₊ : K) ^ n := ?_
    _ = ↑(⌈|a|⌉₊ * ⌈|c|⌉₊ ^ n) := ?_
    _ < (n - d)! := Nat.cast_lt.mpr h
  · rw [abs_mul, abs_pow]
    gcongr <;> try first | positivity | apply Nat.le_ceil
  · simp_rw [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow]

name: Filter.map_atTop_finsetProd_le_of_prod_eq
statement:
@[to_additive /
gives a sufficient condition for comparison of the filter `atTop.map (fun s ↦ ∑ b ∈ s, f b)` with
`atTop.map (fun s ↦ ∑ b ∈ s, g b)`. This is useful to compare the set of limit points of
`∑ b ∈ s, f b` as `s → atTop` with the similar set for `g`. -/]
theorem Filter.map_atTop_finsetProd_le_of_prod_eq {f : α → M} {g : β → M}
    (h_eq : ∀ u : Finset β,
      ∃ v : Finset α, ∀ v', v ⊆ v' → ∃ u', u ⊆ u' ∧ ∏ x ∈ u', g x = ∏ b ∈ v', f b) :
    (atTop.map fun s : Finset α => ∏ b ∈ s, f b) ≤
      atTop.map fun s : Finset β => ∏ x ∈ s, g x
proof:
:= by
  refine ((atTop_basis.map _).le_basis_iff (atTop_basis.map _)).2 fun b _ => ?_
  let ⟨v, hv⟩ := h_eq b
  refine ⟨v, trivial, ?_⟩
  simpa [Finset.image_subset_iff] using! hv

name: Function.Injective.map_atTop_finsetProd_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Function.Injective.map_atTop_finsetProd_eq {g : α → β}
    (hg : Function.Injective g) {f : β → M} (hf : ∀ x, x ∉ Set.range g → f x = 1) :
    map (fun s => ∏ i ∈ s, f (g i)) atTop = map (fun s => ∏ i ∈ s, f i) atTop
proof:
:= by
  have := Classical.decEq β
  apply le_antisymm <;> refine map_atTop_finsetProd_le_of_prod_eq fun s => ?_
  · refine ⟨s.preimage g hg.injOn, fun t ht => ?_⟩
    refine ⟨t.image g ∪ s, Finset.subset_union_right, ?_⟩
    rw [← Finset.prod_image hg.injOn]
    refine (prod_subset subset_union_left ?_).symm
    simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image]
    refine fun y hy hyt => hf y (mt ?_ hyt)
    rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x, ht (Finset.mem_preimage.2 <| hy.resolve_left hyt), rfl⟩
  · refine ⟨s.image g, fun t ht => ?_⟩
    simp only [← prod_preimage _ _ hg.injOn _ fun x _ => hf x]
    exact ⟨_, (image_subset_iff_subset_preimage _).1 ht, rfl⟩

proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hrf => not_le.mp fun hr => ?_, fun hr => (tendsto_const_mul_atTop_of_pos hr).mpr h⟩
  rcases ((h.eventually_ge_atTop 0).and (hrf.eventually_gt_atTop 0)).exists with ⟨x, hx, hrx⟩
  exact (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hr hx).not_gt hrx

name: _root_.Monotone.ciSup_comp_tendsto_atTop
statement:
@[to_dual
/
and `g` tends to `atBot` along a nontrivial filter,
then the indexed infimum of `f ∘ g` is equal to the indexed infimum of `f`.

The assumption `BddBelow (range f)` can be omitted,
if the codomain of `f` is a conditionally complete linear order or a complete lattice, see below.
-/]
theorem _root_.Monotone.ciSup_comp_tendsto_atTop [Preorder β] [ConditionallyCompleteLattice γ]
    {l : Filter α} [l.NeBot] {f : β → γ} (hf : Monotone f) (hb : BddAbove (range f))
    {g : α → β} (hg : Tendsto g l atTop) : ⨆ a, f (g a) = ⨆ b, f b
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty α := nonempty_of_neBot l
  have : Nonempty β := .map g ‹_›
  rw [← csInf_upperBounds_range, ← csInf_upperBounds_range,
    ← hf.upperBounds_range_comp_tendsto_atTop hg, Function.comp_def]
  exacts [hb, hb.mono <| range_comp_subset_range _ _]

name: _root_.Antitone.ciSup_comp_tendsto_atBot
statement:
@[to_dual
/
and `g` tends to `atTop` along a nontrivial filter,
then the indexed infimum of `f ∘ g` is equal to the indexed infimum of `f`.

The assumption `BddBelow (range f)` can be omitted,
if the codomain of `f` is a conditionally complete linear order or a complete lattice, see below.
-/]
theorem _root_.Antitone.ciSup_comp_tendsto_atBot [Preorder β] [ConditionallyCompleteLattice γ]
    {l : Filter α} [l.NeBot] {f : β → γ} (hf : Antitone f) (hb : BddAbove (range f))
    {g : α → β} (hg : Tendsto g l atBot) : ⨆ a, f (g a) = ⨆ b, f b

name: _root_.Monotone.ciSup_comp_tendsto_atTop_of_linearOrder
statement:
@[to_dual
/
and `g` tends to `atBot` along a nontrivial filter,
then the indexed infimum of `f ∘ g` is equal to the indexed infimum of `f`. -/]
theorem _root_.Monotone.ciSup_comp_tendsto_atTop_of_linearOrder [Preorder β]
    [ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder γ] {l : Filter α} [l.NeBot] {f : β → γ} (hf : Monotone f)
    {g : α → β} (hg : Tendsto g l atTop) : ⨆ a, f (g a) = ⨆ b, f b
proof:
:= by
  if hb : BddAbove (range f) then
    exact hf.ciSup_comp_tendsto_atTop hb hg
  else
    rw [iSup, iSup, csSup_of_not_bddAbove, csSup_of_not_bddAbove hb]
    rwa [BddAbove, ← Function.comp_def f g, hf.upperBounds_range_comp_tendsto_atTop hg]

name: HasBasis.iInf'
statement:
protected theorem HasBasis.iInf' {ι : Type*} {ι' : ι → Type*} {l : ι → Filter α}
    {p : ∀ i, ι' i → Prop} {s : ∀ i, ι' i → Set α} (hl : ∀ i, (l i).HasBasis (p i) (s i)) :
    (⨅ i, l i).HasBasis (fun If : Set ι × ∀ i, ι' i => If.1.Finite ∧ ∀ i ∈ If.1, p i (If.2 i))
      fun If : Set ι × ∀ i, ι' i => ⋂ i ∈ If.1, s i (If.2 i)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by
    intro t
    constructor
    · simp only [mem_iInf', (hl _).mem_iff]
      rintro ⟨I, hI, V, hV, -, rfl, -⟩
      choose u hu using hV
      exact ⟨⟨I, u⟩, ⟨hI, fun i _ => (hu i).1⟩, iInter₂_mono fun i _ => (hu i).2⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨I, f⟩, ⟨hI₁, hI₂⟩, hsub⟩
      grw [← hsub]
      exact (biInter_mem hI₁).mpr fun i hi => mem_iInf_of_mem i <| (hl i).mem_of_mem <| hI₂ _ hi⟩

name: HasBasis.iInf
statement:
protected theorem HasBasis.iInf {ι : Type*} {ι' : ι → Type*} {l : ι → Filter α}
    {p : ∀ i, ι' i → Prop} {s : ∀ i, ι' i → Set α} (hl : ∀ i, (l i).HasBasis (p i) (s i)) :
    (⨅ i, l i).HasBasis
      (fun If : Σ I : Set ι, ∀ i : I, ι' i => If.1.Finite ∧ ∀ i : If.1, p i (If.2 i)) fun If =>
      ⋂ i : If.1, s i (If.2 i)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun t => ⟨fun ht => ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rcases (HasBasis.iInf' hl).mem_iff.mp ht with ⟨⟨I, f⟩, ⟨hI, hf⟩, hsub⟩
    exact ⟨⟨I, fun i => f i⟩, ⟨hI, Subtype.forall.mpr hf⟩, trans (iInter_subtype _ _) hsub⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨I, f⟩, ⟨hI, hf⟩, hsub⟩
    grw [← hsub]
    cases hI.nonempty_fintype
    exact iInter_mem.2 fun i => mem_iInf_of_mem ↑i <| (hl i).mem_of_mem <| hf _

name: _root_.Pairwise.exists_mem_filter_basis_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem _root_.Pairwise.exists_mem_filter_basis_of_disjoint {I} [Finite I] {l : I → Filter α}
    {ι : I → Sort*} {p : ∀ i, ι i → Prop} {s : ∀ i, ι i → Set α} (hd : Pairwise (Disjoint on l))
    (h : ∀ i, (l i).HasBasis (p i) (s i)) :
    ∃ ind : ∀ i, ι i, (∀ i, p i (ind i)) ∧ Pairwise (Disjoint on fun i => s i (ind i))
proof:
:= by
  rcases hd.exists_mem_filter_of_disjoint with ⟨t, htl, hd⟩
  choose ind hp ht using fun i => (h i).mem_iff.1 (htl i)
  exact ⟨ind, hp, hd.mono fun i j hij => hij.mono (ht _) (ht _)⟩

name: _root_.Set.PairwiseDisjoint.exists_mem_filter_basis
proof:
:= by

name: eq_iInf_principal

proof:
:= by
  have : Directed (· ≥ ·) fun s : B.sets => 𝓟 (s : Set α) := by
    rintro ⟨U, U_in⟩ ⟨V, V_in⟩
    rcases B.inter_sets U_in V_in with ⟨W, W_in, W_sub⟩
    use ⟨W, W_in⟩
    simp only [le_principal_iff, mem_principal]
    exact subset_inter_iff.mp W_sub
  ext U
  simp [mem_filter_iff, mem_iInf_of_directed this]

    exact GenerateSets.superset (GenerateSets.basic V_in) h
  · rw [le_generate_iff]
    apply mem_filter_of_mem

statement:
theorem HasBasis.to_hasBasis' (hl : l.HasBasis p s) (h : ∀ i, p i → ∃ i', p' i' ∧ s' i' ⊆ s i)
    (h' : ∀ i', p' i' → s' i' ∈ l) : l.HasBasis p' s'
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun t => ⟨fun ht => ?_, fun ⟨i', hi', ht⟩ => mem_of_superset (h' i' hi') ht⟩⟩
  rcases hl.mem_iff.1 ht with ⟨i, hi, ht⟩
  rcases h i hi with ⟨i', hi', hs's⟩
  exact ⟨i', hi', hs's.trans ht⟩

    (h' : ∀ i', p' i' → ∃ i, p i ∧ s i ⊆ s' i') : l.HasBasis p' s'
proof:
:=
  hl.to_hasBasis' h fun i' hi' =>
    let ⟨i, hi, hss'⟩ := h' i' hi'
    hl.mem_iff.2 ⟨i, hi, hss'⟩

proof:

proof:
:= by
  simp only [Filter.Frequently, hl.eventually_iff]; push Not; rfl

name: HasBasis.exists_iff
statement:
theorem HasBasis.exists_iff (hl : l.HasBasis p s) {P : Set α → Prop}
    (mono : ∀ ⦃s t⦄, s ⊆ t → P t → P s) : (∃ s ∈ l, P s) ↔ ∃ i, p i ∧ P (s i)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨_s, hs, hP⟩ =>
    let ⟨i, hi, his⟩ := hl.mem_iff.1 hs
    ⟨i, hi, mono his hP⟩,
    fun ⟨i, hi, hP⟩ => ⟨s i, hl.mem_of_mem hi, hP⟩⟩

name: HasBasis.forall_iff
statement:
theorem HasBasis.forall_iff (hl : l.HasBasis p s) {P : Set α → Prop}
    (mono : ∀ ⦃s t⦄, s ⊆ t → P s → P t) : (∀ s ∈ l, P s) ↔ ∀ i, p i → P (s i)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun H i hi => H (s i) <| hl.mem_of_mem hi, fun H _s hs =>
    let ⟨i, hi, his⟩ := hl.mem_iff.1 hs
    mono his (H i hi)⟩

name: HasBasis.neBot_iff
statement:
protected theorem HasBasis.neBot_iff (hl : l.HasBasis p s) :
    NeBot l ↔ ∀ {i}, p i → (s i).Nonempty

name: HasBasis.eq_bot_iff
statement: theorem HasBasis.eq_bot_iff (hl : l.HasBasis p s) : l = ⊥ ↔ ∃ i, p i ∧ s i = ∅
proof:
:=
  not_iff_not.1 <| neBot_iff.symm.trans <|
    hl.neBot_iff.trans <| by simp only [not_exists, not_and, nonempty_iff_ne_empty]

name: basis_sets
statement: theorem basis_sets (l : Filter α) : l.HasBasis (fun s : Set α => s ∈ l) id

name: asBasis_filter
statement: theorem asBasis_filter (f : Filter α) : f.asBasis.filter = f

name: hasBasis_self
statement:
theorem hasBasis_self {l : Filter α} {P : Set α → Prop} :
    HasBasis l (fun s => s ∈ l ∧ P s) id ↔ ∀ t ∈ l, ∃ r ∈ l, P r ∧ r ⊆ t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hasBasis_iff, id, and_assoc]
  exact forall_congr' fun s =>
    ⟨fun h => h.1, fun h => ⟨h, fun ⟨t, hl, _, hts⟩ => mem_of_superset hl hts⟩⟩

name: HasBasis.comp_surjective
statement:
theorem HasBasis.comp_surjective (h : l.HasBasis p s) {g : ι' → ι} (hg : Function.Surjective g) :
    l.HasBasis (p ∘ g) (s ∘ g)

name: HasBasis.comp_equiv
statement: theorem HasBasis.comp_equiv (h : l.HasBasis p s) (e : ι' ≃ ι) : l.HasBasis (p ∘ e) (s ∘ e)

name: HasBasis.to_image_id'
statement: theorem HasBasis.to_image_id' (h : l.HasBasis p s) : l.HasBasis (fun t ↦ ∃ i, p i ∧ s i = t) id

name: HasBasis.to_image_id
statement:
theorem HasBasis.to_image_id {ι : Type*} {p : ι → Prop} {s : ι → Set α} (h : l.HasBasis p s) :
    l.HasBasis (· ∈ s '' {i | p i}) id

name: HasBasis.restrict
statement:
theorem HasBasis.restrict (h : l.HasBasis p s) {q : ι → Prop}
    (hq : ∀ i, p i → ∃ j, p j ∧ q j ∧ s j ⊆ s i) : l.HasBasis (fun i => p i ∧ q i) s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun t => ⟨fun ht => ?_, fun ⟨i, hpi, hti⟩ => h.mem_iff.2 ⟨i, hpi.1, hti⟩⟩⟩
  rcases h.mem_iff.1 ht with ⟨i, hpi, hti⟩
  rcases hq i hpi with ⟨j, hpj, hqj, hji⟩
  exact ⟨j, ⟨hpj, hqj⟩, hji.trans hti⟩

name: HasBasis.restrict_subset
statement:
theorem HasBasis.restrict_subset (h : l.HasBasis p s) {V : Set α} (hV : V ∈ l) :
    l.HasBasis (fun i => p i ∧ s i ⊆ V) s
proof:
:=
  h.restrict fun _i hi => (h.mem_iff.1 (inter_mem hV (h.mem_of_mem hi))).imp fun _j hj =>
    ⟨hj.1, subset_inter_iff.1 hj.2⟩

name: HasBasis.hasBasis_self_subset
statement:
theorem HasBasis.hasBasis_self_subset {p : Set α → Prop} (h : l.HasBasis (fun s => s ∈ l ∧ p s) id)
    {V : Set α} (hV : V ∈ l) : l.HasBasis (fun s => s ∈ l ∧ p s ∧ s ⊆ V) id
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [and_assoc] using! h.restrict_subset hV

name: HasBasis.ge_iff
statement: theorem HasBasis.ge_iff (hl' : l'.HasBasis p' s') : l ≤ l' ↔ ∀ i', p' i' → s' i' ∈ l
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _i' hi' => h <| hl'.mem_of_mem hi', fun h _s hs =>
    let ⟨_i', hi', hs⟩ := hl'.mem_iff.1 hs
    mem_of_superset (h _ hi') hs⟩

name: HasBasis.le_iff
statement: theorem HasBasis.le_iff (hl : l.HasBasis p s) : l ≤ l' ↔ ∀ t ∈ l', ∃ i, p i ∧ s i ⊆ t

name: HasBasis.le_basis_iff
statement:
theorem HasBasis.le_basis_iff (hl : l.HasBasis p s) (hl' : l'.HasBasis p' s') :
    l ≤ l' ↔ ∀ i', p' i' → ∃ i, p i ∧ s i ⊆ s' i'

name: HasBasis.eq_top_iff
statement: theorem HasBasis.eq_top_iff (h : l.HasBasis p s) : l = ⊤ ↔ ∀ i, p i → s i = univ

name: HasBasis.ext
statement:
theorem HasBasis.ext (hl : l.HasBasis p s) (hl' : l'.HasBasis p' s')
    (h : ∀ i, p i → ∃ i', p' i' ∧ s' i' ⊆ s i) (h' : ∀ i', p' i' → ∃ i, p i ∧ s i ⊆ s' i') :
    l = l'
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [hl.le_basis_iff hl']
    simpa using h'
  · rw [hl'.le_basis_iff hl]
    simpa using h

name: HasBasis.inf'
statement:
theorem HasBasis.inf' (hl : l.HasBasis p s) (hl' : l'.HasBasis p' s') :
    (l ⊓ l').HasBasis (fun i : PProd ι ι' => p i.1 ∧ p' i.2) fun i => s i.1 ∩ s' i.2
proof:
:=
  ⟨by
    intro t
    constructor
    · simp only [mem_inf_iff, hl.mem_iff, hl'.mem_iff]
      rintro ⟨t, ⟨i, hi, ht⟩, t', ⟨i', hi', ht'⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨i, i'⟩, ⟨hi, hi'⟩, inter_subset_inter ht ht'⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨i, i'⟩, ⟨hi, hi'⟩, H⟩
      exact mem_inf_of_inter (hl.mem_of_mem hi) (hl'.mem_of_mem hi') H⟩

name: HasBasis.inf
hasBasis_iInf_of_directed'
statement:
theorem hasBasis_iInf_of_directed' {ι : Type*} {ι' : ι → Sort _} [Nonempty ι] {l : ι → Filter α}
    (s : ∀ i, ι' i → Set α) (p : ∀ i, ι' i → Prop) (hl : ∀ i, (l i).HasBasis (p i) (s i))
    (h : Directed (· ≥ ·) l) :
    (⨅ i, l i).HasBasis (fun ii' : Σ i, ι' i => p ii'.1 ii'.2) fun ii' => s ii'.1 ii'.2
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun t => ?_⟩
  rw [mem_iInf_of_directed h, Sigma.exists]
  exact exists_congr fun i => (hl i).mem_iff

name: hasBasis_iInf_of_directed
statement:
theorem hasBasis_iInf_of_directed {ι : Type*} {ι' : Sort _} [Nonempty ι] {l : ι → Filter α}
    (s : ι → ι' → Set α) (p : ι → ι' → Prop) (hl : ∀ i, (l i).HasBasis (p i) (s i))
    (h : Directed (· ≥ ·) l) :
    (⨅ i, l i).HasBasis (fun ii' : ι × ι' => p ii'.1 ii'.2) fun ii' => s ii'.1 ii'.2
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun t => ?_⟩
  rw [mem_iInf_of_directed h, Prod.exists]
  exact exists_congr fun i => (hl i).mem_iff

name: hasBasis_biInf_of_directed'
statement:
theorem hasBasis_biInf_of_directed' {ι : Type*} {ι' : ι → Sort _} {dom : Set ι}
    (hdom : dom.Nonempty) {l : ι → Filter α} (s : ∀ i, ι' i → Set α) (p : ∀ i, ι' i → Prop)
    (hl : ∀ i ∈ dom, (l i).HasBasis (p i) (s i)) (h : DirectedOn (l ⁻¹'o GE.ge) dom) :
    (⨅ i ∈ dom, l i).HasBasis (fun ii' : Σ i, ι' i => ii'.1 ∈ dom ∧ p ii'.1 ii'.2) fun ii' =>
      s ii'.1 ii'.2
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun t => ?_⟩
  rw [mem_biInf_of_directed h hdom, Sigma.exists]
  grind +splitIndPred

name: hasBasis_biInf_of_directed
statement:
theorem hasBasis_biInf_of_directed {ι : Type*} {ι' : Sort _} {dom : Set ι} (hdom : dom.Nonempty)
    {l : ι → Filter α} (s : ι → ι' → Set α) (p : ι → ι' → Prop)
    (hl : ∀ i ∈ dom, (l i).HasBasis (p i) (s i)) (h : DirectedOn (l ⁻¹'o GE.ge) dom) :
    (⨅ i ∈ dom, l i).HasBasis (fun ii' : ι × ι' => ii'.1 ∈ dom ∧ p ii'.1 ii'.2) fun ii' =>
      s ii'.1 ii'.2
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun t => ?_⟩
  rw [mem_biInf_of_directed h hdom, Prod.exists]
  grind +splitIndPred

name: HasBasis.sup'
statement:
theorem HasBasis.sup' (hl : l.HasBasis p s) (hl' : l'.HasBasis p' s') :
    (l ⊔ l').HasBasis (fun i : PProd ι ι' => p i.1 ∧ p' i.2) fun i => s i.1 ∪ s' i.2
proof:
:=
  ⟨by
    intro t
    simp_rw [mem_sup, hl.mem_iff, hl'.mem_iff, PProd.exists, union_subset_iff,
       ← exists_and_right, ← exists_and_left]
    simp only [and_assoc, and_left_comm]⟩

name: HasBasis.sup
hasBasis_iSup
proof:

statement:
theorem HasBasis.inf_principal (hl : l.HasBasis p s) (s' : Set α) :
    (l ⊓ 𝓟 s').HasBasis p fun i => s i ∩ s'
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun t => by
    simp only [mem_inf_principal, hl.mem_iff, subset_def, mem_ofPred_eq, mem_inter_iff, and_imp]⟩

name: HasBasis.principal_inf
statement:
theorem HasBasis.principal_inf (hl : l.HasBasis p s) (s' : Set α) :

proof:

statement:
theorem HasBasis.inf_principal_neBot_iff (hl : l.HasBasis p s) {t : Set α} :

name: HasBasis.disjoint_iff
statement:
theorem HasBasis.disjoint_iff (hl : l.HasBasis p s) (hl' : l'.HasBasis p' s') :
    Disjoint l l' ↔ ∃ i, p i ∧ ∃ i', p' i' ∧ Disjoint (s i) (s' i')
proof:
:=
  not_iff_not.mp <| by simp only [_root_.disjoint_iff, ← Ne.eq_def, ← neBot_iff, inf_eq_inter,
    hl.inf_basis_neBot_iff hl', not_exists, not_and, bot_eq_empty, ← nonempty_iff_ne_empty]

statement:

statement: theorem inf_principal_neBot_iff {s : Set α} : NeBot (l ⊓ 𝓟 s) ↔ ∀ U ∈ l, (U ∩ s).Nonempty

name: mem_iff_inf_principal_compl
statement: theorem mem_iff_inf_principal_compl {f : Filter α} {s : Set α} : s ∈ f ↔ f ⊓ 𝓟 sᶜ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine not_iff_not.1 ((inf_principal_neBot_iff.trans ?_).symm.trans neBot_iff)
  exact
    ⟨fun h hs => by simpa [Set.not_nonempty_empty] using h s hs, fun hs t ht =>
      inter_compl_nonempty_iff.2 fun hts => hs <| mem_of_superset ht hts⟩

proof:

name: hasBasis_biInf_principal
statement:
theorem hasBasis_biInf_principal {s : β → Set α} {S : Set β} (h : DirectedOn (s ⁻¹'o (· ≥ ·)) S)
    (ne : S.Nonempty) : (⨅ i ∈ S, 𝓟 (s i)).HasBasis (fun i => i ∈ S) s
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun t => by
    refine mem_biInf_of_directed ?_ ne

name: HasBasis.forall_mem_mem

theorem HasBasis.forall_mem_mem (h : HasBasis l p s) {x : α} :

proof:
:= by

name: HasBasis.biInf_mem
statement:
protected theorem HasBasis.biInf_mem [CompleteLattice β] {f : Set α → β} (h : HasBasis l p s)
    (hf : Monotone f) : ⨅ t ∈ l, f t = ⨅ (i) (_ : p i), f (s i)
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (le_iInf₂ fun i hi => iInf₂_le (s i) (h.mem_of_mem hi)) <|
    le_iInf₂ fun _t ht =>
      let ⟨i, hpi, hi⟩ := h.mem_iff.1 ht
      iInf₂_le_of_le i hpi (hf hi)

name: HasBasis.tendsto_left_iff
statement:
theorem HasBasis.tendsto_left_iff (hla : la.HasBasis pa sa) :
    Tendsto f la lb ↔ ∀ t ∈ lb, ∃ i, pa i ∧ MapsTo f (sa i) t

protected theorem HasBasis.principal_prod (sa : Set α) (h : lb.HasBasis pb sb) :

name: HasBasis.prod_same_index
statement:
theorem HasBasis.prod_same_index {p : ι → Prop} {sb : ι → Set β} (hla : la.HasBasis p sa)
    (hlb : lb.HasBasis p sb) (h_dir : ∀ {i j}, p i → p j → ∃ k, p k ∧ sa k ⊆ sa i ∧ sb k ⊆ sb j) :
    (la ×ˢ lb).HasBasis p fun i => sa i ×ˢ sb i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hasBasis_iff, (hla.prod_pprod hlb).mem_iff]
  refine fun t => ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨i, j⟩, ⟨hi, hj⟩, hsub : sa i ×ˢ sb j ⊆ t⟩
    rcases h_dir hi hj with ⟨k, hk, ki, kj⟩
    exact ⟨k, hk, (Set.prod_mono ki kj).trans hsub⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, h⟩
    exact ⟨⟨i, i⟩, ⟨hi, hi⟩, h⟩

name: HasBasis.prod_same_index_mono
statement:
theorem HasBasis.prod_same_index_mono {ι : Type*} [LinearOrder ι] {p : ι → Prop} {sa : ι → Set α}
    {sb : ι → Set β} (hla : la.HasBasis p sa) (hlb : lb.HasBasis p sb)
    (hsa : MonotoneOn sa { i | p i }) (hsb : MonotoneOn sb { i | p i }) :
    (la ×ˢ lb).HasBasis p fun i => sa i ×ˢ sb i
proof:
:=
  hla.prod_same_index hlb fun {i j} hi hj =>
    have : p (min i j) := min_rec' _ hi hj
    ⟨min i j, this, hsa this hi <| min_le_left _ _, hsb this hj <| min_le_right _ _⟩

name: HasBasis.prod_same_index_anti

    simpa only [exists_prop, subset_inter_iff] using
      hl.mem_iff.1 (inter_mem (hl.mem_of_mem hi) (hl.mem_of_mem hj))

statement: theorem finite_sUnion_mem_iff {s : Set (Set α)} (hs : s.Finite) : ⋃₀ s ∈ f ↔ ∃ t ∈ s, t ∈ f

name: eq_pure_of_finite_mem
statement: theorem eq_pure_of_finite_mem (h : s.Finite) (h' : s ∈ f) : ∃ x ∈ s, f = pure x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← biUnion_of_singleton s] at h'
  rcases (Ultrafilter.finite_biUnion_mem_iff h).mp h' with ⟨a, has, haf⟩
  exact ⟨a, has, eq_of_le (Filter.le_pure_iff.2 haf)⟩

  or_iff_not_imp_left.2 fun h =>
    let ⟨_, hs, hfin⟩ := Filter.disjoint_cofinite_right.1 (disjoint_iff_not_le.2 h)
    let ⟨a, _, hf⟩ := eq_pure_of_finite_mem hfin hs

name: exists_ultrafilter_of_finite_inter_nonempty
statement:
theorem exists_ultrafilter_of_finite_inter_nonempty (S : Set (Set α))
    (cond : ∀ T : Finset (Set α), (↑T : Set (Set α)) ⊆ S → (⋂₀ (↑T : Set (Set α))).Nonempty) :
    ∃ F : Ultrafilter α, S ⊆ F.sets
proof:
:=
  haveI : NeBot (generate S) :=
    generate_neBot_iff.2 fun _ hts ht =>
      ht.coe_toFinset ▸ cond ht.toFinset (ht.coe_toFinset.symm ▸ hts)
  ⟨of (generate S), fun _ ht => (of_le <| generate S) <| GenerateSets.basic ht⟩

name: interPairsFilter_pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
theorem interPairsFilter_pairwiseDisjoint : Set.univ.Pairwise
    (fun s t : Set (Set α) => Disjoint (interPairsFilter s) (interPairsFilter t))
proof:
:= by
  intro s _ t _ hst
  simp_rw [← symmDiff_nonempty, nonempty_def, mem_symmDiff] at hst
  rw [Filter.disjoint_iff]
  unfold interPairsFilter
  obtain ⟨x, hx | hx⟩ := hst
  · exact ⟨interPair x, Filter.mem_iInf_of_mem x
      (ite_eq_left hx.1 ▸ Filter.mem_principal_self (interPair x)),
      (interPair x)ᶜ, Filter.mem_iInf_of_mem x
      (ite_eq_right hx.2 ▸ Filter.mem_principal_self (interPair x)ᶜ),
      disjoint_compl_right⟩
  · exact ⟨(interPair x)ᶜ, Filter.mem_iInf_of_mem x
      (ite_eq_right hx.2 ▸ Filter.mem_principal_self (interPair x)ᶜ),
      interPair x, Filter.mem_iInf_of_mem x
      (ite_eq_left hx.1 ▸ Filter.mem_principal_self (interPair x)),
      disjoint_compl_left⟩

name: mem_iff_ultrafilter
statement: theorem mem_iff_ultrafilter : s ∈ f ↔ ∀ g : Ultrafilter α, ↑g ≤ f → s ∈ g
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hf g hg => hg hf, fun H => by_contra fun hf => ?_⟩
  set g : Filter (sᶜ : Set α) := comap (↑) f
  have : NeBot g := comap_neBot_iff_compl_range.2 (by simpa [compl_ofPred])
  simpa using H ((of g).map (↑)) (map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr (of_le g))

name: forall_neBot_le_iff

proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun H f hf => H f f.neBot hf, ?_⟩
  intro H f hf hfg
  exact hp (of_le f) (H _ ((of_le f).trans hfg))

name: ofComapInfPrincipal_mem
statement: theorem ofComapInfPrincipal_mem (h : m '' s ∈ g) : s ∈ ofComapInfPrincipal h
proof:
:= by
  let f := Filter.comap m g ⊓ 𝓟 s
  have : f.NeBot := comap_inf_principal_neBot_of_image_mem h
  have : s ∈ f := mem_inf_of_right (mem_principal_self s)
  exact le_def.mp (of_le _) s this

name: ofComapInfPrincipal_eq_of_map
statement: theorem ofComapInfPrincipal_eq_of_map (h : m '' s ∈ g) : (ofComapInfPrincipal h).map m = g
proof:
:= by
  let f := Filter.comap m g ⊓ 𝓟 s
  have : f.NeBot := comap_inf_principal_neBot_of_image_mem h
  apply eq_of_le
  calc
    Filter.map m (of f) ≤ Filter.map m f := map_mono (of_le _)
    _ ≤ (Filter.map m <| Filter.comap m g) ⊓ Filter.map m (𝓟 s) := map_inf_le
    _ = (Filter.map m <| Filter.comap m g) ⊓ (𝓟 <| m '' s) := by rw [map_principal]
    _ ≤ ↑g ⊓ (𝓟 <| m '' s) := inf_le_inf_right _ map_comap_le
    _ = ↑g := inf_of_le_left (le_principal_iff.mpr h)

statement:

theorem intervalGapsWithin_zero_fst : (F.intervalGapsWithin h a b 0).1 = a

name: intervalGapsWithin_succ_fst_of_lt
statement:
theorem intervalGapsWithin_succ_fst_of_lt (hj : j < k) :
    (F.intervalGapsWithin h a b (j.succ)).1 = (F.orderEmbOfFin (α := α ×ₗ α) h ⟨j, hj⟩).2
proof:
:= by
  have : (j.succ : Fin (k + 1)) = (⟨j, hj⟩ : Fin k).succ := by ext; simp [hj]
  grind [intervalGapsWithin, intervalGapsWithin.fst]

name: intervalGapsWithin_fst_of_lt_lt
statement:
theorem intervalGapsWithin_fst_of_lt_lt (hj₁ : 0 < j) (hj₂ : j - 1 < k) :
    (F.intervalGapsWithin h a b j).1 = (F.orderEmbOfFin (α := α ×ₗ α) h ⟨j - 1, hj₂⟩).2
proof:
:= by
  convert! F.intervalGapsWithin_succ_fst_of_lt h a b (j - 1) hj₂
  omega

name: intervalGapsWithin_last_snd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem intervalGapsWithin_last_snd : (F.intervalGapsWithin h a b (last k)).2 = b

name: intervalGapsWithin_snd_of_lt
statement:
theorem intervalGapsWithin_snd_of_lt (hj : j < k) :
    (F.intervalGapsWithin h a b j).2 = (F.orderEmbOfFin (α := α ×ₗ α) h ⟨j, hj⟩).1
proof:
:= by
  have : (j : Fin (k + 1)) ≠ last k := by grind [val_cast_of_lt]
  simp only [intervalGapsWithin, intervalGapsWithin.snd, this, ↓reduceDIte]
  congr
  ext
  simp only [coe_castPred, val_natCast, Nat.mod_succ_eq_iff_lt]
  lia

name: intervalGapsWithin_mapsTo
statement:
theorem intervalGapsWithin_mapsTo : (Set.Iio k).MapsTo
    (fun (j : ℕ) ↦ ((F.intervalGapsWithin h a b j).2, (F.intervalGapsWithin h a b j.succ).1))
    F
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  rw [mem_Iio] at hj
  simp only [intervalGapsWithin_snd_of_lt, intervalGapsWithin_succ_fst_of_lt,
    SetLike.mem_coe, hj]
  convert! F.orderEmbOfFin_mem h ⟨j, hj⟩ using 1

name: intervalGapsWithin_injOn
statement:

proof:
:= by
  intro j hj j' hj' hjj'
  rw [mem_Iio] at hj hj'
  simp only [hj, hj', intervalGapsWithin_snd_of_lt, intervalGapsWithin_succ_fst_of_lt] at hjj'

proof:

  rw [← F.range_orderEmbOfFin h (α := α ×ₗ α)] at hz
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hz
  use j.val, j.prop
  simp [intervalGapsWithin_snd_of_lt, intervalGapsWithin_succ_fst_of_lt, j.prop, hj,

name: intervalGapsWithin_le_fst
statement:
theorem intervalGapsWithin_le_fst {a b : α} (hFab : ∀ ⦃z⦄, z ∈ F → a ≤ z.1 ∧ z.1 ≤ z.2 ∧ z.2 ≤ b) :
    a ≤ (F.intervalGapsWithin h a b j).1
proof:
:= by
  wlog hj : j < k + 1 generalizing j
  · grind [cast_val_eq_self]
  by_cases hj : j = 0
  · simp [hj]
  · have := hFab (F.intervalGapsWithin_mapsTo h a b (x := j - 1) (by grind))
    have hj₀ : j - 1 + 1 = j := by lia
    simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, hj₀] at this
    grind

name: intervalGapsWithin_snd_le
statement:
theorem intervalGapsWithin_snd_le {a b : α} (hFab : ∀ ⦃z⦄, z ∈ F → a ≤ z.1 ∧ z.1 ≤ z.2 ∧ z.2 ≤ b) :
    (F.intervalGapsWithin h a b j).2 ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  wlog hj : j < k + 1 generalizing j
  · grind [cast_val_eq_self]
  by_cases hj : j = k
  · simp [hj]
  · have := hFab (F.intervalGapsWithin_mapsTo h a b (x := j) (by grind))
    grind

name: intervalGapsWithin_fst_le_snd
statement:
theorem intervalGapsWithin_fst_le_snd {a b : α} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hFab : ∀ ⦃z⦄, z ∈ F → a ≤ z.1 ∧ z.1 ≤ z.2 ∧ z.2 ≤ b)
    (hF : (SetLike.coe F).PairwiseDisjoint (fun z ↦ Set.Icc z.1 z.2)) :
    (F.intervalGapsWithin h a b j).1 ≤ (F.intervalGapsWithin h a b j).2
proof:
:= by
  wlog hj : j < k + 1 generalizing j
  · convert! this (j : Fin (k + 1)) (by grind) using 3 <;> grind [cast_val_eq_self]
  by_cases hj₁ : j = 0
  · simp only [hj₁]
    by_cases hk : 0 = k
    · simp only [natCast_zero, intervalGapsWithin_zero_fst]
      simp [show 0 = last k by grind, hab]
    · exact hFab (F.intervalGapsWithin_mapsTo h a b (x := 0) (by grind)) |>.left
  have hk : k - 1 + 1 = k := by omega
  by_cases hj₂ : j = k
  · simp only [hj₂, natCast_eq_last, intervalGapsWithin_last_snd, ge_iff_le]
    convert! hFab (F.intervalGapsWithin_mapsTo h a b (x := j - 1) (by grind)) |>.right.right using 1
    simp [hj₂, hk]
  rw [intervalGapsWithin_fst_of_lt_lt (hj₁ := by omega) (hj₂ := by omega),
      intervalGapsWithin_snd_of_lt (hj := by omega)]
  have hj₃ : (⟨j - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin k) ≠ ⟨j, by omega⟩ := by grind
  set G := F.orderEmbOfFin (α := α ×ₗ α) h
  have := hF (by simp [G, F.orderEmbOfFin_mem (α := α ×ₗ α)])
    (by simp [G, F.orderEmbOfFin_mem (α := α ×ₗ α)]) (G.injective.ne (hj₃))
  contrapose! this
  simp only [Set.not_disjoint_iff, Set.mem_Icc]
  use (G ⟨j, by omega⟩).1
  have hG : (G ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩).1 ≤ (G ⟨j, by omega⟩).1 :=
    Prod.Lex.le_iff'.mp (G.monotone (by simp [le_iff_val_le_val])) |>.left
  have hFabi := hFab (z := G ⟨j, by omega⟩) (by simp [G, F.orderEmbOfFin_mem (α := α ×ₗ α)])
  simp [hFabi, this.le, hG]

name: intervalGapsWithin_pairwiseDisjoint_Ioc
statement:
theorem intervalGapsWithin_pairwiseDisjoint_Ioc {a b : α}
    (hFab : ∀ ⦃z⦄, z ∈ F → a ≤ z.1 ∧ z.1 ≤ z.2 ∧ z.2 ≤ b) :
    (Set.Iio (k + 1)).PairwiseDisjoint (fun (j : ℕ) ↦
      Set.Ioc (F.intervalGapsWithin h a b j).1 (F.intervalGapsWithin h a b j).2)
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj j' hj' hjj'
  rw [mem_Iio] at hj hj'
  wlog hij' : j < j' generalizing j j'
  · exact (this hj' hj hjj'.symm (by omega)).symm
  rw [Function.onFun, Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]
  suffices (F.intervalGapsWithin h a b j).2 ≤ (F.intervalGapsWithin h a b j').1 by grind
  have hj'₀ : j' - 1 + 1 = j' := by omega
  have := hFab (F.intervalGapsWithin_mapsTo h a b (x := j' - 1) (by grind)) |>.right.left
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, hj'₀] at this
  grw [← this]
  rw [intervalGapsWithin_snd_of_lt (hj := by omega),
      intervalGapsWithin_snd_of_lt (hj := by omega)]
  exact Prod.Lex.le_iff'.mp (F.orderEmbOfFin (α := α ×ₗ α) h |>.monotone (by grind)) |>.left

name: LocallyFiniteOrder.denselyOrdered_iff_subsingleton
statement:
lemma LocallyFiniteOrder.denselyOrdered_iff_subsingleton :
    DenselyOrdered X ↔ Subsingleton X
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun H ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ h.instDenselyOrdered⟩
  rw [← not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton, nontrivial_iff_lt]
  rintro ⟨a, b, hab⟩
  exact not_lt_of_denselyOrdered_of_locallyFinite a b hab

name: WithBot.denselyOrdered_set_iff_subsingleton
statement:
@[to_dual]
lemma WithBot.denselyOrdered_set_iff_subsingleton {s : Set (WithBot X)} :
    DenselyOrdered s ↔ s.Subsingleton
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun H ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ h.denselyOrdered⟩
  rw [← Set.subsingleton_coe, ← not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton, nontrivial_iff_lt]
  suffices DenselyOrdered (WithBot.some ⁻¹' s) by
    rintro ⟨x, y, H⟩
    rw [_root_.denselyOrdered_set_iff_subsingleton] at this
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hz'⟩ := exists_between H
    have hz0 : (⊥ : WithBot X) < z := by simp [(Subtype.coe_lt_coe.mpr hz).trans_le']
    replace hz' : WithBot.unbot z.val hz0.ne' < WithBot.unbot y (hz0.trans hz').ne' := by
      rwa [← WithBot.coe_lt_coe, WithBot.coe_unbot, WithBot.coe_unbot]
    refine absurd (this ?_ ?_) hz'.ne <;>
    simp
  constructor
  simp only [Subtype.exists, Set.mem_preimage, Subtype.forall, Subtype.mk_lt_mk, exists_and_right,
    exists_prop]
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  have : (⟨_, hx⟩ : s) < ⟨_, hy⟩ := by simp [hxy]
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hz'⟩ := exists_between this
  simp only [← Subtype.coe_lt_coe] at hz hz'
  refine ⟨WithBot.unbot z (hz.trans_le' (by simp)).ne', ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · simp
  · rw [← WithBot.coe_lt_coe]
    simp [hz.trans_le]
  · rw [← WithBot.coe_lt_coe]
    simp [hz'.trans_le']

name: mod_injOn_Ico
statement: theorem mod_injOn_Ico (n a : ℕ) : Set.InjOn (· % a) (Finset.Ico n (n + a))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    simp only [zero_add, Ico_zero_eq_range]
    rintro k hk l hl (hkl : k % a = l % a)
    simp only [Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_coe] at hk hl
    rwa [mod_eq_of_lt hk, mod_eq_of_lt hl] at hkl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Ico_succ_left_eq_erase_Ico, succ_add, succ_eq_add_one,
      Ico_succ_right_eq_insert_Ico (by lia)]
    rintro k hk l hl (hkl : k % a = l % a)
    have ha : 0 < a := Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.2 <| by rintro rfl; simp at hk
    simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_erase] at hk hl
    rcases hk with ⟨hkn, rfl | hk⟩ <;> rcases hl with ⟨hln, rfl | hl⟩
    · rfl
    · rw [add_mod_right] at hkl
      refine (hln <| ih hl ?_ hkl.symm).elim
      simpa using Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right (n := n) ha
    · rw [add_mod_right] at hkl
      suffices k = n by contradiction
      refine ih hk ?_ hkl
      simpa using Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right (n := n) ha
    · refine ih ?_ ?_ hkl <;> simp only [Finset.mem_coe, hk, hl]

name: image_Ico_mod
statement: theorem image_Ico_mod (n a : ℕ) : (Ico n (n + a)).image (· % a) = range a
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ha := eq_or_ne a 0
  · rw [range_zero, add_zero, Ico_self, image_empty]
  ext i
  simp only [mem_image, mem_range, mem_Ico]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, _, rfl⟩
    exact mod_lt i ha.bot_lt
  intro hia
  have hn := Nat.mod_add_div n a
  obtain hi | hi := lt_or_ge i (n % a)
  · refine ⟨i + a * (n / a + 1), ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [add_comm (n / a), Nat.mul_add, mul_one, ← add_assoc]
      refine hn.symm.le.trans (Nat.add_le_add_right ?_ _)
      simpa only [zero_add] using add_le_add (zero_le i) (Nat.mod_lt n ha.bot_lt).le
    · refine lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.add_lt_add_right hi (a * (n / a + 1))) ?_
      rw [Nat.mul_add, mul_one, ← add_assoc, hn]
    · rw [Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hia]
  · refine ⟨i + a * (n / a), ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · lia
    · lia
    · rw [Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hia]

name: multiset_Ico_map_mod
statement:
theorem multiset_Ico_map_mod (n a : ℕ) :
    (Multiset.Ico n (n + a)).map (· % a) = Multiset.range a
proof:
:= by
  convert! congr_arg Finset.val (image_Ico_mod n a)
  refine ((nodup_map_iff_inj_on (Finset.Ico _ _).nodup).2 <| ?_).dedup.symm
  exact mod_injOn_Ico _ _

name: Nat.strong_decreasing_induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
lemma Nat.strong_decreasing_induction (base : ∃ n, ∀ m > n, P m) (step : ∀ n, (∀ m > n, P m) → P n)
    (n : ℕ) : P n
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.decreasing_induction_of_not_bddAbove (P := fun n ↦ ∀ m ≥ n, P m) _ _ n n le_rfl
  · intro n ih m hm
    rcases hm.eq_or_lt with rfl | hm
    · exact step n ih
    · exact ih m hm
  · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
    rcases base with ⟨n, hn⟩
    specialize @hb (n + b + 1) (fun m hm ↦ hn _ _)
    all_goals lia

name: Nat.cauchy_induction'
statement:
theorem Nat.cauchy_induction' (seed : ℕ) (h : ∀ n, P (n + 1) → P n) (hs : P seed)
    (hi : ∀ x, seed ≤ x → P x → ∃ y, x < y ∧ P y) (n : ℕ) : P n
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.decreasing_induction_of_infinite h fun hf => _
  intro hf
  obtain ⟨m, hP, hm⟩ := hf.exists_maximal ⟨seed, hs⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hl, hy⟩ := hi m (le_of_not_gt <| not_lt_iff_le_imp_ge.2 <| hm hs) hP
  exact hl.not_ge (hm hy hl.le)

name: Nat.cauchy_induction
statement:
theorem Nat.cauchy_induction (h : ∀ n, P (n + 1) → P n) (seed : ℕ) (hs : P seed) (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hf : ∀ x, seed ≤ x → P x → x < f x ∧ P (f x)) (n : ℕ) : P n
proof:
:=
  seed.cauchy_induction' h hs (fun x hl hx => ⟨f x, hf x hl hx⟩) n

name: Nat.cauchy_induction_mul
statement:
theorem Nat.cauchy_induction_mul (h : ∀ (n : ℕ), P (n + 1) → P n) (k seed : ℕ) (hk : 1 < k)
    (hs : P seed.succ) (hm : ∀ x, seed < x → P x → P (k * x)) (n : ℕ) : P n
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.cauchy_induction h _ hs (k * ·) fun x hl hP => ⟨_, hm x hl hP⟩
  intro _ hl _
  convert! (Nat.mul_lt_mul_right <| seed.succ_pos.trans_le hl).2 hk
  rw [one_mul]

name: Nat.cauchy_induction_two_mul
statement:
theorem Nat.cauchy_induction_two_mul (h : ∀ n, P (n + 1) → P n) (seed : ℕ) (hs : P seed.succ)
    (hm : ∀ x, seed < x → P x → P (2 * x)) (n : ℕ) : P n
proof:
:=
  Nat.cauchy_induction_mul h 2 seed Nat.one_lt_two hs hm n

name: Nat.pow_imp_self_of_one_lt
statement:
theorem Nat.pow_imp_self_of_one_lt {M} [Monoid M] (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 < k)
    (P : M → Prop) (hmul : ∀ x y, P x → P (x * y) ∨ P (y * x))
    (hpow : ∀ x, P (x ^ k) → P x) : ∀ n x, P (x ^ n) → P x
proof:
:=
  k.cauchy_induction_mul (fun n ih x hx ↦ ih x <| (hmul _ x hx).elim
    (fun h ↦ by rwa [_root_.pow_succ]) fun h ↦ by rwa [_root_.pow_succ']) 0 hk
    (fun x hx ↦ pow_one x ▸ hx) fun n _ hn x hx ↦ hpow x <| hn _ <| (pow_mul x k n).subst hx

name: _root_.not_lt_of_denselyOrdered_of_locallyFinite
statement:
lemma _root_.not_lt_of_denselyOrdered_of_locallyFinite [DenselyOrdered α] (a b : α) :
    ¬ a < b
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  induction hs : Finset.Icc a b using Finset.strongInduction generalizing b with | H i ih
  subst hs
  obtain ⟨c, hac, hcb⟩ := exists_between h
  refine ih _ ?_ c hac rfl
  exact Finset.Icc_ssubset_Icc_right (hac.trans hcb).le le_rfl hcb

name: transGen_wcovBy_of_le
statement:
lemma transGen_wcovBy_of_le [Preorder α] [LocallyFiniteOrder α] {x y : α} (hxy : x ≤ y) :
    TransGen (· ⩿ ·) x y
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have : #(Ico x y) < #(Icc x y) := card_lt_card <|
    ⟨Ico_subset_Icc_self, not_subset.mpr ⟨y, ⟨right_mem_Icc.mpr hxy, right_notMem_Ico⟩⟩⟩
  by_cases hxy' : y ≤ x
  
  · exact .single <| wcovBy_of_le_of_le hxy hxy'
  /- and if `¬ y ≤ x`, then `x < y`, not because it is a linear order, but because `x ≤ y`
  already. In that case, since `z` is maximal in `Ico x y`, then `z ⩿ y` and we can use the
  induction hypothesis to show that `Relation.TransGen (· ⩿ ·) x z`. -/
  · obtain ⟨z, hxz, hz⟩ :=
      (Set.finite_Ico x y).exists_le_maximal <| Set.left_mem_Ico.2 <| hxy.lt_of_not_ge hxy'
    have z_card := calc
      #(Icc x z) ≤ #(Ico x y) := card_le_card <| Icc_subset_Ico_right hz.1.2
      _          < #(Icc x y) := this
    have h₁ := transGen_wcovBy_of_le hz.1.1
    have h₂ : z ⩿ y :=
      ⟨hz.1.2.le, fun c hzc hcy ↦ hzc.not_ge <| hz.2 ⟨hz.1.1.trans hzc.le, hcy⟩ hzc.le⟩
    exact .tail h₁ h₂

name: le_iff_transGen_wcovBy
statement:
lemma le_iff_transGen_wcovBy [Preorder α] [LocallyFiniteOrder α] {x y : α} :
    x ≤ y ↔ TransGen (· ⩿ ·) x y
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨transGen_wcovBy_of_le, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  induction h with
  | single h => exact h.le
  | tail _ h₁ h₂ => exact h₂.trans h₁.le

name: le_iff_reflTransGen_covBy
statement:
lemma le_iff_reflTransGen_covBy [PartialOrder α] [LocallyFiniteOrder α] {x y : α} :
    x ≤ y ↔ ReflTransGen (· ⋖ ·) x y

name: transGen_covBy_of_lt
statement:
lemma transGen_covBy_of_lt [Preorder α] [LocallyFiniteOrder α] {x y : α} (hxy : x < y) :
    TransGen (· ⋖ ·) x y
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨z, hxz, hz⟩ := (Set.finite_Ico x y).exists_le_maximal <| Set.left_mem_Ico.2 hxy
  have z_card : #(Ico x z) < #(Ico x y) := card_lt_card <| ssubset_iff_of_subset
    (Ico_subset_Ico_right hz.1.2.le) |>.mpr ⟨z, mem_Ico.2 hz.1, right_notMem_Ico⟩
  /- Since `z` is maximal in `Ico x y`, `z ⋖ y`. -/
  have hzy : z ⋖ y :=
    ⟨hz.1.2, fun c hc hcy ↦ hc.not_ge <| hz.2 (⟨(hz.1.1.trans_lt hc).le, hcy⟩) hc.le⟩
  by_cases hxz : x < z
  /- when `x < z`, then we may use the induction hypothesis to get a chain
  `Relation.TransGen (· ⋖ ·) x z`, which we can extend with `Relation.TransGen.tail`. -/
  · exact .tail (transGen_covBy_of_lt hxz) hzy
  /- when `¬ x < z`, then actually `z ≤ x` (not because it's a linear order, but because
  `x ≤ z`), and since `z ⋖ y` we conclude that `x ⋖ y`, then `Relation.TransGen.single`. -/
  · simp only [lt_iff_le_not_ge, not_and, not_not] at hxz
    exact .single (hzy.of_le_of_lt (hxz hz.1.1) hxy)

name: lt_iff_transGen_covBy
statement:
lemma lt_iff_transGen_covBy [Preorder α] [LocallyFiniteOrder α] {x y : α} :
    x < y ↔ TransGen (· ⋖ ·) x y
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨transGen_covBy_of_lt, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  induction h with
  | single hx => exact hx.1
  | tail _ hb ih => exact ih.trans hb.1

name: monotone_iff_forall_wcovBy
statement:
lemma monotone_iff_forall_wcovBy [Preorder α] [LocallyFiniteOrder α] [Preorder β]
    (f : α → β) : Monotone f ↔ ∀ a b : α, a ⩿ b → f a ≤ f b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hf _ _ h ↦ hf h.le, fun h a b hab ↦ ?_⟩
  simpa [transGen_eq_self] using TransGen.lift f h a b <| le_iff_transGen_wcovBy.mp hab

name: monotone_iff_forall_covBy
statement:
lemma monotone_iff_forall_covBy [PartialOrder α] [LocallyFiniteOrder α] [Preorder β]
    (f : α → β) : Monotone f ↔ ∀ a b : α, a ⋖ b → f a ≤ f b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hf _ _ h ↦ hf h.le, fun h a b hab ↦ ?_⟩
  simpa [reflTransGen_eq_self] using ReflTransGen.lift f h a b <| le_iff_reflTransGen_covBy.mp hab

name: strictMono_iff_forall_covBy
statement:
lemma strictMono_iff_forall_covBy [Preorder α] [LocallyFiniteOrder α] [Preorder β]
    (f : α → β) : StrictMono f ↔ ∀ a b : α, a ⋖ b → f a < f b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hf _ _ h ↦ hf h.lt, fun h a b hab ↦ ?_⟩
  have := Relation.TransGen.lift f h a b
  rw [← lt_iff_transGen_covBy, transGen_eq_self] at this
  exact this hab

name: exists_min_greater
statement:
lemma exists_min_greater [LinearOrder α] [LocallyFiniteOrder α] {x ub : α} (hx : x < ub) :
    ∃ lub, x < lub ∧ ∀ y, x < y → lub ≤ y
proof:
:= by
  
  have h : (Finset.Ioc x ub).Nonempty := ⟨ub, Finset.mem_Ioc.2 ⟨hx, le_rfl⟩⟩
  use Finset.min' (Finset.Ioc x ub) h
  constructor
  · exact (Finset.mem_Ioc.mp <| Finset.min'_mem _ h).1
  rintro y hxy
  obtain hy | hy := le_total y ub
  · refine Finset.min'_le (Ioc x ub) y ?_
    simp [*] at *
  · exact (Finset.min'_le _ _ (Finset.mem_Ioc.2 ⟨hx, le_rfl⟩)).trans hy

theorem Set.finite_iff_bddAbove [SemilatticeSup α] [LocallyFiniteOrder α] [OrderBot α] :
    s.Finite ↔ BddAbove s
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.toFinset.sup id, fun _ hx ↦ Finset.le_sup (f := id) ((Finite.mem_toFinset h).mpr hx)⟩,
    fun ⟨m, hm⟩ ↦ (Set.finite_Icc ⊥ m).subset (fun _ hx ↦ ⟨bot_le, hm hx⟩)⟩

name: Set.finite_iff_bddBelow_bddAbove
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem Set.finite_iff_bddBelow_bddAbove [Nonempty α] [Lattice α] [LocallyFiniteOrder α] :
    s.Finite ↔ BddBelow s ∧ BddAbove s
proof:
:= by
  obtain (rfl | hs) := s.eq_empty_or_nonempty
  · simp only [Set.finite_empty, bddBelow_empty, bddAbove_empty, and_self]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨⟨h.toFinset.inf' ((Finite.toFinset_nonempty h).mpr hs) id,
    fun x hx ↦ Finset.inf'_le id ((Finite.mem_toFinset h).mpr hx)⟩,
    ⟨h.toFinset.sup' ((Finite.toFinset_nonempty h).mpr hs) id, fun x hx ↦ Finset.le_sup' id
    ((Finite.mem_toFinset h).mpr hx)⟩⟩,
    fun ⟨h₀, h₁⟩ ↦ BddBelow.finite_of_bddAbove h₀ h₁⟩

    #(box (n + 1) : Finset (α × β)) =
      #(Icc (-n.succ : α) n.succ) * #(Icc (-n.succ : β) n.succ) -
        #(Icc (-n : α) n) * #(Icc (-n : β) n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [box_succ_eq_sdiff, card_sdiff_of_subset (Icc_neg_mono n.le_succ), Finset.card_Icc_prod,
    Finset.card_Icc_prod]
  simp_rw [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, neg_add_rev, fst_add, fst_neg,
    fst_one, fst_natCast, snd_add, snd_neg, snd_one, snd_natCast]

  | n + 1, _ => by

    norm_cast
    refine tsub_eq_of_eq_add ?_
    zify
    ring

name: isSuccLimit_coe
proof:
:=
  ⟨Set.not_isMin_coe _ hm.1, fun b ↦ by
    simp only [CovBy, not_lt, not_and, not_forall, not_le]
    intro hb
    by_cases hb' : j ≤ b
    · have := hm.2 ⟨b, hb'⟩
      rw [not_covBy_iff (by exact hb)] at this
      obtain ⟨⟨x, h₁⟩, h₂, h₃⟩ := this
      refine ⟨x, h₂, h₃⟩
    · simp only [not_le] at hb'
      refine ⟨j, hb', ?_⟩
      by_contra!
      apply hm.1
      rintro ⟨k, hk⟩ _
      exact this.trans (by simpa using hk)⟩

lemma monotone_or_antitone_iff_uIcc :
    Monotone f ∨ Antitone f ↔ ∀ a b c, c ∈ [[a, b]] → f c ∈ [[f a, f b]]
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro (hf | hf) a b c <;> simp_rw [← Icc_min_max, ← hf.map_min, ← hf.map_max]
    exacts [fun hc => ⟨hf hc.1, hf hc.2⟩, fun hc => ⟨hf hc.2, hf hc.1⟩]
  contrapose!
  rw [not_monotone_not_antitone_iff_exists_le_le]
  rintro ⟨a, b, c, hab, hbc, ⟨hfab, hfcb⟩ | ⟨hfba, hfbc⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨a, c, b, Icc_subset_uIcc ⟨hab, hbc⟩, fun h => h.2.not_gt <| max_lt hfab hfcb⟩
  · exact ⟨a, c, b, Icc_subset_uIcc ⟨hab, hbc⟩, fun h => h.1.not_gt <| lt_min hfba hfbc⟩

  rintro b c h
  rw [Set.ext_iff] at h
  obtain ha | ha := le_or_gt b a
  · have hb := (h b).not
    simp only [ha, left_mem_uIoc, true_iff, notMem_uIoc, ← not_le,
      and_true, not_true, false_and, not_false_iff, or_false] at hb
    refine hb.eq_of_not_lt fun hc => ?_
    simpa [ha, and_iff_right hc, ← @not_le _ _ _ a, iff_not_self, -not_le] using h c
  · refine
      eq_of_mem_uIoc_of_mem_uIoc ((h _).1 <| left_mem_uIoc.2 ha)
        ((h _).2 <| left_mem_uIoc.2 <| ha.trans_le ?_)
    simpa [ha, ha.not_ge, mem_uIoc] using h b

name: uIoc_injective_left
statement: lemma uIoc_injective_left (a : α) : Injective (Ι a)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [uIoc_comm] using uIoc_injective_right a

name: uIoc_union_uIoc
statement: lemma uIoc_union_uIoc (h : b ∈ [[a, c]]) : Ι a b ∪ Ι b c = Ι a c
proof:
:= by
  wlog hac : a ≤ c generalizing a c
  · rw [uIoc_comm, union_comm, uIoc_comm, this _ (le_of_not_ge hac), uIoc_comm]
    rwa [uIcc_comm]
  rw [uIcc_of_le hac] at h
  rw [uIoc_of_le h.1, uIoc_of_le h.2, uIoc_of_le hac, Ioc_union_Ioc_eq_Ioc h.1 h.2]

name: range_natAdd
statement: theorem range_natAdd (m n : ℕ) : range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = {i | m ≤ i.1}
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    apply le_coe_natAdd
  · refine fun (hi : m ≤ i) ↦ ⟨⟨i - m, by lia⟩, ?_⟩
    ext
    simp [hi]

statement:
theorem range_natAdd_eq_Ioi (m n : ℕ) [NeZero m] :
    range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = Ioi (castAdd n ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨_, _⟩
  simp [range_natAdd, lt_def, ← Nat.succ_le_iff, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne m)]

statement:
lemma Iic.coe_succ_of_not_isMax

    (Order.succ i).1 = Order.succ i.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_succ_of_mem]
  apply Order.succ_le_of_lt
  exact lt_of_le_of_ne (α := Set.Iic j) le_top (by simpa using hi)

    Order.succ i = ⟨Order.succ i.1, by
      rw [← coe_succ_of_not_isMax hi]
      apply Subtype.coe_prop⟩

proof:
